subtopics.label: Coronary Artery Disease and Revascularization
subtopics.description: Research on coronary artery disease management including percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), fractional flow reserve, graft patency, multivessel disease strategies, and outcomes of coronary revascularization procedures. Includes comparisons of surgical versus percutaneous approaches, conduit selection, and perioperative outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: PCI, CABG, and multivessel disease strategies with comparisons of surgical versus percutaneous revascularization outcomes.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Surgery Outcomes and Techniques
subtopics.description: Clinical research on outcomes of cardiac surgical procedures including aortic valve replacement, mitral valve repair/replacement, aortic root and arch surgery, thoracoabdominal aortic aneurysm repair, and perioperative management. Encompasses surgical technique comparisons, sex and racial disparities in surgical outcomes, and postoperative complications.
subtopics.short_description: Outcomes of valve repair, aortic surgery, and perioperative management, including sex and racial disparities in surgical results.

subtopics.label: Valvular Heart Disease and Transcatheter Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on valvular heart disease including transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR), surgical aortic valve replacement, mitral valve interventions, tricuspid valve disease, and structural heart procedures. Covers device outcomes, imaging guidance, antithrombotic management post-TAVR, and comparisons between transcatheter and surgical approaches.
subtopics.short_description: TAVR, surgical valve replacement, and structural heart procedures with device outcomes and antithrombotic management.

subtopics.label: Arrhythmias and Cardiac Electrophysiology
subtopics.description: Research on cardiac arrhythmias including atrial fibrillation, ventricular arrhythmias, supraventricular tachycardia, and conduction disorders. Encompasses catheter ablation, cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs), leadless pacemakers, ICD programming, antiarrhythmic pharmacotherapy, and electrophysiology procedural outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Catheter ablation, implantable devices, and pharmacotherapy for atrial fibrillation, ventricular arrhythmias, and conduction disorders.

subtopics.label: Heart Failure Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical and health services research on heart failure including pharmacological management, guideline-directed medical therapy, hospital readmissions, mechanical circulatory support, left ventricular assist devices, cardiogenic shock, and heart failure with preserved versus reduced ejection fraction. Includes studies on polypharmacy, medication adherence, and transitions of care.
subtopics.short_description: Guideline-directed therapy, mechanical circulatory support, and readmission reduction across HFpEF and HFrEF populations.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Imaging and Diagnostic Technologies
subtopics.description: Research on cardiac imaging modalities including echocardiography, cardiac MRI, cardiac CT, transesophageal echocardiography, nuclear imaging, and quantitative susceptibility mapping. Covers applications in structural heart disease assessment, strain analysis, right and left ventricular function quantification, and intraoperative guidance.
subtopics.short_description: Echocardiography, cardiac MRI, CT, and nuclear imaging for structural assessment, ventricular function, and intraoperative guidance.

subtopics.label: Stroke and Cerebrovascular Disease
subtopics.description: Clinical research on ischemic stroke, hemorrhagic stroke, transient ischemic attack, and cerebrovascular conditions including stroke mechanisms, risk factors, antiplatelet and anticoagulation therapy, atrial fibrillation-related stroke, cryptogenic stroke, and stroke outcomes. Encompasses epidemiology, disparities, and secondary prevention strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke mechanisms, anticoagulation strategies, AF-related stroke, and secondary prevention disparities.

subtopics.label: Hypertension Epidemiology and Management
subtopics.description: Research on hypertension including blood pressure control, antihypertensive therapy, hypertensive urgency and emergency, community-based interventions, and hypertension in special populations such as pregnancy, HIV, and low-income countries. Covers global hypertension epidemiology, social determinants, and novel therapeutic approaches including renal denervation.
subtopics.short_description: Blood pressure control, antihypertensive therapy, and community-based interventions across diverse and high-risk populations.

subtopics.label: Pulmonary Embolism and Venous Thromboembolism
subtopics.description: Research on pulmonary embolism and venous thromboembolism including catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, anticoagulation strategies, risk stratification, and outcomes. Covers epidemiology of PE, clot-in-transit, chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension, and management of intermediate and high-risk PE.
subtopics.short_description: Anticoagulation, catheter-directed thrombolysis, and risk stratification for PE and chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension.

subtopics.label: Aortic and Peripheral Vascular Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on aortic aneurysm repair (open and endovascular), aortic dissection management, thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR), peripheral arterial disease revascularization, and vascular surgery outcomes. Includes sex disparities in vascular outcomes, device surveillance, and limb ischemia management.
subtopics.short_description: Open and endovascular aortic repair, aortic dissection, peripheral arterial revascularization, and vascular surgery outcomes.

subtopics.label: Heart Failure Home Care and Patient-Centered Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on home health care for heart failure patients including home health aide training, transitions of care, patient self-care, shared decision-making, and social determinants of health affecting heart failure outcomes. Covers readmission prevention, medication management, and community-based care models.
subtopics.short_description: Transitions of care, patient self-management, shared decision-making, and community-based models to reduce heart failure readmissions.

subtopics.label: Social Determinants of Health and Cardiovascular Disparities
subtopics.description: Research examining social determinants of health, racial and ethnic disparities, and socioeconomic factors in cardiovascular disease outcomes including heart failure, coronary heart disease, stroke, and hypertension. Covers healthcare fragmentation, access to care, and community-based interventions to reduce cardiovascular health disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in cardiovascular outcomes, healthcare access, and community-based equity interventions.

subtopics.label: Basic Cardiovascular Biology and Cardiac Regeneration
subtopics.description: Fundamental research on cardiac biology including cardiomyocyte regeneration, cardiac development, zebrafish heart models, iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes, endothelial biology, sphingolipid signaling, and molecular mechanisms of cardiac disease. Encompasses epigenetics, transcription factors, mitochondrial function, and vascular biology.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiomyocyte regeneration, iPSC models, endothelial biology, and molecular mechanisms of cardiac development and disease.

subtopics.label: Cardio-Oncology and Cancer-Related Cardiovascular Disease
subtopics.description: Research on cardiovascular complications of cancer and cancer therapy including chemotherapy-induced cardiotoxicity, cancer-associated thromboembolism, cardiac tumors, radiation-induced cardiovascular disease, and cardiovascular management in cancer patients. Covers immune checkpoint inhibitor myocarditis, doxorubicin cardiotoxicity, and cancer-related stroke.
subtopics.short_description: Chemotherapy cardiotoxicity, checkpoint inhibitor myocarditis, radiation-induced cardiovascular disease, and cancer-associated thromboembolism.

subtopics.label: Takotsubo Syndrome: Epidemiology, Outcomes, and Management
subtopics.description: Research on Takotsubo (stress) cardiomyopathy covering clinical characteristics, ECG and imaging features, comparison with STEMI, recurrence, beta-blocker therapy, and short- and long-term outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical features, imaging, recurrence risk, and short- and long-term outcomes of stress-induced Takotsubo cardiomyopathy.

subtopics.label: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: Techniques, Grafts, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining CABG surgical techniques including arterial and venous grafting strategies, graft patency, operative outcomes by sex and comorbidity, and quality-of-life measures after bypass surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Arterial and venous grafting strategies, graft patency, operative outcomes by sex and comorbidity, and post-bypass quality of life.

subtopics.label: STEMI Management, Primary PCI, and Myocardial Infarction Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on ST-elevation myocardial infarction management including primary PCI timing, infarct size, microvascular obstruction, supersaturated oxygen therapy, antiplatelet strategies, and temporal trends in MI outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Primary PCI timing, infarct size, microvascular obstruction, antiplatelet strategies, and temporal trends in myocardial infarction outcomes.

subtopics.label: Heart Transplantation Outcomes and Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on heart transplantation covering graft dysfunction, allograft vasculopathy, rejection, donor factors, recipient characteristics, post-transplant weight gain, and long-term survival outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Graft dysfunction, allograft vasculopathy, rejection, donor and recipient factors, and long-term survival after heart transplantation.

subtopics.label: HIV and Cardiovascular Disease Risk and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining cardiovascular complications in people living with HIV, including hypertension, diastolic dysfunction, arterial stiffness, lipid abnormalities, autonomic dysfunction, and the impact of antiretroviral therapy on cardiovascular risk.
subtopics.short_description: Hypertension, arterial stiffness, diastolic dysfunction, and antiretroviral therapy effects on cardiovascular risk in people living with HIV.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 and Cardiovascular Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on cardiovascular manifestations of COVID-19 including myocardial injury, troponin elevation, arrhythmias, thrombotic events, right ventricular dysfunction, myocarditis, and outcomes in hospitalized patients.
subtopics.short_description: Myocardial injury, arrhythmias, thrombotic events, myocarditis, and right ventricular dysfunction in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

subtopics.label: Long COVID and Post-Acute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2
subtopics.description: Research characterizing post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC/Long COVID), including risk factor identification, subphenotyping, environmental determinants, and burden of respiratory and cardiovascular conditions using EHR-based cohort studies.
subtopics.short_description: Risk factors, subphenotypes, and cardiovascular and respiratory burden of PASC using large EHR-based cohort studies.

subtopics.label: Chronic Kidney Disease and Cardiorenal Interactions
subtopics.description: Studies on the intersection of chronic kidney disease and cardiovascular disease, including iron status, FGF23, serotonin, klotho, pulmonary hypertension screening, cardiac biomarkers, and outcomes in CKD patients.
subtopics.short_description: FGF23, klotho, iron status, and cardiac biomarkers linking chronic kidney disease to cardiovascular outcomes and pulmonary hypertension.

subtopics.label: Diabetes, Metabolic Syndrome, and Cardiovascular Risk
subtopics.description: Research on the cardiovascular implications of diabetes and metabolic syndrome, including glycemic control, prediabetes subclassification, autonomic neuropathy, lipid dysregulation, obesity, and risk factor management in diabetic patients.
subtopics.short_description: Glycemic control, autonomic neuropathy, lipid dysregulation, and obesity as cardiovascular risk factors in diabetic patients.

subtopics.label: Stroke Risk Factors, Secondary Prevention, and Smoking Cessation
subtopics.description: Studies on modifiable risk factors for stroke including smoking cessation interventions, antiplatelet therapy, anticoagulation, and secondary prevention strategies after ischemic stroke and TIA.
subtopics.short_description: Smoking cessation, antiplatelet therapy, anticoagulation, and secondary prevention strategies after ischemic stroke and TIA.

subtopics.label: Hypothalamic Neurobiology and Neurogenic Hypertension
subtopics.description: Basic science research on the role of hypothalamic paraventricular nucleus signaling, including angiotensin II, TNF-alpha, estrogen receptors, and NMDA/AMPA glutamate receptors in the neurogenic regulation of blood pressure.
subtopics.short_description: Paraventricular nucleus signaling via angiotensin II, TNF-alpha, and glutamate receptors in the neurogenic regulation of blood pressure.

subtopics.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis and Cardiovascular Disease
subtopics.description: Research on cardiovascular risk in patients with rheumatoid arthritis and inflammatory arthritis, including hyperlipidemia screening, CVD risk prediction, dementia risk, and behavioral interventions to reduce cardiovascular risk.
subtopics.short_description: CVD risk prediction, hyperlipidemia screening, and behavioral interventions for cardiovascular risk reduction in inflammatory arthritis.

subtopics.label: Sex and Gender Disparities in Cardiovascular Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining sex-based differences in cardiovascular disease presentation, treatment, and outcomes including STEMI revascularization, cardiac surgery, cardiogenic shock, cardiac arrest readmission, and patient-physician concordance.
subtopics.display_name: Sex & Gender Disparities in Cardiovascular Care
subtopics.short_description: Sex-based differences in cardiovascular presentation, treatment access, and outcomes across STEMI, cardiac surgery, and cardiogenic shock.

subtopics.label: Mitochondrial Biology, Ischemia-Reperfusion, and Cardioprotection
subtopics.description: Basic and translational research on mitochondrial function in cardiac ischemia-reperfusion injury, including reactive oxygen species production, ischemic preconditioning, complex I biology, and metabolic remodeling in cardiomyopathy models.
subtopics.short_description: Mitochondrial ROS, ischemic preconditioning, complex I biology, and metabolic remodeling in cardiac ischemia-reperfusion injury.

subtopics.label: Stroke and Cerebrovascular Disease
subtopics.description: Research on ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke including mechanisms, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment (thrombolysis, thrombectomy, anticoagulation), outcomes, disparities, and secondary prevention. Covers atrial fibrillation, cervical artery dissection, subarachnoid hemorrhage, cerebral amyloid angiopathy, and cerebrovascular imaging biomarkers.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanisms, treatment, outcomes, and prevention of ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke and cerebrovascular conditions.

subtopics.label: Epilepsy and Seizure Disorders
subtopics.description: Research on epilepsy diagnosis, seizure mechanisms, treatment (antiseizure medications, vagal nerve stimulation, surgery), EEG monitoring, infantile spasms, status epilepticus, and epilepsy care systems. Includes pediatric epilepsy, rare epilepsies, glucose transporter deficiency, and seizure detection technologies.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, seizure mechanisms, pharmacological and surgical treatment, and monitoring of epilepsy across the lifespan.

subtopics.label: Brain Injury and Neurorehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on traumatic brain injury (TBI), acquired brain injury, disorders of consciousness, and neurorehabilitation including cognitive recovery, functional outcomes, assistive technology, and neuromodulation for recovery. Covers pediatric TBI, cognitive-motor dissociation, deep brain stimulation for TBI, and rehabilitation interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Traumatic and acquired brain injury, disorders of consciousness, and cognitive-functional recovery through rehabilitation.

subtopics.label: Neuroimaging Methods and Brain MRI
subtopics.description: Research on advanced neuroimaging techniques including quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM), oxygen extraction fraction mapping, arterial spin labeling, fMRI methods, diffusion imaging, and brain PET. Covers technical development, validation, and clinical application of MRI-based biomarkers for neurological and psychiatric conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Quantitative MRI, fMRI, diffusion, and PET techniques for biomarker development and clinical neurological applications.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy and Peripheral Neuropathy
subtopics.description: Research using corneal confocal microscopy (CCM) as a non-invasive biomarker for peripheral neuropathy, neurodegeneration, and systemic diseases including diabetic neuropathy, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, and stroke. Covers corneal nerve fiber loss quantification, Langerhans cells, and CCM as a surrogate marker for central and peripheral nervous system pathology.
subtopics.short_description: Non-invasive corneal nerve imaging as a biomarker for peripheral neuropathy and systemic neurological disease.

subtopics.label: Multiple Sclerosis: Imaging, Biomarkers, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on multiple sclerosis including MRI-based lesion characterization (paramagnetic rim lesions, QSM), functional and structural connectivity, corneal nerve biomarkers, disease-modifying therapies (natalizumab), and clinical outcomes. Covers demyelination mechanisms, white matter pathology, and treatment effectiveness across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: MRI lesion characterization, corneal biomarkers, disease-modifying therapies, and clinical outcomes in multiple sclerosis.

subtopics.label: Synaptic Biology and Ion Channel Physiology
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of synaptic transmission, vesicle release, and ion channel function including SNARE proteins, Munc13/Munc18, complexin, alpha-synuclein, metabotropic glutamate receptors, potassium channels (BK, K2P, HCN), sodium channels, and glutamate transporters. Covers structural biology, electrophysiology, and pharmacology of synaptic and membrane proteins.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of synaptic transmission, vesicle release, and ion channel structure, function, and pharmacology.

subtopics.label: Neuroinflammation, Microglia, and Neuroimmunology
subtopics.description: Research on neuroinflammation mechanisms including microglial function, tau-driven neuroinflammation, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, neuroimmune interactions, and inflammatory pathways in neurological diseases. Covers microglial NF-κB signaling, cGAS-IFN pathways, CD36, border-associated macrophages, and immune cell trafficking in stroke and neurodegeneration.
subtopics.short_description: Microglial signaling, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, and neuroimmune interactions in stroke and neurological disease.

subtopics.label: Headache Disorders and Pain Neuroscience
subtopics.description: Research on headache disorders including migraine, occipital neuralgia, nerve compression headaches, and surgical treatment (nerve decompression). Covers CGRP-targeted therapies, onabotulinumtoxinA, headache surgery outcomes, trigger-site deactivation, and neuropathic pain mechanisms and treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Migraine, neuropathic pain, CGRP-targeted therapies, and surgical nerve decompression for headache disorders.

subtopics.label: Neural Circuits, Cognition, and Memory
subtopics.description: Research on neural circuit mechanisms underlying cognition, memory, learning, and behavior including hippocampal function, prefrontal cortex circuits, synaptic plasticity, and neuromodulation. Covers mnemonic prediction errors, fear learning, social behavior circuits, reward pathways, and the neural basis of cognitive processes.
subtopics.short_description: Circuit mechanisms underlying memory, learning, fear, reward, and social behavior in hippocampal and prefrontal systems.

subtopics.label: Neurodevelopment, Neurogenetics, and Single-Cell Genomics
subtopics.description: Research on brain development, neurogenetics, and single-cell genomic approaches including RNA splicing, isoform analysis, epigenomics, and transcriptomics in brain cell types. Covers neural stem cells, cortical development, interneuron differentiation, and genetic/epigenetic regulation of brain function and disease.
subtopics.short_description: Brain development, neurogenetics, and single-cell transcriptomic and epigenomic regulation of neural cell types.

subtopics.label: Neurovascular Unit and Blood-Brain Barrier
subtopics.description: Research on blood-brain barrier structure and function, neurovascular coupling, glymphatic system, and cerebrovascular biology. Covers BBB permeability measurement, focused ultrasound BBB opening, pericyte biology, endothelial dysfunction, and neurovascular mechanisms in Alzheimer's disease, stroke, and other neurological conditions.
subtopics.short_description: BBB permeability, neurovascular coupling, glymphatic function, and pericyte biology in neurological conditions.

subtopics.label: Movement Disorders and Neuromodulation
subtopics.description: Research on Parkinson's disease, movement disorders, and neuromodulation including deep brain stimulation (DBS), spinal cord stimulation, transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS), and focused ultrasound. Covers DBS programming, patient attitudes toward DBS, motor circuit mechanisms, and wearable technology for movement disorder monitoring.
subtopics.short_description: Deep brain stimulation, TMS, focused ultrasound, and wearable monitoring for Parkinson's and movement disorders.

subtopics.label: Alzheimer's Disease Biomarkers and Neuroimaging
subtopics.description: Research on Alzheimer's disease biomarkers including amyloid-beta, tau PET, CSF markers, glymphatic clearance, and neuroimaging measures of disease progression. Covers tau-amyloid interactions, blood-brain barrier dysfunction in AD, sleep and tau deposition, choroid plexus, and multimodal imaging approaches for early detection and staging.
subtopics.short_description: Amyloid, tau PET, CSF markers, and multimodal imaging for early detection and staging of Alzheimer's disease.

subtopics.label: Spinal Cord Injury and Spine Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on traumatic spinal cord injury, degenerative spine disease, and spine surgery outcomes including cervical myelopathy, lumbar disc disease, and spinal cord tumors. Covers surgical techniques, neurological outcomes, global health perspectives on spinal trauma, and complications of spine surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Traumatic spinal cord injury, degenerative spine disease, surgical outcomes, and global perspectives on spinal trauma.

subtopics.label: Late-Life Depression, Mood Disorders, and Psychiatric Neuroscience
subtopics.description: Research on the neurobiology, neuroimaging correlates, and treatment of late-life depression, bipolar disorder, PTSD, and related mood disorders, including psychotherapy outcomes and brain circuit dysfunction.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiology, neuroimaging, and treatment of late-life depression, bipolar disorder, PTSD, and related mood disorders.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Neurological Complications and Long COVID
subtopics.description: Studies examining neurological manifestations of COVID-19 infection, including brain imaging findings, cognitive sequelae, long COVID symptoms, post-acute sequelae (PASC), and rehabilitation of neuropsychiatric complications.
subtopics.short_description: Brain imaging findings, cognitive sequelae, and neuropsychiatric rehabilitation in acute and post-acute COVID-19.

subtopics.label: Skull Base Surgery and Cranial Approaches
subtopics.description: Research on surgical approaches to the skull base, cavernous sinus, craniovertebral junction, and parasellar regions, including endoscopic, transpetrosal, frontotemporal, and far lateral techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Endoscopic and open surgical approaches to the skull base, cavernous sinus, and craniovertebral junction.

subtopics.label: Meningioma: PET/MRI Imaging and Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies using DOTATATE PET/MRI for meningioma diagnosis, grading, radiosurgery planning, and response assessment, as well as novel medical therapies for meningiomas.
subtopics.short_description: DOTATATE PET/MRI for meningioma diagnosis, radiosurgery planning, response assessment, and novel medical therapies.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Brain Tumors and CNS Gliomas
subtopics.description: Research on pediatric brain tumors including DIPG, high-grade gliomas, ATRT, and leptomeningeal disease, encompassing convection-enhanced delivery, intraarterial drug delivery, and molecular classification.
subtopics.short_description: DIPG, high-grade gliomas, and pediatric CNS tumors including convection-enhanced and intraarterial drug delivery.

subtopics.label: CNS Gene Therapy and AAV Vector Delivery
subtopics.description: Studies on adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated gene therapy for neurological diseases including CLN2 Batten disease, metachromatic leukodystrophy, and SMA, including biodistribution, safety, and efficacy outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: CNS Gene Therapy & AAV Vector Delivery
subtopics.short_description: AAV-mediated gene therapy for Batten disease, leukodystrophy, and SMA, including safety and biodistribution outcomes.

subtopics.label: Delirium in Pediatric and Critical Care Settings
subtopics.description: Research on the prevalence, risk factors, biomarkers, and outcomes of delirium in pediatric ICU, NICU, and hematopoietic cell transplant settings, including pharmacological prevention strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, biomarkers, risk factors, and pharmacological prevention of delirium in pediatric ICU and NICU settings.

subtopics.label: Stroke Diagnosis, Misdiagnosis, and Quality of Care
subtopics.description: Studies examining diagnostic accuracy, misdiagnosis rates, quality metrics, and healthcare disparities in acute ischemic stroke and TIA management in emergency and inpatient settings.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnostic accuracy, misdiagnosis rates, quality metrics, and healthcare disparities in acute stroke and TIA management.

subtopics.label: Ischemic Stroke Mechanisms, Imaging, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the pathophysiology, neuroimaging biomarkers (OEF, QSM, retinal vessels), cardioembolic sources, and clinical outcomes of ischemic stroke and cerebrovascular events.
subtopics.short_description: Pathophysiology, neuroimaging biomarkers, cardioembolic sources, and clinical outcomes of ischemic cerebrovascular events.

subtopics.label: Dysphagia, Voice Disorders, and Swallowing Neuroscience
subtopics.description: Studies on swallowing dysfunction, aspiration, post-swallow residue, respiratory-swallow coordination, and laryngeal motor neuropathy in neurological conditions including Parkinson's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Swallowing dysfunction, aspiration, respiratory-swallow coordination, and laryngeal neuropathy in neurological disease.

subtopics.label: Breast Reconstruction Sensory Reinnervation
subtopics.description: Research on targeted nipple-areola complex reinnervation and sensory recovery following mastectomy and breast reconstruction, including gender-affirming surgery and comparison of reconstructive techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Targeted nipple-areola reinnervation and sensory recovery following mastectomy and gender-affirming reconstruction.

subtopics.label: HIV-Associated Neurocognitive Disorders
subtopics.description: Studies on cognitive impairment, brain abnormalities, biomarkers, and neuropathology in people living with HIV, including CSF compartmentalization, galectin-9, and cellular rejuvenation strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive impairment, brain biomarkers, CSF compartmentalization, and neuropathology in people living with HIV.

subtopics.label: Neuroimmunology and Innate Lymphoid Cell Biology
subtopics.description: Research on innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), neuropeptide regulation of mucosal immunity, gut-brain immune interactions, and the role of ILC3s in neuroinflammation and tissue protection.
subtopics.short_description: Innate lymphoid cells, neuropeptide-mediated mucosal immunity, and gut-brain immune interactions in neuroinflammation.

subtopics.label: Neurosteroids, Reproductive Hormones, and Mood
subtopics.description: Studies on allopregnanolone, progesterone metabolites, and neuroactive steroids in perinatal anxiety, postpartum depression, and reproductive mood disorders, including estrogen receptor biology.
subtopics.short_description: Allopregnanolone and neuroactive steroids in perinatal anxiety, postpartum depression, and reproductive mood disorders.

subtopics.label: Neurosurgical Education, Simulation, and Assistive Technology
subtopics.description: Research on surgical training methods including augmented reality, virtual reality, 3D neuroanatomy courses, and assistive technology access for patients with brain injury and cognitive impairment.
subtopics.short_description: Augmented reality, virtual reality, and 3D simulation tools for surgical training and patient assistive technology access.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Outcomes, Severity, and Hospitalization
subtopics.description: Research on clinical characteristics, risk factors, severity predictors, and outcomes of hospitalized COVID-19 patients, including comorbidity effects (diabetes, obesity, cancer, heart failure), viral load correlates, and mortality risk stratification.
subtopics.short_description: Risk factors, comorbidity effects, and mortality stratification in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Immunology, Antibody Responses, and Vaccine Effectiveness
subtopics.description: Studies on immune responses to SARS-CoV-2 infection and vaccination, including antibody kinetics, neutralizing antibody development, vaccine effectiveness against variants, waning immunity, hybrid immunity, and breakthrough infections.
subtopics.short_description: Antibody kinetics, neutralizing responses, vaccine effectiveness against variants, and waning or hybrid immunity.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Variants, Transmission Dynamics, and Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies on SARS-CoV-2 variant emergence and spread, transmission dynamics, seroprevalence surveys, reinfection rates, and mathematical modeling of COVID-19 epidemic trajectories.
subtopics.short_description: Variant emergence, seroprevalence, reinfection rates, and mathematical modeling of COVID-19 epidemic trajectories.

subtopics.label: HIV Biology, Reservoir, Antiretroviral Therapy, and Immune Responses
subtopics.description: Research on HIV-1 molecular biology, viral reservoirs, latency reversal, antiretroviral therapy effects on immune reconstitution, HIV-specific T cell and antibody responses, and strategies toward HIV cure.
subtopics.short_description: HIV-1 molecular biology, viral latency, antiretroviral immune reconstitution, and cure-directed strategies.

subtopics.label: HIV Clinical Management, Comorbidities, and Aging
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on people living with HIV focusing on comorbidities (cardiovascular disease, renal dysfunction, neurocognitive impairment, metabolic disorders), aging-related complications, and longitudinal health outcomes in HIV-positive populations.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular, renal, neurocognitive, and metabolic complications in people aging with HIV.

subtopics.label: HIV Prevention, Testing, PrEP, and Community Engagement
subtopics.description: Research on HIV prevention strategies including PrEP uptake and adherence, HIV testing programs (including traditional healer-delivered testing), stigma reduction, and community-based interventions to improve HIV care cascade outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: PrEP uptake, HIV testing programs, stigma reduction, and community-based care cascade interventions.

subtopics.label: Hepatitis B, C, and D: Epidemiology, Treatment, and Elimination
subtopics.description: Studies on hepatitis B, C, and D virus epidemiology, treatment access and outcomes, elimination strategies, Medicaid policy impacts on HCV treatment, and HCV/HBV in special populations including pregnant women and people who inject drugs.
subtopics.display_name: Hepatitis B, C & D Elimination Strategies
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, treatment access, and elimination policy for hepatitis B, C, and D across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Tuberculosis Biology, Drug Development, and Clinical Management
subtopics.description: Research on Mycobacterium tuberculosis biology, drug targets and novel antimycobacterial compounds, mechanisms of drug resistance, latent TB, and clinical management of tuberculosis including drug-resistant strains.
subtopics.short_description: Mycobacterium tuberculosis drug targets, resistance mechanisms, and clinical management of drug-resistant TB.

subtopics.label: Malaria Parasite Biology, Drug Resistance, and Antimalarial Development
subtopics.description: Studies on Plasmodium falciparum and vivax biology including antigenic variation, epigenetic regulation, drug resistance mechanisms, and development of novel antimalarial compounds targeting the proteasome and other pathways.
subtopics.short_description: Plasmodium biology, drug resistance mechanisms, and novel antimalarial compound discovery.

subtopics.label: Sexually Transmitted Infections: Epidemiology, Prevention, and Vaccines
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies and mathematical modeling of sexually transmitted infections including HSV-1/2, gonorrhea, chlamydia, syphilis, and HPV, with focus on global burden, transmission dynamics, and vaccine or prevention strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Global burden, transmission dynamics, and vaccine or prevention strategies for HSV, gonorrhea, syphilis, and HPV.

subtopics.label: Antimicrobial Resistance, Stewardship, and Rapid Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research on antimicrobial resistance mechanisms and epidemiology, rapid molecular diagnostic tests for resistant pathogens, antimicrobial stewardship programs, and clinical outcomes of infections caused by drug-resistant organisms.
subtopics.short_description: Resistance mechanisms, rapid molecular diagnostics, stewardship programs, and outcomes of drug-resistant infections.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Pathophysiology, Molecular Biology, and Experimental Models
subtopics.description: Mechanistic studies on SARS-CoV-2 infection biology including viral entry, host cell tropism, organoid and stem cell models, pathological findings (autopsy, histology), and molecular mechanisms of COVID-19 organ damage.
subtopics.short_description: Viral entry, host cell tropism, organoid models, and molecular mechanisms of COVID-19 organ damage.

subtopics.label: Long COVID and Post-Acute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 Infection
subtopics.description: Research on post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC/Long COVID) including prevalence, risk factors, subphenotypes, neurological and cognitive manifestations, and potential treatments.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, risk factors, neurological manifestations, and emerging treatments for post-acute SARS-CoV-2 sequelae.

subtopics.label: Fungal Infections, Gut Mycobiome, and Host-Fungal Interactions
subtopics.description: Studies on fungal pathogens and the gut mycobiome, including Candida and other fungi in health and disease, fungal regulation of mucosal immunity, mycobiota-IgA interactions, and fungal involvement in inflammatory bowel disease and cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Fungal pathogens, mycobiota-immune interactions, and fungal roles in inflammatory bowel disease and cancer.

subtopics.label: Cytomegalovirus Infection, Immunity, and Vaccine Development
subtopics.description: Research on human and rhesus cytomegalovirus biology, immune correlates of protection, congenital CMV transmission, and development and evaluation of CMV vaccine candidates including mRNA and subunit approaches.
subtopics.short_description: CMV biology, immune correlates of protection, congenital transmission, and mRNA or subunit vaccine candidates.

subtopics.label: Depression: Treatment, Neurobiology, and Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research on the neurobiological underpinnings of major depressive disorder and its subtypes, including pharmacological treatments (antidepressants, ketamine, TMS, ECT), psychotherapies (CBT, PATH, Engage & Connect), brain imaging correlates, and machine learning approaches to predict treatment response and parse depression heterogeneity.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiological mechanisms, pharmacological and psychotherapeutic treatments, and predictive models for major depressive disorder.

subtopics.label: Suicide Risk, Prevention, and Self-Harm
subtopics.description: Epidemiological, clinical, and computational research on suicidal ideation, suicide attempts, and non-suicidal self-injury across the lifespan, including risk stratification models using EHRs and machine learning, geographic and social determinants of suicide risk, prevention interventions, and NLP-based detection of suicidality in clinical text.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiological and computational research on suicidal ideation, self-harm, risk stratification, and prevention interventions across the lifespan.

subtopics.label: Perinatal and Reproductive Mental Health
subtopics.description: Clinical and biological research on mental health conditions during pregnancy and the postpartum period, including postpartum depression prediction and treatment, perinatal anxiety, neurosteroid and immune mechanisms, and reproductive psychiatry education and interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Mental health conditions during pregnancy and postpartum, including depression, anxiety, neurosteroid mechanisms, and reproductive psychiatry interventions.

subtopics.label: Schizophrenia, Psychosis, and Neurodevelopmental Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Translational and clinical research on schizophrenia and related psychotic disorders, encompassing patient-derived organoid models, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, proteomic and neuroimaging biomarkers, negative symptom dimensions, antipsychotic prescribing patterns, cognitive training, and early psychosis intervention financing.
subtopics.short_description: Translational and clinical research on psychotic disorders, including biomarkers, organoid models, cognitive training, and early psychosis intervention.

subtopics.label: Anxiety Disorders, PTSD, and Trauma
subtopics.description: Research on anxiety disorders, PTSD, and trauma-related conditions including fear extinction, VR-based and MDMA-assisted therapies, vasopressin receptor antagonists, childhood trauma effects, prolonged grief disorder, and the neurobiological and psychosocial correlates of trauma across the lifespan.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiological and psychosocial research on anxiety disorders, PTSD, and trauma, including VR-based, MDMA-assisted, and fear-extinction therapies.

subtopics.label: Late-Life Depression, Aging, and Cognitive Comorbidity
subtopics.description: Clinical research focused on depression in older adults, including its relationship to cognitive impairment, small vessel disease, apathy, and executive dysfunction; psychotherapeutic and pharmacological interventions; ecological momentary assessment; and the intersection of depression with aging-related neurobiological changes.
subtopics.short_description: Depression in older adults and its intersection with cognitive impairment, small vessel disease, and aging-related neurobiological changes.

subtopics.label: Autism Spectrum Disorder and Pediatric Neurodevelopment
subtopics.description: Research on autism spectrum disorder and related neurodevelopmental conditions, including molecular and neuroimaging mechanisms, social skills interventions, diagnostic disclosure, caregiver-implemented strategies, and comorbid behavioral conditions such as ADHD and conduct problems in children.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular, neuroimaging, and behavioral research on autism and related neurodevelopmental conditions, including ADHD and caregiver-implemented interventions.

subtopics.label: Digital Health, AI, and Technology in Mental Health
subtopics.description: Research on the application of artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, wearable devices, mobile apps, and chatbots to detect, predict, monitor, and treat mental health conditions including depression, anxiety, suicide risk, and postpartum depression.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning, NLP, wearables, and mobile apps applied to detection, monitoring, and treatment of psychiatric conditions.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic and Mental Health
subtopics.description: Studies examining the psychological impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the general population, healthcare workers, college students, and psychiatric patients, including trends in psychological distress, telemental health expansion, inpatient psychiatry adaptations, and pandemic-related changes in child and adolescent mental health.
subtopics.short_description: Psychological distress, telemental health expansion, and psychiatric care adaptations across populations during the COVID-19 pandemic.

subtopics.label: Mental Health Services, Policy, and Health Systems
subtopics.description: Health services and policy research on mental health care delivery, including behavioral health homes, mental health parity enforcement, integration of mental health into primary and specialty care, early psychosis program financing, telehealth policy, and access to mental health services across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Health systems and policy research on mental health care delivery, parity enforcement, integration into primary care, and access disparities.

subtopics.label: Prolonged Grief Disorder and Bereavement
subtopics.description: Clinical and psychometric research on prolonged grief disorder (PGD), including validation of diagnostic scales (PG-13, PG-13-R) across multiple languages and cultures, neurobiological reward system correlates, risk factors, comorbidity with depression and suicidal ideation, and treatment approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and psychometric research on prolonged grief disorder, including diagnostic validation, neurobiological correlates, and treatment approaches.

subtopics.label: Behavioral Health in Palliative, Hospice, and Serious Illness Care
subtopics.description: Research on the integration of mental health and psychiatric services into palliative care, hospice, and serious illness settings, including prevalence of psychiatric comorbidities, training of palliative care clinicians in mental health, depression screening, and interventions for patients and caregivers at end of life.
subtopics.short_description: Integration of psychiatric services into palliative, hospice, and serious illness care, including depression screening and end-of-life interventions.

subtopics.label: Stress Neurobiology and Brain Circuit Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Preclinical and translational research on the neurobiological mechanisms of stress, including frontostriatal and limbic circuits, paraventricular thalamus, BDNF signaling, sex differences in stress responses, and animal models of chronic stress relevant to depression, anxiety, and motivated behavior.
subtopics.short_description: Preclinical and translational research on stress-related brain circuits, BDNF signaling, and sex differences relevant to depression and anxiety.

subtopics.label: Eating Disorders, Body Image, and Body Dysmorphic Disorder
subtopics.description: Clinical research on anorexia nervosa, binge eating disorder, body dysmorphic disorder, and body image disturbance, including treatment predictors, CBT versus supportive psychotherapy comparisons, perfectionism, and comorbid psychiatric conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical research on anorexia, binge eating, body dysmorphic disorder, and treatment predictors including CBT and comorbid psychiatric conditions.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Delirium and Critical Care Mental Health
subtopics.description: Research on delirium screening, prevention, and outcomes in pediatric intensive care and hospital settings, including assessment tools, risk factors, and post-discharge quality of life. Also covers parental and provider distress in prolonged PICU admissions.
subtopics.short_description: Delirium screening, prevention, and outcomes in pediatric intensive care, including parental distress and post-discharge quality of life.

subtopics.label: Dementia Caregiving: Burden, Self-Efficacy, and Psychosocial Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies examining psychological burden, self-efficacy, depression, and well-being among family caregivers of persons with dementia, including interventions such as positive emotion regulation, social enhancement tools, and cross-cultural analyses of familism and caregiver outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Psychological burden, self-efficacy, and well-being among dementia family caregivers, including psychosocial and cross-cultural interventions.

subtopics.label: Cancer Survivorship: Psychosocial Outcomes and Quality of Life
subtopics.description: Research on psychological distress, quality of life, anxiety, and unmet psychosocial needs among cancer survivors and patients, including breast cancer, gynecologic cancer, and young adult survivors, as well as disparities in psychosocial care utilization.
subtopics.short_description: Psychological distress, quality of life, and unmet psychosocial needs among cancer survivors, including disparities in care utilization.

subtopics.label: Adolescent and Young Adult Substance Use: Risk, Neurodevelopment, and Intervention
subtopics.description: Studies on alcohol, cannabis, e-cigarette, and stimulant use among adolescents and young adults, including neurobiological effects, risk factors, sex differences, and prevention or treatment interventions for substance use disorders in youth.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiological effects, risk factors, and interventions for alcohol, cannabis, and stimulant use among adolescents and young adults.

subtopics.label: Chronic Pain: Psychosocial Factors, Comorbidities, and Behavioral Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on the intersection of chronic pain with psychological distress, depression, inflammation, and functional outcomes, including peer-delivered and behavioral interventions for pain management in diverse populations such as diabetes patients, older adults, and torture survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Intersection of chronic pain with depression, inflammation, and functional outcomes, including behavioral and peer-delivered interventions.

subtopics.label: Post-COVID Neuropsychiatric and Cognitive Sequelae
subtopics.description: Studies examining cognitive deficits, neuropsychiatric symptoms, and functional impairment following COVID-19 infection, including long COVID subphenotypes, rehabilitation approaches, and digital interventions for post-COVID cognitive recovery.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive deficits, neuropsychiatric symptoms, and rehabilitation approaches following COVID-19 infection and long COVID.

subtopics.label: Physician and Trainee Burnout, Wellness, and Professional Distress
subtopics.description: Research on burnout, psychological distress, and wellness among physicians, trainees, and healthcare workers across specialties, including cardiothoracic surgery, pediatric gastroenterology, radiology, and home health aides, with attention to COVID-19 impacts on provider well-being.
subtopics.short_description: Burnout, psychological distress, and wellness among physicians, trainees, and healthcare workers across specialties and care settings.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Behavioral and Mental Health Training and Workforce Development
subtopics.description: Studies on training pediatricians, residents, and fellows in behavioral and mental health competencies, including curriculum development, clinical training environments, and the role of onsite mental health professionals in improving trainee skills and confidence.
subtopics.short_description: Curriculum development and clinical training to build behavioral and mental health competencies among pediatricians and trainees.

subtopics.label: Social Isolation, Loneliness, and Social Connectedness in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on the health consequences of loneliness and social isolation in older adults, including associations with depression, physical health, and quality of life, as well as technology-based and community interventions to enhance social connectedness.
subtopics.short_description: Health consequences of social isolation in older adults and technology-based or community interventions to enhance connectedness.

subtopics.label: HIV, Mental Health, and Aging: Psychosocial and Neuropsychiatric Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Studies on psychiatric symptoms, cognitive decline, inflammation, pain, and psychosocial needs in people living with HIV, with particular focus on older adults, the impact of childhood trauma, and palliative care needs in this population.
subtopics.short_description: Psychiatric symptoms, cognitive decline, and psychosocial needs in older adults living with HIV, including trauma and palliative care.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Psychiatric Inpatient and Partial Hospitalization Programs
subtopics.description: Research on assessment, treatment, and outcomes in adolescent acute psychiatric settings including partial hospitalization and inpatient programs, covering anxiety prevalence, measurement-based care, treatment needs, police involvement, and digital media-related admissions.
subtopics.short_description: Assessment, treatment, and outcomes in adolescent inpatient and partial hospitalization programs, including measurement-based care and digital media impacts.

subtopics.label: Bipolar Disorder: Neurobiological Mechanisms and Treatment Approaches
subtopics.description: Studies investigating the neurobiological underpinnings of bipolar disorder including oxidative stress, GSK-3β signaling, and TRPV1 channels, as well as treatment approaches such as TMS, GLP-1 agonists, and stimulant use in comorbid conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiological underpinnings of bipolar disorder, including oxidative stress and GSK-3β signaling, and emerging treatment approaches.

subtopics.label: Telepsychiatry and Consultation-Liaison Psychiatry Services
subtopics.description: Research on the implementation, effectiveness, and triage of telepsychiatry consultation-liaison services in hospital and emergency department settings, including centralized telepsychiatry models, hybrid consultation approaches, and healthcare utilization patterns following psychiatric hospitalization.
subtopics.short_description: Implementation and effectiveness of telepsychiatry consultation-liaison models in hospital and emergency department settings.

subtopics.label: Racial, Ethnic, and Socioeconomic Disparities in Mental Health and Care Access
subtopics.description: Studies examining how race, ethnicity, socioeconomic status, and structural racism contribute to disparities in mental health outcomes, treatment access, and psychosocial care utilization, including impacts on youth, college students, and minority communities.
subtopics.short_description: Structural racism, ethnicity, and socioeconomic factors driving disparities in mental health outcomes and treatment access across populations.

subtopics.label: Cell Cycle Regulation and Proliferation Signaling
subtopics.description: Research into molecular mechanisms controlling cell cycle progression, including CDK/cyclin complexes, Rb-E2F signaling, checkpoint pathways, DNA replication licensing, and commitment to proliferation or quiescence. Encompasses studies of CDK4/6 inhibitors, cell cycle exit, and stress-mediated regulation of G1/S transitions.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular control of cell cycle progression, checkpoint pathways, CDK/cyclin complexes, and commitment to proliferation or quiescence.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic and Chromatin Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies of chromatin remodeling, histone modifications, DNA methylation, and transcription factor-mediated epigenetic control in development, differentiation, and disease. Includes research on PRC2, SWI/SNF complexes, histone variants, m6A RNA methylation, enhancer-promoter interactions, and epigenetic reprogramming in cancer and stem cells.
subtopics.short_description: Chromatin remodeling, histone modifications, DNA methylation, and transcription factor-driven epigenetic control in development and disease.

subtopics.label: Membrane Protein Structure, Function, and Dynamics
subtopics.description: Structural and biophysical studies of ion channels, transporters, GPCRs, and other integral membrane proteins, including cryo-EM, high-speed AFM, NMR, and molecular dynamics approaches. Covers mechanisms of gating, lipid modulation, conformational dynamics, and pharmacological regulation of membrane proteins.
subtopics.short_description: Structural and biophysical characterization of ion channels, transporters, and GPCRs using cryo-EM, NMR, and molecular dynamics.

subtopics.label: Intracellular Signaling Pathways and Second Messengers
subtopics.description: Research on intracellular signal transduction cascades including cAMP/PKA, PI3K/AKT/mTOR, MAPK/ERK, Wnt/β-catenin, NF-κB, JAK/STAT, and calcium signaling. Encompasses studies of second messenger dynamics, kinase/phosphatase regulation, and pathway crosstalk in physiological and disease contexts.
subtopics.short_description: Signal transduction cascades including PI3K/AKT, MAPK/ERK, Wnt, and calcium signaling in physiological and disease contexts.

subtopics.label: RNA Biology, Gene Expression, and Post-Transcriptional Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies of RNA processing, splicing, isoform diversity, non-coding RNAs, RNA aptamers, and post-transcriptional regulatory mechanisms. Includes research on circular RNAs, lncRNAs, microRNAs, RNA structure, alternative polyadenylation, and tools for RNA imaging and sequencing.
subtopics.short_description: RNA processing, splicing, non-coding RNAs, and post-transcriptional mechanisms controlling gene expression and isoform diversity.

subtopics.label: Cellular Metabolism and Bioenergetics
subtopics.description: Research on metabolic pathways including lipid metabolism, mitochondrial function, NAD+/NADH dynamics, glucose homeostasis, and metabolic reprogramming in cancer, obesity, and disease. Encompasses studies of fatty acid synthesis, oxidative phosphorylation, glycolysis, and metabolic regulation of cell fate.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic pathways including mitochondrial function, lipid metabolism, and metabolic reprogramming in cancer, obesity, and disease.

subtopics.label: Stem Cell Biology and Cellular Differentiation
subtopics.description: Research on stem cell self-renewal, pluripotency, and differentiation into specialized cell types including cardiomyocytes, neurons, adipocytes, and hematopoietic cells. Includes studies of iPSC generation, organoid models, lineage tracing, transcription factor networks governing cell identity, and reprogramming.
subtopics.short_description: Stem cell self-renewal, pluripotency, iPSC generation, organoid models, and transcription factor networks governing cell identity.

subtopics.label: Neuronal and Synaptic Biology
subtopics.description: Studies of synaptic transmission, neurotransmitter release, synaptic vesicle dynamics, neuronal signaling, and molecular mechanisms underlying neurological and psychiatric diseases. Includes research on SNARE proteins, ion channels in neurons, neurotrophic factors, and molecular bases of memory and cognition.
subtopics.short_description: Synaptic transmission, neurotransmitter release, and molecular mechanisms underlying neurological and psychiatric diseases.

subtopics.label: Tumor Microenvironment and Cancer Immunology
subtopics.description: Research on immune cell interactions within the tumor microenvironment, including T cell function, immune checkpoint pathways, innate immune responses, and mechanisms of immune evasion and immunotherapy resistance. Covers studies of CAR T cells, checkpoint inhibitors, radiation-immune interactions, and tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes.
subtopics.short_description: Immune cell interactions, checkpoint pathways, and mechanisms of immune evasion and immunotherapy resistance in solid tumors.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genomics and Molecular Oncology
subtopics.description: Studies of oncogenic mutations, chromosomal instability, tumor suppressor pathways, and molecular drivers of cancer initiation and progression. Includes research on specific oncogenes (KRAS, MYC, TP53), epigenetic drivers, structural variants, clonal evolution, and molecular characterization of diverse cancer types.
subtopics.short_description: Oncogenic mutations, tumor suppressor pathways, and molecular drivers of cancer initiation, progression, and clonal evolution.

subtopics.label: Innate Lymphoid Cells and Mucosal Immunity
subtopics.description: Research on innate lymphoid cell (ILC) biology, mucosal immune responses, and gut immune homeostasis. Covers ILC1, ILC2, and ILC3 functions, their regulation by cytokines and neuropeptides, roles in barrier immunity, and dysregulation in inflammatory bowel disease and cancer.
subtopics.short_description: ILC biology, mucosal immune responses, and gut immune homeostasis in barrier immunity, inflammatory bowel disease, and cancer.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome-Host Interactions and Fungal Biology
subtopics.description: Studies of host-microbiome interactions including gut bacterial and fungal communities, their effects on immunity, metabolism, and disease. Encompasses mycobiome research, microbiota-derived metabolites, IgA regulation of commensals, and microbial manipulation of host physiology.
subtopics.short_description: Host-microbiome interactions involving gut bacterial and fungal communities, metabolites, and their effects on immunity and disease.

subtopics.label: DNA Repair, Genome Stability, and Telomere Biology
subtopics.description: Research on DNA damage response, repair mechanisms including homologous recombination and base excision repair, replication fidelity, and telomere maintenance. Includes studies of BRCA1/2, DNA-PK, telomerase, and genome instability in cancer and aging contexts.
subtopics.short_description: DNA damage response, repair mechanisms, telomere maintenance, and genome instability in cancer and aging contexts.

subtopics.label: Lipid, Sterol, and Membrane Lipid Biology
subtopics.description: Studies of lipid metabolism, sterol transport, sphingolipid signaling, and membrane lipid composition in cellular function and disease. Includes research on cholesterol trafficking, phospholipid scramblases, ceramide biosynthesis, and lipid-mediated regulation of signaling and membrane dynamics.
subtopics.short_description: Lipid metabolism, sterol transport, sphingolipid signaling, and membrane lipid composition in cellular function and disease.

subtopics.label: Gene Therapy, AAV Vectors, and Genome Editing
subtopics.description: Research on adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector development, gene therapy applications, and CRISPR-based genome editing tools. Covers AAV capsid engineering, tissue tropism, therapeutic delivery for genetic diseases, and base editing approaches for disease modeling and correction.
subtopics.display_name: Gene Therapy, AAV Vectors & Genome Editing
subtopics.short_description: AAV vector engineering, CRISPR-based genome editing, and therapeutic delivery strategies for genetic disease correction.

subtopics.label: Viral Hepatitis Epidemiology, Treatment, and Elimination
subtopics.description: Research on hepatitis B, C, and D virus epidemiology, treatment access, elimination strategies, and outcomes across diverse populations including people who inject drugs, pregnant women, and underserved communities. Covers direct-acting antivirals, Medicaid policy, rapid treatment initiation, and global HCV/HBV prevalence studies.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, treatment access, and elimination strategies for hepatitis B, C, and D across diverse and underserved populations.

subtopics.label: Cirrhosis, End-Stage Liver Disease, and Hepatic Complications
subtopics.description: Research on the clinical management, outcomes, and complications of cirrhosis and end-stage liver disease including hepatic encephalopathy, portal hypertension, ascites, kidney dysfunction, alcohol-associated liver disease, and mortality prediction. Covers pharmacologic treatments, hospitalization outcomes, and quality-of-care initiatives.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical management and outcomes of cirrhosis complications including encephalopathy, portal hypertension, ascites, and kidney dysfunction.

subtopics.label: Liver Transplantation: Access, Outcomes, and Disparities
subtopics.description: Research on liver transplantation including waitlist access, living donor practices, post-transplant outcomes, disparities by race and socioeconomic status, and management of specific conditions such as alcohol-associated liver disease, MASH, and hepatitis. Covers policy impacts such as Medicaid expansion on transplant access.
subtopics.short_description: Waitlist access, living donor practices, post-transplant outcomes, and racial and socioeconomic disparities in liver transplantation.

subtopics.label: Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease, Metabolic Liver Disease, and Steatohepatitis
subtopics.description: Research on the pathogenesis, diagnosis, and management of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD/MASLD) and metabolic steatohepatitis including fibrosis assessment, imaging biomarkers, genetic risk factors, comorbidities, and therapeutic interventions. Covers retinoic acid pathways, alcohol-associated liver disease mechanisms, and liver fibrosis noninvasive markers.
subtopics.short_description: Pathogenesis, noninvasive diagnosis, and treatment of NAFLD/MASLD and metabolic steatohepatitis, including fibrosis biomarkers and genetic risk.

subtopics.label: Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Clinical Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis covering medical therapies (biologics, small molecules), surgical techniques, endoscopic monitoring, pregnancy considerations, pediatric IBD, and disease-related complications including VTE and comorbidities. Includes comparative effectiveness of vedolizumab, ustekinumab, and TNF antagonists.
subtopics.short_description: Medical and surgical therapies for Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, including biologics, small molecules, and comparative effectiveness studies.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome, Mucosal Immunity, and Host-Microbiota Interactions
subtopics.description: Research on the gut microbiome's role in mucosal immunity, host metabolism, and disease including ILC biology, fungal microbiota, bile acid signaling, dietary fiber effects, and microbiota manipulation. Covers mechanisms by which commensal bacteria and fungi regulate immune tolerance, inflammation, and metabolic homeostasis.
subtopics.short_description: Host-microbiota interactions governing mucosal immune tolerance, inflammation, and metabolic homeostasis in the gastrointestinal tract.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Cancer Biology, Genetics, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and neuroendocrine tumors covering molecular mechanisms (KRAS, RHAMM, NADK, epigenetic regulation), tumor microenvironment, surgical outcomes, and therapeutic strategies. Includes studies on PDAC precursor lesions, acinar cell carcinoma, and novel targeted therapies.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms, tumor microenvironment, surgical outcomes, and targeted therapies for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and neuroendocrine tumors.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Cancer: Screening, Molecular Biology, and Surgical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on colorectal cancer encompassing screening disparities, molecular pathogenesis (WNT signaling, aPKC, SOX17), surgical management, endoscopic resection techniques, and outcomes. Covers Lynch syndrome, hereditary CRC, tumor immune microenvironment, and health equity in CRC screening and treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Screening disparities, molecular pathogenesis, surgical management, and health equity in colorectal cancer care, including Lynch syndrome.

subtopics.label: Endoscopic Procedures, Interventional GI, and Biliary Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy including EUS-guided procedures, ERCP, endoscopic resection techniques, anti-reflux endoscopic procedures, and biliary interventions. Covers procedural outcomes, novel devices, training, and management of biliary obstruction, pancreatic cysts, and GI bleeding.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy including EUS, ERCP, endoscopic resection, and biliary interventions for GI and pancreatic conditions.

subtopics.label: GERD, Esophageal Motility, and Anti-Reflux Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on gastroesophageal reflux disease, esophageal motility disorders, and anti-reflux surgical and endoscopic interventions including fundoplication, hiatal hernia repair, and sleeve gastrectomy. Covers physiologic assessment using impedance planimetry, pH monitoring, manometry, and outcomes of robotic and laparoscopic approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Physiologic assessment and surgical or endoscopic management of gastroesophageal reflux disease and esophageal motility disorders.

subtopics.label: Obesity Management: Bariatric Surgery and Endoscopic Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on surgical and endoscopic treatments for obesity including endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty, intragastric balloons, Roux-en-Y gastric bypass revision, and bariatric surgery outcomes. Covers metabolic effects, GERD after bariatric procedures, diabetes remission, and comparison of virtual versus in-person follow-up care.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical and endoscopic interventions for obesity, including sleeve gastroplasty, gastric bypass, metabolic outcomes, and diabetes remission.

subtopics.label: Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Biliary Tract Cancers
subtopics.description: Research on hepatocellular carcinoma and biliary tract malignancies including intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, gallbladder neoplasms, and ampullary adenocarcinoma. Covers molecular pathogenesis, imaging-based diagnosis (LI-RADS), locoregional therapies, surgical outcomes, tumor microenvironment, and disparities in treatment and survival.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular pathogenesis, imaging diagnosis, locoregional therapies, and surgical outcomes for liver and biliary tract malignancies.

subtopics.label: Pancreatitis, Pancreatic Cysts, and Biliary Disease
subtopics.description: Research on acute and chronic pancreatitis, pancreatic cystic lesions, and biliary disease including diagnosis, management, and outcomes. Covers ERCP for biliary pancreatitis, morphologic severity assessment, pancreatic cyst cytology, MRI-based detection, and cholangioscopy for gallstone disease.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and management of acute and chronic pancreatitis, pancreatic cystic lesions, and biliary disease including ERCP and cholangioscopy.

subtopics.label: Gastric and Esophageal Cancer: Molecular Targets and Clinical Trials
subtopics.description: Research on gastric, gastroesophageal junction, and esophageal adenocarcinoma covering molecular biomarkers (CLDN18.2, HER2, FGFR2, TP53), targeted therapies (zolbetuximab, andecaliximab), clinical trial outcomes, and genomic characterization. Includes studies on perioperative chemotherapy, surgical lymph node dissection, and real-world biomarker testing patterns.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular biomarkers, targeted therapies, and clinical trial outcomes for gastric, gastroesophageal junction, and esophageal adenocarcinoma.

subtopics.label: Celiac Disease, Eosinophilic Esophagitis, and Functional GI Disorders
subtopics.description: Research on celiac disease, eosinophilic esophagitis, microscopic colitis, and functional gastrointestinal disorders including IBS and constipation. Covers epidemiology, diagnostic approaches, dietary interventions, comorbidities, and management strategies including synbiotics, dietary enzyme supplementation, and pharmacologic treatments.
subtopics.display_name: Celiac Disease, Eosinophilic Esophagitis & Functional GI
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, diagnosis, and management of celiac disease, eosinophilic esophagitis, microscopic colitis, IBS, and functional GI disorders.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Surgery: Perioperative Outcomes, ERAS, and Disparities
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of colorectal conditions including colectomy outcomes, enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocols, minimally invasive techniques, and sociodemographic disparities in surgical care.
subtopics.short_description: Colectomy outcomes, enhanced recovery protocols, minimally invasive techniques, and sociodemographic disparities in colorectal surgical care.

subtopics.label: Small Bowel Obstruction, Appendicitis, and Acute Abdominal Emergencies
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on the management, outcomes, and complications of acute abdominal emergencies including small bowel obstruction, acute appendicitis, and related surgical interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Management, outcomes, and complications of small bowel obstruction, acute appendicitis, and related acute abdominal surgical emergencies.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 and Gastrointestinal/Hepatic Manifestations
subtopics.description: Studies examining the gastrointestinal and hepatic effects of SARS-CoV-2 infection, including GI symptoms, organoid models of infection, liver involvement in children, and pandemic impacts on GI care delivery.
subtopics.short_description: GI symptoms, liver involvement, organoid infection models, and pandemic impacts on care delivery associated with SARS-CoV-2 infection.

subtopics.label: Liver Disease and Hepatic Conditions in Pregnancy
subtopics.description: Research on liver-related conditions during and after pregnancy, including intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy, drug-induced liver injury, elevated ALT, NAFLD, and hepatitis B management in pregnant women.
subtopics.short_description: Hepatic conditions during pregnancy including intrahepatic cholestasis, drug-induced liver injury, NAFLD, and hepatitis B management.

subtopics.label: Hepatocyte Culture Models, AAV Gene Therapy, and Liver Repopulation
subtopics.description: Experimental studies developing and utilizing primary human hepatocyte culture systems, AAV vector-based gene delivery, and in vivo liver repopulation models for liver disease research and therapy.
subtopics.short_description: Primary human hepatocyte culture systems, AAV vector gene delivery, and in vivo liver repopulation models for liver disease research.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome in Transplant Recipients and Infectious Complications
subtopics.description: Studies examining gut microbiota composition, dysbiosis, and infectious complications in hematopoietic cell transplant and solid organ transplant recipients, including post-transplant diarrhea and pathogen colonization.
subtopics.short_description: Microbiota dysbiosis and infectious complications in hematopoietic and solid organ transplant recipients, including pathogen colonization.

subtopics.label: Intestinal Stem Cells, Epithelial Biology, and Mucosal Homeostasis
subtopics.description: Research on intestinal stem cell biology, epithelial cell lineage specification, mucosal homeostasis, and the molecular pathways regulating intestinal epithelial identity and regeneration.
subtopics.short_description: Stem cell biology, epithelial lineage specification, and molecular pathways governing intestinal mucosal homeostasis and regeneration.

subtopics.label: Innate Lymphoid Cells, Dietary Fiber, and Intestinal Inflammation
subtopics.description: Studies on innate lymphoid cell (ILC) biology in the gut, including ILC2 and ILC3 roles in intestinal inflammation, dietary fiber effects on ILC responses, and mucosal immune regulation.
subtopics.short_description: ILC2 and ILC3 roles in gut inflammation, dietary fiber effects on innate lymphoid cell responses, and mucosal immune regulation.

subtopics.label: Schistosomiasis and Parasitic Infections Affecting the GI Tract
subtopics.description: Research on the gastrointestinal and immunological effects of schistosome and other parasitic infections, including mucosal pathology, immune modulation, microbiome disruption, and interactions with viral infections.
subtopics.short_description: GI and immunological effects of schistosome and parasitic infections, including mucosal pathology, immune modulation, and microbiome disruption.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome in Metabolic Disease, Stroke, and Neurological Conditions
subtopics.description: Studies linking gut microbiota composition and function to metabolic disorders, ischemic stroke risk, and neurological outcomes, including microbiome-deficient mouse models and gut-brain axis interactions.
subtopics.display_name: Gut Microbiome in Metabolic & Neurological Disease
subtopics.short_description: Gut microbiota links to metabolic disorders, ischemic stroke risk, and neurological outcomes via gut-brain axis interactions.

subtopics.label: Neonatal and Pediatric Gastrointestinal Disorders
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on gastrointestinal conditions in neonates and children, including necrotizing enterocolitis, neonatal intestinal obstruction, Hirschsprung disease, pediatric aspiration, and recurrent croup.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and translational research on necrotizing enterocolitis, Hirschsprung disease, neonatal obstruction, and pediatric GI conditions.

subtopics.label: Advanced Endoscopic Resection Techniques and Novel Endoscopic Devices
subtopics.description: Preclinical and clinical studies evaluating novel endoscopic platforms, traction devices, and techniques for endoscopic submucosal dissection and full-thickness resection of GI lesions.
subtopics.short_description: Novel endoscopic platforms, traction devices, and techniques for submucosal dissection and full-thickness resection of GI lesions.

subtopics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy, Tumor Microenvironment, and Novel Therapeutic Strategies
subtopics.description: Research on immunotherapy approaches for GI and other cancers, including immune checkpoint blockade, tumor microenvironment modulation, antibody-drug conjugates, and engineered therapeutic agents.
subtopics.short_description: Immune checkpoint blockade, tumor microenvironment modulation, antibody-drug conjugates, and engineered therapies for GI cancers.

subtopics.label: Hepatic Lipid Metabolism, Steatosis, and Metabolic Dysfunction
subtopics.description: Studies on hepatic lipid metabolism pathways, including de novo lipogenesis, fatty acid trafficking, adipocyte browning, and metabolic dysfunction in obesity and liver disease models.
subtopics.short_description: De novo lipogenesis, fatty acid trafficking, and metabolic dysfunction pathways underlying hepatic steatosis and obesity-related liver disease.

subtopics.label: Fecal Microbiota Transplantation, Synbiotics, and Microbiome-Targeted Therapies
subtopics.description: Research on therapeutic manipulation of the gut microbiome through fecal microbiota transplantation, synbiotics, and microbiome-guided interventions for IBD, IBS, and related conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Therapeutic gut microbiome manipulation via fecal microbiota transplantation, synbiotics, and microbiome-guided interventions for IBD and IBS.

subtopics.label: Racial and Ethnic Disparities in Clinical Outcomes and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research documenting racial and ethnic differences in clinical outcomes, treatment receipt, and healthcare utilization across conditions including cardiovascular disease, cancer, stroke, maternal morbidity, and surgical procedures. Includes studies examining mechanisms of disparity such as differential treatment, provider bias, and hospital-level segregation.
subtopics.display_name: Racial & Ethnic Disparities in Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.short_description: Racial and ethnic differences in treatment receipt, healthcare utilization, and outcomes across cardiovascular, cancer, maternal, and surgical conditions.

subtopics.label: Social Determinants of Health and Cardiovascular/Stroke Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining how social determinants of health—including poverty, neighborhood disadvantage, race, and cumulative social vulnerabilities—affect incidence, outcomes, and mortality from cardiovascular disease, heart failure, stroke, and coronary heart disease, primarily using large cohort studies such as REGARDS.
subtopics.short_description: Poverty, neighborhood disadvantage, and cumulative social vulnerability as drivers of cardiovascular disease, stroke, and heart failure incidence and mortality.

subtopics.label: Insurance Coverage, Medicaid Expansion, and Healthcare Access
subtopics.description: Research evaluating the impact of Medicaid expansion, insurance type, and coverage policies on access to care, treatment utilization, and health outcomes across conditions including cancer, liver disease, diabetes, and maternal health. Includes studies on safety-net hospitals and disproportionate share hospital payments.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of Medicaid expansion and insurance policy on care access, treatment utilization, and outcomes across cancer, diabetes, and maternal health.

subtopics.label: Maternal Health Disparities and Reproductive Equity
subtopics.description: Research on racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in maternal morbidity, obstetric outcomes, prenatal care, and reproductive health policy. Includes studies on severe maternal morbidity, prenatal substance use laws, obstetric anesthesia disparities, postpartum outcomes, and reproductive justice frameworks.
