subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in maternal morbidity, obstetric outcomes, prenatal care, and reproductive justice policy.

subtopics.label: Cancer Disparities, Screening Access, and Minority Representation
subtopics.description: Studies examining racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in cancer screening, diagnosis, treatment, and survival, including breast, prostate, lung, colorectal, and other cancers. Covers barriers to screening, underrepresentation in clinical trials, and interventions to reduce cancer health disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic gaps in cancer screening, diagnosis, treatment, survival, and clinical trial representation.

subtopics.label: Healthcare Workforce Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
subtopics.description: Research on gender, racial, and ethnic representation in the healthcare workforce, including academic surgery, radiology, interventional radiology, and other specialties. Covers pipeline programs, promotion and retention disparities, sexual harassment, and DEI initiatives in medical training and academic medicine.
subtopics.short_description: Gender, racial, and ethnic representation in academic medicine and specialty training, including pipeline programs and promotion equity.

subtopics.label: Telehealth Access, Utilization, and Equity
subtopics.description: Studies examining telehealth adoption, access disparities, and outcomes across patient populations, including differences by race, age, geography, insurance status, and socioeconomic factors. Covers implementation during COVID-19, patient and provider experiences, and policy implications for telehealth equity.
subtopics.short_description: Disparities in telehealth adoption and outcomes by race, age, geography, and insurance status, with policy implications for equitable virtual care.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use Disorder, Substance Use Policy, and Health Equity
subtopics.description: Research on disparities in opioid use disorder treatment access, stigma, harm reduction, and substance use policies across racial, socioeconomic, and geographic groups. Includes studies on MOUD in justice settings, naloxone distribution disparities, prenatal substance use laws, and syringe service programs.
subtopics.display_name: Opioid Use Disorder & Substance Use Equity
subtopics.short_description: Racial, socioeconomic, and geographic disparities in opioid treatment access, harm reduction, naloxone distribution, and substance use policy.

subtopics.label: Neighborhood Disadvantage, Built Environment, and Health Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies investigating how neighborhood-level factors—including residential segregation, food environment, built environment, social deprivation, and environmental exposures—affect health outcomes and healthcare utilization. Includes research on geographic variation in Medicare spending and neighborhood social conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Residential segregation, food environment, built environment, and social deprivation as determinants of health outcomes and healthcare utilization.

subtopics.label: Health Disparities and Access to Care in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research examining healthcare access, disease burden, and health system capacity in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa, Haiti, and the Middle East. Includes studies on traditional healer integration, community-based interventions, and structural barriers to care in resource-limited settings.
subtopics.short_description: Healthcare access, disease burden, and structural barriers to care in sub-Saharan Africa, Haiti, and other resource-limited settings.

subtopics.label: Mental Health Disparities, Policy, and Integration
subtopics.description: Research on racial, ethnic, socioeconomic, and geographic disparities in mental health care access, treatment, and outcomes. Includes studies on mental health parity enforcement, behavioral health home programs, integration of mental health into primary care, and disparities in psychiatric treatment utilization.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, socioeconomic, and geographic gaps in mental health care access, parity enforcement, and integration into primary care settings.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Racial, Ethnic, and Socioeconomic Disparities
subtopics.description: Studies documenting racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in COVID-19 infection, severity, mortality, and vaccination, including the role of neighborhood disadvantage, overcrowded housing, and structural factors. Covers disparate impacts on vulnerable populations and community-level interventions to address COVID-19 inequities.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in COVID-19 infection, severity, mortality, and vaccination, shaped by structural and neighborhood factors.

subtopics.label: Measurement, Data Infrastructure, and NLP for Social Determinants of Health
subtopics.description: Research developing and validating methods to measure, extract, and utilize social determinants of health data from electronic health records, administrative data, and surveys. Includes natural language processing approaches, race/ethnicity data quality, algorithmic fairness, and computable biomedical knowledge for health equity.
subtopics.short_description: Methods for extracting and validating social determinants data from EHRs and surveys, including NLP, algorithmic fairness, and race/ethnicity data quality.

subtopics.label: Sex and Gender Disparities in Cardiovascular and Surgical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining sex-based differences in cardiovascular disease treatment, surgical outcomes, and access to care, including coronary artery bypass grafting, aortic procedures, cardiac valve surgery, and cardiogenic shock. Covers mechanisms of sex disparity such as intraoperative anemia and differential revascularization rates.
subtopics.display_name: Sex & Gender Disparities in Cardiovascular Care
subtopics.short_description: Sex-based differences in cardiovascular and surgical treatment access and outcomes, including bypass, valve surgery, and revascularization procedures.

subtopics.label: Diabetes Clinical Management and Glycemic Control
subtopics.description: Research on clinical management of type 1 and type 2 diabetes including pharmacotherapy (insulin, GLP-1 agonists, SGLT2 inhibitors, metformin), glycemic monitoring technologies (CGM, wearables), HbA1c outcomes, diabetic ketoacidosis, and diabetes care delivery in diverse populations and settings.
subtopics.short_description: Pharmacotherapy, continuous glucose monitoring, and care delivery for type 1 and type 2 diabetes across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Diabetic Neuropathy and Corneal Confocal Microscopy
subtopics.description: Studies using corneal confocal microscopy and quantitative sensory testing to diagnose, monitor, and predict diabetic peripheral and autonomic neuropathy, including associations with glycemic control, vitamin D, insulin resistance, and treatment interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Corneal confocal microscopy and sensory testing for diagnosing and monitoring diabetic peripheral and autonomic neuropathy.

subtopics.label: Obesity Treatment: Bariatric Surgery and Endoscopic Procedures
subtopics.description: Research on surgical and endoscopic interventions for obesity including Roux-en-Y gastric bypass, sleeve gastrectomy, duodenal switch, endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty, and intragastric balloons, covering weight loss outcomes, complications, GERD, and metabolic improvements.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical and endoscopic interventions for obesity, including gastric bypass, sleeve gastrectomy, and metabolic outcomes.

subtopics.label: Obesity Pharmacotherapy and Weight Management
subtopics.description: Research on anti-obesity medications including GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists (semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide), first- and second-generation anti-obesity drugs, and medical weight management programs, focusing on efficacy, safety, and long-term weight maintenance.
subtopics.short_description: GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists and other pharmacotherapies for obesity, focusing on efficacy, safety, and weight maintenance.

subtopics.label: Thyroid Disease: Diagnosis, Surgery, and Management
subtopics.description: Research on thyroid nodule evaluation (fine-needle aspiration, molecular testing, TI-RADS), thyroid cancer management (papillary, anaplastic, follicular, medullary), thyroidectomy outcomes, radioactive iodine therapy, and thyroid hormone replacement.
subtopics.short_description: Thyroid nodule evaluation, cancer management, thyroidectomy outcomes, and hormone replacement therapy.

subtopics.label: Adrenal and Parathyroid Disorders
subtopics.description: Research on adrenal disorders including primary hyperaldosteronism, adrenocortical carcinoma, Cushing syndrome, and pheochromocytoma, as well as parathyroid disease including hyperparathyroidism and parathyroid carcinoma, covering surgical management, outcomes, and molecular characterization.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management and molecular characterization of adrenal and parathyroid diseases, including Cushing syndrome and hyperparathyroidism.

subtopics.label: Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease and Metabolic Liver Conditions
subtopics.description: Research on NAFLD/MASLD pathogenesis, diagnosis, and management including liver fibrosis assessment, steatosis biomarkers, PNPLA3 variants, retinoic acid receptor pathways, alcohol-associated liver disease, and clinical care pathways for metabolic liver disease.
subtopics.display_name: Fatty Liver Disease & Metabolic Liver Conditions
subtopics.short_description: Pathogenesis, diagnosis, and clinical management of NAFLD/MASLD and alcohol-associated liver disease.

subtopics.label: Adipocyte Biology, Adipogenesis, and Adipose Tissue Function
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of adipocyte differentiation, lipid metabolism, thermogenesis, and adipokine signaling, including studies on SIRT1, PGC1α, PPAR pathways, adipose tissue browning, and the role of adipose dysfunction in metabolic disease.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of adipogenesis, lipid metabolism, thermogenesis, and adipokine signaling in metabolic disease.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Beta Cell Function and Insulin Secretion
subtopics.description: Research on pancreatic beta cell biology including insulin secretion mechanisms, beta cell differentiation and failure, ER stress responses, islet vascularization, and molecular targets for restoring beta cell function in type 1 and type 2 diabetes.
subtopics.display_name: Pancreatic Beta Cell Biology & Insulin Secretion
subtopics.short_description: Beta cell differentiation, insulin secretion mechanisms, ER stress, and molecular targets for restoring beta cell function.

subtopics.label: Diabetes and Cardiovascular Complications
subtopics.description: Research on cardiovascular outcomes in diabetes patients including myocardial infarction, heart failure, aortic valve replacement, coronary artery disease, arrhythmias, and the impact of glycemic control on cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular outcomes in diabetes, including heart failure, coronary artery disease, and glycemic control effects on mortality.

subtopics.label: Diabetes Epidemiology, Prevention, and Global Burden
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology of type 2 diabetes and prediabetes across global populations, mathematical modeling of diabetes burden, prevention programs, community health worker interventions, and population-level risk factor assessment.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level epidemiology, prevention programs, and global burden modeling for type 2 diabetes and prediabetes.

subtopics.label: Sphingolipid, Cholesterol, and Lipid Metabolism
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of sphingolipid metabolism (ceramide, sphingosine-1-phosphate), cholesterol homeostasis, and lipid signaling in endothelial cells and macrophages, with implications for cardiovascular disease, atherosclerosis, and metabolic dysfunction.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of sphingolipid and cholesterol signaling in vascular cells, with implications for atherosclerosis and metabolic disease.

subtopics.label: Sex Hormones, Hypothalamic Regulation, and Reproductive Endocrinology
subtopics.description: Research on estrogen receptor signaling in the hypothalamus and cardiovascular regulation, neuroactive steroids in reproductive mood disorders, gonadal hormone interactions with puberty and behavior, and reproductive endocrinology including AMH, IGF-1, and ovarian function.
subtopics.short_description: Estrogen receptor signaling, hypothalamic regulation, neuroactive steroids, and ovarian function in reproductive endocrinology.

subtopics.label: Glucose Transport, NAD+ Metabolism, and Cellular Energy Pathways
subtopics.description: Research on GLUT1/GLUT4 glucose transporter biology, NAD+ biosynthesis and precursors (NMN, NRH), mitochondrial metabolism, and metabolic interventions in glucose transporter deficiency syndromes and obesity-related metabolic dysfunction.
subtopics.short_description: GLUT1/GLUT4 transporter biology, NAD+ biosynthesis, and mitochondrial metabolism in obesity and glucose transporter disorders.

subtopics.label: Diabetes and Cancer Comorbidity Management
subtopics.description: Research on the co-management of diabetes and cancer, including diabetes care disruption after cancer diagnosis, racial disparities in diabetes care among cancer survivors, patient and provider perspectives on managing both conditions, and metabolic syndrome surveillance in cancer survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Diabetes care disruption, racial disparities, and metabolic surveillance among cancer survivors managing both conditions.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 and Metabolic Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Research examining the intersection of COVID-19 infection with metabolic conditions including diabetes, obesity, and hyperglycemia, covering disease severity, outcomes, post-acute sequelae, and pathophysiological mechanisms such as adipose tissue infectivity and insulin resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Intersection of COVID-19 with diabetes, obesity, and hyperglycemia, including disease severity and post-acute metabolic sequelae.

subtopics.label: HIV and Cardiometabolic Complications
subtopics.description: Studies investigating cardiometabolic risk factors, body composition changes, cardiovascular disease, renal function, and metabolic dysregulation in people living with HIV, including effects of antiretroviral therapy and metformin interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular risk, body composition changes, and metabolic dysregulation in people living with HIV on antiretroviral therapy.

subtopics.label: Obesity-Related Comorbidities and Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the clinical consequences of obesity across multiple organ systems and life stages, including maternal morbidity, pediatric complications, sleep apnea, pelvic floor disorders, and associations with brain structure and function.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical consequences of obesity across organ systems and life stages, including maternal, pediatric, and neurological complications.

subtopics.label: Wearable Technology and Digital Health for Diabetes Monitoring
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating AI-driven wearable devices, continuous glucose monitoring, and machine learning models for blood glucose prediction, diabetes self-management, and longitudinal monitoring of patients with diabetes.
subtopics.short_description: AI-driven wearables, continuous glucose monitoring, and machine learning for diabetes self-management and blood glucose prediction.

subtopics.label: Peer Support and Behavioral Interventions for Diabetes Self-Management
subtopics.description: Research on peer-delivered cognitive behavioral therapy, storytelling programs, and community-based interventions designed to improve diabetes self-management, medication adherence, pain outcomes, and psychosocial functioning.
subtopics.short_description: Community-based and peer-delivered programs improving diabetes self-management, medication adherence, and psychosocial outcomes.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular Risk Factors, Disparities, and Prevention
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and clinical studies examining cardiovascular disease risk factors, racial and socioeconomic disparities in CVD prevention and treatment, hypertension management, and lipid-lowering therapy across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Racial and socioeconomic disparities in cardiovascular disease prevention, hypertension management, and lipid-lowering therapy.

subtopics.label: Diabetic Microvascular Complications and Retinopathy
subtopics.description: Studies on microvascular complications of diabetes including retinopathy, nephropathy, and neuropathy, with emphasis on screening, prevalence in diverse populations, vitamin D associations, and corneal confocal microscopy findings.
subtopics.short_description: Screening and prevalence of diabetic retinopathy, nephropathy, and neuropathy across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome, Diet, and Host Metabolic Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on how gut microbial communities, dietary patterns, and microbiota-derived metabolites regulate host metabolism, immune function, bile acid signaling, and nutrient homeostasis.
subtopics.short_description: Gut microbial communities, dietary patterns, and microbiota-derived metabolites regulating host metabolism and immune function.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Dysregulation and Alzheimer's Disease
subtopics.description: Studies investigating the metabolic underpinnings of Alzheimer's disease, including brain metabolic alterations, lipidomic profiles, mitochondrial bioenergetics, ketogenic diet effects, and metabolic syndrome biomarkers in cognitive decline.
subtopics.short_description: Brain metabolic alterations, lipidomics, mitochondrial bioenergetics, and metabolic syndrome biomarkers in cognitive decline.

subtopics.label: Hyperlipidemia Management in Inflammatory Arthritis
subtopics.description: Research on barriers, facilitators, and clinical practices for screening and treating hyperlipidemia and cardiovascular risk in patients with rheumatoid arthritis and other inflammatory joint diseases.
subtopics.short_description: Barriers and clinical practices for cardiovascular risk screening and lipid treatment in rheumatoid arthritis patients.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Conditions and Pregnancy Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining the impact of metabolic conditions—including gestational diabetes, obesity, hypertension, and thyroid disorders—on maternal and neonatal outcomes, as well as glucose challenge testing and postpartum cardiovascular risk.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of gestational diabetes, obesity, and thyroid disorders on maternal, neonatal, and postpartum cardiovascular outcomes.

subtopics.label: Obesity, Adiposity, and Brain/Neurological Function
subtopics.description: Research linking body mass index, adiposity, and metabolic factors to brain structure, white matter hyperintensities, hippocampal vasoreactivity, cognitive function, and neurological outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Links between BMI, adiposity, and metabolic factors with brain structure, white matter, hippocampal function, and cognition.

subtopics.label: Glucagon Receptor Structure and Signaling
subtopics.description: Structural and mechanistic studies of glucagon receptor and related family B GPCR signaling, including cryo-EM characterization, allosteric modulation by RAMPs, and G protein activation mechanisms relevant to metabolic regulation.
subtopics.short_description: Cryo-EM characterization, allosteric modulation, and G protein activation mechanisms of glucagon and family B GPCR receptors.

subtopics.label: Diabetes Healthcare Utilization, Access, and Quality of Care
subtopics.description: Studies on healthcare utilization patterns, care fragmentation, insurance coverage, Medicaid expansion effects, and quality improvement initiatives for diabetes and related metabolic conditions in diverse healthcare settings.
subtopics.display_name: Diabetes Healthcare Access & Quality of Care
subtopics.short_description: Healthcare utilization, care fragmentation, insurance coverage, and quality improvement for diabetes in diverse settings.

subtopics.label: FGF23, Vitamin D, and Mineral Homeostasis in Kidney Disease
subtopics.description: Research on fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23), vitamin D metabolism, and mineral homeostasis in the context of chronic kidney disease, dietary influences, and renal tubular regulation.
subtopics.short_description: FGF23 signaling, vitamin D metabolism, and mineral homeostasis in chronic kidney disease and renal tubular regulation.

subtopics.label: Amyloid-β and Tau Pathology in Alzheimer's Disease
subtopics.description: Research investigating the molecular mechanisms of amyloid-β production, aggregation, and clearance, tau phosphorylation, post-translational modifications, fibril formation, and the interplay between amyloid and tau pathologies in Alzheimer's disease and related tauopathies.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of amyloid-β aggregation, tau phosphorylation, and amyloid-tau interplay in Alzheimer's and related tauopathies.

subtopics.label: Neuroinflammation and Microglial Biology in Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Studies examining microglial activation, TREM2 signaling, NF-κB pathways, progranulin deficiency, cannabinoid receptor modulation, and neuroinflammatory mechanisms including cGAS-STING and cytokine signaling in Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and ALS.
subtopics.short_description: Microglial activation, TREM2 signaling, and neuroinflammatory pathways in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS.

subtopics.label: Alpha-Synuclein Biology and LRRK2 Mechanisms in Parkinson's Disease
subtopics.description: Research on alpha-synuclein aggregation, membrane interactions, vesicle trafficking, lysosomal exocytosis, and the structural biology and kinase activity of LRRK1/LRRK2 including microtubule interactions and inhibitor development relevant to Parkinson's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Alpha-synuclein aggregation, vesicle trafficking, and LRRK2 kinase biology as therapeutic targets in Parkinson's disease.

subtopics.label: Blood-Brain Barrier Dysfunction and Neurovascular Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Studies on blood-brain barrier permeability, neurovascular coupling, tPA and plasminogen activator pathways, border-associated macrophages, cerebral amyloid angiopathy, and endothelial dysfunction in aging and neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer's disease.
subtopics.short_description: BBB permeability, neurovascular coupling, and endothelial dysfunction in aging and neurodegenerative disease.

subtopics.label: Glymphatic System, CSF Clearance, and Brain Fluid Dynamics
subtopics.description: Research on glymphatic clearance pathways, perivascular space dynamics, CSF flow, interstitial fluid transport, and their associations with amyloid-β deposition, tau accumulation, and neurodegeneration measured via DTI-ALPS, MRI, and PET imaging.
subtopics.short_description: Glymphatic and perivascular clearance of amyloid-β and tau, assessed via MRI, PET, and DTI-ALPS imaging.

subtopics.label: Neuroimaging Biomarkers and Quantitative MRI/PET Methods
subtopics.description: Development and application of quantitative neuroimaging techniques including quantitative susceptibility mapping, arterial spin labeling, amyloid and tau PET, FDG-PET statistical parametric mapping, and brain oxygen metabolism mapping for diagnosing and monitoring neurodegenerative diseases.
subtopics.short_description: Quantitative MRI and PET techniques for diagnosing and monitoring neurodegeneration, including amyloid, tau, and FDG-PET.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy as Biomarker in Neurodegeneration and Multiple Sclerosis
subtopics.description: Studies using corneal confocal microscopy and retinal nerve fiber analysis to detect and monitor neurodegeneration in multiple sclerosis, mild cognitive impairment, dementia, and Parkinson's disease, establishing corneal nerve loss as a peripheral biomarker of central neurodegeneration.
subtopics.display_name: Corneal Confocal Microscopy as Neural Biomarker
subtopics.short_description: Corneal nerve loss detected by confocal microscopy as a peripheral biomarker of neurodegeneration in MS, dementia, and Parkinson's.

subtopics.label: AAV Gene Therapy for Neurodegeneration including Batten Disease and Alzheimer's
subtopics.description: Research on adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated gene therapy for neurological diseases including CLN2 Batten disease, metachromatic leukodystrophy, Friedreich's ataxia, and Alzheimer's disease, covering vector design, safety, biodistribution, and long-term clinical outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: AAV Gene Therapy for Neurological Disease
subtopics.short_description: AAV-mediated gene therapy for Batten disease, leukodystrophy, Friedreich's ataxia, and Alzheimer's, covering safety and clinical outcomes.

subtopics.label: Computational Drug Repurposing and Knowledge Graph Approaches for Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Application of machine learning, knowledge graphs, biomedical knowledge hubs, and multi-omic frameworks to identify and validate drug repurposing candidates for Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and ALS, including target trial emulation with real-world data.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning and knowledge graph frameworks identifying repurposed drug candidates for Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Dysregulation and Bioenergetics in Alzheimer's Disease
subtopics.description: Studies on metabolic alterations in Alzheimer's disease including lipid dysregulation, mitochondrial succinylation, ketogenic and Mediterranean diets, triglyceride metabolism, bioenergetic capacity, and metabolomic profiling of brain and serum in AD and MCI.
subtopics.short_description: Lipid dysregulation, mitochondrial bioenergetics, ketogenic diet effects, and metabolomic profiling in Alzheimer's disease and MCI.

subtopics.label: Parkinson's Disease Clinical Management: Dysphagia, Sleep, and DBS
subtopics.description: Clinical research on Parkinson's disease management including respiratory-swallow coordination, dysphagia assessment, cough testing, deep brain stimulation timing and programming practices, sleep disturbances, and light therapy interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical management of Parkinson's disease including dysphagia, sleep disturbances, deep brain stimulation, and light therapy.

subtopics.label: ALS, TDP-43 Pathology, and Frontotemporal Dementia Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of ALS and frontotemporal dementia including TDP-43 dysregulation in astrocytes, SOD1 toxicity, transsulfuration pathway alterations, CHCHD10/CHCHD2 amyloid fibrils, and splicing dysregulation in FTD brain tissue.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of ALS and FTD, including TDP-43 dysregulation, SOD1 toxicity, and splicing defects in disease tissue.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning Subtyping and Progression Modeling in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Disease
subtopics.description: Data-driven studies using machine learning, clustering, and electronic health records to identify disease subphenotypes, model progression trajectories, and predict cognitive decline in Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease cohorts.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning and clustering approaches to identify subphenotypes and model cognitive decline trajectories in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's.

subtopics.label: Dementia Caregiving, Palliative Care, and Psychosocial Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on psychosocial factors, caregiver burden, self-efficacy, palliative care needs, pain assessment, and technology-based interventions supporting individuals with dementia and their caregivers in community and clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Caregiver burden, psychosocial interventions, palliative care needs, and technology-based support for people living with dementia.

subtopics.label: Systemic and Vascular Risk Factors for Cognitive Decline and Dementia
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and clinical studies examining associations between systemic conditions—including liver fibrosis, cardiovascular disease, hypertension, intracranial hemorrhage, and metabolic syndrome—and the risk or progression of dementia and cognitive decline.
subtopics.display_name: Systemic & Vascular Risk Factors for Dementia
subtopics.short_description: Associations between cardiovascular disease, metabolic syndrome, liver fibrosis, and risk of dementia or cognitive decline.

subtopics.label: HIV-Associated Neurocognitive Impairment and Brain Pathology
subtopics.description: Research on HIV-related cognitive dysfunction, neuroinflammation, and brain abnormalities including roles of anti-CD4 IgG, extracellular vesicles, cell-free mitochondrial DNA, Galectin-9, and cellular rejuvenation strategies in treated older adults with HIV.
subtopics.short_description: HIV-related cognitive dysfunction, neuroinflammation, and brain pathology in treated older adults living with HIV.

subtopics.label: Computerized Cognitive and Functional Skills Training in Mild Cognitive Impairment
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating computerized cognitive training and functional skills training programs in older adults with and without mild cognitive impairment, including predictors of mastery, performance-based outcomes, and awareness of deficits.
subtopics.display_name: Cognitive Training in Mild Cognitive Impairment
subtopics.short_description: Computerized cognitive and functional skills training programs for older adults with mild cognitive impairment and related outcomes.

subtopics.label: Mitochondrial Complex I Function and Mitochondrial Disease Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research quantifying mitochondrial complex I content and investigating mitochondrial disease manifestations in relation to transcriptome location, including multi-omic analyses of cardiac mitochondrial stress in frataxin deficiency models.
subtopics.short_description: Mitochondrial complex I function, multi-omic analyses of mitochondrial stress, and disease mechanisms in frataxin deficiency models.

subtopics.label: Niemann-Pick Type C Disease: Cholesterol Storage and Pharmacological Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies on Niemann-Pick type C1 disease mechanisms and therapeutic strategies, including HSP90 inhibitors reducing cholesterol storage in NPC1 mutant fibroblasts and pharmacological chaperone effects of itraconazole and posaconazole after washout.
subtopics.short_description: NPC1 disease mechanisms and pharmacological interventions, including HSP90 inhibitors and chaperone effects on cholesterol storage.

subtopics.label: Choroid Plexus Pathology and Calcification in Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Research examining choroid plexus volume, calcification, and their associations with cortical microglial activation, APOE ε4 status, and neurodegeneration biomarkers using multimodal PET, CT, and MRI approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Choroid plexus volume and calcification linked to microglial activation, APOE ε4 status, and neurodegeneration biomarkers via multimodal imaging.

subtopics.label: Depression, Brain Aging, and Cognitive Decline in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Studies investigating the relationship between depressive symptoms, accelerated brain aging, and cognitive decline in older adults, including therapeutic interventions such as Problem Adaptation Therapy for comorbid depression and cognitive impairment.
subtopics.short_description: Depressive symptoms, accelerated brain aging, and cognitive decline in older adults, including targeted psychotherapeutic interventions.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 and SARS-CoV-2 Neurological Complications
subtopics.description: Research on neurological consequences of SARS-CoV-2 infection including dopaminergic neuron senescence, outcomes of Parkinson's disease patients hospitalized with COVID-19, and implications for neurodegenerative disease progression.
subtopics.short_description: Neurological consequences of SARS-CoV-2 infection, including dopaminergic neuron senescence and implications for Parkinson's disease.

subtopics.label: Peripheral Immune Dysregulation and Systemic Inflammation in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Disease
subtopics.description: Studies linking peripheral immune cell imbalances, leukocytosis, and systemic inflammatory markers to amyloid deposition, cognitive decline, and disease progression in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Peripheral immune imbalances and systemic inflammation linked to amyloid deposition and disease progression in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's.

subtopics.label: Novel Molecular Targets and Small Molecule Therapeutics for Alzheimer's Disease
subtopics.description: Research identifying and validating novel molecular targets for Alzheimer's disease treatment, including CK1γ2 activation to reduce amyloid, adenosine deficiency driving synaptic hyperexcitability, transposable element dysregulation, and sex-specific demyelination via Tlr7.
subtopics.display_name: Novel Molecular Targets for Alzheimer's Therapy
subtopics.short_description: Identification and validation of new Alzheimer's drug targets, including CK1δ/γ, adenosine pathways, and transposable element dysregulation.

subtopics.label: Metabolic and Synaptic Mechanisms in Parkinson's Disease Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Studies on metabolic deficits and synaptic biology in Parkinson's disease, including phosphoglycerate kinase as a leverage point for neuronal ATP production, alpha-synuclein modulation by beta- and gamma-synucleins, and cysteine string protein-alpha aggregation via iron-sulfur cluster binding.
subtopics.short_description: Neuronal ATP production, synuclein modulation, and synaptic protein aggregation as metabolic leverage points in Parkinson's disease.

subtopics.label: Advanced MRI Methods for Brain Tissue Characterization and Longitudinal Analysis
subtopics.description: Development and validation of advanced MRI techniques including quantitative susceptibility mapping, myelin volume fraction mapping from multi-echo gradient echo data, landmark-guided spatial normalization, and learning-based longitudinal image change inference for brain research.
subtopics.display_name: Advanced MRI Methods for Brain Characterization
subtopics.short_description: Quantitative susceptibility mapping, myelin volume fraction mapping, and learning-based longitudinal MRI analysis for brain research.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell and Multi-Omic Genomics of Brain Cell Types and Disease
subtopics.description: High-resolution single-cell and multi-omic studies characterizing splicing patterns, chromatin accessibility, transcriptome diversity, and DNA damage across brain cell types in development, aging, and neurological disease states.
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell and multi-omic profiling of splicing, chromatin accessibility, and transcriptome diversity across brain cell types in disease and aging.

subtopics.label: Traumatic Brain Injury, Tau Pathology, and CTE
subtopics.description: Research on traumatic brain injury consequences including altered brain fluid clearance measured by PET, tau PET off-target binding linked to CTE development, and axon-T cell feedback loops enhancing neuroinflammation and axon degeneration.
subtopics.short_description: TBI consequences including altered brain fluid clearance, tau PET binding linked to CTE, and neuroinflammatory axon degeneration.

subtopics.label: Computational Transcriptomic Approaches to Brain Aging and Age-Modulating Compounds
subtopics.description: Computational frameworks leveraging transcriptional age signatures to identify age-modulating compounds in neurons and fibroblasts, and machine learning approaches for neuroimaging sub-cohort analysis and interpretability in aging and neurodegeneration research.
subtopics.short_description: Transcriptional age signatures and machine learning frameworks identifying age-modulating compounds and neuroimaging patterns in brain aging.

subtopics.label: IVF and Assisted Reproductive Technology Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on clinical outcomes of in vitro fertilization and assisted reproductive technologies, including embryo transfer protocols, ovarian stimulation, blastocyst quality, ploidy assessment, sperm parameters, and factors affecting live birth rates.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical outcomes of in vitro fertilization, embryo transfer, ovarian stimulation, and factors affecting live birth rates.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Treatment and Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on systemic therapies, surgical interventions, and clinical outcomes in breast cancer, including chemotherapy regimens, endocrine therapy, targeted agents, immunotherapy, and quality of life during and after treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Systemic therapies, surgical interventions, and quality of life outcomes across breast cancer treatment modalities.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Risk Assessment and Screening
subtopics.description: Research on mammographic screening modalities, breast density, polygenic risk scores, biomarkers, and risk factors for breast cancer detection and prevention, including disparities in screening access and uptake.
subtopics.short_description: Mammographic screening, breast density, polygenic risk scores, and disparities in breast cancer detection and prevention.

subtopics.label: Breast Reconstruction and Surgical Techniques
subtopics.description: Research on postmastectomy breast reconstruction methods including implant-based and autologous approaches, complications such as capsular contracture, sensory outcomes, and disparities in reconstruction access.
subtopics.short_description: Postmastectomy reconstruction methods, implant and autologous approaches, complications, and disparities in access.

subtopics.label: Gynecologic Oncology: Ovarian, Endometrial, and Cervical Cancers
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, molecular characterization, treatment, and outcomes of gynecologic cancers including ovarian, endometrial, and cervical cancers, as well as genetic risk assessment and fertility-sparing approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, molecular characterization, and treatment of ovarian, endometrial, and cervical cancers, including fertility-sparing approaches.

subtopics.label: Perinatal Mental Health and Reproductive Psychiatry
subtopics.description: Research on anxiety, depression, and psychiatric conditions during pregnancy and the postpartum period, including screening tools, neurobiological mechanisms, treatment approaches, and psychosocial interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Anxiety, depression, and psychiatric conditions during pregnancy and postpartum, including screening and treatment approaches.

subtopics.label: Obstetric Complications, Labor Management, and Maternal Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on obstetric complications including hypertensive disorders, placenta accreta spectrum, labor induction and augmentation, cesarean delivery, and maternal morbidity and mortality, with emphasis on racial and socioeconomic disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Hypertensive disorders, labor management, cesarean delivery, and maternal morbidity with attention to racial and socioeconomic disparities.

subtopics.label: Male Infertility, Sperm Biology, and Contraception
subtopics.description: Research on male infertility evaluation and treatment including sperm function, genetic causes of azoospermia, sperm capacitation biology, and development of non-hormonal male contraceptives targeting soluble adenylyl cyclase.
subtopics.short_description: Sperm function, genetic causes of azoospermia, and development of non-hormonal male contraceptives.

subtopics.label: Reproductive Endocrinology, Ovarian Biology, and Folliculogenesis
subtopics.description: Research on ovarian physiology including follicle development, theca cell biology, anti-Müllerian hormone, ovarian xenograft models, and hormonal regulation of reproductive function including progesterone receptor signaling and meiosis.
subtopics.short_description: Follicle development, anti-Müllerian hormone, theca cell biology, and hormonal regulation of reproductive function.

subtopics.label: Uterine Fibroids, Endometriosis, and Pelvic Floor Disorders
subtopics.description: Research on benign uterine and pelvic conditions including fibroids, endometriosis, pelvic organ prolapse, stress urinary incontinence, and pelvic floor dysfunction, encompassing surgical management and patient-reported outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Benign uterine and pelvic conditions including fibroids, endometriosis, prolapse, and pelvic floor dysfunction.

subtopics.label: Cervical Cancer Screening, HPV, and Gynecologic Cytology
subtopics.description: Research on cervical cancer prevention including HPV testing, Papanicolaou test practices, colposcopy, high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions, and HPV vaccination uptake and efficacy.
subtopics.short_description: HPV testing, Papanicolaou practices, colposcopy, and HPV vaccination uptake and efficacy for cervical cancer prevention.

subtopics.label: Sex Differences in Cardiovascular Disease and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on sex-based disparities in cardiovascular conditions including coronary artery bypass grafting, myocardial infarction, Takotsubo syndrome, aortic disease, and cardiac interventions, examining mechanisms and outcomes differences between women and men.
subtopics.short_description: Sex-based disparities in coronary artery disease, myocardial infarction, aortic disease, and cardiac intervention outcomes.

subtopics.label: Contraception, Abortion, and Reproductive Rights
subtopics.description: Research on contraceptive methods and counseling, abortion services and stigma, reproductive autonomy, and policy and legal dimensions of reproductive healthcare access including family planning in low-resource settings.
subtopics.short_description: Contraceptive methods, abortion services, reproductive autonomy, and policy dimensions of reproductive healthcare access.

subtopics.label: Menopause, Perimenopause, and Female Hormonal Neurobiology
subtopics.description: Research on perimenopausal and menopausal physiology including estrogen receptor signaling in the brain and cardiovascular system, neuroinflammation, hypothalamic function, and sex hormone effects on neurological and metabolic outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Perimenopausal physiology, estrogen receptor signaling in the brain, and sex hormone effects on neurological and metabolic outcomes.

subtopics.label: Infectious Disease in Pregnancy: Screening, Prevention, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on infectious diseases during pregnancy including hepatitis B and C, tuberculosis, COVID-19, dengue, and sexually transmitted infections, covering screening strategies, maternal-fetal transmission, vaccination, and clinical outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Screening, prevention, and outcomes for hepatitis, tuberculosis, COVID-19, and STIs during pregnancy, including maternal-fetal transmission.

subtopics.label: Herpes Simplex Virus and STI Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies on herpes simplex virus types 1 and 2 and other sexually transmitted infections including gonorrhea and chlamydia, covering global prevalence, incidence trends, vaccination modeling, and regional burden.
subtopics.short_description: Global prevalence, incidence trends, and regional burden of herpes simplex virus and other sexually transmitted infections.

subtopics.label: Maternal Cytomegalovirus and Congenital Infection
subtopics.description: Studies on maternal cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection, immune responses, antibody correlates of protection, and risk of congenital transmission, including vaccine development and animal models.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal CMV immune responses, antibody correlates of protection, congenital transmission risk, and vaccine development.

subtopics.label: Penicillin Allergy Management in Pregnancy
subtopics.description: Research on the prevalence, management, and clinical consequences of reported penicillin allergy in pregnant women, including antibiotic prophylaxis for Group B Streptococcus, maternal and neonatal outcomes, and allergy evaluation programs.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence and clinical consequences of reported penicillin allergy in pregnant women, including GBS prophylaxis and allergy evaluation.

subtopics.label: Gestational Diabetes: Epidemiology, Screening, and Management
subtopics.description: Studies on gestational diabetes mellitus including prevalence in diverse populations, screening methods, community health worker interventions, online support, glucose monitoring, and associations with adverse pregnancy outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, screening methods, glucose monitoring, and community interventions for gestational diabetes across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Sex Differences in Neurobiology, Brain Function, and Behavior
subtopics.description: Research examining sex-based differences in brain structure, function, gene expression, mitochondrial activity, and behavioral outcomes including depression, stress responses, and resting-state connectivity.
subtopics.short_description: Sex-based differences in brain structure, gene expression, mitochondrial activity, and behavioral outcomes including depression and stress.

subtopics.label: Sex Differences in Surgical and Vascular Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining sex-based disparities in outcomes following vascular and surgical procedures including aortic aneurysm repair, endovascular interventions, lower extremity bypass, hip arthroplasty, and cardiac surgery.
subtopics.display_name: Sex Differences in Surgical & Vascular Outcomes
subtopics.short_description: Sex-based disparities in outcomes following vascular, orthopedic, and cardiac surgical procedures.

subtopics.label: Autoimmune and Chronic Disease Management in Pregnancy
subtopics.description: Research on managing autoimmune and chronic conditions during pregnancy including lupus, antiphospholipid syndrome, inflammatory bowel disease, celiac disease, and polycystic kidney disease, covering maternal and fetal outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Management of lupus, antiphospholipid syndrome, inflammatory bowel disease, and other chronic conditions during pregnancy.

subtopics.label: Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Biology and Racial Disparities
subtopics.description: Studies on the molecular biology, genetic ancestry-associated gene expression, metabolic heterogeneity, and racial disparities in triple-negative and inflammatory breast cancer, including targeted therapeutic approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular biology, ancestry-associated gene expression, and racial disparities in triple-negative and inflammatory breast cancer.

subtopics.label: Breast Imaging, Radiology Practice, and Patient-Centered Care
subtopics.description: Research on breast imaging modalities, radiology consultation services, patient-reported outcomes, COVID-19 impacts on breast imaging practice, and radiologic-pathologic correlations in breast lesions.
subtopics.short_description: Breast imaging modalities, patient-reported outcomes, radiologic-pathologic correlations, and COVID-19 impacts on imaging practice.

subtopics.label: Substance Use During Pregnancy: Cannabis, Alcohol, and Policy
subtopics.description: Studies on substance use during pregnancy including cannabis use disorder, alcohol and tobacco use, periconceptional substance use, and policy frameworks for drug treatment access in pregnant populations.
subtopics.short_description: Cannabis, alcohol, and tobacco use during pregnancy, periconceptional exposure, and policy frameworks for treatment access.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 in Pregnancy: Outcomes, Vaccination, and Placental Pathology
subtopics.description: Research on SARS-CoV-2 infection and vaccination during pregnancy, including maternal and neonatal outcomes, placental pathology, antibody responses, long COVID, and obstetric intensive care management.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal and neonatal outcomes, placental pathology, antibody responses, and vaccination safety for SARS-CoV-2 in pregnancy.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Reproductive and Gynecologic Health
subtopics.description: Research addressing reproductive health in adolescents including pelvic examinations, privacy laws, reproductive counseling for girls with epilepsy, vulvar conditions, and differences in sex development.
subtopics.short_description: Reproductive health in adolescents including counseling, vulvar conditions, differences in sex development, and privacy considerations.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Survivorship, Comorbidities, and Quality of Life
subtopics.description: Studies on quality of life, psychosocial well-being, weight management, diabetes co-management, endocrine therapy side effects, and survivorship challenges in breast cancer patients and survivors.
subtopics.display_name: Breast Cancer Survivorship & Quality of Life
subtopics.short_description: Psychosocial well-being, endocrine therapy side effects, comorbidity management, and survivorship challenges after breast cancer.

subtopics.label: Cellular Senescence and Molecular Aging Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms of aging including cellular senescence, epigenetic clocks, DNA methylation, NAD+ metabolism, telomere biology, and senolytic interventions. Covers pathways such as mTOR, SIRT1/SIRT6, STAT signaling, and age-related genomic instability.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular pathways of aging including senescence, epigenetic clocks, NAD+ metabolism, telomere biology, and senolytic interventions.

subtopics.label: Alzheimer's Disease and Neurodegenerative Pathology
subtopics.description: Research on Alzheimer's disease biomarkers (amyloid-beta, tau, neuroinflammation), neuroimaging, disease mechanisms including microglial activation and neurovascular dysfunction, and therapeutic targets. Includes studies on disease progression, cognitive decline, and preclinical detection.
subtopics.short_description: Biomarkers, disease mechanisms, and therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease and related neurodegenerative conditions.

subtopics.label: Brain Imaging, Cerebrovascular Disease, and Cognitive Impairment
subtopics.description: Studies using neuroimaging (MRI, PET, QSM) to assess cerebrovascular pathology, white matter hyperintensities, brain iron deposition, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, glymphatic function, and their associations with cognitive impairment and dementia. Includes corneal nerve imaging as a surrogate biomarker.
subtopics.short_description: Neuroimaging of cerebrovascular disease, white matter changes, and blood-brain barrier dysfunction linked to cognitive impairment.

subtopics.label: Late-Life Depression, Mental Health, and Psychotherapy
subtopics.description: Research on depression in older adults including neurobiological correlates, psychotherapy interventions (PATH, Engage & Connect, PROTECT), cognitive-behavioral approaches, and treatment of late-life depression with executive dysfunction. Covers suicidal ideation, anhedonia, and mental health service delivery in geriatric populations.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiological correlates and psychotherapy interventions for depression, executive dysfunction, and mental health in older adults.

subtopics.label: Elder Mistreatment, Abuse, and Adult Protective Services
subtopics.description: Research on identification, assessment, prevention, and response to elder mistreatment including physical abuse, financial exploitation, and neglect. Covers emergency department-based response teams, screening tools, legal adjudication, caregiver risk factors, and psychosocial interventions for abuse victims.
subtopics.short_description: Assessment, prevention, and response to elder abuse, financial exploitation, and neglect across clinical and legal settings.

subtopics.label: Frailty, Geriatric Syndromes, and Functional Decline
subtopics.description: Studies on frailty assessment and its clinical consequences including falls, dysphagia, polypharmacy, delirium, and functional decline in older adults. Covers frailty as a predictor of surgical outcomes, heart failure prognosis, and geriatric vulnerabilities across disease contexts.
subtopics.short_description: Frailty assessment and its clinical consequences including falls, delirium, polypharmacy, and functional decline in older adults.

subtopics.label: Nursing Home Quality, Staffing, and Long-Term Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Research on nursing home and long-term care quality, staffing levels, ownership structures (private equity, REITs), clinician roles (SNFists), palliative care delivery, and resident outcomes. Includes studies on COVID-19 impacts on nursing homes and workforce challenges in long-term care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Quality, staffing, ownership structures, and resident outcomes in nursing homes and long-term care settings.

subtopics.label: Dementia Caregiving, Family Caregiver Support, and Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on family caregivers of persons with dementia and older adults, including caregiver burden, self-efficacy, psychosocial interventions, pain and health of caregivers, and integration of caregiver needs into primary care. Covers dementia care coordination gaps and hospice care for dementia patients.
subtopics.short_description: Caregiver burden, psychosocial interventions, and care coordination for family caregivers of persons with dementia.

subtopics.label: Technology, Cognitive Training, and Digital Health for Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on technology-based interventions for cognitive training, functional skills, and social engagement in older adults, including adherence to digital programs, wearable devices, virtual reality, and mobile health applications. Covers the digital divide, older adults' technology adoption, and assistive technologies for aging in place.
subtopics.short_description: Technology-based interventions for cognitive training, social engagement, and aging in place among older adults.

subtopics.label: Aging with HIV: Geriatric Syndromes, Inflammation, and Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Research on aging-related complications in people living with HIV including frailty, cognitive impairment, inflammation, epigenetic aging, and comorbidities. Covers biomarkers of aging (cell-free mitochondrial DNA, epigenetic clocks), geriatric assessment, and interventions such as metformin in older HIV-positive adults.
subtopics.short_description: Frailty, cognitive impairment, inflammation, and epigenetic aging in older adults living with HIV.

subtopics.label: Social Determinants of Health, Disparities, and Care Fragmentation
subtopics.description: Studies examining how social determinants of health, neighborhood conditions, race, and care fragmentation affect health outcomes in older adults including hospitalization, stroke, heart failure, and mortality. Covers racial disparities in care quality, Medicare spending variation, and preventable adverse events.
subtopics.short_description: Neighborhood conditions, race, and care fragmentation as drivers of health outcomes and disparities in older adults.

subtopics.label: Aging, Pulmonary Disease, and Age-Related Immune Dysfunction
subtopics.description: Research on age-related changes in lung biology and immunity including interstitial lung abnormalities, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, impaired antiviral responses in aged lungs, and senescence-related lung pathology. Covers aging effects on pneumococcal and influenza immunity and COVID-19 lung senescence.
subtopics.short_description: Age-related lung biology, interstitial lung disease, and impaired immune responses including senescence-driven pulmonary pathology.

subtopics.label: Cancer Biology, Aging, and Oncology in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on the intersection of aging and cancer including age-related molecular changes promoting tumor progression (methylmalonic acid, clonal hematopoiesis), geriatric assessment in oncology, cancer survivorship, and treatment outcomes in older cancer patients. Covers pan-cancer aging signatures and senescence in cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular aging changes promoting cancer, geriatric oncology assessment, and treatment outcomes in older cancer patients.

subtopics.label: Heart Failure, Cardiovascular Disease, and Geriatric Cardiology
subtopics.description: Research on heart failure and cardiovascular disease in older adults including polypharmacy, deprescribing, geriatric vulnerabilities, home health care transitions, social determinants of outcomes, and cognitive decline after heart failure. Covers geriatric cardiology practice and management of HFpEF and HFrEF in elderly populations.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular disease management in older adults, including polypharmacy, care transitions, and cognitive decline after heart failure.

subtopics.label: Stroke, Cerebrovascular Events, and Neurological Outcomes in Aging
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and clinical research on ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke in older adults including risk factors, post-stroke cognitive and functional outcomes, cerebral amyloid angiopathy, subdural hemorrhage, and long-term stroke sequelae. Covers disparities in stroke care and post-stroke depression.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, risk factors, and post-stroke cognitive and functional outcomes in older adults, including care disparities.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Outcomes, Risk Factors, and Age-Related Vulnerability
subtopics.description: Research examining how age, comorbidities, and demographic factors influence COVID-19 severity, hospitalization, mortality, and post-discharge outcomes, including immune response and vaccination effects in older adults.
subtopics.short_description: Age, comorbidities, and immune response as determinants of COVID-19 severity, hospitalization, and mortality in older adults.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Neurological Complications and Cognitive Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Studies investigating cognitive deficits, neurological sequelae, and functional recovery in COVID-19 patients, including rehabilitation outcomes and the impact of SARS-CoV-2 on brain function and dopaminergic neurons.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive deficits, brain dysfunction, and functional recovery following SARS-CoV-2 infection.

subtopics.label: Pain Management, Chronic Pain, and Musculoskeletal Conditions in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on pain assessment, treatment approaches, and the psychological and functional impact of chronic pain and musculoskeletal conditions in older adults, including beliefs, interventions, and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Pain assessment, treatment approaches, and functional impact of chronic pain and musculoskeletal conditions in older adults.

subtopics.label: Social Isolation, Loneliness, and Well-Being in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Studies examining the health consequences of social isolation and loneliness in older adults, including associations with mortality, dementia, depression, and the role of social support and physical activity.
subtopics.short_description: Health consequences of social isolation and loneliness in older adults, including links to mortality, dementia, and depression.

subtopics.label: Geriatric Emergency Medicine, Trauma, and Acute Care
subtopics.description: Research on emergency department care, trauma outcomes, and acute care delivery for older adults, including geriatric emergency fellowships, fall-related injuries, burn injuries, and inclusion of older adults in clinical research.
subtopics.short_description: Emergency department care, trauma outcomes, and acute care delivery for older adults including fall-related and burn injuries.

subtopics.label: Liver Fibrosis, Hepatic Metabolism, and Cognitive Outcomes in Aging
subtopics.description: Studies linking liver fibrosis, hepatic steatosis, and metabolic dysfunction to cognitive impairment, dementia risk, and brain structural changes in aging populations.
subtopics.short_description: Links between hepatic fibrosis, steatosis, and metabolic dysfunction and cognitive impairment or dementia risk in aging.

subtopics.label: Blood-Brain Barrier Integrity and Neurovascular Dysfunction in Aging and Disease
subtopics.description: Research investigating blood-brain barrier permeability, neurovascular unit dysfunction, and cerebral microvascular changes in aging, Alzheimer's disease, and related neurological conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Blood-brain barrier permeability and neurovascular unit dysfunction in aging, Alzheimer's disease, and related conditions.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular Procedures, Surgical Outcomes, and Age-Related Risk
subtopics.description: Studies examining outcomes of cardiovascular interventions including valve replacement, coronary revascularization, aortic repair, and catheter ablation in older and high-risk patients, with attention to age- and sex-related differences.
subtopics.short_description: Outcomes of valve replacement, coronary revascularization, and other cardiovascular interventions in older and high-risk patients.

subtopics.label: Spinal and Orthopedic Surgery Outcomes in Elderly Patients
subtopics.description: Research on surgical outcomes, complications, and functional recovery following spinal, orthopedic, and musculoskeletal procedures in elderly patients, including cervical fusion, fracture repair, and lumbar degeneration.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical outcomes, complications, and functional recovery after spinal and orthopedic procedures in elderly patients.

subtopics.label: Diabetes, Metabolic Dysfunction, and Aging
subtopics.description: Studies on the epidemiology, complications, and metabolic mechanisms of type 2 diabetes in aging populations, including associations with morbidity, mortality, and age-related metabolic changes.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, complications, and metabolic mechanisms of type 2 diabetes in aging populations.

subtopics.label: Telehealth, Home Care, and Remote Care Delivery for Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on the use of telehealth, telemedicine, and remote monitoring technologies to deliver care to older adults in home and long-term care settings, including feasibility, outcomes, and barriers.
subtopics.display_name: Telehealth & Remote Care for Older Adults
subtopics.short_description: Feasibility, outcomes, and barriers of telehealth and remote monitoring for older adults in home and long-term care settings.

subtopics.label: High-Cost Medicare Patients, Healthcare Utilization, and Preventable Spending
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing high-cost Medicare beneficiaries, patterns of healthcare utilization, potentially preventable spending, and care coordination gaps among older adults with complex chronic conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Patterns of utilization, preventable spending, and care coordination gaps among high-cost older Medicare beneficiaries.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic Clocks, Biological Age, and Aging Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research using epigenetic clocks, DNA methylation, and transcriptional aging frameworks to measure biological age, identify age-modulating compounds, and examine social and environmental influences on epigenetic aging.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation and epigenetic frameworks for measuring biological age and identifying social and environmental aging influences.

subtopics.label: Hypothalamic Neuroendocrine Regulation, Sex Hormones, and Aging
subtopics.description: Studies on sex hormone receptor distribution, estrogen receptor signaling, and hypothalamic neuronal changes associated with aging, menopause, and hypertension in animal models.
subtopics.short_description: Estrogen receptor signaling and hypothalamic neuronal changes associated with aging, menopause, and hypertension.

subtopics.label: Hospice, Palliative Care, and End-of-Life Decision-Making in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on hospice utilization, palliative care needs, end-of-life preferences, and outcomes among older adults with serious illness including dementia, liver disease, and cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Hospice utilization, palliative care needs, and end-of-life preferences among older adults with serious illness.

subtopics.label: COPD and Airway Biology
subtopics.description: Research on the cellular and molecular biology of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, including airway epithelial cell dysfunction, club cell biology, lymphatic involvement, sphingolipid metabolism, smoking-induced dysregulation, and COPD comorbidities and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Cellular and molecular mechanisms of COPD, including airway epithelial dysfunction, sphingolipid metabolism, and smoking-induced dysregulation.

subtopics.label: Interstitial Lung Disease and Pulmonary Fibrosis
subtopics.description: Research on interstitial lung diseases including idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, nonspecific interstitial pneumonia, and interstitial lung abnormalities, covering pathogenesis, biomarkers, quality of life, and clinical management.
subtopics.short_description: Pathogenesis, biomarkers, and clinical management of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, and related interstitial lung diseases.

subtopics.label: Asthma and Allergic Airway Disease
subtopics.description: Research on asthma pathogenesis and treatment, including sphingolipid metabolism, type 2 airway inflammation, innate lymphoid cells, allergen exposure, cytokine signaling, and genetic risk factors for airway hyperreactivity.
subtopics.short_description: Pathogenesis and treatment of asthma, covering type 2 inflammation, innate lymphoid cells, allergen exposure, and genetic risk factors for airway hyperreactivity.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Respiratory Pathophysiology and Critical Illness
subtopics.description: Research on the pulmonary and systemic pathophysiology of severe COVID-19, including ARDS, vascular injury, complement activation, cytokine profiles, barotrauma, mechanical ventilation management, and organ dysfunction trajectories in critically ill patients.
subtopics.short_description: Pulmonary and systemic mechanisms of severe COVID-19, including ARDS, vascular injury, complement activation, and mechanical ventilation management.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Outcomes, Risk Factors, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on clinical characteristics, risk factors, comorbidities, and treatment strategies for hospitalized COVID-19 patients, including antiviral and immunomodulatory therapies, variant severity comparisons, and predictive models for deterioration and mortality.
subtopics.short_description: Risk factors, comorbidities, antiviral and immunomodulatory therapies, and predictive models for deterioration in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

subtopics.label: Long COVID and Post-Acute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2
subtopics.description: Research on post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC/Long COVID), including symptom characterization, subphenotyping, risk factor identification, cognitive and cardiopulmonary manifestations, and disparities across demographic groups.
subtopics.short_description: Symptom characterization, subphenotyping, and cardiopulmonary and cognitive manifestations of post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection.

subtopics.label: Respiratory Infections and Pneumonia Pathogenesis
subtopics.description: Research on bacterial, viral, and fungal respiratory infections including pneumococcal pneumonia, influenza, Streptococcus, Acinetobacter, Chlamydia, and human metapneumovirus, covering host immune responses, pathogen mechanisms, and treatment strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Host immune responses and pathogen mechanisms in bacterial, viral, and fungal respiratory infections including pneumococcal pneumonia and influenza.

subtopics.label: Pulmonary Hypertension and Pulmonary Vascular Disease
subtopics.description: Research on pulmonary hypertension and pulmonary vascular disease, including diagnosis, risk stratification, echocardiographic assessment, right ventricular function, chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension, and outcomes across pulmonary vascular disease subtypes.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, risk stratification, right ventricular function, and outcomes across pulmonary hypertension and pulmonary vascular disease subtypes.

subtopics.label: Pulmonary Embolism Diagnosis and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on acute pulmonary embolism management including catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, surgical embolectomy, risk stratification tools, anticoagulation strategies, and outcomes in diverse patient populations.
subtopics.short_description: Acute pulmonary embolism treatment including catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, risk stratification, and anticoagulation strategies.

subtopics.label: Lung Transplantation and Perioperative Management
subtopics.description: Research on lung transplantation outcomes, perioperative management, primary graft dysfunction, ECMO use, cystic fibrosis retransplantation, cytomegalovirus immunity, and lymphatic anastomosis in transplant recipients.
subtopics.short_description: Transplant outcomes, primary graft dysfunction, ECMO use, perioperative management, and lymphatic anastomosis in lung transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: Mechanical Ventilation and ICU Management
subtopics.description: Research on mechanical ventilation practices, sedation, vasopressor use, tracheostomy, ICU staffing, sepsis management, and outcomes in critically ill adult and pediatric patients.
subtopics.short_description: Ventilation practices, sedation, vasopressor use, tracheostomy, and outcomes in critically ill adult and pediatric patients.

subtopics.label: Airway Epithelium Biology and SARS-CoV-2 Infection Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research on airway epithelial cell biology, ACE2 receptor expression, organoid models of SARS-CoV-2 infection, viral entry mechanisms, and host transcriptomic responses in the respiratory tract.
subtopics.short_description: ACE2 expression, organoid models, viral entry mechanisms, and host transcriptomic responses in airway epithelial cells during SARS-CoV-2 infection.

subtopics.label: Lung Cancer Biology and Surgical Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on lung cancer biology including tumor microenvironment, oncogenic drivers, immune evasion, and surgical treatment approaches including lobectomy versus sublobar resection for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Tumor microenvironment, oncogenic drivers, immune evasion, and surgical approaches including lobectomy versus sublobar resection for early-stage NSCLC.

subtopics.label: Sleep Apnea and Respiratory Physiology
subtopics.description: Research on obstructive sleep apnea including cardiovascular risk, platelet activation, maternal outcomes, CPAP therapy, and related respiratory physiological measurements including respiratory muscle strength and cough assessment.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular risk, platelet activation, CPAP therapy, and respiratory physiological measurements in obstructive sleep apnea.

subtopics.label: Chest Imaging and Pulmonary Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research on chest imaging modalities including CT, MRI, X-ray, and ultrasound for diagnosis and monitoring of pulmonary conditions including ILD, pneumothorax, COVID-19 pneumonia, and lung cancer screening.
subtopics.short_description: CT, MRI, X-ray, and ultrasound applications for diagnosing and monitoring ILD, pneumothorax, COVID-19 pneumonia, and lung cancer.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Cardiac and Thrombotic Complications
subtopics.description: Research on cardiovascular manifestations of COVID-19 including myocarditis, atrial arrhythmias, thrombotic events, troponin elevation, and anticoagulation management in hospitalized patients.
subtopics.short_description: Myocarditis, arrhythmias, thrombotic events, troponin elevation, and anticoagulation management in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Epigenomics, Multi-omics, and Molecular Signatures
subtopics.description: Studies applying DNA methylation profiling, machine learning on epigenetic data, and integrative multi-omics approaches to identify molecular signatures of COVID-19 severity and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation profiling, machine learning, and integrative multi-omics approaches identifying molecular signatures of COVID-19 severity.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Hospital Operations, Surge Capacity, and Preparedness
subtopics.description: Research on hospital and ICU operational responses to COVID-19 including surge capacity planning, rapid ICU expansion, staff redeployment, and preparedness protocols.
subtopics.short_description: ICU surge capacity planning, rapid expansion, staff redeployment, and operational preparedness protocols during the COVID-19 pandemic.

subtopics.label: Pediatric COVID-19 and SARS-CoV-2 in Children
subtopics.description: Studies examining COVID-19 clinical presentation, hospitalization indications, and outcomes specifically in pediatric populations including the Omicron wave and croup presentations.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical presentation, hospitalization indications, and outcomes of COVID-19 in children, including Omicron-wave and croup presentations.

subtopics.label: Tuberculosis and Mycobacterial Infections
subtopics.description: Research on tuberculosis treatment, drug regimens, host-directed therapy, diagnostic methods, and co-infections with mycobacterial species including novel second-line regimens.
subtopics.short_description: TB treatment regimens, host-directed therapy, diagnostic methods, and co-infections with mycobacterial species including novel second-line drugs.

subtopics.label: ICU Quality Improvement, Patient Safety, and Clinical Operations
subtopics.description: Studies addressing ICU quality improvement initiatives, patient safety practices, staffing ratios, clinical databases, and operational tools to enhance critical care delivery.
subtopics.short_description: Quality improvement initiatives, staffing ratios, safety practices, and operational tools to enhance critical care delivery.

subtopics.label: Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation (ECMO) and Extracorporeal Support
subtopics.description: Research on ECMO use in adults and children including hemostatic management, renal replacement therapy during ECMO, temperature management, and outcomes in respiratory failure.
subtopics.short_description: ECMO use in adults and children, covering hemostatic management, renal replacement, temperature management, and outcomes in respiratory failure.

subtopics.label: Lung Cancer Surgical and Perioperative Management
subtopics.description: Studies on perioperative assessment, pulmonary function testing before resection, postoperative complications, and surgical outcomes in lung cancer patients including during COVID-19.
subtopics.short_description: Preoperative pulmonary function assessment, postoperative complications, and surgical outcomes in lung cancer resection patients.

subtopics.label: Lung Cancer Immunotherapy and Targeted Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on immune checkpoint inhibitors, anti-PD-L1 therapy combined with radiation, molecular biomarkers of treatment response, and novel drug delivery approaches for lung cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Checkpoint inhibitors, anti-PD-L1 therapy with radiation, molecular biomarkers of treatment response, and novel drug delivery for lung cancer.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Critical Care and Neonatal Respiratory Management
subtopics.description: Research on critical care management in pediatric and neonatal populations including delirium, sedation practices, unplanned extubations, CPAP in preterm infants, and tracheostomy care.
subtopics.short_description: Delirium, sedation, unplanned extubations, CPAP in preterm infants, and tracheostomy care in pediatric and neonatal critical care settings.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Biology, Animal Models, and Experimental Therapeutics
subtopics.description: Studies using stem cell models, organoids, animal models, and in situ detection methods to investigate SARS-CoV-2 infection mechanisms, immune responses, and experimental therapeutic interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Organoids, stem cell and animal models, and in situ detection methods investigating SARS-CoV-2 infection mechanisms and experimental therapeutics.

subtopics.label: Antimicrobial Resistance and Antibiotic Stewardship
subtopics.description: Research on carbapenem-resistant pathogens, polymyxin breakpoints, hospital-acquired and ventilator-associated pneumonia treatment algorithms, and clinical outcomes of resistant infections.
subtopics.short_description: Carbapenem-resistant pathogens, polymyxin breakpoints, ventilator-associated pneumonia treatment, and outcomes of resistant respiratory infections.

subtopics.label: Thoracic Trauma, Surgery, and Perioperative Respiratory Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on rib fixation in trauma, chest tube management, diaphragm preservation in aortic surgery, respiratory complications after cervical spine surgery, and perioperative respiratory outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Rib fixation, chest tube management, diaphragm preservation, and respiratory complications following thoracic and cervical spine surgery.

subtopics.label: Smoking, Vaping, and Occupational Respiratory Exposures
subtopics.description: Research on electronic cigarette use in adolescents and adults, oral and respiratory effects of vaping, occupational dust exposures, and tobacco-related respiratory disease.
subtopics.short_description: E-cigarette use in adolescents and adults, oral and respiratory effects of vaping, occupational dust exposures, and tobacco-related lung disease.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Neurological Manifestations and Brain Effects
subtopics.description: Studies on neurological presentations of COVID-19 including posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome, neurological symptoms as primary presentation, and brain fog in long COVID.
subtopics.short_description: Neurological presentations of COVID-19 including encephalopathy, brain fog in long COVID, and neurological symptoms as primary disease presentation.
