subtopics.label: Neonatal Critical Care and NICU Management
subtopics.description: Research focused on clinical management of neonates in the NICU, including preterm infant care, neonatal resuscitation, respiratory support, hypoglycemia, neonatal abstinence syndrome, and quality improvement initiatives specific to the neonatal intensive care setting.
subtopics.short_description: Preterm infant care, neonatal resuscitation, respiratory support, and quality improvement in the neonatal intensive care unit.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Intensive Care and Critical Illness Management
subtopics.description: Clinical research on management of critically ill children in the PICU, including sedation practices, delirium assessment and outcomes, early warning scores, tracheostomy timing, respiratory failure, and care transitions during the COVID-19 pandemic.
subtopics.short_description: Management of critically ill children in the PICU, including sedation, delirium, early warning scores, and respiratory failure.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Transfusion Medicine and Hematology
subtopics.description: Research on blood product transfusion practices, bleeding assessment, anticoagulation, and hemostatic management in critically ill children, including those on ECMO, undergoing cardiac surgery, or with malignancy-related coagulopathy.
subtopics.short_description: Blood product use, anticoagulation, and hemostatic management in critically ill children, including those on ECMO or undergoing cardiac surgery.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Epilepsy and Neurological Disorders
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on pediatric epilepsy including infantile spasms, status epilepticus, rare epilepsy syndromes, EEG-based diagnostics, glucose transporter deficiency, and neurological conditions such as Sturge-Weber syndrome and anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis.
subtopics.short_description: Infantile spasms, status epilepticus, rare epilepsy syndromes, EEG diagnostics, and neurological conditions such as anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Brain Tumors and Neurosurgical Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on pediatric central nervous system tumors including DIPG, medulloblastoma, choroid plexus carcinoma, and low-grade gliomas, with focus on convection-enhanced delivery, molecular diagnostics, surgical approaches, and novel therapeutic strategies.
subtopics.short_description: CNS tumors including DIPG, medulloblastoma, and low-grade gliomas, with focus on molecular diagnostics and novel therapeutic delivery.

subtopics.label: Neurodevelopmental Disorders and Autism Spectrum Disorder
subtopics.description: Research on autism spectrum disorder and related neurodevelopmental conditions, including behavioral interventions, social skills training, diagnosis disclosure, caregiver-mediated strategies, and neurobiological mechanisms underlying ASD and ADHD.
subtopics.short_description: Behavioral interventions, neurobiological mechanisms, and caregiver strategies for autism spectrum disorder, ADHD, and related conditions.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Mental Health, Suicide, and Substance Use
subtopics.description: Research on mental health conditions in adolescents including depression, anxiety, suicidal ideation and attempts, substance use disorders, eating disorders, and the impact of social determinants, digital media, and COVID-19 on youth psychiatric outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Depression, anxiety, suicidal ideation, eating disorders, and substance use in adolescents, including social media and COVID-19 impacts.

subtopics.label: Pediatric COVID-19 and Infectious Disease
subtopics.description: Clinical research on SARS-CoV-2 infection in children and adolescents, including disease severity across variants, MIS-C, COVID-19 vaccination in pediatric populations, and management of other pediatric infectious diseases such as RSV, pneumonia, and sepsis.
subtopics.short_description: SARS-CoV-2 severity, MIS-C, pediatric vaccination, and management of RSV, pneumonia, and sepsis in children and adolescents.

subtopics.label: Congenital Heart Disease and Pediatric Cardiology
subtopics.description: Research on congenital heart disease management including tetralogy of Fallot, Fontan surgery, cardiomyocyte biology, cardiac surgery outcomes, and perioperative care in pediatric patients with structural heart defects.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical outcomes, perioperative care, and cardiomyocyte biology in children with structural heart defects including tetralogy of Fallot and Fontan.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Chronic Kidney Disease and Growth
subtopics.description: Research on chronic kidney disease in children and adolescents, including growth impairment, mineral bone disorder, anemia management, pubertal development, and iron therapy in pediatric CKD populations.
subtopics.short_description: Growth impairment, mineral bone disorder, anemia, and pubertal development in children and adolescents with chronic kidney disease.

subtopics.label: Perinatal and Maternal-Neonatal Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical research on pregnancy complications, labor management, and perinatal outcomes including hypertensive disorders, oxytocin use, penicillin allergy in pregnancy, prenatal substance use policies, and neonatal outcomes associated with maternal conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Pregnancy complications, labor management, and neonatal outcomes linked to hypertensive disorders, oxytocin use, and prenatal substance exposure.

subtopics.label: Pediatric HIV, Vertical Transmission, and Immunization
subtopics.description: Research on mother-to-child HIV transmission, broadly neutralizing antibodies, pediatric HIV vaccine development, ART adherence in adolescents, and immune correlates of protection against perinatal HIV infection.
subtopics.short_description: Mother-to-child HIV transmission, broadly neutralizing antibodies, pediatric vaccine development, and ART adherence in adolescents.

subtopics.label: Congenital CMV and Perinatal Vaccine Immunology
subtopics.description: Research on congenital cytomegalovirus transmission, maternal immune correlates of protection, placental antibody transfer, and vaccine development strategies for perinatal pathogens including CMV, rotavirus, and other neonatal infections.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal immune correlates, placental antibody transfer, and vaccine strategies for CMV, rotavirus, and other perinatal pathogens.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Obesity, Diabetes, and Metabolic Health
subtopics.description: Research on obesity, type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, and metabolic syndrome in children and adolescents, including bariatric surgery outcomes, dysglycemia screening, dietary patterns, and corneal biomarkers of diabetic neuropathy.
subtopics.short_description: Obesity, type 2 diabetes, and metabolic syndrome in youth, including bariatric surgery outcomes, dysglycemia screening, and dietary patterns.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Telemedicine, Medical Education, and Workforce
subtopics.description: Research on telemedicine implementation in pediatric care, medical education and training for pediatric residents and fellows, simulation-based learning, and workforce well-being including burnout and compassion fatigue among pediatric providers.
subtopics.short_description: Telemedicine implementation, simulation-based training, and provider well-being including burnout among pediatric clinicians and trainees.

subtopics.label: Childhood Cancer Survivorship and Late Effects
subtopics.description: Research on long-term health outcomes, late effects (cardiotoxicity, hearing loss, underweight mortality), screening utilization, and quality of life in survivors of childhood and young adult cancers. Includes genetic counseling, contraception counseling, and survivorship training programs.
subtopics.short_description: Long-term health outcomes, cardiotoxicity, hearing loss, and quality of life in survivors of childhood and young adult cancers.

subtopics.label: CLN2 Batten Disease and CNS Gene Therapy
subtopics.description: Studies on CLN2-associated Batten disease including retinal degeneration, gene therapy with AAVrh.10 vectors administered intracranially or intracisternally, and long-term survival outcomes. Includes safety, biodistribution, and efficacy of direct CNS gene delivery.
subtopics.short_description: CLN2 Batten disease management and AAV-based gene therapy delivered intracranially or intracisternally, including safety and long-term efficacy.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Traumatic Brain Injury and Neurorehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on cognitive and motor recovery, imaging predictors, assistive technology access, anesthesia exposure, and rehabilitation outcomes following pediatric traumatic brain injury. Includes cognitive assessment tools and covert cognition detection.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive and motor recovery, imaging predictors, assistive technology, and rehabilitation outcomes following pediatric traumatic brain injury.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health
subtopics.description: Studies on sexual and reproductive health education, counseling, and interventions for adolescents including refugee girls, those with epilepsy, and young adults undergoing cancer treatment. Includes pelvic exam practices, HPV vaccination, and privacy laws.
subtopics.short_description: Reproductive health education, HPV vaccination, pelvic exam practices, and counseling for adolescents including those with epilepsy or cancer.

subtopics.label: Child Maltreatment, Foster Care, and Family Violence
subtopics.description: Research on child abuse, neglect, foster care involvement, and family violence prevention, including the impact of Medicaid expansion, prenatal drug use laws, parental opioid use disorder, and health insurance on child welfare outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: Child Maltreatment, Foster Care & Family Violence
subtopics.short_description: Child abuse, neglect, and foster care outcomes in relation to Medicaid policy, parental opioid use disorder, and family violence prevention.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Gastrointestinal Disease and Inflammatory Bowel Disease
subtopics.description: Studies on pediatric gastrointestinal conditions including inflammatory bowel disease, eosinophilic esophagitis, celiac disease, microscopic colitis, and microvillous inclusion disease. Includes VTE complications in IBD, body image, and synbiotic interventions.
subtopics.display_name: Pediatric GI Disease & Inflammatory Bowel Disease
subtopics.short_description: Inflammatory bowel disease, eosinophilic esophagitis, celiac disease, and rare GI conditions in children, including VTE complications and microbiome interventions.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Oncology and Hematologic Malignancies
subtopics.description: Research on pediatric cancers including AML, Hodgkin lymphoma, neuroblastoma, sarcomas, and myeloproliferative neoplasms, covering cytogenetics, treatment outcomes, VTE management, and healthcare transition. Includes delirium in hematopoietic cell transplant.
subtopics.short_description: AML, Hodgkin lymphoma, neuroblastoma, and sarcomas in children, covering cytogenetics, treatment outcomes, and hematopoietic cell transplant.

subtopics.label: Chiari Malformation, Craniosynostosis, and Pediatric Neurosurgery
subtopics.description: Studies on Chiari malformation classification, revision surgery, occipital condyle screw fixation, craniosynostosis repair outcomes, and related neurosurgical procedures in children. Includes imaging metrics, transfusion volume, and rickets complications.
subtopics.short_description: Chiari malformation classification, revision surgery, craniosynostosis repair outcomes, and related neurosurgical procedures in pediatric patients.

subtopics.label: Neonatal and Fetal Brain Imaging and Neurodevelopment
subtopics.description: Research on advanced MRI techniques for fetal and neonatal brain imaging including diffusion MRI atlases, cerebral blood flow trajectories, susceptibility mapping, and reduced field-of-view imaging. Includes longitudinal neurodevelopmental analysis in preterm infants.
subtopics.short_description: Advanced MRI techniques for fetal and neonatal brain imaging, including diffusion atlases, cerebral blood flow, and longitudinal neurodevelopmental analysis.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Pulmonology, Asthma, and Respiratory Disease
subtopics.description: Studies on pediatric asthma risk factors including sphingolipid synthesis, mouse allergen exposure, rhinovirus infection, and bronchopulmonary dysplasia nutrition and imaging. Includes croup management, obstructive sleep apnea in infants, and aerodigestive evaluation.
subtopics.short_description: Asthma risk factors, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, croup, obstructive sleep apnea, and aerodigestive evaluation in pediatric patients.

subtopics.label: Social Determinants of Health, Health Equity, and Child Well-being
subtopics.description: Research examining how social determinants of health, racial disparities, socioeconomic factors, and care coordination gaps affect child health outcomes, mental health, and healthcare utilization. Includes intersectionality analyses and medical home domains.
subtopics.short_description: Racial disparities, socioeconomic factors, and care coordination gaps affecting child health outcomes, mental health, and healthcare utilization.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Substance Use, Neurobiology, and E-cigarettes
subtopics.description: Studies on adolescent substance use including alcohol, cannabis, opioids, and e-cigarettes, examining neurobiological mechanisms, mental health comorbidities, policy impacts, and behavioral interventions. Includes endocannabinoid genetics and vaping trends.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiological mechanisms, mental health comorbidities, and policy impacts of alcohol, cannabis, opioid, and e-cigarette use in adolescents.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Infectious Disease in Global and Resource-Limited Settings
subtopics.description: Research on pediatric infectious diseases in low-resource settings including tuberculosis, HIV, febrile illness management, and care-seeking behavior. Includes TB preventive therapy, isoniazid resistance, and integration of TB/HIV services.
subtopics.short_description: Tuberculosis, HIV, and febrile illness management in children across low-resource settings, including TB preventive therapy and TB/HIV service integration.

subtopics.label: Maternal Infections, Pregnancy Complications, and Perinatal Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies on infections during pregnancy including hepatitis B, hepatitis C, SARS-CoV-2, and HSV, examining maternal and neonatal outcomes, vertical transmission risk, and treatment strategies. Includes placental pathology and penicillin allergy evaluation.
subtopics.short_description: Hepatitis B, hepatitis C, SARS-CoV-2, and HSV in pregnancy, examining vertical transmission risk, neonatal outcomes, and placental pathology.

subtopics.label: Child and Adolescent Mental Health, Psychopathology, and COVID-19 Impact
subtopics.description: Research on child and adolescent mental health including depression, anxiety, psychopathology risk factors, psychiatric emergency presentations, digital media impacts, and COVID-19 pandemic effects on mental health. Includes ACEs, parenting, and behavioral interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Depression, anxiety, psychiatric emergencies, and COVID-19 pandemic effects on child mental health, including ACEs, parenting, and digital media impacts.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Surgery Outcomes and Techniques
subtopics.description: Research on surgical outcomes, operative techniques, and perioperative management in cardiac surgery including coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), aortic valve replacement, mitral valve repair, aortic root and arch surgery, and postoperative complications such as atrial fibrillation, sternal wound infections, and graft patency.
subtopics.short_description: Operative techniques, perioperative management, and postoperative complications in CABG, valve, and aortic surgery.

subtopics.label: Minimally Invasive and Open Spine Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on surgical techniques, outcomes, and technology for spinal disorders including minimally invasive approaches (MIS-TLIF, LLIF, endoscopic), cervical and lumbar procedures, spinal deformity correction, image guidance, robotics, and augmented reality in spine surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical techniques, robotics, and image guidance for spinal disorders including deformity correction and endoscopic approaches.

subtopics.label: Vascular and Aortic Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on endovascular and open surgical management of aortic aneurysms, aortic dissection, peripheral arterial disease, thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR), abdominal aortic aneurysm repair (EVAR/OAR), and outcomes of vascular interventions including limb revascularization and carotid procedures.
subtopics.short_description: Endovascular and open repair of aortic aneurysms, dissection, peripheral arterial disease, and carotid and limb revascularization.

subtopics.label: Thoracic Surgery and Lung Resection
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of lung cancer and thoracic malignancies including lobectomy, segmentectomy, wedge resection, esophagectomy, thymectomy, neoadjuvant therapy, and perioperative outcomes in thoracic surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of lung cancer and thoracic malignancies including lobectomy, esophagectomy, and perioperative outcomes.

subtopics.label: Bariatric and Metabolic Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on surgical and endoscopic interventions for obesity including Roux-en-Y gastric bypass, sleeve gastrectomy, endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty, duodenal switch, and outcomes related to weight loss, metabolic comorbidities, and postoperative management.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical and endoscopic interventions for obesity, including gastric bypass and sleeve gastrectomy, and metabolic comorbidity outcomes.

subtopics.label: Breast Surgery and Reconstruction
subtopics.description: Research on mastectomy, breast reconstruction techniques (implant-based, DIEP flap, autologous), nipple reconstruction, sensory outcomes, capsular contracture, implant safety, and oncologic outcomes in breast cancer surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Mastectomy, implant-based and autologous reconstruction, sensory outcomes, implant safety, and oncologic results in breast surgery.

subtopics.label: Cranial and Skull Base Neurosurgery
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of brain tumors, skull base lesions, Chiari malformation, colloid cysts, craniosynostosis, and neurovascular conditions including operative techniques, approaches, and postoperative outcomes in cranial neurosurgery.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of brain tumors, skull base lesions, craniosynostosis, and neurovascular conditions with operative outcome analysis.

subtopics.label: Postoperative Pain Management and Opioid Prescribing
subtopics.description: Research on postoperative opioid prescribing patterns, persistent opioid use, non-opioid analgesic strategies, multimodal analgesia, and the impact of prescribing policies and regulations on surgical patients.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid prescribing patterns, persistent use, multimodal analgesia strategies, and prescribing policy impacts in surgical patients.

subtopics.label: Colorectal and Gastrointestinal Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of colorectal cancer, inflammatory bowel disease, small bowel obstruction, appendicitis, hernia repair, and endoscopic interventions including outcomes of minimally invasive colorectal procedures and enhanced recovery protocols.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of colorectal cancer, IBD, hernia, and appendicitis, including minimally invasive approaches and recovery protocols.

subtopics.label: Transcatheter and Structural Heart Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR), transcatheter mitral and tricuspid interventions, left atrial appendage occlusion, catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation, and outcomes of percutaneous structural heart procedures.
subtopics.short_description: TAVR, transcatheter mitral and tricuspid repair, left atrial appendage occlusion, and outcomes of percutaneous structural heart procedures.

subtopics.label: Head and Neck Surgery and Thyroid/Parathyroid Procedures
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of thyroid and parathyroid diseases, head and neck cancers, salivary gland tumors, laryngeal procedures, and outcomes of head and neck surgical interventions including voice and swallowing outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: Head & Neck Surgery with Thyroid Procedures
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of thyroid, parathyroid, head and neck cancers, and salivary gland tumors, including voice and swallowing outcomes.

subtopics.label: Urologic Surgery and Prostate Cancer Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of prostate cancer (radical prostatectomy, focal ablation), bladder cancer, upper tract urothelial carcinoma, kidney tumors, and urologic procedures including outcomes of robotic-assisted approaches and biopsy techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Robotic and open surgical management of prostate, bladder, and kidney cancers, including focal ablation and biopsy technique outcomes.

subtopics.label: Obstetric and Gynecologic Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on cesarean delivery, perioperative management in obstetrics, gynecologic laparoscopy, hysterectomy, fibroid management, pelvic organ prolapse repair, sterilization procedures, and outcomes in obstetric and gynecologic surgical care.
subtopics.short_description: Cesarean delivery, hysterectomy, fibroid management, pelvic organ prolapse repair, and perioperative outcomes in gynecologic surgery.

subtopics.label: Global Surgery, Surgical Education, and Workforce
subtopics.description: Research on surgical training, education, simulation, global surgery in low- and middle-income countries, surgical workforce diversity, and quality improvement in surgical care delivery including disparities in access and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical training, simulation, global surgery in low-income settings, workforce diversity, and disparities in surgical access and outcomes.

subtopics.label: Perioperative Management and Anesthesia
subtopics.description: Research on perioperative risk stratification, anesthetic techniques, enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocols, intraoperative monitoring, transfusion practices, and postoperative complications management across surgical specialties.
subtopics.short_description: Perioperative risk stratification, ERAS protocols, anesthetic techniques, intraoperative monitoring, and postoperative complication management.

subtopics.label: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting and Revascularization Strategies
subtopics.description: Research on CABG techniques, graft selection (arterial vs. venous), outcomes by sex and age, multivessel disease management, and comparisons between surgical and percutaneous coronary revascularization approaches.
subtopics.short_description: CABG graft selection, multivessel disease management, and surgical versus percutaneous revascularization outcome comparisons.

subtopics.label: Heart Transplantation and Mechanical Circulatory Support
subtopics.description: Studies examining outcomes after heart transplantation (including donor factors, recipient characteristics, allograft vasculopathy, and rejection), as well as left ventricular assist devices, VA-ECMO, and mechanical circulatory support in cardiogenic shock.
subtopics.short_description: Outcomes after heart transplantation, left ventricular assist devices, VA-ECMO, and mechanical support in cardiogenic shock.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Valve Surgery and Aortic Root Procedures
subtopics.description: Research on surgical aortic valve replacement, mitral valve repair, aortic root replacement, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy myectomy, and outcomes related to valve type selection, frailty, and concomitant procedures.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical aortic and mitral valve repair, aortic root replacement, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy myectomy, and valve selection outcomes.

subtopics.label: Aortic Arch Surgery and Acute Aortic Dissection
subtopics.description: Studies on open aortic arch repair, management of acute type A aortic dissection including malperfusion, elective proximal aortic surgery in high-risk patients, and outcomes in thoracoabdominal aortic aneurysm repair.
subtopics.short_description: Open arch repair, acute type A aortic dissection management, malperfusion, and thoracoabdominal aortic aneurysm repair outcomes.

subtopics.label: Peripheral Nerve Decompression Surgery for Headache and Neuralgia
subtopics.description: Research on surgical decompression of occipital, trigeminal, and other peripheral nerves for treatment of chronic headache disorders, occipital neuralgia, and nerve compression syndromes, including outcomes, treatment delays, and reoperation rates.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical decompression of occipital and trigeminal nerves for chronic headache, neuralgia, and nerve compression syndromes.

subtopics.label: Breast Implant Design, Safety, and Tissue Engineering
subtopics.description: Studies on breast implant surface properties (smooth vs. textured), antifibrotic coatings, positional stability, biocompatibility, capsule formation, and novel tissue engineering approaches including decellularized scaffolds and nipple reconstruction.
subtopics.short_description: Implant surface properties, antifibrotic coatings, biocompatibility, capsule formation, and tissue engineering for breast reconstruction.

subtopics.label: Minimally Invasive Surgery for Pancreatic and Hepatobiliary Disease
subtopics.description: Research on minimally invasive pancreatectomy, liver resection, robotic and laparoscopic approaches for pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, hepatocellular carcinoma, cholangiocarcinoma, and related hepatobiliary conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Robotic and laparoscopic pancreatectomy and liver resection for pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, HCC, and cholangiocarcinoma.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Otolaryngology and Aerodigestive Procedures
subtopics.description: Studies on pediatric ear, nose, and throat conditions including tympanostomy tubes, ankyloglossia, obstructive sleep apnea, aerodigestive evaluation for aspiration and recurrent croup, and tracheostomy timing in critically ill children.
subtopics.short_description: Pediatric ENT conditions including tympanostomy, ankyloglossia, obstructive sleep apnea, aspiration evaluation, and tracheostomy timing.

subtopics.label: Craniofacial Surgery and Facial Fracture Management
subtopics.description: Research on management of facial fractures (frontal sinus, zygoma, mandible, orbital), craniofacial syndrome multidisciplinary care, orofacial clefts, and reconstructive outcomes in craniofacial conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Management of frontal sinus, orbital, and mandibular fractures, craniofacial syndromes, orofacial clefts, and reconstructive outcomes.

subtopics.label: Deep Brain Stimulation and Neuromodulation for Movement and Brain Disorders
subtopics.description: Studies on deep brain stimulation for Parkinson's disease, traumatic brain injury, and other neurological conditions, including programming practices, patient perspectives, MR-guided focused ultrasound, and intrathecal baclofen therapy.
subtopics.short_description: DBS for Parkinson's disease and neurological conditions, MR-guided focused ultrasound, and intrathecal baclofen therapy outcomes.

subtopics.label: Intracerebral Hemorrhage and Stroke Surgical Management
subtopics.description: Research on surgical and minimally invasive management of intracerebral hemorrhage, intraventricular hemorrhage, subarachnoid hemorrhage, and ischemic stroke interventions including catheter-based thrombectomy and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical and minimally invasive management of intracerebral hemorrhage, subarachnoid hemorrhage, and catheter-based stroke interventions.

subtopics.label: Male Reproductive Surgery and Fertility Procedures
subtopics.description: Studies on vasectomy reversal, varicocelectomy, ejaculatory duct obstruction, testicular torsion, and their effects on semen parameters, sperm function, and reproductive outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Vasectomy reversal, varicocelectomy, ejaculatory duct obstruction, and testicular torsion outcomes on semen parameters and fertility.

subtopics.label: Surgical Oncology of Adrenal, Endocrine, and Rare Tumors
subtopics.description: Research on adrenalectomy for primary hyperaldosteronism and adrenocortical carcinoma, splenectomy pathology, pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, and genomic predictors of recurrence after resection of endocrine malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Adrenalectomy for hyperaldosteronism and adrenocortical carcinoma, pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, and genomic recurrence predictors.

subtopics.label: Orthopedic Joint Reconstruction and Arthroplasty Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies on total hip and knee arthroplasty outcomes including revision rates, sex differences, safety-net hospital burden, peer coaching interventions, ankle replacement versus arthrodesis, and distal fibula fracture fixation.
subtopics.short_description: Total hip and knee arthroplasty outcomes including revision rates, sex differences, ankle replacement, and distal fibula fracture fixation.

subtopics.label: Ophthalmic Surgery Outcomes and Device Safety
subtopics.description: Research on cataract surgery techniques and complications, glaucoma surgery device adverse events, vitrectomy platform safety, intraocular lens fixation, ocular gene therapy delivery, and ophthalmic surgical outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Cataract surgery complications, glaucoma device safety, vitrectomy platforms, intraocular lens fixation, and ocular gene therapy delivery.

subtopics.label: Kidney Transplant Immunology and Rejection Monitoring
subtopics.description: Research on immune-mediated rejection mechanisms in kidney allografts, including T-cell and antibody-mediated rejection, urinary cell mRNA and RNA-sequencing biomarkers for noninvasive rejection diagnosis, donor-derived cell-free DNA, and transcriptomic profiling of allograft status.
subtopics.short_description: Immune-mediated rejection mechanisms, noninvasive biomarkers, and transcriptomic profiling of kidney allograft status.

subtopics.label: Kidney Transplant Outcomes, Management, and Complications
subtopics.description: Clinical studies examining outcomes of kidney transplantation including allograft failure transitions, dialysis nonadherence effects, BK virus nephropathy, COVID-19 in transplant recipients, HIV-infected recipients, frailty assessment, robotic surgical techniques, and post-transplant infection management.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical outcomes of kidney transplantation including allograft failure, infections, frailty, and surgical management.

subtopics.label: Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease: Imaging and Disease Monitoring
subtopics.description: Studies focused on MRI-based measurement and deep learning segmentation of kidney and liver volumes in ADPKD, including quantitative susceptibility mapping, hemorrhagic cyst biomarkers, pericardial and pleural effusions, pancreatic cysts, spinal meningeal diverticula, and IVC compression as disease manifestations.
subtopics.short_description: MRI-based kidney and liver volume measurement, deep learning segmentation, and systemic manifestations in polycystic kidney disease.

subtopics.label: CKD Progression: Molecular Mechanisms and Fibrosis
subtopics.description: Research into molecular and cellular mechanisms driving chronic kidney disease progression and fibrosis, including TGF-β1 signaling, mitofusin-2 in macrophages, retinoic acid receptor activity in proximal tubules, iron therapy effects on macrophages, erythropoietin production, and profibrotic gene expression in interstitial cells.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and cellular mechanisms driving chronic kidney disease progression, including TGF-β1 signaling and profibrotic gene expression.

subtopics.label: ENaC, Electrolyte Transport, and Renal Ion Homeostasis
subtopics.description: Mechanistic studies of epithelial sodium channel (ENaC) regulation including ubiquitination, cleavage states, aldosterone-dependent trafficking, and the role of ENaC and ROMK in renal sodium and potassium excretion, as well as proximal tubule transport regulation by dietary potassium.
subtopics.short_description: Epithelial sodium channel regulation and mechanisms of renal sodium, potassium, and electrolyte homeostasis.

subtopics.label: CKD Mineral Metabolism, Bone Disease, and FGF23
subtopics.description: Studies examining mineral and bone disorder in chronic kidney disease, including FGF23 and iron interactions, phosphate management in hemodialysis, vitamin D metabolism via intestinal and renal Cyp24a1, iron therapy effects on bone health in children, parathyroidectomy for secondary hyperparathyroidism, and klotho in CKD outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: FGF23, phosphate management, vitamin D metabolism, and bone health complications in chronic kidney disease.

subtopics.label: Acute Kidney Injury: Epidemiology, Risk Factors, and Critical Care
subtopics.description: Research on acute kidney injury incidence, risk stratification, and management in critical care settings including COVID-19-associated AKI, AKI in MIS-C, AKI prediction using machine learning and federated learning, renal replacement therapy on ECMO, peritoneal dialysis catheter placement, and hydronephrosis risk stratification.
subtopics.display_name: Acute Kidney Injury in Critical Care
subtopics.short_description: AKI incidence, risk stratification, machine learning prediction, and renal replacement therapy in critical care settings.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Chronic Kidney Disease: Growth, Anemia, and Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on chronic kidney disease in children and adolescents, including growth impairment, delayed menarche, anemia management with iron therapy, TNF-α and mineral bone disorder, pubertal LH levels and GFR decline, and longitudinal outcomes in the CKiD cohort.
subtopics.short_description: Growth impairment, anemia, pubertal development, and longitudinal outcomes in children with chronic kidney disease.

subtopics.label: Hemodialysis: Access, Complications, and Patient Management
subtopics.description: Clinical research on hemodialysis including arteriovenous fistula stenosis detection, mechanical thrombectomy for thrombosed access, emergency department utilization, COVID-19 vaccine hesitancy, pain management with transcranial direct current stimulation, IL-6 inhibition with clazakizumab, HCV screening cost-effectiveness, and phosphate management trials.
subtopics.short_description: Arteriovenous fistula care, thrombosis management, pain control, and clinical outcomes in hemodialysis patients.

subtopics.label: Computational Pathology and AI-Based Renal Image Analysis
subtopics.description: Development and validation of deep learning and computational methods for renal pathological image segmentation, 3D glomerular reconstruction, multi-object tracking on serial whole slide images, and lay annotator-based molecular-empowered learning for kidney pathology.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning methods for kidney pathology image segmentation, glomerular reconstruction, and whole-slide image analysis.

subtopics.label: CKD and Cardiovascular Complications
subtopics.description: Research examining the intersection of chronic kidney disease with cardiovascular outcomes, including pulmonary hypertension screening, cardiac biomarkers and quality of life, plasma serotonin and cardiovascular risk, FGF23-driven cardiac metabolic remodeling, eGFR formulas predicting surgical mortality, and tricuspid regurgitation in CKD with cardiogenic shock.
subtopics.short_description: Intersection of chronic kidney disease with cardiac outcomes, including FGF23-driven remodeling and pulmonary hypertension.

subtopics.label: CKD Epidemiology, Awareness, and Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Population-level studies on CKD prevalence, awareness, and outcomes including racial and geographic disparities, CKD in Haiti, HIV-associated CKD in Tanzania, NAFLD-associated CKD, blood pressure targets and mortality, reproductive counseling for women with CKD, and global availability of kidney health tests.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level CKD prevalence, racial and geographic disparities, global kidney health access, and clinical outcomes.

subtopics.label: Kidney Stones, Hyperparathyroidism, and Mineral Disorders
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on kidney stone recurrence and 24-hour urine collection in high-risk formers, parathyroidectomy outcomes for renal secondary hyperparathyroidism, and atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome treatment decisions.
subtopics.short_description: Stone recurrence risk, 24-hour urine evaluation, parathyroidectomy outcomes, and atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome management.

subtopics.label: Renal Cell Carcinoma: Molecular Biology and Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular mechanisms and biomarkers of renal cell carcinoma, including ATF4-driven metabolic remodeling in clear cell RCC, Ndufa4l2 and lipid accumulation, genetically engineered mouse models, CA-125 in renal medullary carcinoma, and cfDNA methylome-based detection.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic remodeling, lipid accumulation, mouse models, and cfDNA-based biomarkers in renal cell carcinoma.

subtopics.label: Electrolyte Disorders: Hyponatremia, Dysnatremia, and Hypophosphatemia
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on electrolyte disturbances in hospitalized patients including inpatient hyponatremia management via e-consults, dysnatremia associations with COVID-19 mortality, hypophosphatemia following ferric carboxymaltose, and MASP2 elevation in thrombotic microangiopathies.
subtopics.short_description: Inpatient management of hyponatremia, dysnatremia, hypophosphatemia, and thrombotic microangiopathy in hospitalized patients.

subtopics.label: Diabetes and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Cardiac Procedures
subtopics.description: Research examining how diabetes mellitus affects in-hospital and short-term mortality, morbidity, and procedural outcomes in patients undergoing cardiac interventions including STEMI management, aortic valve replacement, aortic aneurysm repair, and aortic dissection surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of diabetes mellitus on mortality and morbidity in patients undergoing cardiac interventions and aortic surgery.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Outcomes, Complications, and Subphenotypes
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing clinical presentations, risk factors, complications (including thrombosis, PRES, and ARDS), and post-acute sequelae of COVID-19 infection, including machine-learning-derived subphenotype identification and post-discharge outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Risk factors, complications, machine-learning subphenotypes, and post-acute sequelae of COVID-19 infection.

subtopics.label: Hypertension Management, Complications, and Special Populations
subtopics.description: Research on hypertension diagnosis, blood pressure targets, and management across special populations including pregnancy, HIV patients, and emergency settings, as well as complications such as end-organ damage and primary hyperaldosteronism.
subtopics.short_description: Blood pressure targets, end-organ damage, and hypertension care in pregnancy, HIV, and emergency settings.

subtopics.label: HIV-Associated Renal, Cardiovascular, and Metabolic Complications
subtopics.description: Studies investigating renal, cardiovascular, and metabolic complications in people living with HIV, including albuminuria, diastolic dysfunction, body composition changes, and inflammatory biomarker associations.
subtopics.short_description: Albuminuria, diastolic dysfunction, body composition, and inflammatory biomarkers in people living with HIV.

subtopics.label: Diabetic Microvascular Complications and Risk Factor Control
subtopics.description: Research on the prevalence, risk factors, and prevention of diabetic microvascular complications including neuropathy, retinopathy, and nephropathy, with emphasis on glycemic and blood pressure control targets.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, risk factors, and prevention of diabetic neuropathy, retinopathy, and nephropathy through risk factor control.

subtopics.label: Kidney Dysfunction in Liver Disease and Cirrhosis
subtopics.description: Studies examining the impact of cirrhosis and liver disease on renal outcomes, including kidney dysfunction types and mortality in hospitalized cirrhosis patients, and outcomes after percutaneous coronary intervention in end-stage liver disease.
subtopics.short_description: Renal outcomes, kidney dysfunction types, and mortality in patients with cirrhosis and end-stage liver disease.

subtopics.label: Infectious Complications in Transplant Recipients
subtopics.description: Research on infectious complications following solid organ transplantation, including BK virus nephropathy diagnosis, urinary tract infections, gut microbiota and UTI risk, bacteriophage therapy, and donor-derived malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: BK virus nephropathy, urinary tract infections, gut microbiota, bacteriophage therapy, and donor-derived malignancies post-transplant.

subtopics.label: Pregnancy Outcomes and Counseling in Transplant Recipients
subtopics.description: Studies addressing renal function, pregnancy outcomes, and ethical considerations in solid organ transplant recipients, including uterus transplant recipients and post-transplant pregnancy counseling guidelines.
subtopics.short_description: Renal function, pregnancy outcomes, and counseling guidelines for solid organ and uterus transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: Nephrology Quality Metrics, Payment Models, and Medical Education
subtopics.description: Research on quality measurement and payment reform in nephrology practice, including MIPS performance, value-based care pathways, capitated versus fee-for-service reimbursement, and nephrology medical education innovations.
subtopics.short_description: MIPS performance, value-based care pathways, reimbursement models, and medical education innovations in nephrology.

subtopics.label: Pharmacological Therapies and Drug Effects in CKD and Renal Patients
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating specific pharmacological interventions in CKD and renal patients, including intravenous iron formulations, sevelamer-associated GI injury, anti-TNF therapy renal lesions, and perioperative fluid management.
subtopics.short_description: Intravenous iron formulations, sevelamer-associated injury, anti-TNF renal effects, and perioperative fluid management in renal patients.

subtopics.label: Novel Kidney Disease Biomarkers and Genetic Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research identifying and validating novel biomarkers for kidney disease including proenkephalin-A, IgA glycomics, and APOL1-mediated kidney disease mechanisms and therapeutic targeting.
subtopics.short_description: Proenkephalin-A, IgA glycomics, and APOL1-mediated kidney disease mechanisms and therapeutic targeting.

subtopics.label: Peritoneal Dialysis: Infection Diagnosis and Management
subtopics.description: Studies focused on peritoneal dialysis complications and management, particularly the use of cell-free DNA sequencing for pathogen detection in peritonitis and clinical management of PD patients.
subtopics.short_description: Cell-free DNA sequencing for pathogen detection in peritonitis and clinical management of peritoneal dialysis patients.

subtopics.label: Aortic Surgery and Renal Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining renal outcomes and complications in patients undergoing aortic surgery, including the impact of preoperative renal insufficiency on proximal aortic surgery outcomes and AI-assisted radiation reduction in complex aneurysm repair.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of preoperative renal insufficiency on aortic surgery outcomes and AI-assisted radiation reduction in aneurysm repair.

subtopics.label: Innate Lymphoid Cells and Mucosal Immune Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on innate lymphoid cell (ILC) biology including ILC2s, ILC3s, and their roles in mucosal immunity, tissue homeostasis, gut barrier function, and inflammatory regulation at barrier surfaces. Includes neuropeptide and cytokine control of ILC responses and ILC interactions with microbiota and adaptive immune cells.
subtopics.short_description: ILC biology and cytokine-driven regulation of gut barrier function, tissue homeostasis, and mucosal inflammation.

subtopics.label: Tumor Immune Microenvironment and Cancer Immunotherapy
subtopics.description: Research on immune cell composition and function within the tumor microenvironment, including T cell exhaustion and activation states, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, macrophage polarization, and mechanisms of immune evasion. Encompasses preclinical and translational studies of immune checkpoint blockade, combination immunotherapy strategies, and tumor immunogenicity.
subtopics.short_description: Immune cell composition, T cell exhaustion, and checkpoint blockade strategies within the tumor microenvironment.

subtopics.label: Cytokine and Interferon Signaling in Immune Responses
subtopics.description: Studies of cytokine pathways including type I, II, and III interferons, interleukins, TNF-alpha, and their downstream signaling in immune and non-immune cells. Covers innate immune activation, antiviral responses, inflammasome biology, and cytokine-mediated regulation of inflammation and immune cell function.
subtopics.short_description: Interferon, interleukin, and TNF-alpha pathways governing innate immune activation, inflammasome biology, and inflammatory regulation.

subtopics.label: T Cell Biology, Exhaustion, and Immune Checkpoint Regulation
subtopics.description: Fundamental research on T cell differentiation, activation, exhaustion, and memory formation, including CD4+ and CD8+ T cell subsets, regulatory T cells, and tissue-resident memory T cells. Includes immune checkpoint receptor biology (PD-1, CTLA-4, LAG-3, TIM-3, ICOS, TIGIT, GITR) and small molecule modulation of checkpoint pathways.
subtopics.short_description: T cell differentiation, exhaustion, and memory across CD4+, CD8+, and Treg subsets, including checkpoint receptor biology.

subtopics.label: B Cell Biology, Humoral Immunity, and Antibody Responses
subtopics.description: Research on B cell differentiation, germinal center reactions, antibody class switching, somatic hypermutation, and memory B cell formation. Includes studies of broadly neutralizing antibodies, immunoglobulin structure and function, B cell receptor signaling, and B cell contributions to lymphomagenesis and autoimmunity.
subtopics.short_description: B cell differentiation, germinal center reactions, antibody class switching, and broadly neutralizing antibody development.

subtopics.label: Macrophage and Myeloid Cell Biology in Inflammation
subtopics.description: Studies of macrophage activation, polarization, phagocytosis, and inflammatory signaling including microglial biology in the CNS, tissue-resident macrophage function, and myeloid cell roles in infection, sterile inflammation, and tissue repair. Includes macrophage metabolic regulation and exophagy mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Macrophage activation, polarization, and metabolic regulation in infection, sterile inflammation, and tissue repair.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome, Mycobiome, and Immune Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on interactions between the gut microbiota (bacterial and fungal) and host immune responses, including microbiome-driven regulation of mucosal immunity, IgA responses, immune tolerance, and systemic inflammation. Covers fungal commensalism, mycobiome dysbiosis in disease, and microbiota manipulation of immune cell function.
subtopics.short_description: Bacterial and fungal microbiota interactions with mucosal immunity, IgA responses, and systemic inflammatory regulation.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Immune Responses, Vaccines, and COVID-19 Immunopathology
subtopics.description: Research on host immune responses to SARS-CoV-2 infection including antibody dynamics, T cell responses, innate immune activation, and COVID-19 immunopathology such as complement activation, cytokine storm, and vascular inflammation. Includes mRNA vaccine immunogenicity, protection against variants, waning immunity, and breakthrough infections.
subtopics.short_description: Antibody and T cell responses to SARS-CoV-2, mRNA vaccine immunogenicity, cytokine storm, and variant immune evasion.

subtopics.label: Neuroinflammation and Neuroimmune Interactions
subtopics.description: Studies of immune cell activity in the central nervous system including microglial activation, neuroinflammatory signaling, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, and neuroimmune crosstalk in neurological diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, stroke, and psychiatric conditions. Includes astrocyte-immune interactions and CNS-specific cytokine responses.
subtopics.short_description: Microglial activation, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, and neuroimmune crosstalk in neurological and psychiatric diseases.

subtopics.label: HIV Immunology, Immune Dysfunction, and Reservoir Biology
subtopics.description: Research on HIV-specific immune responses, CD4+ and CD8+ T cell dysfunction, immune activation and inflammation in people living with HIV, HIV reservoir formation and latency reversal, and immunotherapeutic strategies for HIV control. Includes studies of broadly neutralizing antibodies against HIV and immune recovery on antiretroviral therapy.
subtopics.short_description: HIV-specific T cell dysfunction, viral reservoir latency, broadly neutralizing antibodies, and immune recovery on antiretroviral therapy.

subtopics.label: Transplant Immunology and Alloimmune Responses
subtopics.description: Research on immune mechanisms of allograft rejection, tolerance, and monitoring in solid organ and hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Includes urinary and blood biomarkers of rejection, donor-specific antibodies, T cell-mediated and antibody-mediated rejection, and immunosuppression strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanisms of allograft rejection, donor-specific antibodies, tolerance induction, and biomarker-based rejection monitoring.

subtopics.label: Lymphoma Biology and Hematologic Immune Malignancies
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and immunological mechanisms driving B cell and T cell lymphomas, including epigenetic dysregulation, tumor microenvironment remodeling, immune evasion, and targeted therapeutic vulnerabilities. Covers germinal center biology in lymphomagenesis, CAR T cell therapies for hematologic malignancies, and lymphoma immunotherapy.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and immunological drivers of B and T cell lymphomas, including tumor microenvironment remodeling and CAR T cell therapy.

subtopics.label: Autoimmunity, Autoreactivity, and Immune Tolerance
subtopics.description: Studies of self-reactive immune responses, breakdown of immune tolerance, and autoimmune mechanisms including type I interferon-driven autoimmunity, autoreactive B and T cells, and molecular triggers of autoimmune pathology. Covers autoimmune conditions such as lupus, type 1 diabetes antigen presentation, and psoriasis immune mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Self-reactive B and T cell responses, interferon-driven autoimmune pathology, and molecular triggers in lupus, diabetes, and psoriasis.

subtopics.label: Vaccine Immunogenicity and Protective Immune Responses
subtopics.description: Research on vaccine-induced humoral and cellular immune responses, including antibody breadth, durability, and effector functions elicited by viral vaccines (CMV, influenza, HIV, rotavirus). Covers adjuvant effects, maternal vaccination, broadly neutralizing antibody induction, and preclinical vaccine development in animal models.
subtopics.short_description: Antibody breadth, durability, and cellular immunity elicited by viral vaccines, adjuvants, and maternal immunization strategies.

subtopics.label: Inflammatory Signaling, Cellular Senescence, and Sterile Inflammation
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of sterile inflammation including NF-κB, STING, cGAS, and inflammasome pathways, cellular senescence-associated inflammatory phenotypes (SASP), and oxidative stress-driven immune activation. Includes studies of complement activation, necroptosis, and inflammatory mediators in non-infectious tissue injury.
subtopics.short_description: NF-κB, STING, and inflammasome pathways driving senescence-associated inflammation, necroptosis, and non-infectious tissue injury.

subtopics.label: Kidney Allograft Monitoring and Rejection Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research on noninvasive biomarkers and molecular diagnostics for kidney allograft rejection, including urinary cell mRNA profiling, RNA-sequencing, donor-derived cell-free DNA, and transcriptomic signatures for T-cell mediated and antibody-mediated rejection.
subtopics.short_description: Noninvasive biomarkers and molecular diagnostics for detecting T-cell mediated and antibody-mediated kidney allograft rejection.

subtopics.label: Liver Transplantation Outcomes, Access, and Disparities
subtopics.description: Studies examining liver transplant waitlist access, outcomes, and disparities including racial and socioeconomic inequities, Medicaid expansion effects, alcohol-associated liver disease, obesity, and perioperative management.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, socioeconomic, and policy factors shaping liver transplant waitlist access and post-transplant outcomes.

subtopics.label: Heart Transplantation Outcomes and Complications
subtopics.description: Clinical research on heart transplant perioperative management, primary graft dysfunction, allograft vasculopathy, rejection, and long-term survival including effects of donor factors, recipient comorbidities, and allocation policy changes.
subtopics.short_description: Perioperative management, allograft vasculopathy, rejection, and long-term survival after heart transplantation.

subtopics.label: Lung Transplantation Perioperative Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on perioperative and clinical outcomes in double-lung transplantation including primary graft dysfunction prediction, ECMO use, intraoperative factors, cystic fibrosis-specific outcomes, and lymphatic anastomosis.
subtopics.short_description: Primary graft dysfunction, ECMO use, and clinical outcomes in lung transplantation including cystic fibrosis populations.

subtopics.label: Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation: GVHD, Engraftment, and Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on hematopoietic cell transplantation outcomes including graft-versus-host disease prophylaxis, engraftment kinetics, cord blood transplantation, delirium, and perioperative complications in pediatric and adult populations.
subtopics.short_description: GVHD prophylaxis, engraftment kinetics, and perioperative complications in pediatric and adult hematopoietic cell transplantation.

subtopics.label: HCT Donor Matching, Access, and Racial Disparities
subtopics.description: Research on unrelated donor identification, HLA matching, racial and ethnic disparities in access to allogeneic transplantation, and tools to predict donor availability and transplant timing.
subtopics.short_description: HLA matching, unrelated donor identification, and racial disparities in access to allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation.

subtopics.label: Infectious Complications in Transplant Recipients
subtopics.description: Studies on post-transplant infections including CMV, BK virus nephropathy, adenovirus, aspergillosis, gastrointestinal pathogens, and antibiotic effects on gut microbiota in solid organ and hematopoietic cell transplant recipients.
subtopics.short_description: CMV, BK virus, aspergillosis, and other infections in solid organ and hematopoietic cell transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiota and Transplant Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining the role of gut microbiota composition in transplant recipients, including associations with urinary tract infections, post-transplant diarrhea, antibiotic perturbation, and colonization with resistant organisms.
subtopics.short_description: Gut microbiome composition, antibiotic perturbation, and resistant organism colonization in transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: Kidney Transplant Donor Strategies and Recipient Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on kidney transplant donor strategies including HCV-positive donors, living donors, robotic surgical techniques, frailty assessment, dialysis nonadherence, and outcomes in HIV-infected recipients.
subtopics.short_description: HCV-positive donors, living donation, robotic surgery, frailty, and outcomes in diverse kidney transplant recipient populations.

subtopics.label: CMV Immunity, Vaccination, and Immune Correlates in Transplantation
subtopics.description: Research on cytomegalovirus immune responses, vaccine development, antibody correlates of protection, and humoral immunity in transplant and non-transplant settings.
subtopics.short_description: Cytomegalovirus immune responses, antibody correlates of protection, and vaccine strategies in transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: Equity, Social Determinants, and Policy in Liver Transplantation
subtopics.description: Studies on social determinants of health, racial and gender disparities, insurance coverage, and policy interventions affecting liver transplant listing, access, and outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: Social Determinants & Policy in Liver Transplant
subtopics.short_description: Racial, gender, and insurance disparities alongside policy interventions affecting liver transplant listing and access.

subtopics.label: Post-Transplant Malignancy and Immunosuppression-Related Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on malignancies arising in immunosuppressed transplant recipients, including cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, EBV-positive CNS lymphoma, and donor-derived acute myeloid leukemia.
subtopics.short_description: Cancers arising in immunosuppressed transplant recipients, including skin cancers, lymphoma, and donor-derived malignancies.

subtopics.label: Pregnancy and Reproductive Outcomes in Transplant Recipients
subtopics.description: Studies on reproductive counseling, pregnancy outcomes, and renal function in solid organ transplant recipients including uterus transplant recipients and women with chronic kidney disease.
subtopics.short_description: Reproductive counseling, pregnancy outcomes, and renal function in solid organ transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: HCT for Lymphoma, Myeloma, and Myeloproliferative Neoplasms
subtopics.description: Clinical outcomes research on hematopoietic cell transplantation for hematologic malignancies including Hodgkin lymphoma, multiple myeloma, myeloproliferative neoplasms, and peripheral T-cell lymphoma.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical outcomes of hematopoietic cell transplantation for Hodgkin lymphoma, multiple myeloma, and myeloproliferative neoplasms.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Impact on Transplant Recipients and Programs
subtopics.description: Research on COVID-19 outcomes in kidney transplant recipients and waitlisted patients, and the broader impact of the pandemic on transplant program operations and non-COVID patient care.
subtopics.short_description: COVID-19 outcomes in kidney transplant recipients and pandemic effects on transplant program operations.

subtopics.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia and Hematologic Malignancy Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on novel therapeutic agents and salvage regimens for acute myeloid leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and related hematologic malignancies, including targeted therapies and chemotherapy combinations.
subtopics.short_description: Novel targeted therapies and salvage regimens for acute myeloid leukemia, ALL, and related hematologic malignancies.

subtopics.label: Myeloid Neoplasm Biology and Hematopoietic Stem Cell Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies examining the molecular and cellular biology of myelodysplastic syndromes, myeloproliferative neoplasms, and hematopoietic stem cell self-renewal, including epigenetic regulation and microenvironmental signaling.
subtopics.display_name: Myeloid Neoplasm Biology & Stem Cell Regulation
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and epigenetic mechanisms underlying myelodysplastic syndromes, myeloproliferative neoplasms, and hematopoietic stem cell self-renewal.

subtopics.label: Islet and Beta Cell Transplantation and Engraftment
subtopics.description: Research on transplantation of pancreatic islets and beta cells, including vascularization strategies, subcutaneous engraftment, and small molecule approaches to enhance beta cell survival and function.
subtopics.short_description: Pancreatic islet and beta cell transplantation strategies, including vascularization, subcutaneous engraftment, and beta cell survival.

subtopics.label: Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease, Cirrhosis, and Prognosis
subtopics.description: Studies on alcohol use disorder and alcohol-associated liver disease including prognostic scoring, relapse prediction, patient-provider prognosis discordance, and clinical management of decompensated cirrhosis.
subtopics.short_description: Prognostic scoring, relapse prediction, and clinical management of alcohol-associated liver disease and decompensated cirrhosis.

subtopics.label: Liver Allograft Rejection Diagnostics and HCC Treatment Response
subtopics.description: Research on noninvasive biomarkers such as serum microRNAs for diagnosing acute rejection in liver allografts, and imaging-based assessment of hepatocellular carcinoma treatment response using LI-RADS criteria.
subtopics.short_description: Serum microRNA biomarkers for liver allograft rejection and imaging-based hepatocellular carcinoma treatment response evaluation.

subtopics.label: Pediatric HCT and Cancer Complications Including Bleeding and Vaccination
subtopics.description: Research on complications in pediatric hematopoietic cell transplant and cancer patients, including massive bleeding events, HPV vaccine uptake among HSCT survivors, and thrombotic microangiopathy.
subtopics.short_description: Bleeding events, thrombotic microangiopathy, and HPV vaccination in pediatric hematopoietic cell transplant and cancer patients.

subtopics.label: Cellular Therapy Product Processing and Cryopreservation
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating the effects of cryopreservation conditions and temporary storage on the viability and recovery of cellular therapy products used in transplantation.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of cryopreservation conditions and temporary storage on viability and recovery of transplant cellular therapy products.

subtopics.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia: Biology, Treatment, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on AML pathogenesis, molecular subtypes, epigenetic drivers, and clinical management including induction chemotherapy, targeted agents (IDH inhibitors, FLT3 inhibitors, venetoclax, azacitidine), and outcomes in newly diagnosed and relapsed/refractory disease.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular subtypes, epigenetic drivers, and targeted therapies in newly diagnosed and relapsed AML.

subtopics.label: Lymphoma Biology, Molecular Pathogenesis, and Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and epigenetic mechanisms driving B-cell and T-cell lymphomas (DLBCL, follicular lymphoma, mantle cell lymphoma, PTCL, ALCL, CLL), including novel therapeutic strategies such as BTK inhibitors, EZH2 inhibitors, CAR T-cell therapy, and immunochemotherapy regimens.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic and molecular mechanisms driving B- and T-cell lymphomas, with novel targeted and cellular therapies.

subtopics.label: Myeloproliferative Neoplasms and Myelodysplastic Syndromes
subtopics.description: Research on the biology, diagnosis, and management of MPNs (polycythemia vera, essential thrombocythemia, myelofibrosis) and MDS, including JAK2 mutations, epigenetic alterations, interferon therapy, and disease progression to blast phase.
subtopics.short_description: Biology, diagnosis, and management of MPNs and myelodysplastic syndromes, including JAK2 mutations and disease progression.

subtopics.label: Multiple Myeloma: Genomics, Smoldering Disease, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on multiple myeloma biology including genomic profiling of smoldering myeloma, genetic subtypes, treatment with CAR T-cell therapy, proteasome inhibitors, and novel agents, as well as allogeneic transplantation outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Genomic profiling of smoldering and active myeloma, with CAR T-cell therapy, proteasome inhibitors, and transplant outcomes.

subtopics.label: Hematopoiesis, Stem Cell Biology, and Bone Marrow Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research on normal and malignant hematopoiesis including hematopoietic stem cell self-renewal, epigenetic regulation, bone marrow niche signaling, clonal hematopoiesis, and aging-associated remodeling of hematopoietic topography.
subtopics.short_description: Hematopoietic stem cell self-renewal, epigenetic regulation, clonal hematopoiesis, and bone marrow microenvironment signaling.

subtopics.label: CAR T-Cell and Cellular Immunotherapy for Hematologic Malignancies
subtopics.description: Research on CAR T-cell therapy design, clinical outcomes, resistance mechanisms, and combination strategies for hematologic malignancies including B-cell lymphoma, AML, ALL, and multiple myeloma.
subtopics.display_name: CAR T-Cell Therapy for Blood Cancers
subtopics.short_description: Design, clinical outcomes, resistance mechanisms, and combination strategies for CAR T-cell therapy in hematologic malignancies.

subtopics.label: Venous Thromboembolism: Risk, Prevention, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology, risk factors, prophylaxis, and management of venous thromboembolism (DVT and PE) across diverse patient populations including cancer patients, surgical patients, pediatric IBD, and pregnancy, including anticoagulation strategies and hereditary thrombophilia.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, prophylaxis, and anticoagulation strategies for DVT and PE across cancer, surgical, and high-risk populations.

subtopics.label: Pulmonary Embolism: Catheter-Based Therapies and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the management of acute pulmonary embolism with catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, and anticoagulation, including comparative effectiveness, risk stratification, and outcomes in diverse patient populations.
subtopics.short_description: Catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, and risk stratification for acute pulmonary embolism management.

subtopics.label: Transfusion Medicine: Pediatric and Critical Care Practices
subtopics.description: Research on blood component transfusion practices, thresholds, and outcomes in critically ill children, neonates, and patients undergoing cardiac surgery or ECMO, including red blood cell, platelet, and plasma transfusion guidelines.
subtopics.short_description: Blood component transfusion thresholds and outcomes in critically ill children, neonates, and cardiac surgery patients.

subtopics.label: Red Blood Cell Disorders, Anemia, and Transfusion Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on anemia management, red blood cell transfusion outcomes in surgical and hospitalized patients, sickle cell disease, thalassemia, and erythropoiesis including iron deficiency and hemoglobin disorders.
subtopics.display_name: Red Blood Cell Disorders & Anemia Management
subtopics.short_description: Anemia treatment, transfusion outcomes, sickle cell disease, thalassemia, and iron deficiency erythropoiesis.

subtopics.label: Iron Metabolism, Iron Deficiency, and Iron Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on iron deficiency anemia treatment with intravenous iron formulations, iron metabolism in chronic kidney disease, FGF23-related mineral homeostasis, hepcidin biology, and adverse effects of iron therapy including hypophosphatemia.
subtopics.short_description: Intravenous iron therapy, hepcidin biology, FGF23-related mineral homeostasis, and iron management in chronic kidney disease.

subtopics.label: Coagulation Disorders, Anticoagulation, and Hemostasis Management
subtopics.description: Research on anticoagulation therapy management including warfarin, direct oral anticoagulants, antiplatelet agents, fibrinogen replacement, and hemostasis in clinical settings such as cardiac surgery, trauma, and procedural interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Anticoagulation management with DOACs, warfarin, and antiplatelet agents across cardiac surgery, trauma, and procedural settings.

subtopics.label: COVID-19-Associated Coagulopathy, Thrombosis, and Vascular Injury
subtopics.description: Research on the thrombotic and coagulopathic complications of COVID-19 including complement-mediated microvascular injury, pulmonary embolism incidence, hypercoagulable states, and the vascular pathology of severe SARS-CoV-2 infection.
subtopics.short_description: Thrombotic and coagulopathic complications of COVID-19, including complement-mediated microvascular injury and hypercoagulable states.

subtopics.label: Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation: Outcomes, Complications, and Access
subtopics.description: Research on allogeneic and autologous hematopoietic cell transplantation including cord blood transplantation, donor selection, GVHD, infectious complications, engraftment, and disparities in transplant access across racial and ethnic groups.
subtopics.short_description: Allogeneic and autologous HCT outcomes, GVHD, donor selection, cord blood transplantation, and disparities in transplant access.

subtopics.label: Platelet Biology, Platelet Disorders, and Thrombocytopenia Management
subtopics.description: Research on platelet function, platelet transfusion thresholds and outcomes, immune thrombocytopenia diagnosis and treatment, thrombotic microangiopathies, and platelet-related hemostatic disorders including lusutrombopag use and antiphospholipid syndrome.
subtopics.short_description: Platelet function, immune thrombocytopenia, thrombotic microangiopathies, and platelet transfusion thresholds and outcomes.

subtopics.label: Stroke, Cerebrovascular Events, and Antithrombotic Management
subtopics.description: Research on ischemic stroke mechanisms, cerebral venous thrombosis, intracerebral hemorrhage, and anticoagulation/antiplatelet strategies for stroke prevention and treatment, including cancer-associated stroke and atrial fibrillation-related stroke.
subtopics.short_description: Ischemic stroke mechanisms, cerebral venous thrombosis, and anticoagulation strategies for stroke prevention and treatment.

subtopics.label: Lymphoma Diagnosis, Staging, and Bone Marrow Assessment
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating diagnostic tools and staging procedures for lymphoma, including the role of bone marrow biopsy versus PET/CT imaging, CSF analysis, and pathologic assessment in B-cell and T-cell lymphomas.
subtopics.short_description: Bone marrow biopsy, PET/CT imaging, CSF analysis, and pathologic staging tools for B- and T-cell lymphomas.

subtopics.label: Targeted Therapy and Novel Agents in Lymphoma and CLL
subtopics.description: Clinical and preclinical studies of targeted agents including BTK inhibitors (acalabrutinib, ibrutinib), CDK4/6 inhibitors, venetoclax, and BET inhibitors in B-cell malignancies, CLL, and mantle cell lymphoma.
subtopics.short_description: BTK inhibitors, venetoclax, CDK4/6 inhibitors, and BET inhibitors in B-cell malignancies, CLL, and mantle cell lymphoma.

subtopics.label: AML and MDS: Novel Therapeutics, Molecular Biology, and Maintenance Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on novel therapeutic strategies in AML and MDS including oral azacitidine maintenance, BET and ENL YEATS inhibitors, BCL6 targeting, and molecular/cytogenomic characterization of disease subtypes.
subtopics.display_name: AML & MDS Novel Therapeutics & Molecular Biology
subtopics.short_description: Oral azacitidine maintenance, BET and ENL YEATS inhibitors, BCL6 targeting, and cytogenomic characterization in AML and MDS.

subtopics.label: Lung Lymphatic Dysfunction, Vascular Biology, and Pulmonary Disease
subtopics.description: Studies on lymphatic endothelial cell biology in the lung, including cigarette smoke-induced lymphatic thrombosis and dysfunction, PAR1-mediated lymphatic drainage, and the role of lymphatic dysfunction in COPD and emphysema.
subtopics.short_description: Lymphatic endothelial dysfunction in the lung, PAR1-mediated drainage, and lymphatic contributions to COPD and emphysema.

subtopics.label: Spaceflight Biology: Multi-Omics, Immune Responses, and Cardiovascular Effects
subtopics.description: Multi-omic and single-cell studies characterizing physiological, immunological, and coagulation changes in astronauts during and after spaceflight, including secretome profiling and cardiovascular risk assessment.
subtopics.short_description: Multi-omic profiling of immune, coagulation, and cardiovascular changes in astronauts during and after spaceflight.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Outcomes, Complications, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Clinical studies examining COVID-19 outcomes in hospitalized patients including cancer history, viral load, inflammatory markers, organ dysfunction subphenotypes, pregnancy complications, post-acute sequelae, and treatment strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Hospitalized COVID-19 outcomes including organ dysfunction, inflammatory markers, post-acute sequelae, and treatment strategies.

subtopics.label: Endothelial Cell Biology, Vascular Development, and Homeostasis
subtopics.description: Research on endothelial cell specification, transcription factor regulation (ETS factors, c-Maf), endothelial colony-forming cells, and endothelial-leukemia cell interactions relevant to vascular homeostasis and hematologic malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Endothelial specification, transcription factor regulation, and endothelial-leukemia cell interactions in vascular homeostasis.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence, NLP, and Machine Learning in Hematology Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Studies applying machine learning, natural language processing, and AI-driven image analysis to hematopathology diagnosis, flow cytometry classification, report extraction, and clinical decision support in hematologic diseases.
subtopics.display_name: AI & Machine Learning in Hematology Diagnostics
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning, NLP, and AI-driven image analysis for hematopathology diagnosis, flow cytometry, and clinical decision support.

subtopics.label: Cancer-Associated Arterial Thromboembolism and Vascular Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on arterial thromboembolism risk in solid cancer patients, including tumor genomic predictors of thrombosis, ischemic stroke mechanisms in cancer, and management of vascular complications in oncology.
subtopics.short_description: Arterial thromboembolism risk in cancer patients, tumor genomic predictors of thrombosis, and vascular complication management.

subtopics.label: Sickle Cell Disease: Clinical Management, Pain, and Global Health
subtopics.description: Research on sickle cell disease management including opioid prescribing patterns, linkage-to-care interventions in low-resource settings, and clinical outcomes in pediatric and adult populations.
subtopics.display_name: Sickle Cell Disease Management & Global Health
subtopics.short_description: Pain management, opioid prescribing, linkage-to-care interventions, and clinical outcomes in sickle cell disease globally.

subtopics.label: Eosinophil Biology and Gene Therapy for Eosinophilic Disorders
subtopics.description: Preclinical and translational studies on eosinophil-targeting strategies including AAV-mediated gene therapy for hypereosinophilia and chronic eosinophilic leukemia, and neutrophil/eosinophil regulatory mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: AAV-mediated gene therapy for hypereosinophilia and chronic eosinophilic leukemia, and eosinophil regulatory mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Clonal Hematopoiesis, Somatic Mutations, and Cancer Risk
subtopics.description: Studies examining clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP), mosaic chromosomal alterations, and somatic mutations as risk factors for hematologic and solid malignancies, including lineage tracing approaches.
subtopics.short_description: CHIP, mosaic chromosomal alterations, and somatic mutations as risk factors for hematologic and solid malignancies.

subtopics.label: Lung Transplantation: Perioperative Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies on perioperative outcomes, transfusion practices, and intraoperative management in lung transplantation, including cystic fibrosis retransplantation and disease-specific considerations.
subtopics.short_description: Perioperative management, transfusion practices, and intraoperative outcomes in lung transplantation, including cystic fibrosis cases.

subtopics.label: B Cell Differentiation, Humoral Immunity, and Lymphoma Models
subtopics.description: Research on B cell biology including OCT2-mediated chromatin remodeling in humoral immunity, ROCK1-mediated proteostasis, CRISPR-based B cell models, EZH2-driven lymphoma niche formation, and dendritic cell cross-presentation.
subtopics.short_description: B cell chromatin remodeling, proteostasis, CRISPR-based lymphoma models, and EZH2-driven lymphoma niche formation.

subtopics.label: Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery: Techniques, Navigation, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on minimally invasive spinal surgical techniques including MIS-TLIF, endoscopic approaches, tubular laminotomy, and lateral interbody fusion, with emphasis on navigation, robotics, augmented reality, and clinical outcomes. Covers technical development, complication profiles, and comparative effectiveness versus open surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Endoscopic, tubular, and lateral interbody techniques with navigation, robotics, and comparative outcomes versus open surgery.

subtopics.label: Cervical Spine Surgery: ACDF, Arthroplasty, and Deformity Management
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of cervical spine conditions including anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF), cervical disc arthroplasty, laminoplasty, corpectomy, and craniocervical junction procedures.
