Covers complications, radiographic outcomes, pseudarthrosis, adjacent segment disease, and comparative surgical approaches for degenerative cervical myelopathy and trauma.
subtopics.short_description: ACDF, disc arthroplasty, laminoplasty, and craniocervical procedures for degenerative myelopathy, trauma, and adjacent segment disease.

subtopics.label: Traumatic Spinal Injuries: Management and Outcomes in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology, surgical management, neurological outcomes, and post-discharge morbidity of traumatic spinal injuries, with a focus on East African and other low- and middle-income country settings. Includes cost-effectiveness analyses, barriers to care, and follow-up challenges.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, surgical management, and neurological outcomes of traumatic spinal injuries in East African and other low-income countries.

subtopics.label: Spine Surgery Training, Simulation, and Global Capacity Building
subtopics.description: Research on surgical education and training for spine procedures, including high-fidelity simulators, blended learning, telemedicine support, and capacity-building programs in resource-limited settings. Covers curriculum development for minimally invasive spine surgery and the use of smart glasses and telemedical tools.
subtopics.short_description: High-fidelity simulators, blended learning, and global capacity-building programs for minimally invasive spine surgical education.

subtopics.label: Bone Cell Biology: Osteoblast and Osteoclast Signaling and Differentiation
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms governing osteoblast differentiation, osteoclastogenesis, and skeletal mineralization, including key signaling pathways such as ERK/MAPK, hedgehog, GSK3-β, and mTORC1. Includes studies on bone-specific kinases, transcription factors, and sex differences in bone cell biology.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of osteoblast and osteoclast differentiation, skeletal mineralization, and key signaling pathways including ERK/MAPK and mTORC1.

subtopics.label: Osteoarthritis Management and Joint Replacement Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, conservative management, and surgical treatment of osteoarthritis, including total knee and hip arthroplasty outcomes, revision rates, injection therapies, and patient-reported outcomes. Covers disparities in access to joint replacement, perioperative complications, and novel interventional approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, conservative care, and total knee and hip arthroplasty outcomes, including disparities in access and perioperative complications.

subtopics.label: Lumbar Spine Degenerative Disease: Disc, Stenosis, and Fusion
subtopics.description: Research on the pathomechanics, diagnosis, and surgical treatment of lumbar degenerative conditions including disc herniation, spinal stenosis, spondylolisthesis, and intervertebral disc degeneration. Covers lumbar fusion techniques, indirect decompression, facet joint pathology, and radiographic outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Pathomechanics and surgical treatment of disc herniation, spinal stenosis, spondylolisthesis, and lumbar fusion techniques.

subtopics.label: Bone Health, Metabolic Bone Disease, and Osteoporosis
subtopics.description: Research on bone mineral density, osteoporosis, fracture risk, and metabolic bone disorders including the effects of medications (aromatase inhibitors, denosumab, iron therapy), systemic diseases (diabetes, CKD), and hormonal factors on bone health. Includes imaging-based bone assessment and pharmacological interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Osteoporosis, fracture risk, and metabolic bone disorders influenced by medications, systemic disease, and hormonal factors.

subtopics.label: Spinal Deformity: Pediatric and Adult Surgical Management
subtopics.description: Research on the surgical correction of spinal deformity in pediatric and adult populations, including scoliosis, craniocervical instability, and sagittal alignment. Covers surgical techniques, complication prevention, and outcomes in conditions such as Ehlers-Danlos syndrome and Chiari malformation.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical correction of scoliosis and sagittal malalignment in pediatric and adult populations, including Ehlers-Danlos and Chiari malformation.

subtopics.label: Musculoskeletal Pain Management: Interventional and Non-Pharmacologic Approaches
subtopics.description: Research on interventional and non-pharmacologic treatments for musculoskeletal pain conditions including myofascial pain, low back pain, sacroiliac joint pain, and osteoarthritis. Covers injection therapies, radiofrequency neurotomy, acupuncture, virtual reality, mind-body interventions, and digital pain management tools.
subtopics.short_description: Injection therapies, radiofrequency neurotomy, acupuncture, virtual reality, and digital tools for low back, myofascial, and joint pain.

subtopics.label: Cartilage Tissue Engineering and Regenerative Orthopedics
subtopics.description: Research on the engineering and regeneration of cartilage tissues using scaffolds, decellularized xenografts, stem cell co-culture, and 3D-printed constructs. Covers elastic and articular cartilage engineering for auricular, nasal, and joint applications, as well as intervertebral disc regeneration.
subtopics.short_description: Scaffolds, stem cell co-culture, and 3D-printed constructs for articular, auricular, and nasal cartilage repair and disc regeneration.

subtopics.label: Orthopedic Infections: Osteomyelitis, Periprosthetic Joint Infection, and Surgical Site Infection
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, microbiology, and management of orthopedic infections including acute hematogenous osteomyelitis in children, periprosthetic joint infections, and surgical site infections following spine and trauma surgery. Covers novel diagnostic tools such as microbial cell-free DNA sequencing and prevention protocols.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and management of osteomyelitis, periprosthetic joint infections, and surgical site infections using novel microbial diagnostics.

subtopics.label: Sports Medicine and Upper Extremity Musculoskeletal Conditions
subtopics.description: Research on sports-related musculoskeletal injuries and conditions including shoulder impingement, distal clavicular osteolysis, running injuries, and lacrosse-related trauma. Covers diagnostic imaging, injection therapies, and return-to-sport management in recreational and elite athletes.
subtopics.short_description: Shoulder, clavicular, and running-related injuries in recreational and elite athletes, including imaging, injections, and return-to-sport protocols.

subtopics.label: Osseointegrated Prostheses and Limb Amputation Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on osseointegrated prosthetic implants for lower limb amputees, including cost-benefit analyses, infection management, surgical adjuncts such as concurrent thigh lifts, and patient-reported outcomes. Covers implant salvage rates and quality-of-life improvements compared to socket prostheses.
subtopics.short_description: Implant outcomes, infection management, and quality-of-life benefits of osseointegrated prosthetics for lower limb amputees.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Health in Musculoskeletal Medicine
subtopics.description: Research on the application of artificial intelligence, large language models, convolutional neural networks, and digital tools to musculoskeletal diagnosis, surgical planning, and patient management. Covers AI-based fracture detection, chatbot performance for orthopedic queries, and digital chronic pain self-management platforms.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning, neural networks, and digital tools for fracture detection, surgical planning, and musculoskeletal patient management.

subtopics.label: Facial and Craniofacial Fracture Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on epidemiology, management strategies, cost burden, and outcomes of facial fractures including mandible, zygoma, frontal sinus, and pediatric craniofacial injuries in trauma settings.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, surgical strategies, cost burden, and outcomes of mandible, zygoma, frontal sinus, and pediatric craniofacial trauma.

subtopics.label: Upper Cervical Spine: Atlantoaxial and Odontoid Pathology
subtopics.description: Studies focused on C1-C2 instrumented fusion, odontoid fractures in elderly patients, and atlantoaxial osteoarthritis, examining surgical techniques, fusion rates, and functional outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: C1-C2 instrumented fusion, odontoid fractures in elderly patients, and atlantoaxial osteoarthritis surgical techniques and fusion rates.

subtopics.label: Spinal Tumors and Vertebral Metastasis: Biology and Surgical Management
subtopics.description: Research on metastatic spinal disease including surgical outcomes in elderly patients, vertebral skeletal stem cell biology driving metastasis, and rehabilitation for spine tumor patients.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical outcomes, vertebral skeletal stem cell biology, and rehabilitation for metastatic spinal disease and primary spinal tumors.

subtopics.label: Chest Wall Trauma: Rib and Sternal Fixation
subtopics.description: Studies examining surgical fixation of rib and sternal injuries in trauma patients, including mortality benefits in geriatric populations and wound complication prevention strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical fixation of rib and sternal injuries in trauma patients, including mortality benefits in geriatric populations and wound prevention.

subtopics.label: Chronic Kidney Disease and Mineral Bone Disorder
subtopics.description: Research on CKD-related mineral and bone disorders including FGF23 dysregulation, TNF-alpha effects on growth and bone metabolism, vitamin D regulation, and iron therapy-induced hypophosphatemia.
subtopics.short_description: FGF23 dysregulation, vitamin D metabolism, TNF-alpha effects, and iron therapy-induced hypophosphatemia in chronic kidney disease.

subtopics.label: Nipple Reconstruction and Costal Cartilage Tissue Engineering
subtopics.description: Studies on surgical and tissue-engineering approaches to nipple reconstruction, including scaffolded autologous costal cartilage and decellularized xenograft implants for maintaining nipple geometry.
subtopics.short_description: Scaffolded autologous costal cartilage and decellularized xenograft implants for durable nipple geometry in reconstructive surgery.

subtopics.label: Occipital Neuralgia, Headache, and Peripheral Nerve Decompression
subtopics.description: Research on the relationship between musculoskeletal structures and headache disorders, including fascial changes in occipital neuralgia, migraine associations with upper extremity compressive neuropathy, and outcomes of nerve decompression surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Fascial changes in occipital neuralgia, migraine links to compressive neuropathy, and outcomes of peripheral nerve decompression surgery.

subtopics.label: Geriatric Frailty, Body Composition, and Fall Risk
subtopics.description: Studies examining body composition metrics, frailty screening tools, and fall risk factors in older adults, including CT-based body composition profiling and polypharmacy effects in nursing home populations.
subtopics.short_description: CT-based body composition profiling, frailty screening, and polypharmacy effects on fall risk in older adults and nursing home populations.

subtopics.label: Ankle and Foot Fractures and Ligament Injuries
subtopics.description: Research on diagnosis and fixation of ankle and foot injuries including intramedullary screw versus plate fixation for distal fibula fractures, MRI-based assessment of Lisfranc ligament injuries, and pediatric MCL avulsion fractures of the knee.
subtopics.display_name: Ankle & Foot Fractures and Ligament Injuries
subtopics.short_description: Fixation strategies for distal fibula fractures, MRI assessment of Lisfranc ligament injuries, and pediatric ankle and foot trauma.

subtopics.label: Inflammatory Arthritis and Rheumatic Musculoskeletal Disease
subtopics.description: Studies on inflammatory joint diseases including IL-23-driven psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis pathogenesis, lay health worker interventions for rheumatic musculoskeletal diseases, and arthritis prevalence among caregivers.
subtopics.short_description: IL-23-driven psoriatic arthritis pathogenesis, lay health worker interventions, and arthritis prevalence in community and caregiver populations.

subtopics.label: Spine Implant Utilization, Pricing, and Healthcare Economics
subtopics.description: Research on trends in spinal implant utilization and pricing, opioid prescribing patterns by orthopedic surgeons, and economic factors influencing spine surgery practice.
subtopics.short_description: Trends in spinal implant utilization and pricing, opioid prescribing patterns, and economic factors shaping spine surgery practice.

subtopics.label: Multiple Sclerosis Imaging Biomarkers and Lesion Characterization
subtopics.description: Research on advanced MRI techniques (quantitative susceptibility mapping, phase imaging, central vein sign) and corneal confocal microscopy as biomarkers for lesion characterization, neurodegeneration, and disability in multiple sclerosis. Includes paramagnetic rim lesions, myelin water fraction, and structural disconnectivity.
subtopics.short_description: Advanced MRI techniques and corneal imaging as biomarkers for lesion characterization, neurodegeneration, and disability in multiple sclerosis.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy as Biomarker in Multiple Sclerosis and Autoimmune Disease
subtopics.description: Studies using corneal confocal microscopy to quantify corneal nerve fiber loss, axonal degeneration, and immune cell infiltration as biomarkers of neurodegeneration and disease activity in multiple sclerosis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and rheumatoid arthritis.
subtopics.display_name: Corneal Confocal Microscopy in Autoimmune Disease
subtopics.short_description: Corneal nerve fiber loss and immune cell infiltration as biomarkers of neurodegeneration in MS, lupus, and rheumatoid arthritis.

subtopics.label: Multiple Sclerosis Treatment Outcomes and Disease-Modifying Therapies
subtopics.description: Clinical studies evaluating disease-modifying therapies for multiple sclerosis, particularly natalizumab and tofacitinib, including real-world effectiveness, cognitive outcomes, racial/ethnic disparities in treatment response, and CNS biomarkers of disease activity.
subtopics.short_description: Real-world effectiveness, cognitive outcomes, and racial disparities in disease-modifying therapy response for multiple sclerosis.

subtopics.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis Cardiovascular Risk and Comorbidity Management
subtopics.description: Research on cardiovascular disease risk, hyperlipidemia screening, dementia incidence, work disability, and perioperative management in patients with rheumatoid arthritis, including disparities in care and behavioral interventions to reduce CVD risk.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular disease risk, dementia incidence, work disability, and perioperative management in rheumatoid arthritis patients.

subtopics.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis Patient-Centered Outcomes, Disparities, and Clinical Management
subtopics.description: Studies examining racial and ethnic disparities in RA medication use, patient self-assessment of disease activity, lay health worker interventions, depression screening, thoracic manifestations, and synovial tissue pathotyping in rheumatoid arthritis.
subtopics.short_description: Racial and ethnic disparities in RA medication use, patient self-assessment, depression screening, and synovial tissue pathotyping.

subtopics.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Pathogenesis, Pregnancy Outcomes, and Clinical Features
subtopics.description: Research on SLE disease mechanisms including type I interferon signaling, mitochondrial retention, Langerhans cell dysfunction, and clinical studies on pregnancy morbidity, antiphospholipid syndrome management, frailty, and patient-reported experiences in lupus.
subtopics.short_description: SLE disease mechanisms including interferon signaling and mitochondrial retention, plus pregnancy morbidity and antiphospholipid syndrome management.

subtopics.label: Mechanisms of Autoimmunity and Pathogenic Autoreactivity
subtopics.description: Translational and mechanistic studies on the molecular basis of autoimmunity, including posttranslational modifications triggering self-reactivity, B cell-reactive germinal centers, PDIA3 epitope-driven autoreactivity, and the broad spectrum of pathogenic autoreactive immune responses.
subtopics.short_description: Posttranslational modifications, B cell-reactive germinal centers, and epitope-driven autoreactivity underlying pathogenic autoimmune responses.

subtopics.label: Psoriasis, Psoriatic Arthritis, and Spondyloarthritis
subtopics.description: Research on the pathogenesis and treatment of psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis, including IL-23-driven skin and joint disease in mouse models, gut microbiome regulation of sulfasalazine efficacy in IBD-associated spondyloarthritis, and IgG-seq identification of immune-reactive bacteria in Crohn's disease with spondyloarthritis.
subtopics.short_description: IL-23-driven skin and joint disease pathogenesis, gut microbiome regulation of therapy efficacy, and immune-reactive bacteria in spondyloarthritis.

subtopics.label: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Related Autoimmune and Inflammatory Adverse Events
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on immune-related adverse events (irAEs) from immune checkpoint inhibitors, including myocarditis treatment with infliximab, ophthalmic irAE consensus definitions, cumulative incidence in renal and urothelial cancers, and the impact of pre-existing immune-mediated inflammatory disease on ICI outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical management of autoimmune and inflammatory toxicities from immune checkpoint inhibitors, including myocarditis and ophthalmic complications.

subtopics.label: Thyroid Autoimmune Disease: Graves' Disease and Thyroid Autoimmunity
subtopics.description: Clinical research on autoimmune thyroid conditions including Graves' disease surgical complications, thyroid-stimulating immunoglobulin in concomitant papillary thyroid cancer, thyroid replacement therapy effects on IVF outcomes in TPO-antibody-positive women, and thyroid eye disease severity.
subtopics.short_description: Autoimmune thyroid conditions including Graves' disease complications, thyroid eye disease severity, and thyroid antibody effects on fertility outcomes.

subtopics.label: Scleroderma, Interstitial Lung Disease, and Pulmonary Fibrosis
subtopics.description: Research on interstitial lung disease and progressive pulmonary fibrosis in the context of systemic autoimmune disease, including patient-centered outcomes in ILD, patient education needs in scleroderma-ILD, and identification and management of progressive pulmonary fibrosis.
subtopics.short_description: Interstitial lung disease and progressive pulmonary fibrosis in systemic autoimmune disease, including patient-centered outcomes and education needs.

subtopics.label: Immune Thrombocytopenia, Vasculitis, and Vascular Autoimmune Conditions
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on immune thrombocytopenia diagnosis and treatment selection, leukocytoclastic vasculitis with linear IgG deposition, anti-TNF therapy-associated renal lesions, idiopathic systemic capillary leak syndrome pathogenesis, and iloprost use in vascular autoimmune conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and treatment of immune thrombocytopenia, leukocytoclastic vasculitis, capillary leak syndrome, and vascular autoimmune conditions.

subtopics.label: COVID-19-Associated Inflammatory Syndromes and Immunomodulatory Treatments
subtopics.description: Research on COVID-19-related inflammatory conditions including MIS-C in children, treatment with immunomodulators (anakinra, infliximab, IVIG), hydroxychloroquine failure in rheumatic disease patients, and COVID-19 vaccine-related immune reactions.
subtopics.short_description: MIS-C in children, immunomodulatory treatments for COVID-19 inflammation, and vaccine-related immune reactions in rheumatic disease patients.

subtopics.label: Autoimmune Gastritis, Celiac Disease, and Gastrointestinal Autoimmunity
subtopics.description: Clinical and pathological studies on autoimmune gastritis identification, celiac disease comorbidities (eosinophilic esophagitis, frailty in older adults, corneal Langerhans cells), and concurrent gastrointestinal autoimmune conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and pathological features of autoimmune gastritis, celiac disease comorbidities, and concurrent gastrointestinal autoimmune conditions.

subtopics.label: Inflammatory Bowel Disease Clinical Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on treatment strategies, comorbidities, and clinical outcomes in inflammatory bowel disease, including biologic therapies, venous thromboembolism risk, and disease phenotypes.
subtopics.short_description: Biologic therapies, venous thromboembolism risk, comorbidities, and clinical outcomes across inflammatory bowel disease phenotypes.

subtopics.label: Innate Lymphoid Cell Biology in Inflammation and Autoimmunity
subtopics.description: Studies examining the roles of innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), including ILC2s and ILC3s, in regulating intestinal inflammation, neuroinflammation, and immune homeostasis.
subtopics.short_description: Roles of ILC2s and ILC3s in regulating intestinal inflammation, neuroinflammation, and immune homeostasis in autoimmune contexts.

subtopics.label: Store-Operated Calcium Entry and Immunomodulatory Signaling
subtopics.description: Research on store-operated calcium entry (SOCE) pathways and their pharmacological modulation as therapeutic targets in immune and inflammatory conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Store-operated calcium entry pathways and their pharmacological modulation as therapeutic targets in immune and inflammatory disease.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Neurological, Vascular, and Cutaneous Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on the pathophysiology and clinical manifestations of COVID-19 affecting the nervous system, vasculature, and skin, including complement activation and neuro-ophthalmic sequelae.
subtopics.short_description: Pathophysiology of COVID-19 affecting the nervous system, vasculature, and skin, including complement activation and neuro-ophthalmic sequelae.

subtopics.label: Immunoglobulin Biology: IgA Glycomics and Anti-CD4 IgG in HIV
subtopics.description: Research on immunoglobulin structure and function, including IgA glycosylation genetics and the role of anti-CD4 IgG autoantibodies in HIV-associated immune dysfunction and brain abnormalities.
subtopics.short_description: IgA glycosylation genetics and anti-CD4 IgG autoantibodies in HIV-associated immune dysfunction and neurological abnormalities.

subtopics.label: Small Molecule Immunomodulators Targeting RORγt and Tryptophan Metabolism
subtopics.description: Studies on novel small molecule modulators of immune pathways, including RORγt nuclear receptor ligands and tryptophan-derived immunomodulatory metabolites, as potential autoimmune therapeutics.
subtopics.short_description: Novel small molecule modulators of RORγt and tryptophan-derived metabolites as candidate therapeutics for autoimmune disease.

subtopics.label: Autoimmune Encephalitis and Neuropsychiatric Autoimmune Conditions
subtopics.description: Research on autoimmune neurological conditions including anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and blood-brain barrier dysfunction in neuropsychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia.
subtopics.short_description: Anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and blood-brain barrier dysfunction in neuropsychiatric autoimmune conditions including schizophrenia.

subtopics.label: Healthcare Financing, Payment Models, and Insurance Policy
subtopics.description: Research on healthcare payment systems including Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement, value-based payment programs (MIPS, ACOs, bundled payments), insurance coverage policies, drug pricing, private equity investment in healthcare, and the financial organization of health systems.
subtopics.short_description: Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement, value-based payment programs, insurance coverage, drug pricing, and financial organization of health systems.

subtopics.label: Care Coordination, Fragmentation, and Continuity of Care
subtopics.description: Studies examining ambulatory care fragmentation, gaps in care coordination, health information exchange, transitions of care, and their associations with healthcare utilization, costs, and patient outcomes across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Ambulatory care fragmentation, health information exchange, and care transitions and their effects on utilization, costs, and patient outcomes.

subtopics.label: Telemedicine, Telehealth, and Digital Health Services
subtopics.description: Research on the implementation, utilization, effectiveness, and equity implications of telemedicine and digital health technologies across clinical settings, including patient satisfaction, access disparities, and policy changes during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.
subtopics.short_description: Implementation, effectiveness, and equity implications of telemedicine and digital health technologies across clinical settings and policy environments.

subtopics.label: Racial, Ethnic, and Socioeconomic Disparities in Healthcare Access and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Population-level research documenting racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in healthcare access, treatment utilization, quality of care, and clinical outcomes, including studies on structural racism, implicit bias, and interventions to reduce inequities.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic gaps in healthcare access, treatment utilization, quality of care, and clinical outcomes across populations.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use, Substance Use Disorder Treatment, and Drug Policy
subtopics.description: Research on opioid prescribing patterns, prescription drug monitoring programs, medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD), harm reduction interventions, substance use disorder treatment financing, and state and federal drug policies and their effects on health outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid prescribing, prescription monitoring, medications for opioid use disorder, harm reduction, and state and federal drug policy effects on health.

subtopics.label: Social Determinants of Health and Population Health Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining how social determinants of health (SDOH)—including income, education, neighborhood conditions, housing, and social vulnerability—affect cardiovascular disease, cancer, stroke, and other health outcomes, as well as methods for measuring and addressing SDOH in clinical and population settings.
subtopics.short_description: Income, education, housing, and neighborhood conditions as drivers of cardiovascular, cancer, and other population health outcomes.

subtopics.label: Hospital Utilization, Quality Improvement, and Patient Safety
subtopics.description: Research on hospital admission rates, readmissions, length of stay, quality improvement initiatives, patient safety programs, and the organization of inpatient care including ICU staffing, discharge processes, and care protocols.
subtopics.short_description: Hospital admissions, readmissions, quality improvement initiatives, patient safety programs, and inpatient care organization including ICU staffing.

subtopics.label: Nursing Home and Long-Term Care Quality, Staffing, and Policy
subtopics.description: Research on nursing home quality, staffing levels, ownership structures (private equity, REITs), resident outcomes, end-of-life care in long-term care settings, and policies governing skilled nursing facilities and home health care.
subtopics.short_description: Nursing home quality, staffing levels, ownership structures, resident outcomes, and policies governing skilled nursing and home health facilities.

subtopics.label: Medicaid Expansion, Insurance Coverage, and Access to Care
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating the effects of Medicaid expansion under the Affordable Care Act, insurance coverage changes, and related policies on healthcare access, utilization, treatment initiation, and health outcomes across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of Affordable Care Act Medicaid expansion and insurance coverage changes on access, utilization, and health outcomes across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Impact on Health Systems and Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Research on how the COVID-19 pandemic affected healthcare delivery, hospital operations, clinical trial conduct, workforce well-being, and patient care across specialties, including adaptations in care models, resource allocation, and pandemic response strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Pandemic effects on healthcare delivery, hospital operations, workforce well-being, and care model adaptations across clinical specialties.

subtopics.label: Elder Mistreatment, Elder Care, and Aging Services
subtopics.description: Research on the identification, prevention, and response to elder mistreatment and abuse, including emergency department-based programs, multidisciplinary teams, screening tools, and the health and economic consequences of elder abuse in community and institutional settings.
subtopics.short_description: Identification, prevention, and response to elder abuse, including screening tools, multidisciplinary teams, and health and economic consequences.

subtopics.label: Cancer Screening, Survivorship Care, and Oncology Health Services
subtopics.description: Population-level research on cancer screening utilization and disparities, cancer survivorship care coordination, treatment patterns, and the organization of oncology services including access to high-volume centers and guideline-concordant care.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level cancer screening disparities, survivorship care coordination, treatment patterns, and access to guideline-concordant oncology services.

subtopics.label: Home Health Care, Community Health Workers, and Direct Care Workforce
subtopics.description: Research on home health care delivery for patients with chronic conditions, the role and training of home health aides and community health workers, workforce characteristics, and interventions to improve care quality and worker well-being in home and community settings.
subtopics.short_description: Home health delivery for chronic conditions, community health worker roles, workforce characteristics, and care quality in home and community settings.

subtopics.label: Global Health Systems and Healthcare Delivery in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research on healthcare delivery, disease burden, health system capacity, and intervention effectiveness in low- and middle-income countries, with particular focus on sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia, the Middle East, and the Caribbean, including infectious disease programs and emergency care systems.
subtopics.display_name: Global Health Systems in Low-Income Countries
subtopics.short_description: Healthcare delivery, disease burden, and health system capacity in low- and middle-income countries across Africa, South Asia, and the Caribbean.

subtopics.label: Mental Health Services, Behavioral Health Policy, and Psychiatric Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Research on the organization, financing, and delivery of mental health and behavioral health services, including mental health parity enforcement, integration of behavioral health into primary care, psychiatric hospitalization, suicide prevention, and workforce issues in mental health settings.
subtopics.short_description: Financing, organization, and delivery of mental health services, including parity enforcement, primary care integration, and psychiatric workforce issues.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Epidemiology, Clinical Outcomes, and Variants
subtopics.description: Research characterizing SARS-CoV-2 transmission dynamics, clinical severity, hospitalization outcomes, variant-specific disease burden, and population-level epidemiological patterns across diverse geographic settings including Qatar, New York City, and global cohorts.
subtopics.short_description: SARS-CoV-2 transmission dynamics, variant-specific disease burden, and hospitalization outcomes across global populations.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Vaccines, Immunity, and Reinfection Protection
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating mRNA and other COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness, waning immunity, booster doses, hybrid immunity, breakthrough infections, and natural infection protection against SARS-CoV-2 variants including Omicron, primarily from Qatar's national cohort and other large populations.
subtopics.short_description: mRNA and other vaccine effectiveness, waning immunity, booster doses, and hybrid immunity against SARS-CoV-2 variants.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Impact on Health Systems and Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Research examining how the COVID-19 pandemic disrupted healthcare delivery, surgical operations, clinical trials, mental health services, and public health programs, including adaptations such as telehealth expansion, hospital surge planning, and infection control protocols.
subtopics.short_description: COVID-19 impacts on healthcare delivery, surgical operations, mental health services, and telehealth adaptation.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Mental Health and Psychosocial Impacts
subtopics.description: Studies investigating psychological distress, loneliness, anxiety, depression, and mental health service utilization among diverse populations during the COVID-19 pandemic, including healthcare workers, college students, older adults, children, and specific community groups.
subtopics.short_description: Psychological distress, anxiety, and depression among healthcare workers, students, older adults, and community groups during COVID-19.

subtopics.label: Long COVID and Post-Acute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2
subtopics.description: Research characterizing the prevalence, risk factors, symptoms, and functional impacts of post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC/Long COVID), including racial and ethnic disparities, environmental risk factors, and treatment effects on long COVID outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, risk factors, symptoms, and functional impacts of post-acute SARS-CoV-2 sequelae, including racial and ethnic disparities.

subtopics.label: Health Disparities, Social Determinants of Health, and Health Equity
subtopics.description: Population-level research examining how social determinants of health (race/ethnicity, socioeconomic status, neighborhood conditions, insurance coverage) drive disparities in disease outcomes, healthcare access, and mortality across diverse U.S. and international populations.
subtopics.short_description: Social determinants — race, income, neighborhood, insurance — driving disparities in disease outcomes and healthcare access.

subtopics.label: Infectious Disease Epidemiology and Control in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Studies on the burden, transmission, prevention, and treatment of infectious diseases including HIV, tuberculosis, hepatitis, schistosomiasis, malaria, and sexually transmitted infections in low- and middle-income countries across sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia, the Middle East, and Latin America.
subtopics.short_description: Burden, transmission, and control of HIV, TB, malaria, hepatitis, and STIs in low- and middle-income countries.

subtopics.label: HIV-Associated Comorbidities and Cardiovascular Disease in Sub-Saharan Africa
subtopics.description: Research from Tanzania and other sub-Saharan African settings examining cardiovascular complications, renal disease, blood pressure, metabolic disorders, and mortality among people living with HIV, including the effects of antiretroviral therapy on cardiometabolic outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic complications of HIV and antiretroviral therapy in sub-Saharan African populations.

subtopics.label: Non-Communicable Disease Burden and Management in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and intervention research on diabetes, hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and related non-communicable diseases in low- and middle-income country settings including Haiti, Qatar, Tanzania, Jordan, Oman, and India, with emphasis on community-based management and mathematical modeling of disease burden.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology and community-based management of diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease in low- and middle-income settings.

subtopics.label: Sexually Transmitted Infection Epidemiology and Mathematical Modeling
subtopics.description: Systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and mathematical modeling studies characterizing the global and regional epidemiology of herpes simplex virus types 1 and 2, gonorrhea, chlamydia, syphilis, and HIV, including transmission dynamics, intervention impact, and economic burden particularly in MENA, sub-Saharan Africa, and other regions.
subtopics.short_description: Global and regional burden of herpes, gonorrhea, chlamydia, syphilis, and HIV modeled for transmission dynamics and intervention impact.

subtopics.label: Viral Hepatitis Epidemiology, Screening, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology, screening, treatment, and elimination of hepatitis B, C, and D infections across diverse populations including people who inject drugs, pregnant women, and populations in the Middle East, North Africa, and the United States, with emphasis on access to care and treatment outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Screening, treatment, and elimination of hepatitis B, C, and D across high-risk populations and diverse geographic settings.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use, Substance Use Policy, and Harm Reduction
subtopics.description: Studies examining opioid prescribing policies, overdose prevention, naloxone distribution, medication for opioid use disorder, harm reduction programs including syringe service programs, and the economic burden of drug overdose in the United States, with attention to policy effectiveness and health equity.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid prescribing policy, naloxone distribution, medication-assisted treatment, and syringe service program effectiveness.

subtopics.label: Maternal, Perinatal, and Reproductive Health
subtopics.description: Research on maternal morbidity and mortality, perinatal outcomes, prenatal substance use policies, reproductive health disparities, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and interventions to improve maternal and newborn health across diverse populations in the United States and low- and middle-income countries.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal mortality, perinatal outcomes, reproductive health disparities, and interventions across U.S. and LMIC populations.

subtopics.label: Emergency Care, Trauma, and Surgical Capacity in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Studies on traumatic spinal injuries, burn care, emergency medical systems, surgical capacity building, and trauma outcomes in low- and middle-income country settings particularly in East Africa, Pakistan, and other resource-limited environments, including telemedicine and training innovations.
subtopics.display_name: Emergency Care & Surgical Capacity in LMICs
subtopics.short_description: Trauma outcomes, burn care, emergency medical systems, and surgical capacity building in resource-limited settings.

subtopics.label: Elder Mistreatment, Elder Abuse Prevention, and Aging Populations
subtopics.description: Research on the prevalence, risk factors, detection, and community response to elder mistreatment including physical abuse, financial exploitation, and caregiver neglect, with studies examining multidisciplinary team approaches, screening tools, and the impact of COVID-19 on elder abuse rates.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, risk factors, and multidisciplinary responses to physical abuse, financial exploitation, and caregiver neglect in older adults.

subtopics.label: Malaria Parasite Biology, Drug Resistance, and Novel Therapeutics
subtopics.description: Research on Plasmodium falciparum and vivax biology, mechanisms of antimalarial drug resistance, and development of novel therapeutic agents including proteasome inhibitors and epigenetic targets.
subtopics.short_description: Plasmodium biology, antimalarial drug resistance mechanisms, and development of proteasome inhibitors and epigenetic therapeutic targets.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Diagnostics, Testing Methods, and Surveillance
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating RT-PCR, rapid antigen, serological, and molecular assays for SARS-CoV-2 detection, including variant genotyping, wastewater surveillance, and diagnostic performance comparisons.
subtopics.short_description: Performance of RT-PCR, rapid antigen, and serological assays for SARS-CoV-2, including wastewater surveillance and variant genotyping.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Treatment, Therapeutics, and Clinical Management
subtopics.description: Research on pharmacological treatments for COVID-19 including monoclonal antibodies, antivirals, repurposed drugs, and clinical management strategies across disease severity levels.
subtopics.short_description: Monoclonal antibodies, antivirals, and repurposed drug therapies for COVID-19 across disease severity levels.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 in Pediatric Populations and Children's Health During the Pandemic
subtopics.description: Studies examining SARS-CoV-2 infection presentation, severity, hospitalization, and immune responses in children and adolescents, including Omicron wave impacts and pandemic effects on pediatric care.
subtopics.short_description: SARS-CoV-2 severity, hospitalization, and immune responses in children and adolescents, including Omicron wave impacts.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Population Immunity, Mathematical Modeling, and Epidemiological Interventions
subtopics.description: Mathematical and epidemiological modeling of SARS-CoV-2 transmission, herd immunity, reinfection dynamics, non-pharmaceutical interventions, and vaccination prioritization strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Mathematical modeling of SARS-CoV-2 transmission, herd immunity, reinfection dynamics, and vaccination prioritization strategies.

subtopics.label: Suicide Epidemiology, Risk Factors, and Prevention Across Populations
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies of suicidal ideation, attempts, and deaths across demographic groups, including geographic variation, social determinants, adolescent trajectories, and prevention interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level patterns of suicidal ideation, attempts, and deaths, including social determinants and prevention interventions.

subtopics.label: Antimicrobial Resistance, Carbapenem-Resistant Organisms, and Infection Control
subtopics.description: Studies on detection, epidemiology, and management of carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales, multidrug-resistant gram-negative bacteria, and antimicrobial resistance surveillance in clinical and environmental settings.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology and management of carbapenem-resistant organisms and multidrug-resistant gram-negative bacteria in clinical settings.

subtopics.label: Tuberculosis Diagnosis, Treatment, and Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Research on TB diagnosis including novel assays and drug resistance testing, treatment regimens for drug-sensitive and drug-resistant TB, and epidemiological modeling of TB burden and co-morbidities.
subtopics.short_description: Novel TB diagnostics, drug-sensitive and drug-resistant treatment regimens, and epidemiological modeling of TB burden.

subtopics.label: Non-Communicable Disease Epidemiology and Health Research in Qatar and the Gulf Region
subtopics.description: Studies examining diabetes, hypertension, obesity, mental health, and other NCDs in Qatar and Gulf Cooperation Council countries, including population-based surveys, risk factor analyses, and health system capacity.
subtopics.display_name: NCD Epidemiology in Qatar & the Gulf
subtopics.short_description: Diabetes, hypertension, obesity, and mental health burden in Qatar and Gulf Cooperation Council countries.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular Disease Burden and Risk Factors in Low-Income Settings, Particularly Haiti
subtopics.description: Population-based studies of cardiovascular disease prevalence, risk factors (hypertension, diabetes, diet, environmental exposures), and management in low-income countries with a focus on Haiti and sub-Saharan Africa.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence and risk factors for cardiovascular disease in Haiti and sub-Saharan Africa, including hypertension and environmental exposures.

subtopics.label: Heat-Related Illness, Climate Change, and Environmental Health Impacts
subtopics.description: Research on health impacts of extreme heat events and natural disasters, including heat stroke biomarkers, community interventions, cardiovascular and sleep effects, and climate-related health equity.
subtopics.short_description: Health impacts of extreme heat and natural disasters, including cardiovascular effects, community interventions, and climate health equity.

subtopics.label: Perinatal HIV Transmission, Broadly Neutralizing Antibodies, and Infant Immunization
subtopics.description: Studies on maternal-to-child HIV transmission mechanisms, the role of broadly neutralizing antibodies in preventing perinatal and breastmilk transmission, and development of passive and active HIV immunization strategies for infants.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal-to-child HIV transmission, broadly neutralizing antibodies, and passive and active immunization strategies for infants.

subtopics.label: Reproductive Health Policy, Abortion Access, and Contraceptive Autonomy
subtopics.description: Research on abortion access, stigma, and policy including crowdfunding, community-level stigma interventions, and reproductive justice frameworks, as well as contraceptive autonomy and family planning in diverse settings.
subtopics.short_description: Abortion access, stigma, and policy alongside contraceptive autonomy and reproductive justice frameworks across diverse settings.

subtopics.label: Home Health Aides, Long-Term Care Workforce, and Nursing Home Quality
subtopics.description: Studies examining the health, working conditions, and disaster preparedness of home health aides and long-term care workers, as well as quality, staffing, and outcomes in nursing homes.
subtopics.display_name: Long-Term Care Workforce & Nursing Home Quality
subtopics.short_description: Working conditions, disaster preparedness, and health of home health aides alongside staffing and quality in nursing homes.

subtopics.label: Cancer Screening, Survivorship, and Disparities in Access and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on cancer screening uptake, survivorship prevalence and outcomes, and disparities by race, ethnicity, language, and socioeconomic status, including interventions to improve equitable access.
subtopics.short_description: Cancer screening uptake, survivorship outcomes, and racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in access and care.

subtopics.label: Residency & Fellowship Curriculum Development
subtopics.description: Research on the design, implementation, and evaluation of training curricula within residency and fellowship programs across medical specialties, including competency-based education, scholarly activity, and program director perspectives.
subtopics.short_description: Competency-based curriculum development, evaluation, and scholarly training across residency and fellowship programs.

subtopics.label: Simulation-Based & Procedural Skills Training
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating simulation models, high-fidelity simulators, 3D-printed models, virtual reality, and augmented reality tools for procedural and clinical skills training across surgical and non-surgical specialties.
subtopics.short_description: High-fidelity simulators, virtual reality, and 3D-printed models for clinical and procedural skills education.

subtopics.label: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion in Medicine
subtopics.description: Research examining gender, racial, and ethnic representation in academic medicine, surgical specialties, and training programs, including initiatives to address disparities in faculty promotion, awards, and recruitment of underrepresented minorities.
subtopics.short_description: Gender, racial, and ethnic representation in academic medicine, faculty promotion, and recruitment of underrepresented minorities.

subtopics.label: Faculty Development & Academic Leadership
subtopics.description: Research on faculty development programs, leadership curricula, mentorship, academic promotion, and the skills and roles needed for effective leadership in academic medicine and medical education.
subtopics.short_description: Leadership curricula, mentorship, academic promotion, and faculty development programs in academic medicine.

subtopics.label: Physician & Healthcare Worker Burnout and Well-Being
subtopics.description: Studies investigating burnout prevalence, moral distress, compassion fatigue, and wellness interventions among physicians, residents, fellows, and other healthcare professionals across specialties.
subtopics.short_description: Burnout prevalence, moral distress, compassion fatigue, and wellness interventions across healthcare professions.

subtopics.label: Medical Student Education & Clerkship Training
subtopics.description: Research on undergraduate medical education including clerkship curricula, assessment methods, virtual and remote learning innovations, and student engagement across clinical and preclinical training.
subtopics.short_description: Undergraduate medical education including clerkship curricula, assessment methods, and virtual learning innovations.

subtopics.label: Telehealth, Virtual Learning & Digital Education Technologies
subtopics.description: Research on the use of telemedicine, virtual classrooms, e-learning platforms, augmented reality, and digital tools for medical education, remote clinical training, and healthcare delivery.
subtopics.short_description: E-learning platforms, virtual classrooms, and digital tools for medical education and remote clinical training.

subtopics.label: Surgical Training, Learning Curves & Operative Education
subtopics.description: Studies examining surgical skill acquisition, learning curves, operative autonomy assessment, research training during surgical residency, and the impact of experience on surgical outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical skill acquisition, learning curves, operative autonomy, and the impact of experience on surgical outcomes.

subtopics.label: Home Health Aides & Direct Care Workforce
subtopics.description: Research on the training, health, working conditions, job satisfaction, and role of home health aides and direct care workers in supporting patients with chronic conditions such as heart failure.
subtopics.short_description: Training, working conditions, and job satisfaction of home health aides and direct care workers supporting chronic-disease patients.

subtopics.label: Palliative Care Education & Clinician Training
subtopics.description: Research on training programs, competency development, and educational interventions for palliative care and hospice medicine clinicians, including mental health integration, communication skills, and fellowship program curricula.
subtopics.short_description: Competency development, communication skills training, and fellowship curricula for palliative and hospice medicine clinicians.

subtopics.label: Global Health Education & Capacity Building in Low-Resource Settings
subtopics.description: Studies on surgical training, capacity building, and healthcare education initiatives in low- and middle-income countries, including telementoring, simulation-based training, and surgical camps in sub-Saharan Africa and other resource-limited settings.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical training, telementoring, and healthcare education initiatives in low- and middle-income countries.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Impact on Healthcare Workforce & Training
subtopics.description: Research examining how the COVID-19 pandemic affected healthcare worker well-being, clinical training disruptions, redeployment, and institutional adaptations in residency programs and clinical operations.
subtopics.short_description: Pandemic effects on healthcare worker well-being, clinical training disruptions, and institutional adaptations in residency programs.

subtopics.label: Communication Skills Training & Patient-Provider Interaction
subtopics.description: Research on educational interventions, curricula, and assessment tools designed to improve clinician communication skills, including breaking bad news, prognostic communication, and patient-provider concordance effects on care.
subtopics.short_description: Educational interventions to improve clinician communication, including breaking bad news and prognostic conversations.

subtopics.label: ICU Staffing, Workforce Models & Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining intensivist staffing ratios, ICU workforce composition, advanced practice provider roles, and the relationship between staffing patterns and patient outcomes in critical care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Intensivist staffing ratios, advanced practice provider roles, and staffing patterns in relation to critical care outcomes.

subtopics.label: Radiology & Imaging Education and Training
subtopics.description: Research on curriculum development, simulation tools, fellowship training, and competency assessment in diagnostic radiology and breast imaging education. Includes longitudinal curricula, hands-on MRI training, oral boards preparation, and integration of radiology into clinical clerkships.
subtopics.short_description: Curriculum development, simulation tools, and competency assessment in diagnostic radiology and breast imaging training.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Behavioral & Mental Health Competency Training
subtopics.description: Studies examining how pediatric residents and fellows acquire competency in behavioral and mental health care, including training site characteristics, educational resources, and self-reported preparedness for managing pediatric mental health conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Resident and fellow preparedness for behavioral and mental health care, including training resources and self-assessed competency.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use Disorder Treatment: Clinician Attitudes, Stigma & Practice Patterns
subtopics.description: Research on how clinician stigma, training background, and institutional policies shape treatment of opioid use disorder and substance use disorders, including prescribing behavior, harm reduction approaches, and barriers to medication-assisted treatment.
subtopics.display_name: Clinician Attitudes Toward Opioid Use Disorder
subtopics.short_description: Stigma, training, and institutional policies shaping clinician prescribing and harm reduction for opioid use disorder.

subtopics.label: CPR, Bleeding Control & Community Emergency Response Training
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating bystander and community-level training programs in cardiopulmonary resuscitation, hemorrhage control (Stop the Bleed), and emergency response skills, including program implementation, effectiveness, and barriers to adoption.
subtopics.short_description: Bystander training programs in CPR, hemorrhage control, and emergency response skills, including effectiveness and adoption barriers.

subtopics.label: Elder Mistreatment Detection, Assessment & Clinical Response
subtopics.description: Research on identifying, documenting, and responding to elder mistreatment across clinical settings including emergency departments and prehospital care, encompassing tool development, interdisciplinary team models, and specialist roles.
subtopics.short_description: Identifying, documenting, and responding to elder mistreatment across emergency departments and clinical settings.

subtopics.label: Interprofessional Collaboration, Peer Coaching & Team-Based Care Training
subtopics.description: Studies on training peer coaches, lay health workers, and interprofessional teams to deliver or support clinical care, including motivational interviewing, collaborative care models, and facilitators and barriers to interprofessional practice.
subtopics.short_description: Training peer coaches and interprofessional teams in collaborative care models, motivational interviewing, and team-based practice.

subtopics.label: Nursing Home & Long-Term Care Workforce Burnout and Turnover
subtopics.description: Research examining how resident aggression, burnout, and fatigue contribute to staff turnover intentions in nursing homes and long-term care facilities, including cross-cultural studies and leadership factors affecting resilience.
subtopics.short_description: Resident aggression, burnout, and fatigue as drivers of staff turnover in nursing homes and long-term care facilities.

subtopics.label: Diagnostic Error, Clinical Practice Gaps & Quality Improvement
subtopics.description: Studies identifying gaps in clinical diagnosis, screening, and practice patterns across specialties, including diagnostic errors in stroke and neurology, screening adherence, and quality improvement initiatives to address care deficiencies.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical diagnosis gaps, screening adherence, and quality improvement initiatives addressing care deficiencies across specialties.

subtopics.label: Medical & University Student Mental Health and Well-Being
subtopics.description: Research on mental health, stress, and well-being among medical and university students, including factors associated with perceived stress, internet addiction, and interventions to support student mental health across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Stress, mental health challenges, and wellness interventions among medical and university students across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Specialty-Specific Competency Assessment & Training Programs
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating competency assessment tools, training curricula, and educational interventions across medical specialties including pharmacy, genetic counseling, speech-language pathology, and emergency medicine, with focus on skill acquisition and knowledge gaps.
subtopics.short_description: Competency tools and training curricula across pharmacy, genetic counseling, speech-language pathology, and emergency medicine.

subtopics.label: Healthcare System Policy, Workforce Organization & Practice Patterns
subtopics.description: Research examining how healthcare system structures, policies, and physician practice patterns affect care delivery, including hospital-physician integration, telehealth delivery variation, single-payer perspectives, and academic compensation models.
subtopics.short_description: System structures, physician practice patterns, telehealth variation, and compensation models affecting care delivery.

subtopics.label: Arts, Humanities & Reflective Practice in Medicine
subtopics.description: Studies on the use of creative arts, poetry, music therapy, contemplative medicine, and humanities-based approaches to support clinician well-being, patient care, and professional identity formation in medical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Creative arts, poetry, music therapy, and humanities-based approaches supporting clinician well-being and professional identity.

subtopics.label: Patient-Provider Trust, Engagement & Shared Decision-Making
subtopics.description: Research on factors shaping patient trust in providers, patient perspectives on care quality, race concordance effects, and clinician strategies for building therapeutic relationships and addressing patient concerns.
subtopics.short_description: Patient trust, race concordance effects, and clinician strategies for therapeutic relationships and shared decision-making.

subtopics.label: Health Equity, Disparities & Community-Based Screening
subtopics.description: Studies addressing racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic health disparities through community screening programs, equity-focused clinical trial design, implicit bias in clinical care, and social determinants of health integration into practice.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic health disparities addressed through community screening, implicit bias reduction, and social determinants.

subtopics.label: Prolonged Grief Disorder: Assessment, Epidemiology, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on the measurement, validation, prevalence, risk factors, and treatment of Prolonged Grief Disorder (PGD), including psychometric validation of scales (PG-13, PG-13-R) across cultures, correlates such as attachment and trauma, and pharmacological or psychological interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Measurement, prevalence, risk factors, and psychological or pharmacological treatment of Prolonged Grief Disorder across cultures.

subtopics.label: Mental Health Integration in Hospice and Palliative Care
subtopics.description: Research examining the integration of behavioral health and psychiatric services into hospice and palliative care settings, including surveys of unmet mental health needs, service gaps, training competencies, and models for delivering psychiatric care to seriously ill patients.
subtopics.display_name: Behavioral Health Integration in Palliative Care
subtopics.short_description: Models and gaps in delivering psychiatric and behavioral health services to seriously ill patients in hospice and palliative settings.

subtopics.label: Hospice Utilization, Quality, and Organizational Factors
subtopics.description: Studies on patterns of hospice use, quality of care measures, site of death, and the impact of organizational factors such as private equity acquisition on hospice care delivery and patient outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Patterns of hospice use, quality-of-care measures, and the effect of organizational factors like private equity on care delivery.

subtopics.label: Goals-of-Care Communication and Prognostic Disclosure
subtopics.description: Research on clinician-patient communication about prognosis, goals of care, and serious illness, including interventions to improve prognostic understanding, training programs for delivering bad news, and factors influencing communication quality across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Clinician-patient communication about prognosis and serious illness, including training programs and interventions across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Advance Care Planning and End-of-Life Decision-Making
subtopics.description: Studies on advance care planning practices, do-not-resuscitate orders, surrogate decision-making, and end-of-life care preferences, including disparities by race/ethnicity, immigrant status, and disability, and interventions to improve ACP engagement.
subtopics.short_description: ACP practices, surrogate decision-making, DNR orders, and disparities in end-of-life preferences by race, ethnicity, and disability status.

subtopics.label: Family Caregiver Burden, Well-Being, and Support Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on the physical, psychological, and social burden experienced by family caregivers of seriously ill patients, including interventions to reduce caregiver distress, improve self-efficacy, and support caregivers in hospice and home care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Physical, psychological, and social burden on family caregivers of seriously ill patients, and interventions to reduce distress and improve well-being.

subtopics.label: Pain and Symptom Management in Serious Illness
subtopics.description: Research on assessment and treatment of pain and other symptoms (dyspnea, fatigue, constipation) in seriously ill patients, including opioid prescribing patterns, non-pharmacological interventions, and symptom burden in specific disease populations.
subtopics.display_name: Pain & Symptom Management in Serious Illness
subtopics.short_description: Assessment and treatment of pain, dyspnea, and fatigue in seriously ill patients, including opioid prescribing and non-pharmacological approaches.

subtopics.label: Spiritual, Religious, and Integrative Care in Palliative Settings
subtopics.description: Studies on the role of spirituality, religion, and complementary/integrative medicine (including music therapy, art therapy, and poetry) in palliative care, examining their impact on patient well-being, pain, and quality of death.
subtopics.short_description: Role of spirituality, religion, and complementary therapies such as music and art in improving well-being and quality of death.

subtopics.label: Palliative Care Education, Workforce Training, and Program Development
subtopics.description: Research on training programs, educational curricula, and workforce development in palliative and hospice medicine, including fellowship training, simulation-based education, telehealth-based education, and integration of trainees into clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Training curricula, fellowship programs, simulation-based education, and telehealth-based workforce development in palliative and hospice medicine.

subtopics.label: Telehealth, COVID-19, and Palliative Care Service Delivery
subtopics.description: Studies on the adaptation of palliative care delivery during the COVID-19 pandemic, including telemedicine implementation, virtual consultations, ethics consultation during crisis, and the impact of COVID-19 on end-of-life care practices.
subtopics.short_description: Adaptation of palliative care through telemedicine and virtual consultations during the COVID-19 pandemic, including ethics consultation in crisis settings.

subtopics.label: Racial, Ethnic, and Socioeconomic Disparities in Palliative and End-of-Life Care
subtopics.description: Research examining disparities in access to and quality of palliative care, hospice use, advance care planning, and end-of-life outcomes among racial/ethnic minority, immigrant, and socioeconomically disadvantaged populations.
subtopics.short_description: Disparities in palliative care access, hospice use, and end-of-life outcomes among racial, ethnic, immigrant, and socioeconomically disadvantaged populations.

subtopics.label: Disorders of Consciousness: Ethics, Assessment, and Decision-Making
subtopics.description: Research on ethical, clinical, and legal issues surrounding patients with disorders of consciousness, including assessment of covert awareness, ethical frameworks for research and care, and disability rights considerations.
subtopics.short_description: Ethical, legal, and clinical issues in caring for patients with disorders of consciousness, including covert awareness assessment and disability rights.

subtopics.label: Psychiatric Comorbidities and Psychosocial Outcomes in Serious Illness
subtopics.description: Studies on the prevalence and impact of psychiatric conditions (depression, anxiety, PTSD) in patients with serious illness and their caregivers, including screening, psychosocial interventions, and the relationship between mental health and end-of-life care utilization.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence and impact of depression, anxiety, and PTSD in seriously ill patients and caregivers, and psychosocial interventions to address them.

subtopics.label: Hospice Caregiver Experience and Home-Based Palliative Care Quality
subtopics.description: Research on caregiver-reported quality measures in home hospice care, challenges faced by hospice caregivers, and interventions to improve caregiver preparedness, symptom management support, and satisfaction with home-based end-of-life care.
subtopics.display_name: Hospice Caregiver Experience & Home Care Quality
subtopics.short_description: Caregiver-reported quality measures in home hospice, challenges in caregiving, and interventions to improve preparedness and satisfaction.

subtopics.label: ICU Utilization, Mechanical Ventilation, and End-of-Life Care in Critical Settings
subtopics.description: Research examining intensive care unit utilization patterns, mechanical ventilation allocation and triage, and the impact of palliative care on reducing aggressive interventions during terminal hospitalizations.
subtopics.short_description: Intensive care utilization, mechanical ventilation triage, and palliative care's role in reducing aggressive interventions during terminal hospitalizations.

subtopics.label: Quality of Life and Patient-Reported Outcomes in Interstitial Lung Disease
subtopics.description: Studies focused on measuring and improving health-related quality of life, symptom burden, and patient-centered outcomes in patients with interstitial lung diseases including idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and hypersensitivity pneumonitis.
subtopics.display_name: Quality of Life in Interstitial Lung Disease
subtopics.short_description: Health-related quality of life, symptom burden, and patient-centered outcomes in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and related interstitial lung diseases.

subtopics.label: Cancer Survivorship, Quality of Life, and Patient-Reported Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on long-term quality of life, symptom monitoring, and survivorship outcomes in cancer patients including breast cancer, AML, and other malignancies, often using patient-reported outcome measures.
subtopics.short_description: Long-term quality of life, symptom monitoring, and survivorship outcomes in cancer patients using patient-reported outcome measures.

subtopics.label: Geriatric Assessment and Care for Older Adults with Serious Illness
subtopics.description: Studies applying geriatric assessment tools and frameworks to older adults with serious illnesses such as cancer, heart failure, dementia, and HIV, examining functional outcomes, care quality, and multimorbidity.
subtopics.short_description: Geriatric assessment frameworks applied to older adults with cancer, heart failure, dementia, and HIV, examining functional outcomes and multimorbidity.

subtopics.label: Crisis Standards of Care, Resource Allocation, and Pandemic Ethics
subtopics.description: Ethical and policy analyses of resource allocation, triage protocols, and crisis standards of care during pandemics and public health emergencies, including equity concerns for vulnerable populations.
subtopics.display_name: Crisis Standards of Care & Pandemic Ethics
subtopics.short_description: Ethical and policy analysis of triage protocols, resource allocation, and equity concerns for vulnerable populations during public health emergencies.

subtopics.label: High-Cost Medicare Patients and End-of-Life Spending Patterns
subtopics.description: Research characterizing high-cost Medicare beneficiaries, geographic variation in spending, and potentially preventable or wasteful expenditures at the end of life.
subtopics.short_description: Geographic variation, high-cost beneficiary profiles, and potentially preventable expenditures in Medicare end-of-life care.

subtopics.label: Caregiver Health, Self-Care, and Physician Engagement with Caregiver Needs
subtopics.description: Studies examining how caregiving roles affect caregivers' own health behaviors and self-care, including medication misuse, diabetes management, and physician motivations to address caregiver needs.
subtopics.short_description: How caregiving roles affect caregivers' own health behaviors, including medication misuse, chronic disease management, and physician engagement with caregiver needs.

subtopics.label: Digital Health and mHealth Interventions for Symptom Monitoring and Self-Management
subtopics.description: Research on mobile health applications, electronic patient-reported outcomes, and virtual care platforms designed to monitor symptoms and support self-management in patients with serious illness or cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Mobile apps, electronic patient-reported outcomes, and virtual platforms for symptom monitoring and self-management in serious illness and cancer.

subtopics.label: Aggressiveness of End-of-Life Care and Social Determinants
subtopics.description: Studies examining how social support, interpersonal relationships, financial burden, and racial/ethnic background influence the aggressiveness of care and resource utilization at the end of life.
subtopics.short_description: Influence of social support, financial burden, and racial or ethnic background on care intensity and resource utilization at end of life.

subtopics.label: Clinical Ethics Consultation and Ethical Dilemmas in Hospital Care
subtopics.description: Research on ethics consultation services in hospital settings, including surgical specialties, elder mistreatment, periviability counseling, and the role of power dynamics in clinical decision-making.
subtopics.short_description: Ethics consultation services in hospital settings, covering surgical ethics, elder mistreatment, periviability counseling, and clinical power dynamics.

subtopics.label: Medical Aid in Dying, Deprescribing, and End-of-Life Treatment Decisions
subtopics.description: Studies on physician participation in medical aid in dying, patient and provider attitudes toward deprescribing in serious illness, and decision-making around treatment intensity near the end of life.
subtopics.short_description: Physician participation in medical aid in dying, attitudes toward deprescribing in serious illness, and treatment intensity decisions near end of life.

subtopics.label: Opioid Prescribing Practices and Policy Interventions
subtopics.description: Research examining opioid prescribing patterns, state prescribing cap laws, prescription drug monitoring programs, and policy interventions aimed at reducing opioid overprescribing in surgical and chronic pain contexts. Includes studies on postoperative opioid use, persistent opioid use, and the effects of regulatory changes on dispensing behavior.
subtopics.short_description: Prescribing patterns, monitoring programs, and policy interventions to reduce opioid overprescribing in surgical and chronic pain settings.

subtopics.label: Medications for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD) and Treatment Access
subtopics.description: Studies on medication-assisted treatment for opioid use disorder including buprenorphine, methadone, and extended-release naltrexone, covering treatment initiation, retention, cost-effectiveness, and barriers to access in primary care, emergency department, and justice settings. Includes policy analyses of MOUD coverage and payment models.
subtopics.short_description: Buprenorphine, methadone, and naltrexone treatment access, retention, and cost-effectiveness across clinical and justice settings.

subtopics.label: Naloxone Distribution, Harm Reduction Programs, and Overdose Prevention
subtopics.description: Research on naloxone distribution programs, syringe service programs, overdose prevention centers, and harm reduction messaging strategies. Covers racial/ethnic disparities in naloxone access, the role of pharmacies and community programs, and the impact of harm reduction services on overdose mortality.
subtopics.short_description: Overdose prevention through naloxone programs, syringe services, and harm reduction strategies, including disparities in community access.

subtopics.label: Cannabis Use, Legalization Policy, and Health Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining the effects of medical and recreational cannabis legalization on opioid use, chronic pain treatment, cannabis use disorder, and public health outcomes. Includes research on adolescent cannabis use, cannabis product labeling, and the neurobiological effects of cannabinoids.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of medical and recreational cannabis legalization on opioid use, pain treatment, and public health across age groups.

subtopics.label: Neurobiology and Preclinical Models of Alcohol Use Disorder
subtopics.description: Preclinical and neurobiological research on alcohol use disorder including animal models of binge drinking, sex differences in alcohol consumption, brain circuit mechanisms, and neuroimaging studies of heavy alcohol use. Covers BNST function, hippocampal changes, and estrogen signaling in alcohol behavior.
subtopics.short_description: Preclinical models, brain circuit mechanisms, and neuroimaging studies of heavy alcohol use, including sex differences in consumption.

subtopics.label: Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease: Clinical Outcomes and Treatment
subtopics.description: Clinical research on alcohol-associated liver disease (ALD) including prognostic factors, liver transplantation access and outcomes, relapse predictors, alcohol treatment discussions, and the role of alcohol taxes. Covers disparities in transplant access and the impact of alcohol use disorder treatment on liver disease outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical outcomes, transplantation access, relapse predictors, and disparities in care for alcohol-associated liver disease.

subtopics.label: Molecular Mechanisms of Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease and Retinoid Metabolism
subtopics.description: Basic science research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying alcohol-associated liver disease, with emphasis on retinoid metabolism, retinoic acid receptor signaling, intestinal barrier function, and hepatic stress responses. Includes studies on fenretinide, RAR-beta, and ethanol-induced hepatic retinoid disruption.
subtopics.display_name: Molecular Pathology of Alcoholic Liver Disease
subtopics.short_description: Cellular mechanisms of alcohol-associated liver injury, focusing on retinoid metabolism, receptor signaling, and intestinal barrier function.

subtopics.label: Hepatitis C Treatment and Prevention Among People Who Inject Drugs
subtopics.description: Research on hepatitis C virus (HCV) testing, treatment initiation, and care delivery models for people who inject drugs (PWID), including syringe service program-based care, rapid treatment initiation, cost-effectiveness analyses, and barriers to low-threshold HCV treatment. Covers Medicaid policy, co-located services, and HCV epidemiology in PWID populations.
subtopics.display_name: Hepatitis C Care for People Who Inject Drugs
subtopics.short_description: HCV testing, treatment models, and cost-effectiveness for people who inject drugs, including syringe program-based and low-threshold care.

subtopics.label: Prenatal Substance Use, Child Welfare Policy, and Neonatal Outcomes
