subtopics.description: Research on prenatal substance use policies including punitive versus supportive legal frameworks, their effects on neonatal outcomes, infant maltreatment reports, child welfare involvement, and treatment-seeking behavior among pregnant people. Covers neonatal abstinence syndrome, toxicology screening, and state-level legal mapping.
subtopics.display_name: Prenatal Substance Use & Child Welfare Policy
subtopics.short_description: Punitive versus supportive legal frameworks for prenatal substance use and their effects on neonatal outcomes and treatment-seeking behavior.

subtopics.label: Economic Burden and Cost-Effectiveness of Opioid Use Disorder Interventions
subtopics.description: Economic analyses of opioid use disorder including cost-of-illness estimates, cost-effectiveness of pharmacological and digital therapeutics, budget impact tools for MOUD in justice settings, and economic losses from overdose deaths. Covers health-related quality of life outcomes and economic evaluations in clinical trial networks.
subtopics.display_name: Economic Burden of Opioid Use Disorder
subtopics.short_description: Cost-of-illness estimates, cost-effectiveness of MOUD and digital therapeutics, and economic losses from opioid overdose deaths.

subtopics.label: Stigma, Provider Attitudes, and Barriers to Substance Use Disorder Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies on stigma experienced by people with substance use disorders in healthcare settings, provider attitudes toward OUD treatment, and structural barriers to care. Includes development of stigma measurement scales, qualitative studies of patient and provider perspectives, and interventions to reduce stigma in clinical and public contexts.
subtopics.short_description: Provider attitudes, structural barriers, and stigma measurement in substance use disorder care, with interventions to improve access.

subtopics.label: Tobacco Use, Smoking Cessation, and E-Cigarette Research
subtopics.description: Research on smoking cessation interventions, tobacco use epidemiology, e-cigarette and vaping trends, and pharmacist or provider-delivered cessation programs. Covers smoking cessation after stroke, nicotine metabolism, adolescent vaping, and mental health comorbidities associated with electronic cigarette use.
subtopics.short_description: Smoking cessation interventions, e-cigarette trends, adolescent vaping, and mental health comorbidities associated with tobacco use.

subtopics.label: Neurobiological Mechanisms of Opioid Reward, Stress, and Sex Differences
subtopics.description: Preclinical research on the neurobiological underpinnings of opioid use including hippocampal opioid receptor distribution, sex differences in opioid system responses, chronic stress effects on opioid gene expression, and endocannabinoid modulation of opioid reward. Covers delta opioid receptors, glutamate receptors, and oxycodone conditioned place preference models.
subtopics.short_description: Preclinical research on opioid receptor systems, sex differences, stress effects on gene expression, and endocannabinoid modulation of reward.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Impact on Substance Use Services and Overdose
subtopics.description: Research examining how the COVID-19 pandemic affected substance use disorder treatment, harm reduction services, healthcare utilization among people who use drugs, and overdose rates. Covers telehealth expansion, service disruptions at syringe programs, policy adaptations, and the pandemic's effect on drug overdose economic burden.
subtopics.short_description: Pandemic effects on substance use treatment, harm reduction services, overdose rates, and telehealth policy adaptations.

subtopics.label: Adolescent and Young Adult Substance Use: Risk Factors and Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies on substance use initiation, risk factors, and interventions among adolescents and young adults, including alcohol use and neurodevelopment, prescription stimulant misuse, trauma-related substance use, and training programs for treating co-occurring mental health and substance use disorders in youth.
subtopics.short_description: Risk factors, neurodevelopmental effects, and interventions for substance use initiation among adolescents and young adults.

subtopics.label: Opioid Prescribing and Pain Management in Cancer Patients
subtopics.description: Research examining opioid prescription trends, access, and outcomes specifically in cancer patients, including bone metastasis, pancreatic cancer, and Medicare coverage restrictions for cancer pain management.
subtopics.display_name: Opioid Prescribing in Cancer Pain Management
subtopics.short_description: Opioid prescription trends, access barriers, and coverage restrictions for pain management in oncology patients.

subtopics.label: Multimodal and Non-Opioid Analgesia Strategies in Perioperative Care
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating non-opioid and multimodal analgesic approaches to reduce opioid consumption in surgical and perioperative settings, including ketamine, complementary medicine, and nonopioid analgesic prescriptions.
subtopics.short_description: Non-opioid and multimodal analgesic strategies, including ketamine and complementary medicine, to reduce surgical opioid consumption.

subtopics.label: Prescription Drug Monitoring, Patient Behavior, and Long-Term Opioid Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on prescription drug monitoring programs, patient behaviors during long-term opioid therapy, public perceptions of opioid use, and EHR-based interventions to guide opioid prescribing.
subtopics.short_description: Prescription drug monitoring, patient behaviors during long-term opioid therapy, and EHR-based tools to guide prescribing decisions.

subtopics.label: Safer Opioid Supply Programs and Drug Decriminalization Policies
subtopics.description: Evaluation of safer opioid supply policies and drug decriminalization initiatives, particularly in British Columbia, examining their effects on opioid prescribing rates, hospitalizations, and overdose outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Evaluation of safer supply programs and drug decriminalization initiatives and their effects on prescribing, hospitalizations, and overdose.

subtopics.label: Racial and Socioeconomic Disparities in Opioid and Pain Treatment Access
subtopics.description: Studies examining how race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic factors shape access to opioid analgesics and pain treatments, including community-level disparities in opioid distribution and racial differences in medication use.
subtopics.display_name: Racial Disparities in Opioid & Pain Treatment
subtopics.short_description: Race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic factors shaping access to opioid analgesics and pain treatment at individual and community levels.

subtopics.label: Suicide, Mental Health Comorbidities, and Behavioral Addictions
subtopics.description: Research on suicide rates, decedent profiles, and mental health comorbidities including gambling disorder and psychiatric diagnoses, with a focus on identifying risk factors and prevention strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Suicide rates, psychiatric comorbidities, and gambling disorder among people with substance use disorders, with prevention implications.

subtopics.label: Integration of Behavioral Health and Addiction Treatment into Medical Care and Policy
subtopics.description: Studies addressing policy frameworks and implementation strategies for integrating mental health and addiction treatment into general medical care, including mental health parity enforcement and hospice behavioral health needs.
subtopics.short_description: Policy frameworks and implementation strategies for integrating addiction and mental health treatment into mainstream medical care.

subtopics.label: HIV Prevention, PrEP Access, and Health Services for People Who Use Drugs
subtopics.description: Research on HIV prevention strategies including PrEP navigation and contingency management for transgender women, sexual minority men, and people who inject drugs with substance use disorders.
subtopics.display_name: HIV Prevention & PrEP for People Who Use Drugs
subtopics.short_description: HIV prevention strategies, PrEP navigation, and contingency management for people who inject drugs and sexual minority populations.

subtopics.label: Sedative and Benzodiazepine Prescribing Risks in Vulnerable Populations
subtopics.description: Studies examining the risks associated with sedative and benzodiazepine prescribing in older adults and ICU survivors, including fall risk after stroke and new sedative prescriptions following critical illness.
subtopics.short_description: Risks of sedative and benzodiazepine prescribing in older adults and ICU survivors, including falls and new prescriptions after critical illness.

subtopics.label: Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorders and Alcohol-Related Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Research on the physical and health consequences of prenatal alcohol exposure including fetal alcohol spectrum disorder ocular measurements, and alcohol's association with breast tissue composition and other comorbidities.
subtopics.short_description: Health consequences of prenatal alcohol exposure, including fetal alcohol spectrum disorders and alcohol-related physical comorbidities.

subtopics.label: Neuroimaging and Machine Learning Methods in Substance Use and Psychiatric Research
subtopics.description: Studies applying machine learning and deep learning methods to neuroimaging data for interpreting psychiatric and substance use disorder-related brain changes, including interpretability tools and sub-cohort analysis.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning and deep learning applied to neuroimaging data to interpret brain changes in substance use and psychiatric disorders.

subtopics.label: Medicaid Coverage Policies and Access to HCV and Specialty Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on Medicaid policy changes affecting access to hepatitis C treatment and other specialty care, including the removal of fee-for-service restrictions and their impact on provider experience with managed care organizations.
subtopics.short_description: Medicaid policy changes affecting hepatitis C and specialty care access, including removal of fee-for-service restrictions and managed care impacts.

subtopics.label: Psoriasis Treatment and Outcomes Across Diverse Skin Types
subtopics.description: Research on the efficacy and safety of biologic and topical therapies for psoriasis (including guselkumab, ixekizumab, risankizumab, secukinumab, and calcipotriene/betamethasone) with specific attention to outcomes in patients with skin of color and diverse racial/ethnic groups. Includes clinical trial analyses, health disparities, and geographic barriers to psoriasis care.
subtopics.short_description: Biologic and topical psoriasis treatment efficacy, safety, and care disparities across diverse racial and ethnic populations.

subtopics.label: Atopic Dermatitis Therapeutics and Diverse Populations
subtopics.description: Clinical research on systemic and topical treatments for atopic dermatitis including abrocitinib, baricitinib, dupilumab, lebrikizumab, and tapinarof, with emphasis on efficacy across racial groups, Fitzpatrick skin types, and special populations. Includes development of disease severity assessment tools for diverse skin types.
subtopics.short_description: Systemic and topical atopic dermatitis therapies evaluated across Fitzpatrick skin types, racial groups, and special populations.

subtopics.label: Hidradenitis Suppurativa: Disease Characterization and Management
subtopics.description: Studies on the pathophysiology, comorbidities, and treatment of hidradenitis suppurativa (HS), including biologic therapies (adalimumab, ertapenem), corticosteroid injections, antiandrogen therapy, and inflammatory biomarkers. Encompasses disease severity assessment, comorbid conditions such as PCOS, and treatment in special populations including intellectually disabled patients.
subtopics.short_description: Pathophysiology, comorbidities, biologic treatments, and severity assessment for hidradenitis suppurativa.

subtopics.label: Acne Vulgaris Treatment and Post-Inflammatory Hyperpigmentation in Skin of Color
subtopics.description: Research on acne treatment strategies tailored to patients with skin of color, including topical agents (trifarotene, dapsone gel, clindamycin/adapalene/benzoyl peroxide), management algorithms, and treatment of acne sequelae such as post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation. Addresses racial and ethnic variations in acne presentation and therapeutic response.
subtopics.short_description: Acne treatment strategies and management of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation tailored to skin-of-color patients.

subtopics.label: Melanoma Immunotherapy and Checkpoint Inhibition
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on immune checkpoint inhibitors (nivolumab, ipilimumab, PD-1 blockade) and combination immunotherapy strategies for advanced melanoma, including long-term survival outcomes, adaptive dosing, and mechanisms of T cell-mediated antitumor immunity. Encompasses CAR T cell approaches and neutrophil engagement in antigen escape.
subtopics.short_description: Immune checkpoint inhibitors, combination immunotherapy, and T cell-mediated antitumor mechanisms in advanced melanoma.

subtopics.label: Melanoma Targeted Therapy, Biology, and Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Research on BRAF/MEK-targeted therapies (dabrafenib, trametinib) for BRAF-mutant melanoma, melanocyte biology including melanin synthesis and melanosomal pH regulation, tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte prognostication, and racial disparities in melanoma outcomes. Includes studies on acral melanoma staging and metabolic interventions.
subtopics.short_description: BRAF/MEK-targeted therapies, melanocyte biology, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and racial disparities in melanoma outcomes.

subtopics.label: Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma and Lymphoproliferative Disorders
subtopics.description: Clinical and histopathologic studies on primary cutaneous lymphoproliferative disorders including mycosis fungoides, lymphomatoid papulosis, and CD4+ small/medium-sized T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder. Covers treatment approaches, pediatric presentations, disease classification, and outcomes in special populations.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, classification, and treatment of mycosis fungoides, lymphomatoid papulosis, and related cutaneous lymphoproliferative disorders.

subtopics.label: Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma, Rare Skin Tumors, and Metastasis
subtopics.description: Research on cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) in immunocompromised patients, molecular mechanisms of SCC metastasis via the CD200-CD200R axis, and rare cutaneous neoplasms including Kaposi sarcoma, primary cutaneous leiomyosarcoma, and chondroid syringoma. Includes genomic characterization of skin tumors.
subtopics.short_description: Squamous cell carcinoma metastasis mechanisms, rare cutaneous neoplasms, and genomic characterization of skin tumors.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Cutaneous Manifestations and Skin Pathology
subtopics.description: Studies on skin manifestations of COVID-19 including livedoid and purpuric eruptions, complement-mediated microvascular injury, SARS-CoV-2 protein deposition in cutaneous microvasculature, and skin biopsy findings correlating with disease severity. Includes COVID-19 vaccine-induced skin reactions and vulvar aphthous ulcers post-vaccination.
subtopics.short_description: Cutaneous eruptions, complement-mediated microvascular injury, and vaccine-related skin reactions associated with COVID-19.

subtopics.label: Melasma, Pigmentation Disorders, and Cosmetic Dermatology
subtopics.description: Clinical research on treatment of melasma and pigmentation disorders including hydroquinone, novel depigmenting agents, and combination skincare regimens, as well as cosmetic dermatology procedures such as dermal micro-coring and platelet-rich plasma/fibrin for facial rejuvenation. Includes education and training in cosmetic dermatology.
subtopics.short_description: Treatment of melasma and pigmentation disorders alongside cosmetic procedures for facial rejuvenation and skin renewal.

subtopics.label: Wound Healing, Skin Reconstruction, and Surgical Techniques
subtopics.description: Research on wound healing strategies and reconstructive surgical techniques including alpha-gal nanoparticles for diabetic and irradiated wounds, keystone advancement flaps, dermal regeneration templates for scalp defects, prevascularized collagen scaffolds, and topical tacrolimus for flap survival. Encompasses both experimental and clinical approaches to cutaneous repair.
subtopics.short_description: Experimental and clinical strategies for wound repair, reconstructive flaps, and dermal scaffold-based skin regeneration.

subtopics.label: Inflammatory Skin Disease Immunology and Neuroimmune Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Mechanistic studies on immune and neuroimmune pathways in inflammatory skin diseases, including IL-23/Th17 axis in psoriasis, Langerhans cell antigen presentation and CGRP-mediated Th17 immunity, lupus photosensitivity via ADAM17 dysregulation, axon-T cell feedback loops in skin inflammation, and kynurenamine immunomodulation.
subtopics.short_description: Immune and neuroimmune mechanisms in psoriasis, lupus, and other inflammatory skin diseases, including IL-23/Th17 and CGRP pathways.

subtopics.label: Infectious Skin Diseases and Dermatologic Manifestations of Infection
subtopics.description: Clinical and diagnostic research on infectious dermatologic conditions including monkeypox/mpox recognition and management, Kaposi sarcoma associated with KSHV, and skin manifestations of systemic infections. Covers diagnostic approaches, clinical guidance, and epidemiology of cutaneous infectious diseases.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, management, and epidemiology of cutaneous infections including mpox, KSHV-associated Kaposi sarcoma, and systemic infection manifestations.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Tools in Skin Cancer Diagnosis
subtopics.description: Research applying machine learning and deep learning approaches to dermatologic diagnosis, including interpretable ensemble models for skin lesion classification, automated tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte scoring for melanoma prognostication, and computational image analysis for skin disease detection.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning and deep learning tools for skin lesion classification, melanoma prognostication, and automated dermatologic image analysis.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy as a Biomarker for Peripheral Neuropathy
subtopics.description: Research using corneal confocal microscopy (CCM) to detect, quantify, and monitor small nerve fiber loss in diabetic peripheral neuropathy, including studies on corneal nerve fiber length, density, and fractal dimension as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers across type 1 and type 2 diabetes.
subtopics.short_description: Corneal confocal microscopy to detect and monitor small nerve fiber loss in diabetic peripheral neuropathy.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy in Neurological and Systemic Diseases
subtopics.description: Studies applying corneal confocal microscopy to detect nerve fiber loss and immune cell changes as biomarkers in non-diabetic systemic and neurological conditions including multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, dementia, stroke, rheumatoid arthritis, lupus, and long COVID.
subtopics.short_description: Corneal nerve fiber and immune cell changes as biomarkers in MS, Parkinson's, dementia, and other systemic conditions.

subtopics.label: Age-Related Macular Degeneration Treatment and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on neovascular and dry AMD, including anti-VEGF therapy outcomes, real-world injection patterns, intraocular antibody responses, and molecular mechanisms such as lipofuscin-induced necroptosis and CLIC4-related RPE pathology.
subtopics.short_description: Anti-VEGF therapy outcomes, injection patterns, and molecular mechanisms in neovascular and dry macular degeneration.

subtopics.label: Ocular Gene Therapy for Retinal Diseases
subtopics.description: Preclinical and clinical studies on gene therapy approaches for retinal diseases including nAMD, retinitis pigmentosa, and inherited retinal dystrophies, covering AAV vector delivery, intravitreal and subretinal administration, optogenetic strategies, and safety/efficacy evaluations.
subtopics.display_name: Ocular Gene Therapy for Retinal Disease
subtopics.short_description: AAV vector delivery, optogenetic strategies, and safety evaluations for inherited retinal dystrophies and AMD.

subtopics.label: Deep Learning and AI for Retinal Disease Diagnosis and Prognosis
subtopics.description: Development and validation of deep learning models and AI algorithms applied to fundus photographs, OCT images, and longitudinal imaging data for diagnosing and predicting progression of glaucoma, AMD, and other retinal diseases.
subtopics.display_name: AI & Deep Learning in Retinal Imaging
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning models applied to fundus and OCT images for diagnosing and predicting glaucoma, AMD, and retinal disease.

subtopics.label: Glaucoma Diagnosis, Monitoring, and Surgical Management
subtopics.description: Research on glaucoma detection, structural monitoring using OCT-based metrics, intraocular pressure regulation, pharmacological treatments, and adverse events associated with glaucoma surgical devices and implants.
subtopics.short_description: OCT-based structural monitoring, intraocular pressure regulation, and outcomes of glaucoma surgical devices.

subtopics.label: Advanced Retinal Imaging and Diagnostic Technologies
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating novel and advanced imaging modalities for retinal and choroidal assessment, including ultra-widefield imaging, swept-source OCT, confocal scanning laser ophthalmoscopy, choroidal indocyanine green angiography, and quantitative ultrasound for vitreous and scleral evaluation.
subtopics.short_description: Ultra-widefield imaging, swept-source OCT, and quantitative ultrasound for retinal and choroidal assessment.

subtopics.label: Cataract and Vitreoretinal Surgical Techniques and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical research on surgical interventions including femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery, 3D digital visualization systems, vitrectomy platforms, scleral fixation of intraocular lenses, and dropless surgical protocols, including adverse event analyses from the FDA MAUDE database.
subtopics.short_description: Femtosecond laser cataract surgery, 3D visualization, vitrectomy platforms, and dropless surgical protocol outcomes.

subtopics.label: Myopia and Scleral Biomechanics
subtopics.description: Investigations into the structural and biomechanical changes in the sclera and choroid associated with myopia progression, using high-frequency quantitative ultrasound and mechanical testing to characterize microstructural remodeling.
subtopics.short_description: Structural and biomechanical remodeling of the sclera and choroid associated with myopia progression.

subtopics.label: Diabetic Retinopathy and Ocular Microvascular Complications
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and clinical studies on diabetic retinopathy and related microvascular complications, including prevalence in sub-Saharan Africa, retinal vessel analysis as a stroke biomarker, and the impact of glycemic and blood pressure control on retinopathy outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, retinal vessel analysis, and glycemic and blood pressure impacts on diabetic retinopathy outcomes.

subtopics.label: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension and Neuro-Ophthalmology
subtopics.description: Research on idiopathic intracranial hypertension (IIH) including venous sinus stenting for treatment, optic nerve diameter measurement for intracranial pressure monitoring, papilledema detection, and neuro-ophthalmic complications of COVID-19 and other neurological conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Venous sinus stenting, optic nerve pressure monitoring, papilledema detection, and neuro-ophthalmic complications.

subtopics.label: Oculoplastics, Adnexal Disease, and Periorbital Conditions
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on oculoplastic and adnexal conditions including thyroid eye disease, ptosis and its association with mental health, periorbital measurement tools, telemedicine use by oculoplastic surgeons, and ocular/oculofacial trauma in sports and pediatric settings.
subtopics.short_description: Thyroid eye disease, ptosis, periorbital trauma, and telemedicine use in oculoplastic and adnexal care.

subtopics.label: Ophthalmology Healthcare Delivery, Equity, and Practice Patterns
subtopics.description: Research examining healthcare access, workforce diversity, private equity investment, telemedicine adoption, and disparities in ophthalmic care delivery including cataract surgery rates by race and gender, residency program diversity, and community-based screening initiatives.
subtopics.short_description: Healthcare access, workforce diversity, private equity, and disparities in cataract surgery and ophthalmic screening.

subtopics.label: Inherited Retinal Degeneration and Retinal Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on genetic and molecular mechanisms of inherited retinal degenerations including CLN2-associated Batten disease, retinitis pigmentosa (RPGR variants, rhodopsin mutations), VPS35-related retinal alpha-synuclein pathology, and foveal hypoplasia genetics.
subtopics.short_description: Genetic and molecular mechanisms of retinitis pigmentosa, Batten disease, and other inherited retinal dystrophies.

subtopics.label: Glycemic Control and Pharmacological Treatment of Diabetic Neuropathy
subtopics.description: Research examining how intensive glycemic control, glucose-lowering medications, insulin delivery systems, and metabolic interventions affect peripheral and corneal nerve fiber structure and diabetic neuropathy progression in type 1 and type 2 diabetes.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of glucose-lowering therapies and insulin delivery on corneal nerve structure and diabetic neuropathy outcomes.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy in Pediatric and Metabolic Conditions
subtopics.description: Studies using corneal confocal microscopy to detect nerve fiber loss or immune cell changes in pediatric populations and metabolic conditions including obesity, celiac disease, autism spectrum disorder, and adolescent metabolic syndrome.
subtopics.short_description: Corneal confocal microscopy to detect nerve changes in children and patients with obesity, celiac disease, and autism.

subtopics.label: Vitamin D Status and Diabetes Complications
subtopics.description: Investigations into the role of vitamin D metabolites (D2 and D3) and their ratios as biomarkers or risk factors for diabetes-related complications including neuropathy, hypertension, and microvascular disease.
subtopics.short_description: Vitamin D metabolite ratios as biomarkers for neuropathy, hypertension, and microvascular diabetes complications.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy in Neurodegeneration and Rare Diseases
subtopics.description: Application of corneal confocal microscopy and related ocular measures to detect neurodegeneration or autonomic dysfunction in rare and neurological conditions including Guillain-Barré syndrome, Fabry disease, and dementia.
subtopics.short_description: Ocular measures of neurodegeneration and autonomic dysfunction in Guillain-Barré syndrome, Fabry disease, and dementia.

subtopics.label: Uveal Melanoma and Ocular Oncology
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and genetic mechanisms driving uveal melanoma progression, including the role of polycomb repressive complexes and chromosomal instability in tumor biology and clinical outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and genetic drivers of uveal melanoma progression, including polycomb complexes and chromosomal instability.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Treatment Outcomes and Clinical Trials
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and real-world studies evaluating treatments for localized, metastatic, and castration-resistant prostate cancer, including androgen deprivation therapy, enzalutamide, abiraterone, cabazitaxel, radiotherapy, and surgical approaches such as radical prostatectomy. Focuses on survival endpoints, functional outcomes, and treatment sequencing.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical trials and real-world studies on localized, metastatic, and castration-resistant prostate cancer treatments, survival, and functional outcomes.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Molecular Biology and Genomics
subtopics.description: Molecular, genomic, and epigenomic studies of prostate cancer including androgen receptor signaling, chromatin remodeling, neuroendocrine differentiation, lineage plasticity, lipid metabolism, and driver mutations such as SPOP, BRCA2, and RB1. Encompasses transcriptomic profiling, single-cell analyses, and identification of therapeutic vulnerabilities.
subtopics.short_description: Genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic studies of androgen receptor signaling, lineage plasticity, and therapeutic vulnerabilities in prostate cancer.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Imaging, Biopsy, and Diagnostic Tools
subtopics.description: Studies on multiparametric MRI, PSMA PET/CT, AI-assisted image analysis, and biopsy techniques (transperineal vs. transrectal, MRI-targeted) for detection and characterization of clinically significant prostate cancer. Includes radiomics, deep learning classifiers, and prebiopsy MRI impact on pathological concordance.
subtopics.short_description: Multiparametric MRI, PSMA PET/CT, AI-assisted analysis, and targeted biopsy techniques for detecting clinically significant prostate cancer.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Screening, Surveillance, and Health Disparities
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and health services research on PSA screening trends, active surveillance utilization, racial and ethnic disparities in prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment, and sociodemographic factors influencing management of localized prostate cancer. Includes studies on USPSTF guideline impacts and genomic testing in clinical decision-making.
subtopics.short_description: PSA screening trends, active surveillance utilization, and racial and sociodemographic disparities in prostate cancer diagnosis and management.

subtopics.label: PSMA-Targeted Theranostics and Radiopharmaceuticals in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Preclinical and clinical research on PSMA-targeted imaging agents and radioligand therapies including 177Lu-PSMA-617, 177Lu-J591, 177Lu-rhPSMA-10.1, and 64Cu/67Cu-based ligands for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Covers dosimetry, safety analyses, and theranostic strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Preclinical and clinical research on PSMA-targeted imaging agents and lutetium-based radioligand therapies for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

subtopics.label: Bladder and Urothelial Cancer: Treatment, Genomics, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on bladder cancer and urothelial carcinoma including immunotherapy (atezolizumab, pembrolizumab, epacadostat), antibody-drug conjugates (sacituzumab govitecan), neoadjuvant chemotherapy, FGFR-targeted therapy, genomic evolution (APOBEC mutagenesis, ecDNA), and surgical outcomes of radical cystectomy. Encompasses upper tract urothelial carcinoma and muscle-invasive disease.
subtopics.short_description: Immunotherapy, antibody-drug conjugates, genomic evolution, and surgical outcomes in bladder cancer and urothelial carcinoma.

subtopics.label: Renal Cell Carcinoma: Systemic Therapy, Genomics, and Surgical Management
subtopics.description: Research on clear cell and other subtypes of renal cell carcinoma covering systemic therapies (pazopanib, immune checkpoint inhibitors, RAS inhibitors), molecular biology (ATF4/ISR, NDUFA4L2, metabolic remodeling), genomic landscape after treatment, liquid biopsy, and surgical approaches including nephrectomy and ablative techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Systemic therapies, molecular biology, genomic landscape, liquid biopsy, and surgical management of clear cell and other renal cell carcinoma subtypes.

subtopics.label: Kidney Stones, Endourology, and Percutaneous Procedures
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on kidney stone management including percutaneous nephrolithotomy (PCNL), retrograde intrarenal surgery with laser lithotripsy, ureteroscopy practice patterns, spontaneous stone passage prediction, and 24-hour urine collection in high-risk stone formers. Includes imaging modalities for stone detection.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical management of kidney stones via PCNL, ureteroscopy, laser lithotripsy, and imaging-guided stone detection and passage prediction.

subtopics.label: Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia and Functional Urology
subtopics.description: Research on surgical and minimally invasive treatments for benign prostatic hyperplasia (TURP, PUL, water vapor thermal therapy), ureteral stent management, stress urinary incontinence surgery including sling mesh implants, pelvic floor disorders, and urologic chronic pelvic pain syndrome (UCPPS) including bladder hyperalgesia and pelvic floor muscle tenderness.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical and minimally invasive BPH treatments, urinary incontinence surgery, pelvic floor disorders, and urologic chronic pelvic pain syndrome.

subtopics.label: Male Infertility, Spermatology, and Reproductive Medicine
subtopics.description: Clinical and basic science research on male infertility including semen analysis trends, varicocelectomy outcomes, azoospermia genetics, sperm chromatin fragmentation, vasectomy reversal, testicular torsion, and assisted reproductive technology outcomes. Encompasses sperm capacitation biology, spermatogenesis regulation, and novel reproductive techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Semen analysis, varicocelectomy, azoospermia genetics, sperm biology, vasectomy reversal, and assisted reproductive technology outcomes in men.

subtopics.label: Non-Hormonal Male Contraception and Sperm Signaling Biology
subtopics.description: Basic and translational research on soluble adenylyl cyclase (sAC/ADCY10) as a target for on-demand non-hormonal male contraception, including inhibitor design, pharmacological evaluation, sperm motility rescue with cAMP analogs, and characterization of sAC-null sperm. Covers sperm metabolic changes during capacitation.
subtopics.short_description: Soluble adenylyl cyclase inhibition as a target for on-demand male contraception, including sperm motility, cAMP signaling, and capacitation biology.

subtopics.label: Penile, Erectile, and Prosthetic Urology
subtopics.description: Clinical research on erectile dysfunction management including intracavernosal injection therapy, inflatable penile prosthesis surgery (complications, antibiotic prophylaxis, concurrent incontinence surgery), Peyronie's disease treatment with collagenase, and penile cancer surgical outcomes. Includes post-prostatectomy sexual function and erectile dysfunction after colorectal surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Penile prosthesis surgery, intracavernosal therapy, Peyronie's disease treatment, and post-prostatectomy sexual function outcomes.

subtopics.label: Urothelial Carcinoma Cytopathology and Pathological Diagnosis
subtopics.description: Studies on cytological and histopathological diagnosis of urothelial carcinoma including The Paris System quantitation criteria, nuclear hypochromasia in high-grade urothelial carcinoma, morphologic variance by anatomical location, Z-stack imaging for whole slide images, and ancillary immunohistochemical markers such as SPINK1 for urothelial dysplasia and carcinoma in situ.
subtopics.short_description: Cytological and histopathological diagnosis of urothelial carcinoma using Paris System criteria, imaging tools, and ancillary immunohistochemical markers.

subtopics.label: Urinary Tract Infections, Microbiome, and Infectious Complications
subtopics.description: Research on urinary tract infection pathogenesis, diagnosis, and prevention including the role of gut microbiota in UTI risk, Ureaplasma/Mycoplasma in recurrent UTIs, Enterococcus virulence, bacteriophage therapy post-transplant, procalcitonin diagnostic accuracy, and infectious complications of urological procedures.
subtopics.short_description: UTI pathogenesis, gut microbiota influence, bacteriophage therapy, diagnostic biomarkers, and infectious complications of urological procedures.

subtopics.label: Prostate and Urological Cancer Biomarkers and Liquid Biopsy
subtopics.description: Translational studies on circulating tumor DNA, cell-free DNA methylation, plasma metabolomics, ctDNA serial monitoring, and tissue-based genomic biomarkers for prostate, renal, and urothelial cancers. Includes polygenic risk scores, tumor mutational burden, and multi-analyte approaches for early detection, risk stratification, and treatment response monitoring.
subtopics.short_description: Circulating tumor DNA, cell-free methylation, plasma metabolomics, and multi-analyte approaches for detection, risk stratification, and treatment monitoring.

subtopics.label: Dysphagia Assessment and Swallowing Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on the evaluation, diagnosis, and treatment of swallowing disorders, including FEES and VFSS methodologies, respiratory-swallow coordination, pharyngeal residue quantification, and swallowing rehabilitation in neurogenic and other dysphagic populations.
subtopics.short_description: Evaluation, diagnosis, and treatment of swallowing disorders across neurogenic and dysphagic populations.

subtopics.label: Voice Disorders, Vocal Fold Pathology, and Laryngology
subtopics.description: Research on vocal fold lesions, voice disorders, laryngoscopic evaluation, phonosurgery outcomes, and voice rehabilitation including phonotraumatic lesions, vocal fold paralysis, hemorrhage, and gender-affirming voice modification.
subtopics.short_description: Vocal fold lesions, laryngoscopic evaluation, phonosurgery outcomes, and voice rehabilitation including gender-affirming modification.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Imaging in Laryngoscopy and Head and Neck Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research applying artificial intelligence, deep learning, and advanced imaging techniques to laryngoscopy, vocal fold pathology classification, head and neck cancer imaging, and clinical decision support in otolaryngology.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning and advanced imaging applied to laryngoscopy, vocal fold classification, and head and neck cancer diagnostics.

subtopics.label: Head and Neck Cancer: Oral Cavity, Oropharynx, and Squamous Cell Carcinoma
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology, molecular biology, staging, surgical management, and outcomes of oral cavity and oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas, including depth of invasion, nodal metastasis, and prognostic factors.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, molecular biology, staging, and surgical outcomes of oral cavity and oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas.

subtopics.label: Thyroid and Parathyroid Surgery and Pathology
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management, outcomes, and pathology of thyroid and parathyroid conditions, including thyroidectomy complications, thyroid cancer prognosis, hormone replacement, and access to high-volume centers.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management, complications, and oncologic outcomes of thyroid and parathyroid conditions.

subtopics.label: Facial Fractures and Craniofacial Trauma
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology, management, and cost burden of facial fractures including zygoma, mandible, and frontal sinus fractures, with analysis of injury patterns, treatment trends, and outcomes in urban trauma settings.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, management, and cost burden of facial fractures including zygoma, mandible, and frontal sinus injuries.

subtopics.label: Rhinology, Sinusitis, and Sinonasal Conditions
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, management, and surgical treatment of rhinosinusitis and sinonasal conditions, including chronic rhinosinusitis guidelines adherence, balloon sinuplasty, sinonasal complications, and pediatric rhinosinusitis microbiome.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, management, and surgical treatment of rhinosinusitis and sinonasal conditions across adult and pediatric populations.

subtopics.label: Hearing Loss, Audiology, and Vestibular Schwannoma
subtopics.description: Research on hearing loss epidemiology, audiologic outcomes, cochlear implantation, vestibular schwannoma management, and the psychosocial and functional impacts of hearing impairment across the lifespan.
subtopics.short_description: Hearing loss epidemiology, cochlear implantation, vestibular schwannoma management, and psychosocial impacts of hearing impairment.

subtopics.label: Laryngoscopy Simulation, Surgical Training, and Low-Cost Devices
subtopics.description: Research on simulation-based surgical training tools, 3D-printed laryngeal and thyroplasty simulators, low-cost laryngoscope design, and assessment of procedural skills in laryngology and otolaryngology education.
subtopics.short_description: Simulation-based training tools, 3D-printed laryngeal simulators, and low-cost laryngoscope design for otolaryngology education.

subtopics.label: Cough Assessment, Airway Protection, and Respiratory Muscle Strength
subtopics.description: Research on objective and auditory-perceptual assessment of cough, respiratory muscle strength measurement tools, cough as a dysphagia screening modality, and airway protective responses in neurological and dysphagic populations.
subtopics.short_description: Objective and perceptual cough assessment, respiratory muscle strength tools, and airway protective responses in neurological populations.

subtopics.label: Cartilage Tissue Engineering and Auricular Reconstruction
subtopics.description: Research on bioengineering approaches to auricular and nasal cartilage reconstruction, including decellularized xenograft scaffolds, 3D-printed external scaffolds, mesenchymal stem cell chaperoning, and in vivo implant studies.
subtopics.short_description: Bioengineering approaches to auricular and nasal cartilage reconstruction using scaffolds, stem cells, and 3D-printed implants.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Airway, Aerodigestive Disorders, and Tracheostomy
subtopics.description: Research on pediatric aerodigestive conditions including chronic aspiration, recurrent croup, ankyloglossia, obstructive sleep apnea in infants, tympanostomy tube placement, and tracheostomy care and education.
subtopics.short_description: Pediatric aerodigestive conditions including aspiration, ankyloglossia, obstructive sleep apnea, and tracheostomy care.

subtopics.label: Healthcare Disparities, Access to Care, and Health Policy in Otolaryngology
subtopics.description: Research examining disparities in access to otolaryngologic care, including the effects of insurance status, the Affordable Care Act, telemedicine, and socioeconomic factors on outcomes and utilization across head and neck conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Insurance status, socioeconomic factors, and telemedicine effects on otolaryngologic care access and outcomes.

subtopics.label: Salivary Gland Pathology and Parotid Tumors
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, imaging, and management of salivary gland disorders including parotid pleomorphic adenoma, acinic cell carcinoma, adenoid cystic carcinoma, and sialendoscopy for chronic sialadenitis.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, imaging, and management of salivary gland disorders including parotid tumors and chronic sialadenitis.

subtopics.label: Peripheral Nerve Decompression and Surgical Treatment of Headache and Neuralgia
subtopics.description: Research on surgical decompression of peripheral nerves (occipital, trigeminal, and related) for treatment of chronic headaches, migraines, and neuralgias, including outcomes, timing, and nerve reconstruction techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical decompression of occipital and trigeminal nerves for chronic migraines, headaches, and neuralgias.

subtopics.label: Skull Base Surgery: Endoscopic, Endonasal, and Open Approaches
subtopics.description: Studies examining surgical approaches to the skull base including endonasal endoscopic routes to the craniovertebral junction, cavernous sinus, petrous apex, and related structures, with emphasis on technique and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Endoscopic and open surgical approaches to the skull base, cavernous sinus, petrous apex, and craniocervical junction.

subtopics.label: Post-Anti-Reflux Surgery Dysphagia and Esophageal Motility
subtopics.description: Research investigating dysphagia and esophageal motility disorders following anti-reflux and hiatal hernia repair surgeries, including endoscopic balloon dilation, planimetry-based assessment, and outcomes of Linx and robotic procedures.
subtopics.short_description: Dysphagia and esophageal motility disorders following anti-reflux and hiatal hernia repair, including dilation and robotic outcomes.

subtopics.label: Surgical Ergonomics, Workforce Well-Being, and Burnout in Otolaryngology
subtopics.description: Studies examining musculoskeletal strain, ergonomic challenges, and professional burnout among otolaryngologists, with particular focus on gender-specific ergonomic issues and factors affecting professional fulfillment.
subtopics.short_description: Musculoskeletal strain, ergonomic challenges, and burnout among otolaryngologists, with focus on gender-specific occupational factors.

subtopics.label: Rhinoplasty, Nasal Reconstruction, and Implant Materials
subtopics.description: Research on surgical techniques and materials for nasal reconstruction and augmentation rhinoplasty, including nasal tip delamination techniques and biocompatible polylactic acid scaffold implants.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical techniques and biocompatible implant materials for nasal reconstruction and augmentation rhinoplasty.

subtopics.label: Chiari Malformation and Craniocervical Junction Disorders
subtopics.description: Studies on surgical management of Chiari malformation and craniocervical junction pathology, including revision surgery predictors in children, intraoperative alignment optimization, and occipitocervical fusion outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of Chiari malformation and craniocervical junction pathology, including revision predictors and fusion outcomes.

subtopics.label: Nerve Injury Imaging, Neurography, and Facial Nerve Palsy
subtopics.description: Research on diagnostic imaging and biomarker approaches for head and neck nerve injuries, including magnetic resonance neurography for sensory nerve injuries and cerebrospinal fluid proteomics in idiopathic facial nerve palsy.
subtopics.display_name: Nerve Injury Imaging & Facial Nerve Palsy
subtopics.short_description: MR neurography and proteomics-based biomarker approaches for head and neck nerve injuries and idiopathic facial nerve palsy.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Impact on Otolaryngology Practice and Pediatric Presentations
subtopics.description: Studies examining the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on otolaryngology clinical practice, inpatient consultation patterns, pediatric surgical screening, and COVID-19-related pediatric airway presentations such as croup during the Omicron wave.
subtopics.short_description: Pandemic effects on otolaryngology consultations, pediatric surgical screening, and COVID-related airway presentations.

subtopics.label: Head and Neck Reconstruction and Microsurgery in Special Populations
subtopics.description: Research on microsurgical and reconstructive approaches for head and neck defects in complex patient populations, including immunocompromised patients, transplant recipients, and those with rare syndromes such as Fanconi anemia.
subtopics.short_description: Microsurgical reconstruction for head and neck defects in immunocompromised patients, transplant recipients, and rare syndrome populations.

subtopics.label: Sinonasal Papilloma and Benign Sinonasal Tumors
subtopics.description: Studies on the clinical behavior, histologic subtypes, and outcomes of sinonasal papillomas including inverted and combined exophytic-inverted papilloma subtypes.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical behavior, histologic subtypes, and outcomes of sinonasal papillomas including inverted and exophytic-inverted variants.

subtopics.label: Obstructive Sleep Apnea: Oral Appliance and Non-CPAP Therapies
subtopics.description: Research evaluating mandibular advancement devices and other non-CPAP oral appliance therapies for obstructive sleep apnea, including efficacy, effectiveness, and patient outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Efficacy and patient outcomes of mandibular advancement devices and non-CPAP therapies for obstructive sleep apnea.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Epidemiology, Outcomes, and Surveillance
subtopics.description: Population-level studies examining SARS-CoV-2 transmission dynamics, infection rates, seroprevalence, variant characteristics, vaccine effectiveness, and clinical outcomes including hospitalization, mortality, and post-acute sequelae across diverse populations and settings.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level studies on SARS-CoV-2 transmission, seroprevalence, vaccine effectiveness, and clinical outcomes including long COVID.

subtopics.label: Social Determinants of Health and Health Disparities
subtopics.description: Research examining how social, economic, racial, ethnic, and neighborhood-level factors shape disease incidence, healthcare access, treatment utilization, and health outcomes, including studies on structural racism, poverty, and cumulative social vulnerability indices.
subtopics.short_description: How social, economic, and neighborhood-level factors shape disease incidence, healthcare access, and health outcomes across populations.

subtopics.label: Chronic Disease Epidemiology and Risk Factor Analysis
subtopics.description: Observational and cohort studies characterizing the prevalence, incidence, and risk factors for chronic conditions including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, hypertension, obesity, and chronic kidney disease across diverse populations, with emphasis on modifiable risk factors and comorbidity patterns.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, incidence, and modifiable risk factors for cardiovascular disease, diabetes, obesity, and related chronic conditions.

subtopics.label: Infectious Disease Epidemiology and Surveillance
subtopics.description: Population-based studies on the prevalence, incidence, transmission dynamics, and burden of infectious diseases including HIV, hepatitis B and C, sexually transmitted infections, tuberculosis, and emerging pathogens, with emphasis on surveillance methods and mathematical modeling of epidemic trajectories.
subtopics.short_description: Population-based burden, transmission dynamics, and epidemic modeling for HIV, hepatitis, STIs, tuberculosis, and emerging pathogens.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use, Substance Use Disorders, and Drug Policy
subtopics.description: Epidemiological research on opioid prescribing patterns, opioid use disorder prevalence and treatment, overdose mortality, harm reduction interventions, and the impact of state and federal drug policies on substance use outcomes across populations.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology of opioid prescribing, overdose mortality, harm reduction interventions, and the impact of drug policy on substance use outcomes.

subtopics.label: Maternal, Perinatal, and Reproductive Health Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Population-level studies on maternal morbidity and mortality, perinatal outcomes, pregnancy complications, prenatal substance use policies, reproductive health disparities, and the epidemiology of conditions affecting pregnant and postpartum populations.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level research on maternal morbidity, perinatal outcomes, pregnancy complications, and reproductive health disparities.

subtopics.label: Cancer Epidemiology, Screening, and Survivorship
subtopics.description: Observational studies on cancer incidence, screening utilization and effectiveness, disparities in cancer care access and outcomes, survivorship prevalence, and the epidemiology of specific cancer types across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Cancer incidence, screening utilization, disparities in care access, and survivorship prevalence across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Mental Health Epidemiology and Suicide Prevention
subtopics.description: Population-based research on the prevalence and incidence of mental health conditions, suicidal ideation and behavior, psychological distress, and the social and demographic determinants of mental health outcomes, including surveillance of suicide trends and risk factors.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence of mental health conditions, suicidal ideation, and social determinants of psychological distress at the population level.

subtopics.label: Healthcare Utilization, Fragmentation, and Quality
subtopics.description: Studies examining patterns of healthcare use, care fragmentation across providers and settings, preventable hospitalizations and readmissions, and the relationship between care coordination quality and patient outcomes in Medicare and other populations.
subtopics.short_description: Patterns of healthcare use, care coordination quality, preventable hospitalizations, and readmissions in Medicare and other populations.

subtopics.label: Stroke and Cerebrovascular Disease Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Population-based and registry studies on stroke incidence, risk factors, recurrence, outcomes, and disparities, including research on specific stroke subtypes, cerebrovascular conditions, and the epidemiology of transient ischemic attack across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Population-based research on stroke incidence, risk factors, recurrence, outcomes, and disparities across cerebrovascular conditions.

subtopics.label: Global Health and Population Health in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies conducted in low- and middle-income countries examining disease burden, risk factor prevalence, health system capacity, and community-based interventions for chronic and infectious diseases, with emphasis on sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia, the Middle East, and the Caribbean.
subtopics.short_description: Disease burden, risk factor prevalence, and community-based interventions in low- and middle-income countries across Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean.

subtopics.label: Elder Mistreatment, Aging, and Long-Term Care
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and surveillance research on the prevalence, risk factors, and health consequences of elder mistreatment, as well as studies on aging-related health outcomes, nursing home quality, and long-term care utilization among older adults.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, risk factors, and health consequences of elder mistreatment, nursing home quality, and long-term care utilization among older adults.

subtopics.label: Vaccine Effectiveness, Immunization, and Immune Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Population-level studies evaluating vaccine effectiveness, immunogenicity, waning immunity, and the epidemiological impact of vaccination programs against COVID-19 and other infectious diseases, including mathematical modeling of vaccination strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level evaluation of vaccine effectiveness, waning immunity, and the epidemiological impact of vaccination strategies.

subtopics.label: Racial and Ethnic Disparities in Clinical Outcomes and Treatment Access
subtopics.description: Studies documenting racial and ethnic differences in disease presentation, treatment receipt, surgical outcomes, and mortality across clinical conditions including cardiovascular disease, cancer, maternal health, and surgical procedures, with analysis of structural and systemic contributors.
subtopics.display_name: Racial & Ethnic Disparities in Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.short_description: Racial and ethnic differences in treatment receipt, surgical outcomes, and mortality across cardiovascular, cancer, and maternal health conditions.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning, EHR-Based Epidemiology, and Predictive Modeling
subtopics.description: Methodological and applied studies using electronic health records, machine learning, natural language processing, and advanced statistical methods to identify disease subphenotypes, predict clinical outcomes, extract social determinants of health, and conduct population-level epidemiological analyses.
subtopics.short_description: Electronic health records, machine learning, and NLP applied to disease subphenotyping, outcome prediction, and population-level epidemiological analysis.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genomics and Somatic Mutation Profiling
subtopics.description: Research characterizing somatic mutations, structural variants, copy number alterations, and mutational signatures across cancer types using whole-genome, whole-exome, and targeted sequencing. Includes tumor evolution, clonal dynamics, and genomic drivers of cancer progression and metastasis.
subtopics.short_description: Characterization of somatic mutations, structural variants, and mutational signatures across cancer types using whole-genome and targeted sequencing.

subtopics.label: Epigenomics, Chromatin Regulation, and Gene Expression
subtopics.description: Studies of DNA methylation, histone modifications, chromatin accessibility, 3D chromatin architecture, and epigenetic reprogramming in cancer, development, and disease. Includes ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, HiChIP, and multi-omics approaches linking epigenetic states to transcriptional programs.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation, histone modifications, chromatin accessibility, and 3D architecture linking epigenetic states to transcriptional programs in cancer and disease.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy, Circulating Tumor DNA, and Cell-Free DNA
subtopics.description: Research on circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), cell-free DNA (cfDNA), and circulating tumor cells (CTCs) for cancer detection, monitoring, minimal residual disease assessment, and resistance profiling. Includes methylation-based cfDNA assays, whole-genome cfDNA sequencing, and clinical validation studies.
subtopics.short_description: Circulating tumor DNA, cell-free DNA, and circulating tumor cells for cancer detection, treatment monitoring, and resistance profiling.

subtopics.label: GWAS, Polygenic Risk Scores, and Population Genomics
subtopics.description: Genome-wide association studies, polygenic risk score development and validation, and population-level genomic analyses to identify disease susceptibility loci and quantify inherited risk. Includes multi-ancestry studies, pharmacogenomics GWAS, and applications of PRS to cancer screening and disease prediction.
subtopics.short_description: Genome-wide association studies and polygenic risk score development to identify disease susceptibility loci and quantify inherited risk across populations.

subtopics.label: Hereditary Cancer Syndromes, Genetic Counseling, and Cascade Testing
subtopics.description: Research on hereditary cancer predisposition syndromes (BRCA1/2, Lynch syndrome, etc.), genetic counseling practices, cascade testing strategies, and clinical implementation of germline genetic testing. Includes disparities in access to genetic services and outcomes of hereditary cancer surveillance programs.
subtopics.short_description: Hereditary cancer predisposition syndromes, germline genetic testing, cascade testing strategies, and access to genetic counseling services.

subtopics.label: Transcriptomics, RNA Sequencing, and RNA Biology
subtopics.description: Studies employing bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing, long-read isoform sequencing, alternative splicing analysis, and RNA modification (m6A) profiling to characterize gene expression, transcript diversity, and post-transcriptional regulation in development, disease, and cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing, alternative splicing, and RNA modification profiling to characterize gene expression and post-transcriptional regulation.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Multi-Omics and Spatial Genomics
subtopics.description: Research applying single-cell genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic profiling—including spatial transcriptomics—to resolve cellular heterogeneity in tumors, tissues, and developmental systems. Includes multimodal integration methods and single-cell atlases of human tissues.
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic profiling with spatial transcriptomics to resolve cellular heterogeneity in tumors and tissues.

subtopics.label: Precision Oncology, Molecular Biomarkers, and Targeted Therapy
subtopics.description: Application of genomic and molecular profiling to guide cancer treatment selection, identify predictive biomarkers, and evaluate targeted therapies. Includes next-generation sequencing in clinical oncology, tumor mutational burden, gene expression signatures, and companion diagnostics.
subtopics.short_description: Genomic and molecular profiling to guide cancer treatment selection, identify predictive biomarkers, and evaluate targeted therapies and companion diagnostics.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic Aging, Clonal Hematopoiesis, and DNA Methylation Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research using DNA methylation clocks and epigenetic biomarkers to measure biological aging, and studies of clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) and mosaic chromosomal alterations as aging-related genomic phenomena with disease implications.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation clocks, biological aging biomarkers, and clonal hematopoiesis as aging-related genomic phenomena with disease implications.

subtopics.label: Hematologic Malignancy Genomics and Epigenetics
subtopics.description: Genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic characterization of lymphomas and leukemias, including identification of driver mutations, chromatin dysregulation, and molecular subtypes. Covers AML, CLL, DLBCL, and other hematologic cancers with emphasis on precision medicine and therapeutic targeting.
subtopics.short_description: Genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic characterization of lymphomas and leukemias, including driver mutations, molecular subtypes, and precision medicine targets.

subtopics.label: Gene Therapy, AAV Vectors, and Genome Editing
subtopics.description: Research on adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector development and delivery for monogenic diseases, CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing approaches, and gene therapy clinical trials. Includes safety and efficacy studies for neurological, metabolic, and inherited disorders.
subtopics.short_description: AAV vector development, CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing, and gene therapy clinical trials for neurological, metabolic, and inherited disorders.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Genomics, Risk, and Precision Medicine
subtopics.description: Genomic and molecular studies of breast cancer including hereditary risk assessment, somatic mutation profiling, gene expression subtypes, racial/ethnic disparities in tumor biology, and biomarker-guided treatment. Covers BRCA1/2, polygenic risk, ctDNA monitoring, and CDK4/6 inhibitor pharmacogenomics.
subtopics.short_description: Hereditary risk, somatic mutation profiling, gene expression subtypes, and biomarker-guided treatment in breast cancer, including racial and ethnic disparities.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Molecular Profiling and Genomics
subtopics.description: Molecular characterization of prostate cancer including androgen receptor signaling, chromatin remodeling, genomic subtypes, neuroendocrine differentiation, and lineage plasticity. Includes studies of BRCA2, SPOP, EZH2, and other drivers, as well as genomic biomarkers for prognosis and treatment selection.
subtopics.short_description: Androgen receptor signaling, chromatin remodeling, genomic subtypes, and biomarkers for prognosis and treatment selection in prostate cancer.

subtopics.label: Space Omics, Astronaut Genomics, and Environmental Exposures
subtopics.description: Multi-omics studies of astronauts and civilian spaceflight participants examining genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic changes induced by spaceflight. Includes clonal hematopoiesis in space, telomere dynamics, immune responses, and biospecimen collection standards for space medicine.
subtopics.short_description: Multi-omics characterization of genomic, epigenomic, and immune changes induced by spaceflight, including clonal hematopoiesis and telomere dynamics.

subtopics.label: Neurological and Psychiatric Disease Genomics
subtopics.description: Genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic studies of neurological and psychiatric disorders including Alzheimer's disease, schizophrenia, autism spectrum disorder, Parkinson's disease, and epilepsy. Includes iPSC-derived models, GWAS findings, gene expression profiling, and molecular mechanisms of neurodegeneration.
subtopics.short_description: Genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic studies of Alzheimer's, schizophrenia, autism, Parkinson's, and epilepsy, including iPSC models and GWAS findings.

subtopics.label: iPSC Generation, Reprogramming, and Pluripotency
subtopics.description: Research on the generation of induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), mechanisms of cellular reprogramming, and maintenance of pluripotency, including epigenetic regulation, chromatin dynamics, and gene regulatory networks governing stem cell identity.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanisms of cellular reprogramming, pluripotency maintenance, and epigenetic regulation of stem cell identity.

subtopics.label: Organoid Models for Disease and Drug Screening
subtopics.description: Development and application of organoid systems derived from pluripotent or tissue-specific stem cells to model human diseases, study pathogen infection, and perform drug screening, including brain, lung, cardiac, intestinal, and pancreatic organoids.
subtopics.short_description: Stem cell-derived organoid systems for modeling human disease, pathogen infection, and therapeutic drug screening.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Differentiation, Regeneration, and Cardiomyocyte Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on cardiomyocyte differentiation from pluripotent stem cells, cardiac regeneration mechanisms, cardiomyocyte division and polyploidy, and iPSC-derived cardiac models for disease modeling and cardiotoxicity screening.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiomyocyte differentiation from pluripotent stem cells, cardiac regeneration, and iPSC-derived models for disease and toxicity.

subtopics.label: Zebrafish Heart and Tissue Regeneration Models
subtopics.description: Use of zebrafish as a model organism to study heart regeneration, epicardial progenitor activation, lymphatic vessel development, and tissue repair mechanisms including regulatory elements and signaling pathways governing regenerative responses.
subtopics.short_description: Zebrafish models of heart regeneration, epicardial progenitor activation, and signaling pathways governing tissue repair.

subtopics.label: Hematopoietic Stem Cell Biology and Clonal Hematopoiesis
subtopics.description: Research on hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell (HSPC) biology, including self-renewal, differentiation, epigenetic regulation, clonal hematopoiesis mutations (DNMT3A, SF3B1, JAK2), and aging-associated remodeling of the hematopoietic system.
subtopics.short_description: HSC self-renewal, differentiation, clonal hematopoiesis mutations, and aging-associated remodeling of the blood system.

subtopics.label: Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation and Clinical Applications
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on hematopoietic stem cell transplantation including cord blood transplantation, haplo-identical approaches, engraftment kinetics, cryopreservation, and shared care models for improving transplant access and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and translational research on cord blood, haplo-identical transplantation, engraftment, and transplant access.

subtopics.label: Neural Stem Cells, Neurogenesis, and Brain Organoid Models
subtopics.description: Research on neural stem cell self-renewal, neuronal differentiation, and brain organoid models used to study neurodevelopmental disorders (schizophrenia, ASD), neurodegeneration, and the effects of pathogens or drugs on neural progenitor biology.
subtopics.short_description: Neural stem cell differentiation and brain organoid models for neurodevelopmental disorders and neurodegeneration research.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Beta Cell Differentiation, Function, and Regeneration
subtopics.description: Studies on pancreatic beta cell differentiation, identity maintenance, functional regulation, and regenerative strategies including iPSC-derived beta cells, transplantation models, and molecular targets for diabetes therapy.
subtopics.short_description: iPSC-derived beta cell generation, identity maintenance, and regenerative strategies for diabetes therapy.

subtopics.label: Airway Epithelial Stem and Progenitor Cell Biology
subtopics.description: Research on airway basal stem and progenitor cells including their differentiation, response to injury or infection (HIV, SARS-CoV-2, smoking), and role in lung disease such as COPD, with organoid and in vitro models of airway epithelium.
subtopics.short_description: Airway basal stem cell differentiation, injury response, and organoid models of lung disease including COPD.

subtopics.label: Tissue Engineering, Biomaterials, and Scaffold-Based Reconstruction
subtopics.description: Development and evaluation of biomaterial scaffolds, decellularized matrices, and 3D-printed constructs for tissue engineering applications including cartilage, nipple, nasal, and skin reconstruction, as well as vascularized tissue constructs.
subtopics.short_description: Biomaterial scaffolds, decellularized matrices, and 3D-printed constructs for cartilage, skin, and vascularized tissue reconstruction.

subtopics.label: Endothelial and Vascular Progenitor Cell Biology
subtopics.description: Research on endothelial progenitor cells, endothelial cell identity maintenance, angiogenesis, and vascular development including lineage tracing, transcription factor regulation, and applications in organoid vascularization and tissue regeneration.
subtopics.short_description: Endothelial progenitor identity, angiogenesis, and vascular development for organoid vascularization and tissue regeneration.

subtopics.label: Skeletal Stem Cells, Osteoblast Differentiation, and Bone Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on osteoblast and skeletal stem cell differentiation, signaling pathways regulating bone formation and mineralization (hedgehog, ERK MAPK, GSK3-β), and skeletal stem cell contributions to bone homeostasis and disease.
subtopics.short_description: Osteoblast and skeletal stem cell differentiation, signaling pathways regulating bone mineralization and homeostasis.

subtopics.label: Adipocyte Differentiation and Adipose Tissue Biology
subtopics.description: Research on preadipocyte and adipocyte differentiation, adipogenesis regulation, and adipose tissue biology including circadian control, epigenetic regulators, metabolic signaling, and the role of adipose progenitors in metabolic disease.
subtopics.short_description: Adipogenesis regulation, epigenetic control, and adipose progenitor roles in metabolic disease.

subtopics.label: Lineage Plasticity, Cancer Stem Cells, and Cell Fate Transitions
subtopics.description: Research on cancer cell lineage plasticity, transdifferentiation, and cancer stem cell biology including epigenetic reprogramming, tumor cell identity transitions, and the role of stem cell transcription factors in tumor initiation and therapy resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Tumor cell identity transitions, epigenetic reprogramming, and stem cell factors driving therapy resistance.

subtopics.label: Hepatocyte Biology, Liver Regeneration, and Chimeric Mouse Models
subtopics.description: Research on primary human hepatocyte culture, expansion, and transplantation using chimeric mouse models, including liver repopulation strategies, disease modeling (NAFLD), and gene therapy applications in humanized liver systems.
subtopics.short_description: Primary human hepatocyte expansion, chimeric mouse liver repopulation, and humanized models for disease and gene therapy.

subtopics.label: Glioblastoma Stem Cells and Tumor Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research on glioblastoma stem cell biology, including the role of the tumor microenvironment (hypoxia, chromatin remodeling, neural development mimicry) in maintaining GSC states and driving tumor progression.
subtopics.short_description: Glioblastoma stem cell maintenance driven by hypoxia, chromatin remodeling, and tumor microenvironment signaling.

subtopics.label: KRAS Oncogenic Variants and Precision Cancer Modeling
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing distinct oncogenic KRAS alleles and their phenotypic consequences in pancreatic, lung, and other cancers, including in vivo allelic series and base-editing preclinical models.
subtopics.short_description: Oncogenic KRAS allele characterization and base-editing preclinical models across pancreatic, lung, and other cancers.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic and Chromatin Regulation in Cancer and Differentiation
subtopics.description: Research on chromatin architecture, histone modifications, and epigenetic regulators (EZH2, BMI1, cohesin, histone H1, m6A) in cancer development, cell fate, and therapeutic targeting.
subtopics.short_description: Histone modifications, chromatin architecture, and epigenetic regulators governing cancer development and cell fate.

subtopics.label: m6A RNA Modification and Epitranscriptomic Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies on m6A mRNA methylation machinery including YTHDF proteins and METTL3, examining how epitranscriptomic modifications regulate mRNA stability, translation, and cell fate decisions.
subtopics.short_description: m6A mRNA methylation machinery and epitranscriptomic control of mRNA stability, translation, and cell fate decisions.

subtopics.label: Intestinal Stem Cell Niche and Signaling
subtopics.description: Research on Lgr5+ intestinal stem cell biology, including niche support from lymphatics and fibroblasts, Wnt/NF-κB/PI3K signaling cross-talk, and lineage characterization methods.
subtopics.short_description: Lgr5+ intestinal stem cell biology, niche support from lymphatics and fibroblasts, and Wnt/NF-κB pathway cross-talk.

subtopics.label: Nerve Regeneration, Peripheral Neuropathy, and Neural Repair
subtopics.description: Studies on peripheral nerve regeneration in diabetic neuropathy, spinal cord injury, and surgical nerve repair, including corneal nerve imaging, cytokine signaling, and corticospinal axon sprouting.
subtopics.short_description: Nerve regeneration in diabetic neuropathy, spinal cord injury, and surgical repair, including cytokine and axon sprouting mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Wound Healing, PRP, and Regenerative Injection Therapies
subtopics.description: Research on regenerative approaches to wound healing and musculoskeletal conditions, including alpha-gal nanoparticles, platelet-rich plasma/fibrin injections, and bone marrow aspirate for osteoarthritis.
subtopics.short_description: Platelet-rich plasma, alpha-gal nanoparticles, and bone marrow aspirate approaches for wound healing and musculoskeletal conditions.

subtopics.label: Intervertebral Disc Degeneration and Regenerative Strategies
subtopics.description: Studies on the biology of intervertebral disc degeneration and evaluation of regenerative therapies including non-stem-cell-based approaches targeting collagen production and disc biomechanics.
subtopics.short_description: Biology of disc degeneration and regenerative therapies targeting collagen production and disc biomechanics.

subtopics.label: Ovarian Follicle, Theca Cell, and Reproductive Biology
subtopics.description: Research characterizing human ovarian follicle biology including theca cell subtypes, antral follicle molecular signatures in xenografts, AMH signaling, and gamete generation methods.
subtopics.short_description: Human ovarian follicle biology, theca cell subtypes, AMH signaling, and molecular signatures of antral follicle development.

subtopics.label: Breast Stem Cell Markers and Cancer Risk Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies examining the association of stem cell markers (CD44, CD24, ALDH1A1) in benign breast tissue with breast cancer risk, mammographic density, and reproductive/anthropometric factors.
subtopics.display_name: Breast Stem Cell Markers & Cancer Risk
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiological links between stem cell markers in benign breast tissue, mammographic density, and breast cancer risk.

subtopics.label: AML and Leukemia Stem Cell Biology and Therapy Resistance
subtopics.description: Research on acute myeloid leukemia stem cell maintenance, therapy-induced senescence, epigenetic heterogeneity, BCL6 survival signaling, and IDH/NPM1/FLT3 mutation cooperativity driving disease.
subtopics.display_name: AML Stem Cell Biology & Therapy Resistance
subtopics.short_description: Leukemia stem cell maintenance, epigenetic heterogeneity, and mutation cooperativity driving AML progression and resistance.

subtopics.label: CRISPR-Based Genome Editing for Disease Modeling and Functional Genomics
subtopics.description: Studies employing CRISPR/Cas9 and base-editing technologies to generate precise cancer models, B cell loss-of-function mutants, sex-reversed mice, and functional domain screens in stem and cancer cells.
subtopics.short_description: CRISPR/Cas9 and base-editing tools for precise cancer models, functional genomic screens, and stem cell engineering.

subtopics.label: Wnt Signaling, Secretion, and Developmental Patterning
subtopics.description: Research on Wnt pathway components including WLS/Evi-mediated Wnt transport, Wnt/β-catenin cross-talk with other pathways, and OTX2-driven enhancer remodeling in definitive endoderm specification.
subtopics.short_description: Wnt pathway transport, β-catenin cross-talk, and enhancer remodeling in endoderm specification and developmental patterning.

subtopics.label: Neurodegeneration, Microglia, and Tau Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on tau protein interactions with synaptic and mitochondrial processes in neurodegeneration, microglial population dynamics including MAC2+ progenitor-like cells, and progranulin-deficient FTD microglial signaling.
subtopics.short_description: Tau interactions in synaptic and mitochondrial neurodegeneration, microglial progenitor dynamics, and FTD microglial signaling.
