subtopics.label: Patient-Derived Xenograft and In Vivo Cancer Models
subtopics.description: Research developing and applying patient-derived xenograft (PDX) and in vivo cancer models for hepatocellular carcinoma, HIV immunotherapy evaluation, and general cancer model characterization.
subtopics.short_description: PDX and in vivo cancer models for hepatocellular carcinoma, HIV immunotherapy evaluation, and tumor characterization.

subtopics.label: Membrane Protein Structure and Function
subtopics.description: Structural and functional studies of integral membrane proteins including ion channels, transporters, GPCRs, and scramblases using cryo-EM, high-speed AFM, NMR, and molecular dynamics simulations to elucidate mechanisms of gating, transport, and lipid interactions at atomic resolution.
subtopics.short_description: Atomic-resolution studies of ion channels, transporters, and GPCRs using cryo-EM, NMR, and molecular dynamics.

subtopics.label: Cryo-EM and High-Resolution Structural Biology of Macromolecular Complexes
subtopics.description: Cryo-EM and related structural approaches to determine atomic-resolution structures of macromolecular complexes including motor proteins, chromatin remodelers, cell wall synthesis machinery, and signaling complexes, revealing mechanisms of assembly, activation, and regulation.
subtopics.short_description: Atomic-resolution cryo-EM structures of macromolecular complexes revealing mechanisms of assembly, activation, and regulation.

subtopics.label: Lipid Biology, Sphingolipid Metabolism, and Membrane Lipid Dynamics
subtopics.description: Biochemical and functional studies of lipid metabolism including sphingolipid synthesis, cholesterol transport and homeostasis, phospholipid scrambling, and fatty acid metabolism, with emphasis on their roles in cardiovascular disease, cancer, and cellular signaling.
subtopics.short_description: Sphingolipid synthesis, cholesterol transport, and phospholipid dynamics in cardiovascular disease, cancer, and cell signaling.

subtopics.label: RNA Modifications, m6A Epitranscriptomics, and RNA Biology
subtopics.description: Studies of post-transcriptional RNA modifications, particularly N6-methyladenosine (m6A) and related modifications, including their deposition, recognition by reader proteins, effects on mRNA stability and translation, and roles in stress responses and disease.
subtopics.short_description: m6A and related RNA modifications governing mRNA stability, translation, and stress responses in disease contexts.

subtopics.label: NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Bioenergetics, and Cellular Energy
subtopics.description: Biochemical studies of NAD+/NADH metabolism, mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes, oxidative phosphorylation, and cellular energy homeostasis, including enzyme kinetics, metabolic flux analysis, and therapeutic targeting of bioenergetic pathways.
subtopics.short_description: Enzyme kinetics and metabolic flux analysis of NAD+/NADH pathways and oxidative phosphorylation as therapeutic targets.

subtopics.label: Protein Structure, Aggregation, and Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Structural and biophysical characterization of proteins involved in neurodegenerative diseases including tau, alpha-synuclein, amyloid-beta, and BDNF, examining post-translational modifications, aggregation mechanisms, membrane interactions, and synaptic function.
subtopics.short_description: Structural and biophysical characterization of tau, alpha-synuclein, and amyloid-beta aggregation mechanisms in neurodegeneration.

subtopics.label: Soluble Adenylyl Cyclase, cAMP Signaling, and Contraception
subtopics.description: Biochemical and pharmacological studies of soluble adenylyl cyclase (sAC/ADCY10) including its activation by bicarbonate, inhibitor development for male contraception, roles in sperm function, melanin synthesis, and cAMP microdomain signaling.
subtopics.short_description: Biochemical and pharmacological studies of soluble adenylyl cyclase, cAMP microdomains, and inhibitor development for contraception.

subtopics.label: Small Molecule Drug Discovery and Target Engagement
subtopics.description: Discovery, optimization, and biophysical characterization of small molecule inhibitors and modulators targeting immune checkpoints (LAG-3, ICOS, TIM-3, VISTA), proteasomes, kinases, and other therapeutic targets using high-throughput screening, structure-activity relationships, and biochemical assays.
subtopics.short_description: High-throughput screening and structure-activity optimization of inhibitors targeting immune checkpoints, kinases, and proteasomes.

subtopics.label: Mycobacterium tuberculosis Biochemistry and Drug Targets
subtopics.description: Biochemical and structural studies of Mycobacterium tuberculosis enzymes and metabolic pathways including cell wall biosynthesis, NAD metabolism, fatty acid oxidation, proteasome function, and redox biology, with emphasis on identifying and validating novel drug targets.
subtopics.short_description: Structural and enzymatic studies of tuberculosis metabolic pathways to identify and validate novel antimicrobial drug targets.

subtopics.label: Ion Channel Biophysics and Electrophysiology
subtopics.description: Biophysical and electrophysiological studies of voltage-gated, ligand-gated, and mechanosensitive ion channels including sodium, potassium, calcium, and chloride channels, examining gating mechanisms, pharmacology, and roles in excitability and disease.
subtopics.short_description: Gating mechanisms, pharmacology, and disease roles of voltage-gated, ligand-gated, and mechanosensitive ion channels.

subtopics.label: Metabolomics and Metabolic Profiling in Disease
subtopics.description: Untargeted and targeted metabolomics studies characterizing metabolic alterations in cancer, neurodegeneration, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and infection, using mass spectrometry and related approaches to identify biomarkers and metabolic vulnerabilities.
subtopics.short_description: Mass spectrometry-based metabolic profiling to identify biomarkers and vulnerabilities in cancer, neurodegeneration, and infection.

subtopics.label: Lipid Metabolism and De Novo Lipogenesis in Cancer
subtopics.description: Biochemical studies of fatty acid synthesis, cholesterol biosynthesis, and lipid metabolic reprogramming in cancer cells, including FASN, ACC, SREBP2, and related enzymes as therapeutic targets, and the role of lipid metabolism in tumor progression and drug resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Fatty acid synthesis, cholesterol biosynthesis, and lipid reprogramming as therapeutic targets in tumor progression and drug resistance.

subtopics.label: DNA Replication, Repair, and Telomere Maintenance
subtopics.description: Biochemical and structural studies of DNA replication machinery, double-strand break repair, telomere maintenance proteins, and genome stability mechanisms, including studies in model organisms and human cells.
subtopics.short_description: Biochemical and structural studies of replication machinery, double-strand break repair, and telomere stability mechanisms.

subtopics.label: GPCR Signaling, Receptor Pharmacology, and Allosteric Regulation
subtopics.description: Structural and functional studies of G protein-coupled receptors including adrenergic receptors, metabotropic glutamate receptors, and glucagon receptors, examining activation mechanisms, G protein coupling, allosteric modulation, and pharmacological regulation.
subtopics.short_description: Structural and functional analysis of GPCR activation, G protein coupling, and allosteric modulation across receptor families.

subtopics.label: Synaptic Vesicle Biology and Neurotransmitter Release
subtopics.description: Biochemical and biophysical studies of synaptic vesicle proteins including Munc13, complexin, alpha-synuclein, and SNARE complexes, examining mechanisms of vesicle docking, priming, fusion, and neurotransmitter release.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of vesicle docking, priming, and SNARE-mediated fusion underlying neurotransmitter release.

subtopics.label: Chromatin Regulation, Epigenetic Dysregulation, and Lymphomagenesis
subtopics.description: Research on how chromatin-modifying complexes (cohesin, PRC1/2, histone variants, HDAC, SETD2, ARID1A) and epigenetic regulators drive B-cell lymphoma development, germinal center biology, and transcriptional reprogramming in hematologic malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Chromatin-modifying complexes and epigenetic dysregulation driving B-cell lymphoma and germinal center transcriptional reprogramming.

subtopics.label: Cell Cycle Regulation, CDK Activity, and Proliferation Control
subtopics.description: Studies examining CDK4/6 signaling, G1 phase commitment, cell cycle entry and exit under stress, and the molecular mechanisms by which cyclin-dependent kinases control proliferation in normal and cancer cells.
subtopics.short_description: CDK4/6 signaling, G1 phase commitment, and cyclin-dependent kinase mechanisms controlling proliferation in cancer cells.

subtopics.label: Glucose Transport, GLUT Biology, and Metabolic Disease
subtopics.description: Research on GLUT1/GLUT4 transporter biology, glucose homeostasis, insulin signaling, and therapeutic strategies for glucose transporter deficiency syndromes and type 2 diabetes, including beta-cell function and pancreatic islet biology.
subtopics.short_description: GLUT1/GLUT4 transporter biology, insulin signaling, and therapeutic strategies for glucose transporter deficiency and type 2 diabetes.

subtopics.label: Extracellular Vesicles, Particles, and Cancer Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on extracellular vesicles and particles as cancer biomarkers, mediators of metabolic dysfunction, and modulators of immune responses, including their isolation, proteomic profiling, and roles in tumor progression and metastasis.
subtopics.short_description: Extracellular vesicles as cancer biomarkers and mediators of immune modulation, metabolic dysfunction, and tumor metastasis.

subtopics.label: Adipocyte Differentiation, Lipid Metabolism, and Adipose Biology
subtopics.description: Research on adipogenesis, preadipocyte differentiation, lipid handling in adipose tissue, and proteomic/metabolic characterization of adipocytes, including catecholamine-driven lipolysis and UHRF1-mediated regulation.
subtopics.short_description: Adipogenesis, lipid handling, and proteomic characterization of adipose tissue including lipolysis and epigenetic regulation.

subtopics.label: Innate Immune Signaling, Inflammasome Activation, and Inflammatory Pathways
subtopics.description: Studies on NLRP3 inflammasome activation, caspase-11 interactions, necroptosis via RIPK3/MLKL, macrophage programming by cytokines, and innate immune responses to bacterial and viral pathogens.
subtopics.short_description: NLRP3 inflammasome, necroptosis, and macrophage innate immune responses to bacterial and viral pathogens.

subtopics.label: HIV-1 Antibody Responses, Vaccine Immunology, and Broadly Neutralizing Antibodies
subtopics.description: Research on broadly neutralizing antibodies against HIV-1, SOSIP trimer immunogens, antibody neutralization mechanisms, glycan heterogeneity effects, and vaccine strategies to elicit protective humoral immunity.
subtopics.short_description: Broadly neutralizing antibodies, SOSIP trimer immunogens, and vaccine strategies to elicit protective humoral immunity against HIV-1.

subtopics.label: Cytomegalovirus Glycoprotein B Antibodies and Vaccine Development
subtopics.description: Studies on antibody responses to cytomegalovirus glycoprotein B (gB), vaccine-elicited versus natural infection antibody profiles, and the development of CMV vaccines targeting gB epitopes.
subtopics.short_description: Antibody responses to CMV glycoprotein B and vaccine strategies targeting gB epitopes for protective immunity.

subtopics.label: Influenza Antibody Responses, Broadly Neutralizing Antibodies, and Vaccine Antigens
subtopics.description: Research on broadly neutralizing antibodies targeting conserved influenza epitopes (hemagglutinin anchor, stalk), polyreactive B cells, preexisting immunity effects on vaccine responses, and egg-derived glycan antigenic decoys.
subtopics.short_description: Broadly neutralizing antibodies targeting conserved influenza epitopes and preexisting immunity effects on vaccine responses.

subtopics.label: Epithelial Sodium Channel (ENaC) Regulation and Renal Sodium Transport
subtopics.description: Studies on ENaC subunit expression, ubiquitination, cleavage, aldosterone-dependent trafficking, and regulation of sodium and potassium excretion in the kidney.
subtopics.short_description: Epithelial sodium channel subunit trafficking, aldosterone-dependent regulation, and renal sodium and potassium excretion.

subtopics.label: Cell Migration, Actin Cytoskeleton Dynamics, and Membrane Protrusions
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular mechanisms controlling cell migration, including F-actin organization, membrane protrusion dynamics, fascin and T-plastin function, RhoC/ROCK signaling, and ER-PM contact gradients directing motility.
subtopics.short_description: F-actin organization, membrane protrusion dynamics, and RhoC/ROCK signaling mechanisms controlling directed cell motility.

subtopics.label: Nanoparticle-Based Drug Delivery, Theranostics, and Targeted Cancer Therapy
subtopics.description: Studies on ultrasmall silica nanoparticles, peptide nanofibers, and targeted ligands (PSMA, FAP-α) for cancer drug delivery, imaging, and theranostic applications in prostate, lung, gastric, and other cancers.
subtopics.short_description: Ultrasmall silica nanoparticles and targeted ligands for cancer drug delivery, imaging, and theranostic applications.

subtopics.label: Malaria Parasite Biology, Antigenic Variation, and Epigenetic Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on Plasmodium falciparum antigenic variation, var gene switching, histone methyltransferase roles, and the metabolic and epigenetic regulation of sexual differentiation in malaria parasites.
subtopics.short_description: Plasmodium falciparum var gene switching, histone methyltransferase roles, and epigenetic regulation of sexual differentiation.

subtopics.label: SARS-CoV-2 Antibody Responses, Antiviral Strategies, and COVID-19 Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on broadly neutralizing antibodies against SARS-CoV-2 variants, antiviral drug identification, organoid models of infection, and molecular mechanisms of viral entry and immune evasion.
subtopics.short_description: Broadly neutralizing antibodies, antiviral drug identification, and molecular mechanisms of SARS-CoV-2 entry and immune evasion.

subtopics.label: Membrane Biophysics, Lipid-Protein Interactions, and Vesicle Dynamics
subtopics.description: Biophysical studies on lipid-protein interactions at membranes, including clathrin lattice mechanics, annexin-lipid interactions, phospholipid scrambling, VDAC-mediated phospholipid import, StarD4 sterol trafficking, and high-speed AFM imaging of membrane protein dynamics.
subtopics.short_description: Biophysical studies of lipid-protein interactions, clathrin mechanics, phospholipid scrambling, and sterol trafficking at membranes.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Development and Regeneration
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms governing heart development, cardiomyocyte differentiation, and cardiac regeneration, including studies in zebrafish, mouse, and human stem cell models. Encompasses transcription factor regulation of cardiogenesis, cardiomyocyte polyploidy, and epicardial progenitor biology.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and cellular mechanisms of heart development, cardiomyocyte differentiation, and cardiac regeneration across model systems.

subtopics.label: Neural Differentiation and Cortical Development
subtopics.description: Studies on the specification, differentiation, and circuit integration of neurons and neural progenitor cells during brain development, including cortical layering, interneuron maturation, and axon guidance and pruning. Encompasses transcription factor control of neural stem cell fate and cortical patterning.
subtopics.short_description: Specification, differentiation, and circuit integration of neurons and progenitors during cortical development and brain patterning.

subtopics.label: Pluripotent Stem Cell Biology and Reprogramming
subtopics.description: Research on the generation, maintenance, and epigenetic regulation of pluripotent stem cells (ESCs and iPSCs), including reprogramming mechanisms, chromatin state transitions, and genomic stability. Covers applications of iPSCs for disease modeling and directed differentiation.
subtopics.short_description: Generation, maintenance, and epigenetic regulation of ESCs and iPSCs, including reprogramming mechanisms and directed differentiation.

subtopics.label: Organoid Models for Developmental and Disease Research
subtopics.description: Use of brain, lung, pancreatic, and other organoid systems derived from human pluripotent or patient-specific stem cells to model developmental processes, congenital conditions, and disease pathology. Includes cerebral organoids for neuropsychiatric disorders and airway/islet organoids for infectious and metabolic disease.
subtopics.short_description: Brain, lung, pancreatic, and other organoid systems derived from human stem cells to model developmental and disease processes.

subtopics.label: Hematopoietic Stem Cell Fate and Differentiation
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular regulation of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell differentiation, including epigenetic and transcriptional control of lineage specification, clonal hematopoiesis, and the role of mutations in myeloid and lymphoid fate decisions. Encompasses single-cell multi-omics approaches to dissect hematopoietic hierarchies.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic and transcriptional control of hematopoietic stem cell differentiation, clonal hematopoiesis, and myeloid/lymphoid fate decisions.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic and Chromatin Regulation of Cell Identity
subtopics.description: Studies on how chromatin modifications, histone variants, DNA methylation, and chromatin remodeling complexes regulate cell identity, lineage commitment, and developmental transitions. Includes PRC2 function, histone H1/H3.3 roles, and 3D genome organization in stem cells and differentiating tissues.
subtopics.short_description: Chromatin modifications, histone variants, DNA methylation, and 3D genome organization governing cell identity and lineage commitment.

subtopics.label: Osteoblast Differentiation and Skeletal Development
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular pathways governing osteoblast differentiation, bone formation, and skeletal patterning, including signaling through ERK/MAPK, hedgehog, Wnt, and GSK3-β pathways. Encompasses studies on craniosynostosis, skeletal stem cells, and mineralization defects.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular pathways governing bone formation, skeletal patterning, and mineralization, including craniosynostosis and skeletal stem cells.

subtopics.label: Intestinal Epithelial Lineage and Stem Cell Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on the specification, maintenance, and plasticity of intestinal epithelial cell lineages, including Lgr5+ intestinal stem cells, goblet cells, and colonocyte identity. Encompasses Wnt/β-catenin signaling, niche interactions, and lineage reversion in homeostasis and cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Specification, maintenance, and plasticity of intestinal epithelial lineages, including Lgr5+ stem cells and Wnt/β-catenin niche signaling.

subtopics.label: Endothelial Cell Specification and Vascular Development
subtopics.description: Research on the origin, specification, and functional maintenance of endothelial cells and vascular progenitors, including angiogenesis, blood-brain barrier formation, and organ-specific vascular zonation. Covers ETS transcription factor control of endothelial identity and endothelial colony-forming cells.
subtopics.short_description: Origin and functional maintenance of endothelial cells and vascular progenitors, including angiogenesis and blood-brain barrier formation.

subtopics.label: Neural Tube Defects and Developmental Genetics
subtopics.description: Genetic and genomic studies investigating the etiology of neural tube defects including spina bifida, encompassing genome-wide association studies, copy number variant analyses, regulatory genomic elements, and nutritional risk factors such as vitamin B12. Includes developmental genetics of related congenital malformations.
subtopics.short_description: Genetic and genomic etiology of neural tube defects including spina bifida, encompassing GWAS, copy number variants, and nutritional risk factors.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic β Cell Differentiation and Function
subtopics.description: Research on the differentiation, identity maintenance, and functional regulation of pancreatic β cells, including transcription factor control, epigenetic regulation, and lineage plasticity relevant to diabetes. Encompasses CDK4 signaling, ALDH1A3 inhibition, RAR-β deletion, and SARS-CoV-2-induced transdifferentiation.
subtopics.short_description: Transcription factor control, epigenetic regulation, and lineage plasticity of pancreatic β cells relevant to diabetes pathology.

subtopics.label: Adipocyte Differentiation and Adipogenesis
subtopics.description: Studies on the molecular regulation of preadipocyte commitment and adipocyte differentiation, including circadian clock control, transcription factor networks (FOXO1, FABP4), epigenetic regulators (UHRF1), and metabolic reprogramming. Encompasses in vitro models and primary cell culture systems.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular regulation of preadipocyte commitment and adipocyte differentiation, including circadian control and epigenetic regulators.

subtopics.label: Gametogenesis and Reproductive Development
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms of spermatogenesis, oogenesis, meiosis, and folliculogenesis, including genetic causes of male infertility, oocyte maturation signaling, and ovarian follicle dynamics. Encompasses progesterone receptor signaling in meiosis and assisted reproductive technology applications.
subtopics.short_description: Cellular and molecular mechanisms of spermatogenesis, oogenesis, meiosis, and folliculogenesis, including genetic causes of infertility.

subtopics.label: Lineage Plasticity and Cell Fate in Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies on how developmental lineage programs, transcription factors, and epigenetic states govern cell fate plasticity in cancer, including histological transformation, neuroendocrine differentiation, and tumor cell state transitions. Encompasses glioma, lung, colorectal, and prostate cancer lineage reprogramming.
subtopics.display_name: Lineage Plasticity & Cell Fate in Cancer
subtopics.short_description: Developmental transcription factors and epigenetic states driving cell fate plasticity, histological transformation, and tumor state transitions.

subtopics.label: Wnt and Hedgehog Developmental Signaling Pathways
subtopics.description: Research on the roles of Wnt and Hedgehog signaling pathways in tissue patterning, organogenesis, and cell fate specification during development and in disease contexts. Includes structural studies of Wnt secretion machinery and pathway activity in intestinal, hepatic, and skeletal tissues.
subtopics.short_description: Roles of Wnt and Hedgehog pathways in tissue patterning, organogenesis, and cell fate specification during development and disease.

subtopics.label: Airway Epithelial Cell Differentiation and Lung Disease
subtopics.description: Research on differentiation, cellular organization, and dysfunction of airway epithelial cells including club cells and basal stem/progenitor cells in the context of smoking, HIV, and COPD.
subtopics.short_description: Differentiation and dysfunction of airway epithelial progenitor cells in the context of smoking, HIV, and chronic lung disease.

subtopics.label: m6A RNA Modification and Epitranscriptomic Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies on m6A mRNA methylation machinery including METTL3 and YTHDF reader proteins, and their roles in post-transcriptional gene regulation and mRNA stability.
subtopics.short_description: m6A mRNA methylation machinery and reader proteins governing post-transcriptional gene regulation and mRNA stability.

subtopics.label: Glioma Stem Cells and Tumor Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research examining how the tumor microenvironment, including hypoxia and cellular states, supports glioma stem cell maintenance and influences glioblastoma biology and IDH-targeted therapy.
subtopics.short_description: Microenvironmental and hypoxic regulation of glioma stem cell maintenance and glioblastoma biology, including IDH-targeted therapy.

subtopics.label: B Cell Differentiation and Lymphomagenesis
subtopics.description: Studies on transcriptional and chromatin regulators including ARID1A and cohesin complex genes that control B cell fate decisions and contribute to germinal center-derived lymphoma.
subtopics.short_description: Transcriptional and chromatin regulators controlling B-cell fate decisions and germinal center-derived lymphoma development.

subtopics.label: IVF Embryo Assessment and Reproductive Technology
subtopics.description: Research applying computational and imaging approaches to assess human embryo quality, ploidy prediction, and blastocyst conversion rates in assisted reproductive technology.
subtopics.short_description: Computational and imaging approaches for evaluating human embryo quality, ploidy, and blastocyst conversion in assisted reproduction.

subtopics.label: Maternal Programming of Offspring Development and Behavior
subtopics.description: Studies on how maternal factors including cytokines, hormones, and gestational environment program offspring neurodevelopment, immune function, and behavior.
subtopics.short_description: Gestational factors including cytokines and hormones that program offspring neurodevelopment, immune function, and behavior.

subtopics.label: Microglial Biology and Brain Innate Immunity
subtopics.description: Research on microglial subpopulations, their resistance to pharmacological depletion, and the role of innate immune cells in brain development and neurological disease.
subtopics.short_description: Microglial subpopulations and innate immune cell roles in brain development, homeostasis, and neurological disease.

subtopics.label: Endoderm Specification and Organ Patterning
subtopics.description: Research on transcription factor-mediated enhancer remodeling and signaling pathways that direct definitive endoderm specification and patterning of endoderm-derived organs including kidney and pancreas.
subtopics.short_description: Transcription factor-driven enhancer remodeling and signaling pathways directing endoderm specification and organ patterning.

subtopics.label: Cell Cycle Regulation and Entry into Quiescence
subtopics.description: Studies on molecular mechanisms controlling cell cycle progression, density-dependent quiescence, and the regulation of cyclin D1 and CDK inhibitors in proliferating cells.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms controlling cell cycle progression, density-dependent quiescence, and CDK inhibitor regulation in proliferating cells.

subtopics.label: Tissue Regeneration and Stress Response Signaling
subtopics.description: Research on molecular regulators of tissue regeneration including Sirt1-mediated mitochondrial stress responses, nuclear pore remodeling, and cardiac scar-to-syncytium regeneration strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular regulators of tissue regeneration including Sirt1-mediated mitochondrial stress responses and cardiac scar regeneration strategies.

subtopics.label: iPSC Genome Editing and Disease Modeling Tools
subtopics.description: Methodological advances in CRISPR-based genome editing in human iPSCs and related tools including BAC vectors and iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells for disease modeling.
subtopics.short_description: CRISPR-based genome editing advances in human iPSCs and derived cell types for modeling neurological and developmental disease.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome-Immune System Interactions
subtopics.description: Research on how gut microbial communities shape host immune responses, including IgA production, T cell tolerance, immune checkpoint modulation, and mucosal immunity. Covers commensal bacteria-driven immune regulation and dysbiosis-associated immune dysfunction.
subtopics.short_description: Commensal bacteria-driven immune modulation, mucosal immunity, and dysbiosis-associated immune dysfunction in the gut.

subtopics.label: Innate Lymphoid Cells in Mucosal and Gut Immunity
subtopics.description: Studies on innate lymphoid cells (ILC3s, ILC2s) and their roles in regulating intestinal inflammation, microbiota sensing, immune tolerance, and mucosal barrier function. Includes ILC3 survival signaling, CTLA-4 expression, and dietary fiber-driven ILC2 responses.
subtopics.short_description: ILC2 and ILC3 roles in intestinal inflammation, microbiota sensing, and mucosal barrier maintenance.

subtopics.label: Fungal Microbiome (Mycobiome) in Health and Disease
subtopics.description: Research on the role of fungal communities in the gut and other body sites, including fungal-immune interactions, IgA/IgG regulation of fungi, mycobiome dysbiosis in IBD and COVID-19, and fungal involvement in cancer. Covers Candida, Kazachstania, and other fungal taxa.
subtopics.short_description: Gut and body-site fungal communities, mycobiome dysbiosis, and fungal-immune interactions in IBD, COVID-19, and cancer.

subtopics.label: Microbiome-Bile Acid and Metabolite Interactions
subtopics.description: Studies examining how gut microbiota regulate bile acid metabolism, amino acid processing, and other metabolic pathways that influence host physiology, immunity, and disease. Includes bile acid signaling, TMA/TMAO production, and microbiota-derived metabolites in cancer and inflammation.
subtopics.short_description: Gut microbiota regulation of bile acid metabolism, amino acid processing, and host-influencing microbial metabolites.

subtopics.label: Fecal Microbiota Transplantation and Therapeutic Microbiome Manipulation
subtopics.description: Research on fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) and other therapeutic interventions targeting the microbiome, including FMT for ulcerative colitis, pouchitis, and IBD-associated conditions. Covers donor strain engraftment, synbiotics, probiotics, and microbiome-guided therapies.
subtopics.short_description: FMT, probiotics, and synbiotics as therapeutic strategies for IBD, pouchitis, and microbiome-guided clinical interventions.

subtopics.label: Microbiome in Cancer and Immunotherapy Response
subtopics.description: Studies on how gut and tumor-associated microbiomes influence cancer progression and response to immunotherapy, including immune checkpoint inhibitors. Covers colorectal cancer, pancreatic cancer, gastrointestinal cancers, and antibiotic-mediated disruption of immunotherapy efficacy.
subtopics.short_description: Gut and tumor-associated microbiome influences on cancer progression and immune checkpoint inhibitor efficacy.

subtopics.label: Statistical and Computational Methods for Microbiome Analysis
subtopics.description: Development and benchmarking of statistical, machine learning, and bioinformatic tools for microbiome data analysis, including differential abundance testing, clustering, batch effect correction, and multi-omics integration. Covers methods such as MaAsLin2, ZINQ, ConQuR, and phylogenetic deep learning.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning, differential abundance testing, and multi-omics integration tools for microbiome data analysis.

subtopics.label: Antibiotic Resistance Genes and Hospital/Environmental Microbiomes
subtopics.description: Research on the distribution and transfer of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) in hospital environments, urban settings, indoor dust, and wastewater. Includes metagenomic surveillance of opportunistic pathogens and AMR in clinical and environmental contexts.
subtopics.short_description: Metagenomic surveillance of antibiotic resistance genes in hospital, urban, and wastewater microbial environments.

subtopics.label: Microbiome in Transplantation and Immunocompromised Patients
subtopics.description: Studies on gut microbiome dynamics in hematopoietic cell and kidney transplant recipients, including colonization with pathogens, post-transplant diarrhea, antibiotic perturbation, and microbiome-mediated protection against infections. Covers clinical outcomes linked to microbiome composition.
subtopics.short_description: Gut microbiome dynamics, pathogen colonization, and clinical outcomes in hematopoietic and kidney transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: Microbiome in Inflammatory Bowel Disease and Intestinal Inflammation
subtopics.description: Research on gut microbiome alterations in IBD (Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis) and related intestinal inflammatory conditions, including dysbiosis, adherent-invasive E. coli, bile acid changes post-resection, and microbiome-guided treatment strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Gut dysbiosis, adherent-invasive E. coli, and microbiome-guided treatment strategies in Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.

subtopics.label: Urogenital and Reproductive Tract Microbiomes
subtopics.description: Studies on microbial communities in the cervicovaginal tract, urinary tract, and placenta, including associations with schistosome infection, HPV persistence, UTI risk, and pregnancy outcomes. Covers microbiome composition and host-pathogen interactions in reproductive and urinary contexts.
subtopics.short_description: Cervicovaginal, urinary, and placental microbial communities and their links to HPV, UTI risk, and pregnancy outcomes.

subtopics.label: Microbiome and Host Biology During Spaceflight
subtopics.description: Research characterizing microbiome composition, immune responses, and multi-omics profiles of astronauts during and after spaceflight missions. Includes longitudinal studies of microbial shifts, skin and gut microbiome changes, and the Space Omics and Medical Atlas (SOMA).
subtopics.short_description: Longitudinal multi-omics profiling of astronaut microbiome and immune shifts during and after spaceflight missions.

subtopics.label: Diet, Nutrition, and Microbiome Interactions
subtopics.description: Studies on how dietary components—including fiber, fermentable carbohydrates, and specific nutrients—shape gut microbiome composition and downstream host metabolic and immune outcomes. Covers inulin, FODMAPs, synbiotics, and dietary restriction effects on microbial communities.
subtopics.short_description: Dietary fiber, fermentable carbohydrates, and nutrient effects on gut microbiome composition and host metabolic outcomes.

subtopics.label: Parasitic Infections and Microbiome Alterations
subtopics.description: Research on how helminth and parasitic infections (particularly Schistosoma species) alter host microbiome composition, mucosal immunity, and systemic immune phenotypes. Includes cervicovaginal microbiome changes and immune dysregulation associated with schistosomiasis.
subtopics.short_description: Helminth and Schistosoma infection effects on host microbiome composition, mucosal immunity, and systemic immune phenotypes.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome and Cerebrovascular/Neurological Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining the relationship between gut microbial communities, intestinal dysbiosis, and cerebrovascular events such as ischemic stroke, including protective bacterial signatures and gut-brain axis mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Gut microbial community links to ischemic stroke risk, protective bacterial signatures, and gut-brain axis mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Respiratory and Upper Airway Microbiomes
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing microbial communities of the respiratory tract and upper airways, including the middle meatus, tonsils, adenoids, and oropharynx, and their roles in conditions such as chronic rhinosinusitis and aspiration pneumonia.
subtopics.short_description: Microbial communities of the airways, tonsils, and oropharynx and their roles in sinusitis and respiratory disease.

subtopics.label: Microbiome Sample Collection, Genetic Tools, and Methodological Advances
subtopics.description: Development and validation of practical tools for microbiome research, including novel stool collection and preservation kits, and genetic manipulation techniques for non-model gut microorganisms to enable mechanistic studies.
subtopics.short_description: Validated stool collection kits and genetic manipulation techniques enabling mechanistic microbiome research.

subtopics.label: Intestinal Barrier Function, Neonatal Gut, and Mucosal Healing
subtopics.description: Research on mechanisms maintaining or restoring intestinal barrier integrity, including pharmacological interventions for alcohol-related gut permeability, epigenetic regulation in necrotizing enterocolitis, and immune-mediated mucosal healing via hepcidin-iron sequestration.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanisms of gut barrier integrity, mucosal healing, and epigenetic regulation in necrotizing enterocolitis and alcohol-related permeability.

subtopics.label: Engineered Bacteria and Synthetic Biology for Therapeutic Applications
subtopics.description: Studies employing genetically engineered or modified bacteria as therapeutic agents, including engineered probiotics designed to reprogram the tumor microenvironment and boost cancer immunotherapy efficacy.
subtopics.short_description: Genetically engineered probiotics and synthetic biology approaches to reprogram tumor microenvironments and enhance cancer immunotherapy.

subtopics.label: AAV Vector Design, Tropism, and Safety Characterization
subtopics.description: Research on adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector engineering including capsid modifications for tissue tropism, biodistribution profiling, safety assessments, and production quality control for gene therapy applications.
subtopics.short_description: Capsid modifications, tissue tropism, biodistribution profiling, and quality control for AAV-based gene therapy vectors.

subtopics.label: AAV-Mediated Gene Therapy for Neurological and CNS Diseases
subtopics.description: Preclinical and clinical studies using AAV vectors to deliver therapeutic genes directly to the central nervous system for treatment of neurological disorders including Batten disease, Friedreich's ataxia, metachromatic leukodystrophy, Parkinson's disease, and Alzheimer's disease.
subtopics.display_name: AAV Gene Therapy for CNS Disorders
subtopics.short_description: Preclinical and clinical AAV-mediated gene delivery for neurological diseases including Batten disease, Friedreich's ataxia, and Parkinson's disease.

subtopics.label: Ocular Gene Therapy for Retinal and Macular Diseases
subtopics.description: Development and clinical evaluation of gene therapy approaches for inherited and acquired retinal diseases, including AAV-mediated intravitreal delivery of aflibercept (ixo-vec/ADVM-022) for neovascular AMD, optogenetic vision restoration, and CLN2-associated retinal degeneration.
subtopics.short_description: AAV-mediated and optogenetic gene therapy approaches for inherited retinal diseases and neovascular macular degeneration.

subtopics.label: CAR T Cell Therapy: Engineering, Clinical Outcomes, and Combination Strategies
subtopics.description: Research on chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapies covering CAR design and engineering, clinical outcomes in hematologic malignancies and solid tumors, combination with radiation, and strategies to overcome treatment failure and antigen escape.
subtopics.short_description: CAR design, clinical outcomes in hematologic and solid tumors, and strategies to overcome antigen escape and treatment failure.

subtopics.label: T Cell-Based Immunotherapy and Adoptive Cell Transfer
subtopics.description: Studies on adoptive transfer of antigen-specific cytotoxic T lymphocytes, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and engineered T cell receptor therapies for cancer and viral infections, including manufacturing, functional enhancement, and clinical evaluation.
subtopics.short_description: Manufacturing and clinical evaluation of antigen-specific cytotoxic T lymphocytes, TILs, and engineered TCR therapies for cancer and viral infections.

subtopics.label: Pharmacological Chaperone Approaches for Protein Misfolding Diseases
subtopics.description: Research on small molecule pharmacological chaperones that stabilize misfolded or aggregated proteins to restore function in lysosomal storage disorders and other protein misfolding diseases, including Niemann-Pick type C and STXBP1-related disorders.
subtopics.short_description: Small molecules that stabilize misfolded proteins to restore function in lysosomal storage disorders and related protein misfolding diseases.

subtopics.label: iPSC Generation, Genome Editing, and Disease Modeling
subtopics.description: Methods and applications of induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) derivation, CRISPR-based genome editing including base editing, and generation of precision disease models for therapeutic development and mechanistic studies.
subtopics.short_description: Induced pluripotent stem cell generation, CRISPR-based editing including base editing, and precision disease modeling for therapeutic development.

subtopics.label: Bacterial Artificial Chromosome and High-Capacity Vector Engineering
subtopics.description: Technical methods for engineering bacterial artificial chromosomes (BACs) and other high-capacity cloning vectors, including one-step and two-step homology arm preparation and electroporation protocols for transgenic applications.
subtopics.short_description: Bacterial artificial chromosome and large-insert vector construction methods for transgenic and gene therapy applications.

subtopics.label: mRNA, Circular RNA, and RNA-Based Therapeutic Platforms
subtopics.description: Development of mRNA and circular RNA platforms for therapeutic protein expression, vaccine delivery, and RNA aptamer-based gene regulation, including nucleoside-modified mRNA vaccines and RNA nanodevice engineering.
subtopics.short_description: Nucleoside-modified mRNA, circular RNA, and RNA aptamer platforms for therapeutic protein expression, vaccines, and gene regulation.

subtopics.label: Hepatocyte-Targeted Gene and Cell Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on gene and cell therapy approaches targeting the liver, including AAV transduction of human hepatocytes in chimeric mouse models, primary hepatocyte expansion and genetic manipulation, and in vivo hepatocyte implantation models.
subtopics.short_description: AAV transduction, primary hepatocyte expansion, and in vivo implantation models for liver-directed gene and cell therapy.

subtopics.label: Tumor Antigen Identification and Cancer Immunotherapy Enhancement
subtopics.description: Studies identifying tumor-associated and neoantigens for immunotherapy targeting, including radiation-induced neoantigen exposure, cell surface target discovery, and epigenetic or metabolic strategies to enhance antitumor immune responses.
subtopics.short_description: Identification of tumor-associated and neoantigens, and epigenetic or metabolic strategies to enhance antitumor immune responses.

subtopics.label: HIV Reservoir Elimination and Immunotherapy Strategies
subtopics.description: Preclinical and clinical research on immunotherapeutic strategies to target and eliminate HIV reservoirs, including BCL-2 antagonism, participant-derived xenograft models, dendritic cell therapy, and mRNA vaccine-mediated HIV latency reversal.
subtopics.short_description: Immunotherapeutic strategies targeting HIV reservoirs, including BCL-2 antagonism, dendritic cell therapy, and mRNA vaccine-mediated latency reversal.

subtopics.label: Nanoparticle and Non-Viral Delivery Platforms for Nucleic Acids
subtopics.description: Development and evaluation of nanoparticle-based and non-viral delivery systems for nucleic acid therapeutics including siRNA, mRNA, and combination therapies, with applications in cancer and cardiovascular disease.
subtopics.short_description: Nanoparticle-based delivery systems for siRNA, mRNA, and combination nucleic acid therapeutics in cancer and cardiovascular disease.

subtopics.label: Cell Therapy Product Manufacturing and Cryopreservation
subtopics.description: Research on manufacturing, storage, and quality control of cellular therapy products including cryopreservation conditions, myeloid progenitor cell therapies, and endothelial cell-assisted transplantation approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Quality control, cryopreservation optimization, and manufacturing processes for cellular therapy products including myeloid and endothelial cell therapies.

subtopics.label: Gene Therapy for Eosinophilic and Hypereosinophilic Disorders
subtopics.description: Research on AAV-mediated and other gene therapy approaches targeting eosinophil reduction in chronic eosinophilic leukemia and hypereosinophilia, including vectorized antibody delivery strategies.
subtopics.short_description: AAV-mediated and vectorized antibody strategies targeting eosinophil reduction in chronic eosinophilic leukemia and hypereosinophilia.

subtopics.label: Endothelial Cell Biology and Vascular Regeneration
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing endothelial progenitor and clonal repopulating cells, their lineage origins, and their roles in blood vessel formation, maintenance, and regenerative medicine applications.
subtopics.short_description: Characterization of endothelial progenitor cells, their lineage origins, and roles in blood vessel formation and regenerative medicine.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Beta Cell Biology and Diabetes Therapeutic Strategies
subtopics.description: Research on beta cell heterogeneity, dysfunction in type 2 diabetes, SARS-CoV-2-induced transdifferentiation, and small molecule approaches to enhance beta cell survival and function after transplantation.
subtopics.short_description: Beta cell heterogeneity, dysfunction in type 2 diabetes, and small molecule approaches to enhance survival and function after transplantation.

subtopics.label: Genetic Manipulation of Gut Microbiota
subtopics.description: Development and application of genetic tools for manipulating non-model gut microorganisms to study host-microbiome interactions, colon inflammation, and microbiome-associated disease mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Genetic tools for engineering non-model gut microorganisms to study host-microbiome interactions and microbiome-associated disease mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Tumor Microenvironment and Combination Cancer Immunotherapy
subtopics.description: Investigations into how the tumor microenvironment shapes immunotherapy responses, including strategies combining immune checkpoint blockade with microenvironment-targeting agents and neutrophil engagement by T cell therapies to overcome antigen escape.
subtopics.short_description: Tumor microenvironment influences on immunotherapy response, combining checkpoint blockade with microenvironment-targeting and T cell strategies.

subtopics.label: Bioethics and Policy in Gene and Cell Therapy
subtopics.description: Ethical and policy analyses surrounding the application of gene therapy and advanced biomedical technologies, including considerations of societal impact, risk-benefit frameworks, and the principle of non-maleficence.
subtopics.short_description: Ethical frameworks and policy analyses addressing societal impact, risk-benefit considerations, and non-maleficence in gene and cell therapy.

subtopics.label: Cardiac and Musculoskeletal Tissue Regeneration
subtopics.description: Research on regenerative strategies for cardiac scar tissue and intervertebral disc degeneration, encompassing cell-based, gene-based, and small molecule approaches to restore tissue function.
subtopics.short_description: Cell-based, gene-based, and small molecule strategies to restore function in cardiac scar tissue and degenerating intervertebral discs.

subtopics.label: Small Molecule Discovery, Design & Optimization
subtopics.description: Research focused on identifying, synthesizing, and optimizing small molecule compounds through high-throughput screening, structure-activity relationships, computational methods (including free energy perturbation and virtual screening), and medicinal chemistry campaigns targeting diverse therapeutic proteins including immune checkpoints, kinases, and infectious disease enzymes.
subtopics.short_description: High-throughput screening, medicinal chemistry, and computational methods to identify and optimize small molecule drug candidates.

subtopics.label: Antimicrobial Target Identification & Drug Development
subtopics.description: Research identifying and validating novel drug targets in bacterial and parasitic pathogens, including Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Plasmodium falciparum, and other infectious agents, encompassing target essentiality studies, inhibitor discovery, structure-activity relationships, and preclinical evaluation of antimicrobial compounds.
subtopics.short_description: Target identification, inhibitor discovery, and preclinical evaluation of compounds against bacterial and parasitic pathogens.

subtopics.label: Cancer Targeted Therapy, Resistance Mechanisms & Precision Oncology
subtopics.description: Research on molecularly targeted cancer therapies including CDK4/6 inhibitors, KRAS inhibitors, androgen receptor antagonists, and other precision agents, with emphasis on mechanisms of acquired and intrinsic resistance, biomarker identification, and strategies to overcome treatment failure across solid tumors and hematologic malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Precision oncology agents, acquired resistance mechanisms, and biomarker strategies across solid tumors and hematologic malignancies.

subtopics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy: Checkpoint Inhibitors, CAR-T & Combination Strategies
subtopics.description: Research on immune checkpoint blockade (PD-1/PD-L1, CTLA-4, LAG-3, TIM-3, TIGIT, ICOS), CAR-T cell therapies, and combination immunotherapy strategies including radiation, targeted agents, and novel immune modulators, encompassing preclinical mechanistic studies and clinical trial results.
subtopics.short_description: Immune checkpoint blockade, CAR-T cell therapies, and combination strategies integrating radiation, targeted agents, and immune modulators.

subtopics.label: Antibody, Biologic & Vaccine Development
subtopics.description: Research on the development and characterization of monoclonal antibodies, broadly neutralizing antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates, mRNA vaccines, and other biologics targeting viral pathogens (HIV, CMV, SARS-CoV-2, influenza) and cancer, including immunogen design, Fc-mediated effector functions, and preclinical/clinical immunogenicity evaluation.
subtopics.short_description: Monoclonal antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates, mRNA vaccines, and biologic immunogen design for viral and cancer targets.

subtopics.label: Gene Therapy, AAV Vectors & Nucleic Acid Delivery
subtopics.description: Research on adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector engineering, gene therapy for inherited and acquired diseases, nucleic acid delivery platforms including mRNA and RNA aptamers, and ocular gene therapy, encompassing vector design, biodistribution, safety evaluation, and therapeutic efficacy in preclinical and clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: AAV vector engineering, mRNA delivery platforms, and therapeutic gene transfer for inherited and acquired diseases.

subtopics.label: GPCR, Ion Channel & Membrane Transporter Structural Pharmacology
subtopics.description: Research on the structural basis of GPCR activation, ion channel gating, and membrane transporter function using cryo-EM, molecular dynamics, and biophysical methods, with direct implications for drug design including allosteric modulation, ligand efficacy, and mechanisms of anesthetic and pharmacological action.
subtopics.short_description: Structural and biophysical characterization of GPCRs, ion channels, and membrane transporters to guide allosteric and ligand-based drug design.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Disease, Obesity & Diabetes Pharmacotherapy
subtopics.description: Research on pharmacological interventions for obesity, type 2 diabetes, and related metabolic disorders, including GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists (tirzepatide, semaglutide, liraglutide), insulin formulations, SGLT2 inhibitors, and novel targets such as ALDH1A3, BACH2, and CDK4, encompassing clinical trials, real-world evidence, and mechanistic studies.
subtopics.short_description: GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists, SGLT2 inhibitors, and novel targets for obesity, type 2 diabetes, and related metabolic disorders.

subtopics.label: Hematologic Malignancy Treatment & Novel Agents
subtopics.description: Research on pharmacological treatment of leukemias, lymphomas, and myeloproliferative neoplasms, including clinical trials of novel agents (venetoclax, ibrutinib, acalabrutinib, azacitidine, gilteritinib, ivosidenib, revumenib), combination regimens, resistance mechanisms, and biomarker-driven patient selection.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical trials and resistance mechanisms for novel agents targeting leukemias, lymphomas, and myeloproliferative neoplasms.

subtopics.label: Radiopharmaceuticals, Theranostics & Targeted Radionuclide Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on the development and clinical evaluation of radiopharmaceuticals for cancer imaging and therapy, including PSMA-targeted agents for prostate cancer, pretargeted radioimmunotherapy approaches (GPA33, HER2), alpha-emitting radionuclides (225Ac), and PET imaging probes for tumor characterization.
subtopics.short_description: Development and clinical evaluation of theranostic radiopharmaceuticals for cancer imaging and targeted radionuclide treatment.

subtopics.label: Neurodegeneration & CNS Drug Targets
subtopics.description: Research on pharmacological targeting of neurodegenerative disease mechanisms including tau pathology, amyloid-beta, alpha-synuclein, and neuroinflammation, encompassing small molecule inhibitors, immunotherapy approaches, drug repurposing, and mechanistic studies in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ALS, and related disorders.
subtopics.short_description: Pharmacological targeting of tau, amyloid-beta, alpha-synuclein, and neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ALS, and related disorders.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Antiviral & Immunomodulatory Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on pharmacological interventions for SARS-CoV-2 infection including antiviral agents (remdesivir, Paxlovid, molnupiravir, VV116, ensitrelvir), monoclonal antibodies, immunomodulators (anakinra, infliximab, vilobelimab, fluvoxamine), and combination strategies, encompassing clinical trials, real-world outcomes, and mechanistic studies.
subtopics.short_description: Antiviral agents, monoclonal antibodies, and immunomodulators for SARS-CoV-2, evaluated in clinical trials and real-world settings.

subtopics.label: Drug Repurposing, Computational Discovery & Knowledge Graphs
subtopics.description: Research employing computational approaches including machine learning, knowledge graphs, network pharmacology, and bioinformatics to identify new therapeutic uses for existing drugs, predict drug-target interactions, and prioritize candidates for experimental validation across diverse disease areas.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning, knowledge graphs, and network pharmacology to identify new therapeutic uses and predict drug-target interactions.

subtopics.label: Dermatology: Biologics, Small Molecules & Topical Therapies
subtopics.description: Research on pharmacological treatment of inflammatory skin diseases (atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, hidradenitis suppurativa, acne) and skin cancer, including biologics (dupilumab, lebrikizumab, risankizumab, guselkumab), JAK inhibitors (abrocitinib, baricitinib), and topical agents, with emphasis on efficacy across diverse skin tones and real-world outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Biologics, JAK inhibitors, and topical agents for inflammatory skin diseases and skin cancer, with real-world efficacy data.

subtopics.label: Anesthesia, Analgesic & Psychoactive Drug Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms of volatile and intravenous anesthetics, analgesics, opioids, psychedelics, and ketamine, including ion channel targets, synaptic effects, pharmacokinetics, and translational studies linking molecular mechanisms to clinical anesthetic potency and pain management.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and cellular mechanisms of anesthetics, opioids, psychedelics, and ketamine linking ion channel targets to clinical pharmacology.

subtopics.label: Opioid Stewardship, Prescribing Policy & Regulation
subtopics.description: Research examining the effects of state and federal opioid prescribing laws, prescription drug monitoring programs, prescribing cap legislation, and institutional policies on opioid dispensing patterns, persistent opioid use, and overdose outcomes across surgical and chronic pain populations.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of federal and state opioid laws, monitoring programs, and institutional policies on prescribing patterns and overdose outcomes.

subtopics.label: Postoperative Opioid Prescribing & Perioperative Analgesia
subtopics.description: Studies investigating postoperative opioid prescribing patterns, multimodal analgesia strategies, opioid-sparing techniques, and persistent postoperative opioid use across diverse surgical procedures and patient populations.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid-sparing strategies, multimodal analgesia, and persistent postoperative opioid use across surgical populations.

subtopics.label: Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy & Corneal Confocal Microscopy
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, progression, and risk factors of diabetic peripheral neuropathy using corneal confocal microscopy and quantitative sensory testing, including the impact of glycemic control, metabolic factors, and pharmacological interventions on nerve fiber loss.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and progression of diabetic peripheral neuropathy using corneal confocal microscopy and quantitative sensory testing.

subtopics.label: Headache Disorders & Surgical Nerve Decompression
subtopics.description: Research on the surgical management of headache disorders including occipital neuralgia, nerve compression headaches, and migraine via nerve decompression, trigger-site deactivation, and neuromodulation, including outcomes, treatment delays, and anatomical considerations.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of occipital neuralgia, migraine, and nerve compression headaches via decompression and neuromodulation.

subtopics.label: Migraine Treatment & Pharmacotherapy
subtopics.description: Studies on pharmacological prevention and acute treatment of migraine, including CGRP-targeted monoclonal antibodies, onabotulinumtoxinA, and combination therapies, as well as socioeconomic and psychiatric factors influencing migraine medication use and adherence.
subtopics.short_description: CGRP-targeted therapies, onabotulinumtoxinA, and socioeconomic factors influencing migraine treatment adherence.

subtopics.label: Anesthetic Mechanisms & Pharmacology
subtopics.description: Basic and translational research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms of volatile and intravenous anesthetics, including ion channel modulation (K2P, HCN, Nav, TRPV channels), effects on synaptic transmission, presynaptic calcium dynamics, and neuronal excitability.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and cellular mechanisms of volatile and intravenous anesthetics, including ion channel modulation and synaptic effects.

subtopics.label: Regional Anesthesia & Neuraxial Techniques
subtopics.description: Clinical research on regional anesthesia techniques including neuraxial blocks, peripheral nerve blocks, epidural injections, and local anesthetic pharmacology, covering efficacy, complications, and applications in obstetric, surgical, and interventional pain settings.
subtopics.short_description: Neuraxial blocks, peripheral nerve blocks, and local anesthetic pharmacology across surgical and obstetric settings.

subtopics.label: Chronic Pain Psychology, Psychosocial Factors & Self-Management
subtopics.description: Research on psychological, social, and behavioral dimensions of chronic pain including cognitive-behavioral interventions, positive affect skills, discrimination, stress, well-being practices, and digital or peer-support tools for chronic pain self-management.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive-behavioral interventions, psychosocial factors, and digital tools for chronic pain self-management and well-being.

subtopics.label: Cancer Pain Management & Opioid Use in Oncology
subtopics.description: Studies on opioid prescribing, access, and outcomes for cancer patients including bone metastasis, pancreatic cancer, and advanced illness, as well as the impact of cannabis legalization, Medicare coverage restrictions, and celiac plexus neurolysis on cancer pain management.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid prescribing, access, and outcomes for cancer patients, including policy impacts and interventional pain approaches.

subtopics.label: Chronic Pelvic Pain & Urologic Pain Syndromes
subtopics.description: Research on urologic chronic pelvic pain syndrome (UCPPS), interstitial cystitis, and related conditions, including pelvic floor muscle tenderness, sexual dysfunction, bladder hyperalgesia, and multidisciplinary approaches to diagnosis and treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Urologic chronic pelvic pain, interstitial cystitis, and multidisciplinary approaches to diagnosis and treatment.

subtopics.label: Neuromodulation & Interventional Pain Procedures
subtopics.description: Clinical research on interventional pain management techniques including spinal cord stimulation, radiofrequency neurotomy, transcranial direct current stimulation, occipital nerve stimulation, and virtual reality-assisted procedural training and pain relief.
subtopics.short_description: Spinal cord stimulation, radiofrequency neurotomy, transcranial stimulation, and virtual reality-assisted pain procedures.

subtopics.label: Perioperative Care, Enhanced Recovery & Critical Care Analgesia
subtopics.description: Research on enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocols, perioperative fluid management, sedation practices in the ICU, ketamine use in mechanically ventilated patients, and multidisciplinary approaches to reducing postoperative complications and length of stay.
subtopics.short_description: ERAS protocols, perioperative fluid management, ICU sedation, and strategies to reduce postoperative complications.

subtopics.label: Neuropathic Pain Biology & Peripheral Nerve Pathology
subtopics.description: Translational and clinical research on neuropathic pain mechanisms including small fiber neuropathy, peripheral nerve injury, traumatic neuromas, corneal nerve loss in non-diabetic conditions (COVID-19, Guillain-Barré), and pharmacological targets such as HCN channels and probucol.
subtopics.short_description: Small fiber neuropathy, peripheral nerve injury, traumatic neuromas, and pharmacological targets for neuropathic pain.

subtopics.label: Opioid Pharmacology, Addiction Biology & Cannabis Interactions
subtopics.description: Basic science and translational research on opioid receptor biology, hippocampal opioid system modulation by sex and stress, endocannabinoid interactions with opioid reward and analgesia, and the relationship between cannabis laws and opioid use disorder outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid receptor biology, endocannabinoid-opioid interactions, and cannabis policy effects on opioid use disorder outcomes.

subtopics.label: Pain Care Disparities, Access & Health Equity
subtopics.description: Research examining racial, ethnic, socioeconomic, and geographic disparities in pain treatment, opioid access, anesthesia techniques, and adherence to pain management protocols across surgical, obstetric, and chronic pain populations.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, socioeconomic, and geographic disparities in pain treatment and opioid access across clinical populations.

subtopics.label: Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery & Decompression Techniques
subtopics.description: Research on minimally invasive surgical approaches for spinal conditions including tubular laminotomy, endoscopic techniques, TLIF, LLIF, and cervical decompression procedures, evaluating clinical outcomes, safety, and technical innovations.
subtopics.short_description: Endoscopic and tubular approaches for spinal decompression, evaluating clinical outcomes, safety, and technical innovations.

subtopics.label: Cervical Spine Surgery: Outcomes & Complications
subtopics.description: Studies examining clinical and radiographic outcomes of cervical spine procedures including ACDF, laminoplasty, corpectomy, atlantoaxial fusion, and foraminotomy, with attention to complications, fusion rates, and patient selection.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and radiographic outcomes of ACDF, laminoplasty, corpectomy, and cervical fusion procedures.

subtopics.label: Breast Sensation Recovery After Mastectomy & Reconstruction
subtopics.description: Research on sensory outcomes following mastectomy and breast reconstruction, including neurotized DIEP flaps, implant-based reconstruction, nipple-areola complex reinnervation, and factors affecting sensory recovery and quality of life.
subtopics.short_description: Sensory outcomes following mastectomy and reconstruction, including neurotized flaps and nipple-areola reinnervation.

subtopics.label: Lung Transplantation: Perioperative Management & Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies on intraoperative and perioperative management of lung transplant patients, including extubation timing, blood lactate as a predictor of graft dysfunction, disease-specific implications, and multidisciplinary care strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Intraoperative and perioperative care strategies for lung transplant patients, including extubation timing and graft dysfunction prediction.

subtopics.label: Intervertebral Disc Degeneration & Regenerative Therapies
subtopics.description: Research on the pathophysiology of intervertebral disc degeneration and evaluation of regenerative and non-stem-cell-based therapeutic approaches including biological injections and structural interventions for chronic low back pain.
subtopics.short_description: Pathophysiology of intervertebral disc degeneration and biological or structural interventions for chronic low back pain.

subtopics.label: Complementary & Integrative Medicine in Palliative & Supportive Care
subtopics.description: Studies examining the use, perception, and evidence base for complementary and integrative medicine (CIM) approaches—including acupuncture, aromatherapy, tai chi, and spiritual care—for pain and symptom management in palliative, oncologic, and chronic pain populations.
subtopics.short_description: Acupuncture, aromatherapy, tai chi, and spiritual care for pain and symptom management in palliative and oncologic settings.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Pain Management, Opioid Use & Sedation
subtopics.description: Research on opioid prescribing, sedation practices, and analgesia in pediatric populations, including PICU sedation, opioid cap laws affecting youth, maternal opioid prescriptions and child outcomes, and minimally invasive anesthesia for pediatric procedures.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid prescribing, PICU sedation, and analgesia strategies in pediatric populations, including policy impacts on youth.

subtopics.label: Pain Assessment & Management in Older Adults & Home Care
subtopics.description: Studies on pain measurement tools, drug use patterns, and pain experiences in older adults receiving home care or managing chronic conditions, including multidimensional assessment instruments and heart failure-related pain.
subtopics.short_description: Pain measurement tools, drug use patterns, and multidimensional assessment in older adults receiving home or chronic care.

subtopics.label: Intraoperative Opioid Exposure & Oncologic Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research investigating the relationship between intraoperative opioid administration and cancer-related outcomes, including tumor genomics, survival differences, and perioperative ischemic risk in cancer patients.
subtopics.short_description: Relationship between intraoperative opioid exposure and cancer survival, tumor genomics, and perioperative ischemic risk.

subtopics.label: Perioperative Transfusion Practices & Blood Management
subtopics.description: Studies on blood product utilization and transfusion practices in surgical settings including cardiac surgery, liver transplantation, and pediatric craniosynostosis repair, examining outcomes and standardization of transfusion protocols.
subtopics.short_description: Blood product utilization and transfusion protocol standardization in cardiac surgery, transplantation, and pediatric procedures.

subtopics.label: Sickle Cell Disease, Musculoskeletal Pain & Comorbidity Burden
subtopics.description: Research on pain and health outcomes in sickle cell disease and musculoskeletal conditions, including surgical morbidity, stress measurement, aromatase inhibitor-related musculoskeletal symptoms, and arthritis prevalence in caregivers.
subtopics.short_description: Pain burden, surgical morbidity, and comorbidity in sickle cell disease and musculoskeletal conditions.

subtopics.label: Sleep, Neurophysiology & Cognitive Function in Pain Contexts
subtopics.description: Studies examining the intersection of sleep health, neurophysiological monitoring, and cognitive or motor performance in pain-related and perioperative contexts, including dexmedetomidine sleep modulation, cortical arousal tracking, and physiatrist sleep documentation.
subtopics.short_description: Sleep health, cortical arousal monitoring, and cognitive performance in pain-related and perioperative contexts.

subtopics.label: Prostate Biopsy Techniques & Urologic Procedural Pain
subtopics.description: Research comparing transperineal versus transrectal prostate biopsy approaches for infection prevention and cancer detection, and evaluating in-office ablative procedures for prostate cancer with attention to pain and procedural outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Transperineal versus transrectal biopsy approaches and in-office ablative procedures for prostate cancer, with focus on pain outcomes.

subtopics.label: Natural Language Processing and Text Mining for Clinical Records
subtopics.description: Research applying NLP, rule-based systems, and large language models to extract structured information from clinical notes, pathology reports, discharge summaries, and EHR free text, including named entity recognition, assertion classification, and information extraction for clinical and research purposes.
subtopics.short_description: Extraction of structured clinical information from notes, reports, and EHR free text using NLP and large language models.

subtopics.label: Large Language Models and Generative AI in Clinical and Biomedical Applications
subtopics.description: Research evaluating, fine-tuning, and deploying large language models and generative AI for medical question answering, clinical evidence summarization, radiology report generation, medical education, and healthcare decision support, including benchmarking and trustworthiness assessments.
subtopics.short_description: Evaluation and deployment of large language models for medical question answering, report generation, and healthcare decision support.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning Prediction Models Using Electronic Health Records
subtopics.description: Research developing and validating machine learning and deep learning models that use structured EHR data to predict clinical outcomes including mortality, readmission, disease progression, treatment response, and risk stratification across diverse patient populations.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning models using structured EHR data to predict mortality, readmission, disease progression, and patient risk.

subtopics.label: Computable Phenotyping, EHR Data Infrastructure, and Clinical Data Warehouses
subtopics.description: Research on building and evaluating clinical data infrastructure including enterprise data warehouses, common data models, computable phenotype algorithms, EHR-based cohort identification, and data governance frameworks to support clinical and translational research.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical data warehouses, common data models, and phenotype algorithms supporting translational and population research.

subtopics.label: Deep Learning for Medical Image Analysis and Radiology
subtopics.description: Research applying convolutional neural networks, transformers, and other deep learning architectures to analyze medical images including radiology (X-ray, MRI, CT), pathology whole slide images, ophthalmology, and ultrasound for detection, segmentation, classification, and prognostication.
subtopics.short_description: Neural network methods applied to radiology, pathology, and ophthalmic images for detection, segmentation, and prognosis.

subtopics.label: Clinical Decision Support Systems and AI-Assisted Clinical Tools
subtopics.description: Research designing, implementing, and evaluating AI-driven clinical decision support tools, best practice alerts, order sets, and automated e-consults integrated into clinical workflows to improve guideline adherence, diagnostic accuracy, and patient outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Design and evaluation of AI-integrated alerts, order sets, and decision tools to improve guideline adherence and patient outcomes.

subtopics.label: Wearable Devices, mHealth Apps, and Digital Health Monitoring
subtopics.description: Research on wearable sensors, mobile health applications, and passive sensing technologies for monitoring, predicting, and managing health conditions including mental health, diabetes, sleep disorders, and chronic disease, encompassing scoping reviews and clinical evaluations.
subtopics.short_description: Wearable sensors and mobile health apps for continuous monitoring and management of chronic and behavioral health conditions.

subtopics.label: Federated Learning and Privacy-Preserving Methods for Healthcare Data
subtopics.description: Research developing and applying federated learning frameworks and privacy-preserving computational methods to train predictive models across distributed healthcare datasets including EHRs from multiple institutions, addressing data heterogeneity and security challenges.
subtopics.short_description: Privacy-preserving frameworks for training predictive models across distributed, multi-institutional healthcare datasets.

subtopics.label: Biomedical Knowledge Graphs and Computational Drug Repurposing
subtopics.description: Research constructing and applying biomedical knowledge graphs, network embeddings, and graph-based machine learning to support drug repurposing, target identification, disease mechanism discovery, and integrative biomedical knowledge representation.
subtopics.short_description: Graph-based machine learning on biomedical knowledge networks for drug repurposing, target identification, and disease discovery.

subtopics.label: Data-Driven Patient Subphenotyping and Disease Stratification
subtopics.description: Research using unsupervised and semi-supervised machine learning methods applied to clinical, imaging, and omics data to identify clinically meaningful patient subphenotypes, subtypes, and risk strata for conditions including sepsis, COVID-19, depression, Alzheimer's disease, and Parkinson's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Unsupervised machine learning on clinical and omics data to identify disease subtypes and risk strata across patient populations.

subtopics.label: NLP and Informatics for Social Determinants of Health and Mental Health Surveillance
subtopics.description: Research applying natural language processing, machine learning, and social media analysis to identify social determinants of health, mental health conditions, suicidality, and behavioral risk factors from clinical notes, online platforms, and administrative data.
subtopics.display_name: NLP for Social Determinants & Mental Health
subtopics.short_description: Natural language processing and social media analysis to detect social risk factors, mental health conditions, and behavioral signals.

subtopics.label: Telehealth, Patient Portals, and Digital Patient Engagement
subtopics.description: Research evaluating telehealth platforms, patient portals, electronic personal health records, and digital engagement tools for remote care delivery, patient-reported outcomes, informed consent, and health information access, including adoption barriers and COVID-19-driven expansion.
subtopics.short_description: Evaluation of telehealth platforms, patient portals, and digital tools for remote care delivery and patient-reported outcomes.

subtopics.label: Computational Genomics, Multi-Omics Integration, and Bioinformatics Pipelines
subtopics.description: Research developing computational methods and pipelines for analyzing genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic, and multi-omics data including variant calling, RNA-seq analysis, methylation profiling, microbiome analysis, and integrative multi-omics approaches for biomedical discovery.
subtopics.short_description: Pipelines and methods for genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic, and microbiome data analysis supporting biomedical discovery.

subtopics.label: AI Fairness, Bias Mitigation, and Health Equity in Biomedical Informatics
subtopics.description: Research identifying, measuring, and mitigating algorithmic bias and health disparities in AI and machine learning models applied to clinical data, including fairness-aware model development, equity in diagnostic tools, and representation of underserved populations in predictive systems.
subtopics.short_description: Identification and mitigation of algorithmic bias in clinical AI models, with focus on equitable outcomes across patient populations.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genomics, Somatic Evolution, and Structural Variation
subtopics.description: Research applying computational genomics methods to characterize somatic mutations, structural variants, chromosomal instability, DNA methylation drivers, and tumor evolutionary dynamics across cancer types. Includes whole-genome sequencing, copy number analysis, and multi-omics integration for understanding cancer progression.
subtopics.short_description: Computational characterization of somatic mutations, structural variants, and tumor evolutionary dynamics across cancer types.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy, Circulating Tumor DNA, and Cell-Free DNA for Cancer Detection
