subtopics.description: Studies developing and validating liquid biopsy approaches using circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), cell-free DNA (cfDNA), extracellular vesicles, and circulating tumor cells for cancer detection, monitoring, and prognosis. Includes methylome profiling, error-corrected sequencing, and machine learning integration for ultrasensitive cancer surveillance.
subtopics.short_description: Validation of ctDNA, cfDNA, and extracellular vesicle approaches for ultrasensitive cancer detection, monitoring, and prognosis.

subtopics.label: Neuroimaging, Brain Connectivity, and Computational Neuroscience
subtopics.description: Research applying machine learning and deep learning to neuroimaging data (fMRI, structural MRI, PET) to analyze brain connectivity, predict cognitive outcomes, classify neurological and psychiatric disorders, and model brain aging. Includes resting-state functional connectivity, structural connectomes, and neural encoding models.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning applied to fMRI and structural MRI data to model brain connectivity, aging, and neurological disorder classification.

subtopics.label: Computational Pathology and AI-Based Histological Image Analysis
subtopics.description: Studies developing and applying deep learning and machine learning methods to analyze histopathological images including H&E slides, tissue microarrays, and multiplexed imaging for cancer diagnosis, grading, biomarker prediction, and prognosis. Includes tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte scoring, tumor purity estimation, and whole-slide image analysis.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning analysis of whole-slide histopathology images for cancer diagnosis, grading, biomarker prediction, and prognosis.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Informatics, Surveillance, and Predictive Modeling
subtopics.description: Research applying informatics, machine learning, and data science methods to COVID-19 pandemic surveillance, risk prediction, clinical outcome modeling, and public health response. Includes epidemiological modeling, laboratory test-based prediction, contact tracing apps, and AI-driven treatment optimization.
subtopics.short_description: Informatics and machine learning methods for pandemic surveillance, clinical outcome prediction, and public health response.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning for Radiological Imaging, Diagnosis, and Quantification
subtopics.description: Studies applying machine learning and deep learning to radiological modalities including chest X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and PET for disease detection, organ segmentation, quantification, and clinical outcome prediction. Includes radiomic feature extraction, image reconstruction, and automated measurement tools.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning applied to CT, MRI, X-ray, and PET for disease detection, organ segmentation, and radiomic feature extraction.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell and Spatial Omics Computational Methods
subtopics.description: Research developing and applying computational methods for single-cell RNA sequencing, single-cell multi-omics, spatial transcriptomics, and chromatin accessibility profiling. Includes tools for isoform discovery, cell demultiplexing, spatial tissue architecture analysis, and integration of transcriptomic and epigenomic data.
subtopics.short_description: Computational tools for single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and multi-omics integration across tissue architectures.

subtopics.label: Next-Generation Sequencing Technologies, Benchmarking, and Bioinformatics Tools
subtopics.description: Studies benchmarking, developing, and validating next-generation sequencing platforms and bioinformatics pipelines for DNA/RNA analysis, including long-read sequencing, structural variant detection, isoform assembly, and metagenomics. Covers performance assessment, error correction, and novel algorithmic approaches for sequence data processing.
subtopics.short_description: Benchmarking and development of NGS platforms and pipelines for variant detection, isoform assembly, and metagenomics.

subtopics.label: Informatics and Data Methods for Elder Mistreatment Detection and Research
subtopics.description: Research applying informatics, data linkage, and machine learning methods to identify, classify, and study elder mistreatment using administrative data, criminal justice records, Medicare claims, and multidisciplinary team data. Includes development of screening tools, coding methodologies, and healthcare utilization analysis for elder abuse victims.
subtopics.short_description: Data linkage, machine learning, and administrative records analysis to identify and study elder abuse and mistreatment patterns.

subtopics.label: AI and Machine Learning for Ophthalmology and Retinal Disease
subtopics.description: Studies applying deep learning and machine learning to ophthalmic imaging including fundus photography, optical coherence tomography (OCT), and retinal vessel analysis for disease detection, progression prediction, and clinical decision support. Covers age-related macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, and retinal biomarker extraction.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning applied to fundus photography and OCT imaging for retinal disease detection, progression prediction, and biomarker extraction.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence in Reproductive Medicine and Embryo Assessment
subtopics.description: Research applying AI and deep learning to in vitro fertilization (IVF), including embryo ranking, ploidy prediction, ovarian stimulation outcome modeling, and time-lapse imaging analysis. Covers both algorithmic development and clinical validation of AI-assisted embryo selection tools.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning for embryo ranking, ploidy prediction, and ovarian stimulation modeling to support AI-assisted embryo selection.

subtopics.label: AI and Machine Learning for Laryngology, Voice, and Otolaryngology
subtopics.description: Studies applying artificial intelligence and deep learning to laryngoscopic imaging, vocal fold pathology classification, cough sound analysis, and otolaryngology applications. Includes scoping reviews of AI in laryngeal cancer, automated image classification, and AI-assisted clinical tools for head and neck conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning applied to laryngoscopic imaging, vocal fold pathology, and cough analysis for otolaryngology clinical tools.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning for Surgical Outcome Prediction and Perioperative Care
subtopics.description: Research applying machine learning models to predict surgical complications, postoperative outcomes, and perioperative risk using clinical and imaging data. Includes breast reconstruction, bowel obstruction, donor site complications, and AI-assisted procedural guidance.
subtopics.display_name: ML for Surgical Outcomes & Perioperative Risk
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning models predicting surgical complications, postoperative outcomes, and perioperative risk from clinical and imaging data.

subtopics.label: Health Informatics Infrastructure, Data Governance, and Research Operations
subtopics.description: Studies addressing the organizational, technical, and operational aspects of health informatics infrastructure including data science unit establishment, enterprise data warehouses, health information exchange, registry linkage, EHR usability, and research data governance frameworks. Covers real-world evidence generation and coordinated registry networks.
subtopics.short_description: Organizational and technical frameworks for data warehouses, health information exchange, EHR usability, and research data governance.

subtopics.label: PET Scanner Design and Detector Technology
subtopics.description: Research on positron emission tomography hardware innovations including depth-encoding detector modules, prismatoid light-guide arrays (Prism-PET), sparse ring configurations, time-of-flight improvements, and signal processing methods for high-resolution quantitative neuroimaging and oncological imaging.
subtopics.short_description: Hardware advances in PET detector modules, time-of-flight systems, and signal processing for high-resolution neuroimaging and oncology.

subtopics.label: Quantitative Ultrasound Imaging and Tissue Characterization
subtopics.description: Development and validation of quantitative ultrasound (QUS) methods for tissue characterization, including acoustic microscopy, backscatter coefficient analysis, ultrasound localization microscopy, and high-frequency ultrasound for assessing ocular biomechanics, lung disease, lymph node metastasis, and vascular flow.
subtopics.short_description: Acoustic backscatter and localization microscopy methods for characterizing ocular, pulmonary, vascular, and lymphatic tissues.

subtopics.label: Wearable Devices and AI for Health Monitoring
subtopics.description: Research on wearable sensors and artificial intelligence algorithms for continuous monitoring, prediction, and management of health conditions including diabetes, depression, anxiety, sleep disorders, Parkinson's disease, and general physiological parameters in clinical and community settings.
subtopics.short_description: Continuous physiological monitoring using wearable devices and AI algorithms for diabetes, neurological, and mental health conditions.

subtopics.label: Tissue Engineering Scaffolds and Biomaterials
subtopics.description: Engineering of biomaterial scaffolds and constructs for tissue regeneration including 3D-printed bioabsorbable polymers, decellularized xenografts, peptide nanofiber hydrogels, collagen scaffolds, and cartilage engineering for applications in nipple reconstruction, auricular cartilage, wound healing, and organ repair.
subtopics.short_description: Bioabsorbable polymers, hydrogels, and decellularized scaffolds engineered for cartilage, wound, and organ tissue regeneration.

subtopics.label: Breast Implant Design and Reconstructive Biomaterials
subtopics.description: Research on breast implant materials, surface coatings, mesh scaffolds (poly-4-hydroxybutyrate, acellular dermal matrix), and implant stability designs aimed at reducing complications such as capsular contracture, infection, and positional instability in alloplastic breast reconstruction.
subtopics.short_description: Implant surface coatings, mesh scaffolds, and stability designs to reduce capsular contracture and infection in breast reconstruction.

subtopics.label: Nanoparticle-Based Drug Delivery and Therapeutics
subtopics.description: Engineering of nanoparticles, nanofibers, and nanoconjugates for targeted drug delivery in cancer, wound healing, and infectious disease, including ultrasmall silica nanoparticles, peptide nanofiber platforms, alpha-gal nanoparticles, alginate microparticles, and convection-enhanced delivery systems for brain tumors.
subtopics.short_description: Engineered nanoparticles and nanofiber platforms for targeted delivery in cancer, wound healing, and infectious disease.

subtopics.label: Focused Ultrasound and Neuromodulation Devices
subtopics.description: Research on focused ultrasound for blood-brain barrier opening, drug delivery enhancement, and neuromodulation, as well as transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) targeting and deep brain stimulation (DBS) for neurological conditions including Alzheimer's disease, epilepsy, and traumatic brain injury.
subtopics.short_description: Ultrasound-mediated blood-brain barrier opening, drug delivery, and brain stimulation for Alzheimer's, epilepsy, and TBI.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Implantable Electronic Devices and Leadless Pacing
subtopics.description: Development and clinical evaluation of cardiac implantable electronic devices including leadless pacemakers, dual-chamber pacing systems, subcutaneous ICDs, cardiac resynchronization therapy, and left bundle branch area pacing, with focus on device performance, complications, and atrioventricular synchrony.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical evaluation of leadless pacemakers, subcutaneous ICDs, and resynchronization therapy for cardiac rhythm management.

subtopics.label: Robotic and Minimally Invasive Surgical Systems
subtopics.description: Research on robotic surgical platforms and minimally invasive techniques across specialties including cardiac, bariatric, urologic, and general surgery, evaluating operative outcomes, learning curves, cost-effectiveness, and technical innovations in robotic-assisted procedures.
subtopics.short_description: Robotic surgical platforms across cardiac, urologic, and general surgery, with outcomes, learning curves, and cost-effectiveness data.

subtopics.label: Image-Guided and Augmented Reality Navigation in Spine Surgery
subtopics.description: Engineering and clinical evaluation of navigation technologies for spinal surgery including 3D intraoperative navigation, augmented reality overlays, robotic assistance, and image fusion for pedicle screw placement, minimally invasive transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion, and endoscopic spine procedures.
subtopics.short_description: Intraoperative 3D navigation, augmented reality overlays, and robotic assistance for precise spinal implant placement.

subtopics.label: Soft Robotic Catheters and Flexible Electronics for Cardiac Mapping
subtopics.description: Design and validation of catheter-deployable soft robotic devices integrated with flexible and stretchable electronics for high-density cardiac electrophysiology mapping, including conformable sensor arrays for left atrial arrhythmia mapping and ablation guidance.
subtopics.display_name: Soft Robotic Catheters for Cardiac Mapping
subtopics.short_description: Catheter-deployable soft robotic devices with flexible sensor arrays for high-density atrial electrophysiology mapping and ablation.

subtopics.label: 3D Printing for Medical Devices and Surgical Simulation
subtopics.description: Application of 3D printing technology to create low-cost surgical simulators, anatomical training models, patient-specific surgical guides, and functional medical devices including laryngeal models, thyroplasty simulators, laparoscopic cannulas, and coronary artery models for procedural training and planning.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-specific surgical guides, anatomical training models, and low-cost simulators produced via 3D printing technology.

subtopics.label: Advanced MRI Reconstruction and Quantitative Imaging
subtopics.description: Development of computational methods for MRI image reconstruction and quantitative mapping including quantitative susceptibility mapping, fMRI motion correction, deep learning-based reconstruction, and multiecho field inversion techniques for improved neuroimaging and body imaging accuracy.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning and computational methods for quantitative MRI mapping, motion correction, and susceptibility imaging.

subtopics.label: Ocular Biomechanics, Imaging Devices, and Ophthalmic Technology
subtopics.description: Research on biomechanical characterization of ocular tissues in myopia and glaucoma, development of ophthalmic imaging and measurement devices, and analysis of adverse events associated with ophthalmic surgical devices including vitrectomy platforms and intraocular lens fixation systems.
subtopics.short_description: Biomechanical characterization of eye tissues in myopia and glaucoma, plus safety analysis of ophthalmic surgical devices.

subtopics.label: Vascularization Strategies for Tissue Engineering and Organoids
subtopics.description: Engineering approaches to achieve functional vascularization in tissue-engineered constructs and organoids, including adaptable endothelial cell platforms, prevascularized scaffolds, and islet transplantation with engineered vasculature for subcutaneous engraftment and organ-on-chip applications.
subtopics.short_description: Engineered vascular networks in scaffolds, organoids, and islet transplants for functional tissue engraftment.

subtopics.label: Spinal Implants, Fusion Devices, and Disc Degeneration
subtopics.description: Research on spinal implants including cervical cages, interbody fusion devices, disc arthroplasty prostheses, and the biomechanics and pathomechanisms of intervertebral disc degeneration. Covers clinical outcomes, implant materials, and fusion rates.
subtopics.short_description: Cervical cages, interbody fusion devices, and disc arthroplasty prostheses with biomechanical and clinical outcomes data.

subtopics.label: Minimally Invasive and Endoscopic Spine Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on minimally invasive spine surgery techniques including endoscopic approaches, transforaminal discectomy, foraminotomy, and associated complications, training, and intraoperative monitoring methods.
subtopics.short_description: Endoscopic discectomy, foraminotomy, and transforaminal techniques with associated training and complication profiles.

subtopics.label: Telemedicine, Augmented Reality, and Remote Surgical Support
subtopics.description: Studies on augmented reality, smart glasses, and telemedical platforms used to support surgical procedures and clinical training remotely, including applications in low- and middle-income country settings.
subtopics.short_description: Smart glasses and telemedical platforms enabling remote surgical guidance and clinical training in resource-limited settings.

subtopics.label: Orofacial and Respiratory Strength Assessment Devices
subtopics.description: Research on devices and tools for measuring tongue, lip, cheek, and respiratory muscle strength, including validation of low-cost manometers and handheld cough testing instruments for dysphagia and pulmonary assessment.
subtopics.short_description: Validated instruments for measuring tongue, lip, and respiratory muscle strength in dysphagia and pulmonary assessment.

subtopics.label: Seizure Detection Devices and Neurological Monitoring
subtopics.description: Research on commercial and research-grade devices for detecting seizures using acoustic, wearable, or electrophysiological signals, as well as EEG-based monitoring of brain-injured patients.
subtopics.short_description: Wearable and EEG-based devices for seizure detection and continuous neurological monitoring in brain-injured patients.

subtopics.label: Osseointegrated Prostheses for Limb Amputees
subtopics.description: Studies on osseointegrated implant systems for lower limb amputees, covering cost-benefit analyses, infection management, surgical complications, and concurrent soft tissue procedures to optimize outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Implant systems for limb amputees covering surgical outcomes, infection management, and cost-benefit analysis.

subtopics.label: Deep Learning and AI for Medical Image Analysis
subtopics.description: Research applying deep learning and AI methods to medical image segmentation, classification, and multimodal analysis across biomedical imaging modalities including OCT, laryngoscopy, thermography, and vascular imaging.
subtopics.display_name: Deep Learning for Medical Image Analysis
subtopics.short_description: AI-driven segmentation and classification across OCT, laryngoscopy, thermography, and vascular imaging modalities.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Regeneration and Cardiomyocyte Research
subtopics.description: Research on cardiac tissue regeneration strategies, isolation and characterization of cardiomyocytes from human and animal myocardium, and electrophysiological phenotyping of iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes for drug testing.
subtopics.short_description: Tissue regeneration strategies and iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte electrophysiology for cardiac repair and drug testing.

subtopics.label: Assistive Technology and mHealth for Older Adults and Cognitive Impairment
subtopics.description: Studies on the design, usability, and effectiveness of assistive technologies, smartwatches, mHealth apps, and remote sensing systems for older adults with cognitive impairments or dexterity limitations.
subtopics.short_description: Smartwatches, mHealth apps, and remote sensing systems designed for older adults with cognitive or dexterity limitations.

subtopics.label: Point-of-Care Diagnostics and Rapid Testing Systems
subtopics.description: Research on portable, rapid, and low-cost diagnostic platforms for infectious diseases and metabolic conditions, including isothermal nucleic acid testing for COVID-19 and closed-loop insulin delivery systems.
subtopics.short_description: Portable, low-cost platforms for rapid nucleic acid testing and metabolic monitoring in clinical and field settings.

subtopics.label: Surgical Ergonomics, Training, and Simulation
subtopics.description: Research on ergonomic challenges in surgical practice (particularly for female surgeons), operative learning curves, and simulation-based training tools including manikins and virtual reality for procedural skill development.
subtopics.short_description: Ergonomic challenges in surgery, operative learning curves, and VR or manikin-based simulation for skill development.

subtopics.label: Optogenetics for Retinal and Neural Applications
subtopics.description: Research on engineering platforms and cellular mechanisms for optogenetic therapy targeting retinal degenerative diseases and non-neuronal cell habituation, including clinical translation of light-activated interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Light-activated intervention platforms targeting retinal degenerative diseases and non-neuronal cell habituation mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Acoustic and Ultrasound-Based Biomedical Tools
subtopics.description: Research on novel acoustic and ultrasound-based devices for biomedical applications including arteriovenous fistula stenosis detection via blood flow sounds, acousto-hydrodynamic oocyte manipulation, and low-intensity pulsed ultrasound for fracture healing.
subtopics.short_description: Novel acoustic tools for fistula stenosis detection, oocyte manipulation, and low-intensity ultrasound fracture healing.

subtopics.label: Breast Reconstruction Surgical Techniques and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on surgical techniques and outcomes in breast reconstruction including fat grafting, cryoablation for early-stage breast cancer, nerve repair methods, and nipple reconstruction using autologous cartilage scaffolds.
subtopics.short_description: Fat grafting, cryoablation, nerve repair, and autologous cartilage scaffolds for nipple and breast reconstruction.

subtopics.label: Brain Vascular Imaging and Hemodynamics
subtopics.description: Research on imaging and measurement of cerebrovascular hemodynamics including third harmonic generation microscopy for cortical vessel flow, MRI-based oxygen extraction fraction mapping, and cerebral venous perfusion pressure modeling.
subtopics.short_description: MRI and microscopy-based measurement of cerebrovascular flow, oxygen extraction, and venous perfusion pressure.

subtopics.label: MRI Physics, Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping & Advanced MR Methods
subtopics.description: Research on advanced MRI acquisition and reconstruction techniques including quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM), oxygen extraction fraction mapping, diffusion MRI, MR spectroscopy, water/fat separation, and novel pulse sequences for quantitative tissue characterization in brain, body, and vascular applications.
subtopics.short_description: Novel MRI acquisition, reconstruction, and quantitative techniques including QSM, diffusion MRI, and MR spectroscopy for tissue characterization.

subtopics.label: PET Imaging, Nuclear Medicine & Radiopharmaceuticals
subtopics.description: Research on PET scanner technology, radiopharmaceutical development and theranostics, PET/MRI hybrid imaging, radiolabeled tracers for oncology and neurology (including PSMA, DOTATATE, amyloid/tau PET), dosimetry, and pretargeted radioimmunotherapy for cancer treatment.
subtopics.short_description: PET scanner technology, radiopharmaceutical development, theranostics, and radiolabeled tracers for oncology and neurology applications.

subtopics.label: Brain MRI, Neuroimaging Biomarkers & Cerebrovascular Disease
subtopics.description: Research using structural and functional MRI to characterize brain pathology including white matter hyperintensities, cerebral small vessel disease, multiple sclerosis lesion characterization (paramagnetic rim lesions, QSM), glymphatic clearance, brain iron deposition, and neuroimaging biomarkers for neurodegenerative and cerebrovascular conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Structural and functional MRI characterization of white matter disease, cerebral small vessel disease, and neurodegeneration biomarkers.

subtopics.label: Functional MRI, Brain Connectivity & Neuropsychiatric Applications
subtopics.description: Research employing resting-state and task-based fMRI, brain network analysis, and connectome mapping to study psychiatric and neurological conditions including depression, autism, schizophrenia, traumatic brain injury, stroke recovery, and Alzheimer's disease, including methodological advances in fMRI acquisition and denoising.
subtopics.short_description: Resting-state and task-based fMRI and connectome mapping applied to psychiatric and neurological conditions including depression and Alzheimer's disease.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning for Medical Image Analysis
subtopics.description: Research developing and validating AI, machine learning, and deep learning algorithms for medical image classification, segmentation, detection, and report generation across imaging modalities including chest X-ray, pathology, ophthalmology, and multimodal clinical data, with emphasis on model fairness, interpretability, and clinical deployment.
subtopics.display_name: AI & Deep Learning in Medical Imaging
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning algorithms for image classification, segmentation, and report generation across modalities, with focus on fairness and clinical deployment.

subtopics.label: Breast Imaging, Screening & Mammography
subtopics.description: Research on breast cancer screening technologies (mammography, MRI, tomosynthesis, ultrasound), mammographic density as a biomarker, breast cancer risk assessment, screening disparities, cryoablation and interventional breast procedures, and breast imaging workforce and education topics.
subtopics.short_description: Mammography, MRI, and tomosynthesis for breast cancer screening, density biomarkers, risk assessment, and interventional breast procedures.

subtopics.label: Interventional Radiology & Vascular Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on image-guided interventional procedures including catheter-directed therapies for pulmonary embolism, endovascular aortic repair, embolization, ablation, venous interventions, and biliary/hepatic procedures, with emphasis on technique development, outcomes, and patient safety.
subtopics.short_description: Image-guided catheter-directed therapies, endovascular repair, embolization, and ablation with emphasis on outcomes and patient safety.

subtopics.label: CT Imaging: Techniques, Applications & Lung Disease
subtopics.description: Research on CT imaging techniques and clinical applications including lung cancer screening, interstitial lung abnormalities, COVID-19 chest CT findings, CT-based body composition analysis, pulmonary nodule management, and CT-guided procedures, encompassing both diagnostic and interventional CT use.
subtopics.short_description: CT techniques for lung cancer screening, pulmonary nodule management, body composition analysis, and CT-guided interventional procedures.

subtopics.label: Prostate MRI, Genitourinary Imaging & Urologic Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on multiparametric MRI for prostate cancer detection and staging, MRI-guided biopsy techniques, PSMA PET/MRI, focal ablation therapies (cryoablation, irreversible electroporation), and imaging in genitourinary conditions including ADPKD and urologic oncology.
subtopics.short_description: Multiparametric MRI and PSMA PET/MRI for prostate cancer detection, MRI-guided biopsy, and focal ablation therapies in urologic oncology.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Imaging: Echocardiography, CMR & Structural Heart Disease
subtopics.description: Research on cardiac imaging modalities including echocardiography (speckle tracking, 3D echo, TEE), cardiac MRI for myocardial characterization, valvular heart disease assessment, right ventricular function quantification, and imaging guidance for structural heart interventions including TAVR and mitral valve repair.
subtopics.short_description: Echocardiography, cardiac MRI, and valvular disease assessment supporting structural heart interventions including TAVR and mitral valve repair.

subtopics.label: Ophthalmic Imaging: Retinal, Corneal & Ocular Ultrasound
subtopics.description: Research on ophthalmic imaging technologies including optical coherence tomography, ultra-widefield retinal imaging, corneal confocal microscopy as a biomarker for neuropathy and neurodegeneration, quantitative ultrasound for ocular structures, and AI-based analysis of fundus and retinal images for glaucoma and macular degeneration.
subtopics.short_description: OCT, ultra-widefield retinal imaging, corneal confocal microscopy, and AI-based fundus analysis for glaucoma and macular degeneration.

subtopics.label: Neuroimaging in Brain Tumors, Spine & Neurosurgical Planning
subtopics.description: Research on imaging for brain tumors (glioma, meningioma, DIPG), spinal imaging including MRI characterization of disc disease and surgical planning, image-guided neurosurgical interventions, convection-enhanced delivery monitoring, and radiomics for tumor characterization and treatment response assessment.
subtopics.short_description: Imaging for glioma, meningioma, and spinal disease, including radiomics, image-guided neurosurgical planning, and treatment response assessment.

subtopics.label: Radiology Education, Training & Workforce Development
subtopics.description: Research on medical education innovations in radiology including virtual and simulation-based learning, augmented reality for anatomy and procedural training, e-learning platforms, diversity and inclusion initiatives, radiology residency and fellowship curriculum development, and radiologist wellness and workforce issues.
subtopics.short_description: Simulation-based learning, augmented reality training, diversity initiatives, and curriculum development for radiology residency and fellowship programs.

subtopics.label: Neuroimaging in Alzheimer's Disease & Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Research using multimodal neuroimaging (PET amyloid/tau, MRI volumetry, arterial spin labeling, glymphatic mapping) to characterize Alzheimer's disease pathology, track disease progression, identify imaging biomarkers of neurodegeneration, and evaluate brain fluid clearance and blood-brain barrier dysfunction.
subtopics.short_description: Multimodal PET and MRI to characterize Alzheimer's pathology, track neurodegeneration, and evaluate glymphatic and blood-brain barrier function.

subtopics.label: Radiation Therapy Planning, Delivery & Radiobiology
subtopics.description: Research on radiation therapy techniques including stereotactic body radiotherapy, MRI-guided radiotherapy, dosimetry optimization, radiation combined with immunotherapy (CAR T, checkpoint inhibitors), radiobiological effects on tumors, and treatment response assessment using imaging biomarkers in oncology.
subtopics.short_description: Stereotactic and MRI-guided radiotherapy, dosimetry optimization, radiation-immunotherapy combinations, and imaging-based treatment response assessment.

subtopics.label: Clinical Trial Design, Methodology, and Infrastructure
subtopics.description: Research addressing the design, conduct, and methodological foundations of clinical trials including trial registration, recruitment strategies, adaptive designs, registry-based trials, pragmatic trials, and the organizational infrastructure supporting clinical research programs such as CTSA enterprise data warehouses and research computing platforms.
subtopics.short_description: Methodological foundations and organizational infrastructure for designing, registering, and conducting clinical trials.

subtopics.label: Biomarker Development and Liquid Biopsy
subtopics.description: Research focused on the discovery, validation, and clinical application of circulating biomarkers including circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), cell-free DNA methylation, circulating tumor cells, extracellular vesicles, and proteomic/metabolomic signatures for cancer detection, monitoring, and treatment response assessment.
subtopics.short_description: Discovery and clinical validation of circulating tumor DNA, cell-free DNA, and proteomic signatures for cancer detection and monitoring.

subtopics.label: Oncology Clinical Trials and Treatment Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and real-world effectiveness studies evaluating systemic therapies, immunotherapies, targeted agents, and combination regimens across solid tumors and hematologic malignancies, including phase I-III trials reporting efficacy, safety, and patient-reported outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Phase I–III trials and real-world studies evaluating systemic therapies, immunotherapies, and targeted agents across malignancies.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning and EHR-Based Clinical Prediction
subtopics.description: Studies applying machine learning, deep learning, and artificial intelligence to electronic health record data for clinical prediction, patient subphenotyping, risk stratification, and decision support across diverse disease areas including cancer, cardiovascular disease, sepsis, and psychiatric conditions.
subtopics.short_description: AI and machine learning applied to electronic health records for clinical risk stratification, subphenotyping, and decision support.

subtopics.label: Advanced Imaging Biomarkers and Quantitative Imaging
subtopics.description: Development and validation of quantitative imaging methods including MRI-based techniques (quantitative susceptibility mapping, perfusion imaging, diffusion imaging, functional connectivity), PET imaging, and computational image analysis as biomarkers for neurological, cardiovascular, and oncologic diseases.
subtopics.short_description: Validation of MRI, PET, and computational imaging methods as biomarkers for neurological, cardiovascular, and oncologic diseases.

subtopics.label: Patient-Reported Outcomes and Quality of Life Research
subtopics.description: Research developing, validating, and applying patient-reported outcome measures (PROs), health-related quality of life instruments, and symptom monitoring tools in clinical trials and real-world settings across oncology, chronic disease, and psychiatric conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Development and application of PRO measures and symptom monitoring tools in clinical trials and real-world care settings.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Therapeutics, Vaccines, and Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Translational and clinical research on SARS-CoV-2 including vaccine effectiveness studies, therapeutic interventions, antibody responses, epidemiological modeling, long COVID characterization, and clinical outcomes across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and translational research on SARS-CoV-2 vaccines, therapeutics, long COVID, and population-level outcomes.

subtopics.label: Gene Therapy and AAV Vector Development
subtopics.description: Preclinical and clinical research on adeno-associated virus (AAV) and other gene therapy vectors, including vector engineering, biodistribution, safety evaluation, and therapeutic applications for neurological, ocular, cardiovascular, and metabolic diseases.
subtopics.short_description: Engineering and clinical translation of AAV and gene therapy vectors for neurological, ocular, and metabolic diseases.

subtopics.label: Precision Oncology and Tumor Genomics
subtopics.description: Research integrating genomic, transcriptomic, and molecular profiling of tumors to identify actionable alterations, predict treatment response, characterize resistance mechanisms, and guide precision oncology approaches in solid tumors and hematologic malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Genomic and molecular tumor profiling to identify actionable alterations, predict treatment response, and characterize resistance.

subtopics.label: Neurology, Stroke, and Traumatic Brain Injury Translational Research
subtopics.description: Translational and clinical research on stroke, traumatic brain injury, and neurological disorders including biomarker discovery, neuroimaging outcomes, rehabilitation interventions, neuroprotective strategies, and clinical trial design for neurological conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Biomarker discovery, neuroimaging outcomes, and neuroprotective strategies for stroke, TBI, and neurological disorders.

subtopics.label: HIV, Infectious Disease, and Vaccine Translational Research
subtopics.description: Translational research on HIV pathogenesis, treatment, reservoir characterization, broadly neutralizing antibodies, and vaccine development, as well as clinical studies of other infectious diseases including CMV, tuberculosis, and emerging pathogens.
subtopics.short_description: HIV pathogenesis, reservoir characterization, broadly neutralizing antibodies, and vaccine development for infectious diseases.

subtopics.label: Wearable Devices, Digital Health, and mHealth Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on wearable sensors, mobile health applications, digital biomarkers, and technology-based interventions for monitoring, predicting, and managing chronic conditions including diabetes, cardiovascular disease, mental health disorders, and neurological conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Wearable sensors and mobile health applications for monitoring and managing chronic, cardiovascular, and neurological conditions.

subtopics.label: Transplantation, Allograft Monitoring, and Biomarker Validation
subtopics.description: Translational research on solid organ transplantation including noninvasive biomarker development for rejection monitoring, urinary cell transcriptomics, donor-derived cell-free DNA, microbiome effects on transplant outcomes, and clinical management of transplant recipients.
subtopics.short_description: Noninvasive biomarker development for rejection surveillance and clinical management of solid organ transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: Translational Research Workforce Development and CTSA Programs
subtopics.description: Research addressing the organizational, workforce, and programmatic aspects of translational science including physician-scientist training, NIH K-award programs, research capacity building in underserved settings, clinical trial policy, and CTSA hub infrastructure for supporting bench-to-bedside research.
subtopics.short_description: Physician-scientist training, NIH K-award programs, and CTSA hub infrastructure supporting bench-to-bedside research capacity.

subtopics.label: Alzheimer's Disease and Neurodegeneration Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Translational research on Alzheimer's disease and related neurodegenerative conditions focusing on amyloid and tau biomarkers, neuroimaging measures, fluid biomarkers, glymphatic function, and early detection strategies linking molecular pathology to clinical outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Amyloid, tau, and neuroimaging biomarkers linking molecular pathology to clinical outcomes in Alzheimer's and related dementias.

subtopics.label: Cost-Effectiveness Analysis of Medical Interventions
subtopics.description: Research applying formal cost-effectiveness and cost-benefit frameworks to evaluate medical treatments, diagnostics, and interventions, including ICER calculations, microsimulation models, and return-on-investment analyses across diverse clinical areas.
subtopics.short_description: Formal cost-effectiveness and cost-benefit frameworks applied to treatments, diagnostics, and interventions across clinical areas.

subtopics.label: Pharmaceutical Pricing, Biosimilars, and Drug Coverage Policy
subtopics.description: Research examining drug pricing dynamics, biosimilar market entry and uptake, formulary restrictions, Medicare Part B and D coverage policies, and the role of intermediaries such as pharmacy benefit managers and group purchasing organizations in shaping pharmaceutical spending.
subtopics.short_description: Pharmaceutical pricing dynamics, biosimilar market entry, formulary restrictions, and the role of PBMs in shaping drug spending.

subtopics.label: Economic Dimensions of Opioid Use Disorder and Overdose
subtopics.description: Research quantifying the economic burden of opioid use disorder and overdose deaths, evaluating cost-effectiveness of medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD), analyzing payment and coverage policies for OUD treatment, and assessing the economic impact of opioid prescribing regulations.
subtopics.short_description: Economic burden of opioid use disorder, cost-effectiveness of MOUD, and financial impact of opioid prescribing regulations.

subtopics.label: Private Equity, Market Consolidation, and Healthcare Prices
subtopics.description: Research investigating the effects of private equity acquisitions, physician management companies, and corporate consolidation on healthcare prices, utilization, quality, and spending across sectors including nursing homes, hospice, ophthalmology, dermatology, and anesthesia.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of private equity acquisitions and corporate consolidation on healthcare prices, utilization, and quality across sectors.

subtopics.label: Value-Based Payment Programs and Physician Incentive Systems
subtopics.description: Research evaluating Medicare value-based payment programs including the Merit-Based Incentive Payment System (MIPS), Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs), the Medicare Shared Savings Program, and alternative payment models, focusing on performance measurement, financial incentives, and care quality outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Medicare value-based programs including MIPS, ACOs, and the Shared Savings Program, focusing on incentives and care quality.

subtopics.label: Medicaid Expansion, Insurance Coverage, and Access to Care
subtopics.description: Research examining the effects of Medicaid expansion under the Affordable Care Act on insurance coverage, access to care, treatment utilization, and health outcomes across populations including cancer patients, liver disease, foster youth, and low-income adults.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of ACA Medicaid expansion on insurance coverage, care access, treatment utilization, and health outcomes.

subtopics.label: Healthcare Spending, Utilization, and Waste Reduction
subtopics.description: Research analyzing patterns of healthcare spending and utilization including potentially preventable spending, geographic variation in Medicare costs, high-cost patient populations, low-value services, and interventions to reduce unnecessary healthcare resource use.
subtopics.short_description: Patterns of healthcare spending, geographic variation in costs, low-value services, and interventions to reduce unnecessary resource use.

subtopics.label: Telehealth Expansion, Utilization, and Economic Impact
subtopics.description: Research evaluating the adoption, utilization patterns, cost implications, and quality outcomes of telehealth and telemedicine services, including policy changes during and after COVID-19, variation by provider and patient characteristics, and impacts on downstream care use.
subtopics.short_description: Adoption, cost implications, and quality outcomes of telehealth services, including policy changes following COVID-19.

subtopics.label: Nursing Home and Long-Term Care Economics and Quality
subtopics.description: Research examining financial structures, ownership models, staffing levels, and quality outcomes in nursing homes and long-term care settings, including the roles of private equity, real estate investment trusts, and skilled nursing facility payment policies.
subtopics.short_description: Financial structures, ownership models, staffing, and quality outcomes in nursing homes and long-term care settings.

subtopics.label: Economic Burden of Disease and Mortality
subtopics.description: Research quantifying the societal and economic costs of specific diseases, conditions, and mortality events including opioid overdose, maternal mortality, COVID-19 deaths, infectious diseases, and chronic conditions, using human capital and productivity loss frameworks.
subtopics.short_description: Societal and economic costs of diseases, chronic conditions, and mortality using human capital and productivity loss frameworks.

subtopics.label: Surgical Procedure Costs, Reimbursement, and Value
subtopics.description: Research analyzing the costs, reimbursement trends, and value of surgical and procedural interventions using time-driven activity-based costing, claims data, and cost-minimization approaches across specialties including urology, orthopedics, cardiac surgery, and general surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Costs, reimbursement trends, and value of surgical interventions across specialties using activity-based costing and claims data.

subtopics.label: Hepatitis C, HIV, and Infectious Disease Treatment Economics
subtopics.description: Research evaluating the cost-effectiveness, financing, and policy barriers to treatment for hepatitis C virus, HIV, and other infectious diseases, including Medicaid coverage restrictions, rapid treatment initiation programs, and economic modeling of elimination strategies.
subtopics.display_name: Hepatitis C, HIV & Infectious Disease Economics
subtopics.short_description: Cost-effectiveness, financing, and policy barriers to treatment for hepatitis C, HIV, and other infectious diseases.

subtopics.label: Racial, Ethnic, and Socioeconomic Disparities in Healthcare Access and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research documenting and analyzing disparities in healthcare access, treatment utilization, and outcomes by race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status, including the role of insurance type, neighborhood conditions, and social determinants of health in driving inequitable care.
subtopics.short_description: Disparities in healthcare access, treatment utilization, and outcomes driven by race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status.

subtopics.label: Payment Model Innovation and Healthcare Financing Reform
subtopics.description: Research examining novel payment and financing models for healthcare delivery including bundled payments, capitation, surprise billing legislation, coordinated specialty care financing, and the economic implications of payment reform for providers and patients.
subtopics.short_description: Novel payment models including bundled payments, capitation, and surprise billing legislation and their implications for providers and patients.

subtopics.label: Epidemiological and Economic Modeling of Disease Burden and Interventions
subtopics.description: Research using mathematical and simulation modeling to project disease burden, evaluate the population-level impact of public health interventions, and estimate the economic value of vaccination, screening, and prevention programs for infectious and chronic diseases.
subtopics.short_description: Mathematical and simulation models projecting disease burden and estimating the economic value of vaccination, screening, and prevention.

subtopics.label: Mental Health and Addiction Integration into General Healthcare
subtopics.description: Research on integrating behavioral health, mental health, and addiction treatment into general medical care settings, including policy levers, care models, and outcomes for patients with serious mental illness or co-occurring disorders.
subtopics.short_description: Integration of mental health and addiction treatment into general medical care, including policy levers and outcomes for complex patients.

subtopics.label: Cannabis Legalization Policy and Health Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining the effects of medical and recreational cannabis legalization on opioid use, chronic pain treatment, illegal drug markets, and patterns of cannabis consumption.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of medical and recreational cannabis legalization on opioid use, chronic pain treatment, and drug market patterns.

subtopics.label: Healthcare Workforce Burnout, Turnover, and Training
subtopics.description: Research on physician and healthcare worker turnover, burnout, financial stresses in training, and workforce retention challenges including home health aides and direct care workers.
subtopics.short_description: Physician and healthcare worker turnover, burnout, financial stresses in training, and workforce retention challenges.

subtopics.label: Elder Abuse, Mistreatment, and Financial Exploitation
subtopics.description: Studies on the identification, coding, prevention, and economic dimensions of elder abuse, mistreatment, and financial exploitation among older adults.
subtopics.short_description: Identification, prevention, and economic dimensions of elder abuse, mistreatment, and financial exploitation among older adults.

subtopics.label: Cardiogenic Shock Management, Mechanical Circulatory Support, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on utilization of mechanical circulatory support devices, hospital transfer patterns, advanced therapy centers, and outcomes in patients with cardiogenic shock and acute myocardial infarction.
subtopics.short_description: Utilization of mechanical circulatory support devices, hospital transfer patterns, and outcomes in cardiogenic shock patients.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Impact on Health Systems, Workforce, and Vulnerable Populations
subtopics.description: Studies examining the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on healthcare delivery, ICU capacity, health disparities, child mental health, social safety net policies, and vulnerable populations including home care workers and refugees.
subtopics.display_name: COVID-19 Impact on Health Systems & Populations
subtopics.short_description: Effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on healthcare delivery, workforce capacity, health disparities, and vulnerable populations.

subtopics.label: Global Health Systems, Surgical Capacity, and Access in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research on healthcare capacity, surgical access, cost-effectiveness of interventions, and health system barriers in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa.
subtopics.display_name: Global Health Systems in Low-Income Countries
subtopics.short_description: Healthcare capacity, surgical access, and cost-effectiveness of interventions in low- and middle-income countries.

subtopics.label: Opioid Prescribing Regulation and Policy Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies on the effects of regulatory and institutional policies—including drug rescheduling, marketing restrictions, and emergency department MOUD initiation—on opioid prescribing patterns and treatment access.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of regulatory policies, drug rescheduling, and marketing restrictions on opioid prescribing patterns and treatment access.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Reconstruction Access, Disparities, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on patterns, disparities, and outcomes in postmastectomy breast reconstruction, including the influence of race, surgeon gender, legislation, and institutional factors.
subtopics.short_description: Patterns, disparities, and outcomes in postmastectomy breast reconstruction by race, surgeon characteristics, and institutional factors.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular Testing, Procedure Value, and Appropriateness
subtopics.description: Studies examining the appropriateness, value, and disparities in cardiovascular diagnostic testing and procedures, including high- versus low-value testing by insurance type and executive screening programs.
subtopics.short_description: Appropriateness and value of cardiovascular diagnostic testing and procedures, including disparities by insurance type.

subtopics.label: Hospice, Palliative Care, and End-of-Life Healthcare Utilization
subtopics.description: Research on healthcare utilization, mortality, and cost considerations for patients receiving hospice or palliative care, including those with dementia and heart failure at end of life.
subtopics.short_description: Healthcare utilization, mortality, and cost considerations for patients receiving hospice or palliative care at end of life.

subtopics.label: Geographic, Racial, and Socioeconomic Disparities in Healthcare Access and Utilization
subtopics.description: Studies documenting disparities in access to care, screening, and treatment by race, ethnicity, geography, and socioeconomic status across a range of conditions including cancer, cardiovascular disease, and chronic illness.
subtopics.display_name: Geographic & Racial Disparities in Care Access
subtopics.short_description: Disparities in access to screening and treatment by race, geography, and socioeconomic status across cancer, cardiovascular, and chronic conditions.

subtopics.label: Neonatal, Pediatric Care Policy, and Child Health Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on policies and clinical practices affecting neonatal and pediatric health outcomes, including prenatal substance use policies, neonatal ICU resource use, pediatric tracheostomy timing, and child mental health.
subtopics.short_description: Policies and clinical practices affecting neonatal and pediatric health outcomes, including prenatal substance use and child mental health.

subtopics.label: Health Information Technology, Billing Automation, and Data Systems
subtopics.description: Studies on the use of electronic medical records, health information exchange, natural language processing, and data systems to improve clinical documentation, billing, and care quality.
subtopics.display_name: Health IT, Billing Automation & Data Systems
subtopics.short_description: Electronic health records, natural language processing, and data systems applied to clinical documentation, billing, and care quality.

subtopics.label: Comorbidity, Chronic Disease Burden, and Healthcare Resource Utilization
subtopics.description: Research examining how comorbidities and multimorbidity—including COPD, diabetes, sickle cell disease, and mental illness—drive healthcare utilization, hospitalizations, and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: How multimorbidity including COPD, diabetes, and mental illness drives healthcare utilization, hospitalizations, and patient outcomes.

subtopics.label: Telehealth Clinical Service Delivery and Patient Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining the implementation, utilization, and clinical outcomes of telehealth and telemedicine services across medical specialties, including emergency medicine, primary care, surgery, and specialty care. Covers patient satisfaction, safety, care quality, and comparisons between virtual and in-person visits.
subtopics.short_description: Implementation, utilization, and patient outcomes of telehealth services across medical specialties, comparing virtual and in-person care.

subtopics.label: Telehealth Expansion and Innovation During COVID-19
subtopics.description: Studies documenting the rapid scale-up of telehealth platforms, virtual care models, and remote consultation services in response to the COVID-19 pandemic, including implementation challenges, workflow adaptations, and lessons learned across healthcare settings.
subtopics.short_description: Rapid expansion of virtual care platforms and remote consultation services during the COVID-19 pandemic, including workflow adaptations and lessons learned.

subtopics.label: Telehealth Access, Equity, and Disparities
subtopics.description: Research investigating disparities in telehealth access and utilization across demographic, socioeconomic, and geographic groups, including barriers to video visits, digital divide issues, and interventions to promote equitable virtual care delivery.
subtopics.short_description: Disparities in telehealth access across demographic, socioeconomic, and geographic groups, and interventions to promote equitable virtual care.

subtopics.label: Mobile Health Applications and Digital Therapeutic Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on smartphone and tablet-based applications designed to deliver therapeutic interventions, symptom monitoring, self-management support, and behavioral health programs, including feasibility, acceptability, and efficacy studies across diverse patient populations.
subtopics.short_description: Smartphone-based applications delivering therapeutic interventions, symptom monitoring, and self-management support across diverse patient populations.

subtopics.label: Wearable Devices and Remote Patient Monitoring
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating wearable sensors, implantable devices, and remote monitoring technologies for continuous physiological data collection, disease management, and clinical decision support, including cardiac implantable electronic devices, glucose monitors, and activity trackers.
subtopics.short_description: Wearable sensors and remote monitoring technologies for continuous physiological data collection, disease management, and clinical decision support.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Clinical Care
subtopics.description: Research applying AI, machine learning, deep learning, and large language models to clinical diagnosis, disease prediction, treatment decision support, and patient management, including chatbots, natural language processing, and multimodal AI systems in healthcare.
subtopics.display_name: AI & Machine Learning in Clinical Care
subtopics.short_description: AI, machine learning, and large language models applied to clinical diagnosis, disease prediction, and treatment decision support in healthcare.

subtopics.label: Chatbots and Conversational Agents for Mental Health and Patient Engagement
subtopics.description: Research on AI-powered chatbots and conversational agents designed to support mental health screening, patient education, and engagement, including scoping reviews of chatbot features, technical evaluation metrics, and patient perceptions of chatbot-delivered care.
subtopics.short_description: AI-powered conversational agents supporting mental health screening, patient education, and engagement in digital care settings.

subtopics.label: Virtual Reality, Augmented Reality, and Simulation in Healthcare
subtopics.description: Studies examining the use of virtual reality, augmented reality, and simulation technologies for clinical training, procedural education, pain management, and therapeutic interventions, including VR-based exposure therapy, procedural skill training, and patient-facing VR applications.
subtopics.short_description: Virtual and augmented reality technologies for clinical training, pain management, procedural education, and therapeutic interventions.

subtopics.label: Virtual Medical Education and Telemedicine Training
subtopics.description: Research on virtual and remote educational platforms for medical students, residents, and healthcare professionals, including online curricula, virtual clinical experiences, telemedicine skills training, and simulation-based learning during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.
subtopics.short_description: Online curricula, virtual clinical experiences, and telemedicine skills training for medical students, residents, and healthcare professionals.

subtopics.label: Digital Cognitive Training and Technology Use in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on computerized cognitive training programs, technology-based functional skills interventions, and digital tools designed to support cognitive health and everyday functioning in older adults, including studies on adherence, efficacy, and predictors of training outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: Digital Cognitive Training for Older Adults
subtopics.short_description: Computerized cognitive training programs and digital tools supporting cognitive health and everyday functioning in older adult populations.

subtopics.label: Technology Adoption, Digital Literacy, and Aging in Place
subtopics.description: Studies examining factors influencing older adults' adoption of digital technologies, mobile devices, and wearables for health management and aging in place, including digital literacy assessment, barriers to adoption, and interventions to reduce the age-related digital divide.
subtopics.short_description: Factors influencing older adults' adoption of digital health technologies, digital literacy barriers, and interventions to reduce the age-related digital divide.

subtopics.label: Patient Portals, Electronic Health Records, and Digital Patient Engagement
subtopics.description: Research on electronic personal health records, patient portal adoption and use, secure messaging, and digital tools for patient-provider communication, including studies on portal access for caregivers, adolescents, and oncology patients.
subtopics.short_description: Electronic health records, patient portal adoption, secure messaging, and digital tools for patient-provider communication across clinical settings.

subtopics.label: Remote and Digital Interventions for Chronic Disease and Weight Management
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating remotely delivered or digitally supported programs for chronic disease management including weight loss, diabetes, heart failure, and cancer survivorship, examining clinical outcomes, feasibility, and comparative effectiveness versus in-person care.
subtopics.short_description: Remotely delivered programs for chronic disease management including weight loss, diabetes, heart failure, and cancer survivorship.

subtopics.label: Telehealth and Digital Interventions for Behavioral and Mental Health
subtopics.description: Research on telepsychiatry, telemental health platforms, and digital interventions for mental health conditions including depression, anxiety, PTSD, and substance use disorders, covering clinical outcomes, implementation, and policy dimensions of virtual behavioral health care.
subtopics.short_description: Telepsychiatry and digital interventions for depression, anxiety, PTSD, and substance use disorders, covering outcomes, implementation, and policy.

subtopics.label: Social Media, Online Communities, and Digital Health Information
subtopics.description: Studies analyzing health-related content on social media platforms, online patient communities, and digital health information sources, including machine learning analysis of user-generated content, misinformation, and the role of online communities in patient support and education.
subtopics.short_description: Health-related content on social media platforms and online communities, including misinformation analysis and patient support in digital spaces.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Telehealth and Virtual Care for Children
subtopics.description: Research on telemedicine and virtual care delivery specifically for pediatric populations, including neuropsychology, urgent care, autism social skills programs, and assessment tools for pediatric residents.
subtopics.short_description: Telemedicine and virtual care delivery for pediatric populations, including urgent care, autism programs, and neuropsychology assessment.

subtopics.label: Digital Tools for Genetic Cancer Risk Assessment and Cascade Testing
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating web-based, digital, and technology-assisted tools for collecting cancer family history, assessing hereditary cancer risk, and facilitating cascade genetic testing among at-risk individuals.
subtopics.short_description: Web-based and digital tools for collecting cancer family history, assessing hereditary cancer risk, and facilitating cascade genetic testing.

subtopics.label: Telehealth and Digital Health Technologies in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research on the application of telemedicine, smartphones, and smart glasses to support surgical procedures, emergency transport, and healthcare delivery in low- and middle-income country settings.
subtopics.short_description: Telemedicine and smartphone-based technologies supporting surgical care, emergency transport, and healthcare delivery in resource-limited settings.

subtopics.label: Video-Based Patient Education and Procedural Instruction
subtopics.description: Studies examining the use of educational videos and multimedia instructions to improve patient comprehension, procedural preparation, and health knowledge across clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Educational videos and multimedia instructions improving patient comprehension, procedural preparation, and health knowledge across clinical settings.

subtopics.label: Acoustic and Biosignal-Based Digital Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research on using audio recordings, cough sounds, and other biosignals for automated detection and screening of clinical conditions such as seizures and respiratory diseases.
subtopics.short_description: Audio recordings, cough sounds, and biosignals used for automated screening and detection of seizures, respiratory diseases, and other conditions.

subtopics.label: Digital and Technology-Enabled Harm Reduction and Substance Use Services
subtopics.description: Studies on the use of digital tools, telehealth, online surveys, and technology-assisted strategies to support harm reduction, syringe service programs, and addiction treatment, including pandemic-era adaptations.
subtopics.short_description: Digital tools and telehealth strategies supporting harm reduction, syringe service programs, and addiction treatment, including pandemic-era adaptations.

subtopics.label: Digital and Technology-Supported Elder Abuse Detection and Intervention
subtopics.description: Research on screening tools, protective interventions, and service delivery adaptations for identifying and responding to elder abuse and neglect, including PTSD treatment outcomes in survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Screening tools and service delivery adaptations for identifying and responding to elder abuse, neglect, and trauma in older adult populations.

subtopics.label: Clinical Informatics, E-Consults, and Hospital Digital Operations
subtopics.description: Studies on the use of clinical informatics systems, automatic e-consults, smartphone alerts, and digital workflows to improve hospital operations, clinical decision-making, and patient safety.
subtopics.short_description: Informatics systems, e-consults, smartphone alerts, and digital workflows improving hospital operations, clinical decisions, and patient safety.

subtopics.label: Digital and Operational Health System Responses to COVID-19
subtopics.description: Research on hospital preparedness, resource reallocation, clinical protocols, and informatics-driven adaptations implemented by health systems during the COVID-19 pandemic.
subtopics.display_name: Health System Digital Response to COVID-19
subtopics.short_description: Hospital preparedness, resource reallocation, clinical protocols, and informatics-driven adaptations implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic.

subtopics.label: Mobile Health and Digital Interventions for Vulnerable and Underserved Populations
subtopics.description: Studies on mobile health surveys, apps, and digital tools targeting underserved or vulnerable groups including dialysis patients, transgender individuals, HIV-positive populations, and urban psychiatric patients.
subtopics.short_description: Mobile health apps and digital tools targeting vulnerable groups including dialysis patients, transgender individuals, and urban psychiatric patients.

subtopics.label: Digital and Virtual Interventions for College Student Mental Health
subtopics.description: Research on digital, virtual, and technology-mediated approaches to addressing mental health needs of college and university students, including COVID-19 impacts and culturally tailored virtual partnerships.
subtopics.display_name: Digital Mental Health for College Students
subtopics.short_description: Technology-mediated approaches addressing mental health needs of college students, including COVID-19 impacts and culturally tailored virtual programs.

subtopics.label: Telemedicine in Surgical and Specialty Clinical Practice
subtopics.description: Studies on the implementation and principles of telemedicine in surgical specialties including plastic surgery, telepathology for oncology, and direct-to-consumer telemedicine kiosks.
subtopics.short_description: Implementation of telemedicine in surgical practice including plastic surgery, telepathology for oncology, and direct-to-consumer telemedicine kiosks.

subtopics.label: Digital and Technology-Based Support for Caregivers and Home-Based Care
subtopics.description: Research on technology-assisted interventions supporting informal caregivers, home health aides, and hospice care delivery, including mobile apps, training protocols, and tele-paramedicine for home-based patient management.
subtopics.display_name: Digital Support for Caregivers & Home Care
subtopics.short_description: Technology-assisted interventions supporting informal caregivers, home health aides, and hospice care delivery through mobile apps and tele-paramedicine.

subtopics.label: Passive Sensing, LLMs, and Wearables for Mental Health and Well-Being Monitoring
subtopics.description: Studies using passive sensing technologies, large language models, and wearable devices to monitor mental health, detect depression and anxiety, and deliver personalized well-being recommendations.
subtopics.display_name: Passive Sensing & Wearables for Mental Health
subtopics.short_description: Passive sensing technologies, wearables, and large language models monitoring mental health, detecting depression, and delivering well-being recommendations.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell RNA-Seq Methods, Tools, and Computational Frameworks
subtopics.description: Development and benchmarking of computational methods, statistical models, and experimental protocols for single-cell RNA sequencing, including differential expression analysis, demultiplexing, clustering, and data integration across cell types and conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Computational methods, statistical models, and experimental protocols for single-cell RNA sequencing, clustering, and data integration.

subtopics.label: Spatial Transcriptomics and Multiplexed Tissue Imaging
subtopics.description: Methods and applications of spatially resolved transcriptomics, multiplexed immunofluorescence, CODEX, and mass spectrometry imaging to map tissue architecture, cell-type distributions, and microenvironmental interactions at single-cell or near-single-cell resolution.
subtopics.short_description: Spatially resolved transcriptomics and multiplexed imaging to map tissue architecture and cell-type distributions at single-cell resolution.

subtopics.label: Long-Read Sequencing and Single-Cell Isoform Resolution
subtopics.description: Application of long-read sequencing technologies (PacBio, Oxford Nanopore) and single-cell long-read methods to resolve full-length RNA isoforms, alternative splicing, and polyadenylation patterns across cell types, tissues, and disease states.
subtopics.short_description: Long-read single-cell methods resolving full-length RNA isoforms, alternative splicing, and polyadenylation patterns across cell types and disease states.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Multi-Omics: Epigenome, Chromatin Accessibility, and Transcriptome Integration
subtopics.description: Joint profiling of chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, DNA methylation, and transcriptome in single cells to characterize epigenetic regulation of cell identity, differentiation, and disease-associated cell states.
subtopics.short_description: Joint profiling of chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, and transcriptome to characterize epigenetic regulation of cell identity and disease states.

subtopics.label: Tumor Microenvironment and Immune Cell Heterogeneity in Cancer
subtopics.description: Single-cell and spatial characterization of immune cell composition, tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte states, and stromal interactions within the tumor microenvironment across cancer types, linking cellular heterogeneity to clinical outcomes and immunotherapy response.
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell and spatial characterization of immune composition, tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte states, and stromal interactions across cancer types.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Transcriptomics of Brain Cell Types and Neurological Disease
subtopics.description: Single-cell and single-nucleus transcriptomic and epigenomic profiling of neurons, glia, and microglia to characterize cell-type-specific gene expression, splicing, and disease-associated states in neurodegeneration, psychiatric disorders, and brain injury.
subtopics.display_name: Brain Cell Types & Neurological Disease States
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell and single-nucleus profiling of neurons, glia, and microglia in neurodegeneration, psychiatric disorders, and brain injury.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Analysis of Hematopoiesis, Clonal Evolution, and Blood Disorders
subtopics.description: Single-cell genomic and transcriptomic approaches to characterize hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell differentiation, clonal hematopoiesis, somatic mutations, and lineage dynamics in normal hematopoiesis and hematologic malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell genomics of hematopoietic stem cell differentiation, clonal hematopoiesis, and lineage dynamics in normal and malignant blood.

subtopics.label: Organoids, Stem Cell Differentiation, and Cell Fate Specification
subtopics.description: Use of organoids, pluripotent stem cell-derived models, and single-cell profiling to study cell fate decisions, lineage specification, and tissue development, including applications to disease modeling in cardiac, pancreatic, neural, and other organ systems.
subtopics.short_description: Organoid and pluripotent stem cell models with single-cell profiling to study cell fate decisions and tissue development across organ systems.

subtopics.label: Lineage Tracing, Cell Plasticity, and Tumor Evolution
subtopics.description: Single-cell approaches to track clonal lineages, measure phenotypic plasticity, and reconstruct evolutionary trajectories in cancer and normal tissue, using barcoding, mitochondrial DNA mutations, and computational methods to infer cell state transitions.
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell barcoding and computational methods to track clonal lineages, phenotypic plasticity, and evolutionary trajectories in cancer and normal tissue.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Characterization of Airway and Lung Epithelial Biology
subtopics.description: Single-cell transcriptomic and spatial profiling of airway and lung epithelial cell types to characterize cell-type-specific gene expression, disease-associated dysregulation, and responses to infection or injury in conditions such as COPD, IPF, and COVID-19.
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell transcriptomic and spatial profiling of lung epithelial cell types in COPD, IPF, COVID-19, and other respiratory conditions.

subtopics.label: Multi-Omics Profiling of Spaceflight-Associated Physiological Changes
subtopics.description: Comprehensive single-cell, transcriptomic, proteomic, and epigenomic profiling of astronaut biospecimens to characterize molecular and cellular responses to spaceflight, including immune dysregulation, hematopoietic changes, and tissue-specific adaptations.
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell and multi-omic profiling of astronaut biospecimens to characterize molecular responses to spaceflight, including immune and hematopoietic changes.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Atlas of Pancreatic Islets and Diabetes Pathophysiology
subtopics.description: Single-cell transcriptomic and multi-omic profiling of pancreatic islet cell types, including beta cell heterogeneity and dysfunction, to elucidate mechanisms of type 1 and type 2 diabetes and identify therapeutic targets.
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell and multi-omic profiling of pancreatic islet cell types and beta cell dysfunction to elucidate mechanisms of type 1 and type 2 diabetes.

subtopics.label: Proteomic Profiling and Cell Surface Characterization
subtopics.description: Mass spectrometry-based and proximity proteomics approaches to characterize cell-type-specific protein expression, surface proteomes, extracellular vesicles, and protein-protein interactions in cancer, disease, and normal tissue contexts.
subtopics.short_description: Mass spectrometry and proximity proteomics approaches to characterize cell-type-specific protein expression, surface proteomes, and extracellular vesicles.

subtopics.label: Innate Lymphoid Cells and Gut Immune Homeostasis
subtopics.description: Single-cell and functional characterization of innate lymphoid cell (ILC) subsets, their transcriptional regulation, and their roles in intestinal immune homeostasis, tolerance, and inflammatory responses.
subtopics.display_name: Innate Lymphoid Cells & Gut Immune Homeostasis
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell and functional characterization of ILC subsets and their roles in intestinal immune homeostasis, tolerance, and inflammatory responses.

subtopics.label: Endothelial Cell Heterogeneity and Vascular Biology
subtopics.description: Single-cell transcriptomic and functional characterization of endothelial cell subtypes, their specification during organogenesis and regeneration, and their roles in angiogenesis, tissue homeostasis, and disease contexts including cancer and organ development.
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell transcriptomic profiling of endothelial subtypes and their roles in angiogenesis, organogenesis, and disease including cancer.

subtopics.label: B Cell Lymphoma Genomics, Epigenetics, and Transformation
subtopics.description: Research into the genetic and epigenetic mechanisms driving B cell lymphoma development, including cohesin complex dosage, chromatin regulators (CREBBP, KMT2D, EZH2), and oncogenic mutations (BTG1, TBL1XR1) that promote malignant transformation and immune evasion.
subtopics.short_description: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms driving B cell lymphoma development, including chromatin regulators and oncogenic mutations promoting malignant transformation.

subtopics.label: Cell Cycle Regulation and Differentiation Commitment
subtopics.description: Studies examining how cell cycle progression, G1 phase checkpoints, and molecular competition regulate the timing of terminal differentiation and cell fate commitment, including roles of CDK4/6, lipid checkpoints, and circadian rhythms.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms by which cell cycle progression and G1 checkpoints regulate the timing of terminal differentiation and cell fate commitment.

subtopics.label: Adipocyte Differentiation, Metabolism, and Proteomics
