subtopics.description: Research characterizing adipocyte differentiation programs and metabolic regulation using proteomic and transcriptomic approaches, including SILAC-based profiling of 3T3-L1 cells, metformin effects, HIF1α-PPARγ networks, and circadian control of preadipocyte commitment.
subtopics.short_description: Proteomic and transcriptomic characterization of adipocyte differentiation programs, metabolic networks, and circadian control of preadipocyte commitment.

subtopics.label: Transcriptomic Profiling of Kidney Transplant Rejection and Allografts
subtopics.description: Single-cell and bulk RNA-sequencing studies of kidney allografts to characterize immune cell infiltration, T cell and NK cell gene signatures, fibroblast origins, and molecular markers associated with acute and chronic rejection.
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell and bulk RNA-sequencing of kidney allografts to characterize immune infiltration and molecular markers of acute and chronic rejection.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Immune Response, Epigenetics, and Vascular Pathology
subtopics.description: Studies investigating the immunological and epigenetic consequences of SARS-CoV-2 infection, including DNA methylation signatures in severe disease, epigenetic memory in hematopoietic progenitors, fungal microbiota-driven neutrophil activation, and vascular necroptosis in ARDS.
subtopics.short_description: Immunological and epigenetic consequences of SARS-CoV-2 infection, including DNA methylation signatures, hematopoietic epigenetic memory, and vascular pathology.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Regeneration, Cardiomyocyte Biology, and Heart Injury Response
subtopics.description: Research on cardiac regeneration mechanisms including epicardial progenitor activation in zebrafish, cross-species inflammatory responses to heart injury, cardiomyocyte isolation and division quantification, and SARS-CoV-2-induced ferroptosis in pacemaker cells.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanisms of cardiac regeneration, epicardial progenitor activation, cardiomyocyte biology, and heart injury responses across model organisms.

subtopics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy: T Cell Therapies, Immune Combinations, and Tumor Immune Evasion
subtopics.description: Studies on enhancing anti-tumor immunity through combination immunotherapy strategies, including CAR-T cell therapies, GITR engagement, neutrophil-T cell cooperation, radiation plus checkpoint blockade, and mechanisms of tumor immune escape via chromosomal instability and endothelial necroptosis.
subtopics.short_description: Combination immunotherapy strategies including CAR-T cells, checkpoint blockade, and mechanisms of tumor immune escape via chromosomal instability.

subtopics.label: Ovarian Follicle Biology and Reproductive Cell Characterization
subtopics.description: Single-cell and molecular studies characterizing ovarian follicle cell populations, including theca cell subtypes, antral follicle isolation protocols, xenograft versus native follicle molecular signatures, and AMH-driven premature luteinization.
subtopics.short_description: Single-cell and molecular characterization of ovarian follicle cell populations, theca cell subtypes, and AMH-driven reproductive dysregulation.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Cancer Stem Cells, Microenvironment, and Epigenetic Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on colorectal cancer initiation and progression focusing on epithelial aPKC deficiency, hyaluronan-driven microenvironment remodeling, MTA2-SATB2 chromatin complexes maintaining colonic identity, and intestinal stem cell niche support.
subtopics.short_description: Colorectal cancer initiation and progression through epithelial deficiency, microenvironment remodeling, and chromatin complexes maintaining colonic identity.

subtopics.label: Lupus and Autoimmune Innate Immune Dysregulation
subtopics.description: Studies examining innate immune mechanisms in lupus, including IFN-driven IL-1β secretion in monocytes, Langerhans cell ADAM17 regulation in photosensitivity, and lymphatic fluid as an immunosurveillance conduit for tissue-specific inflammatory signals.
subtopics.short_description: Innate immune mechanisms in lupus including IFN-driven monocyte activation, Langerhans cell regulation, and lymphatic immunosurveillance of inflammatory signals.

subtopics.label: Circulating Tumor Cells and Liquid Biopsy in Cancer
subtopics.description: Methods and analyses for isolating and characterizing circulating tumor cells (CTCs) and circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) in cancer patients, including HER2-low CTC isolation, CTC cluster genomics, and machine learning integration for treatment response prediction.
subtopics.short_description: Isolation and characterization of circulating tumor cells and ctDNA in cancer patients, including CTC cluster genomics and treatment response prediction.

subtopics.label: Liver Cell Biology: Zonation, Fibrosis, and Transcriptional Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on hepatic cell biology including aging-associated disruption of hepatocyte zonation, HNF4α regulation in cirrhosis and liver failure, hedgehog-driven peribiliary fibrogenic mesenchymal cells, and AAV vector tropism in liver cells.
subtopics.short_description: Hepatic cell biology encompassing hepatocyte zonation, HNF4α regulation in cirrhosis, peribiliary fibrogenic cells, and AAV vector tropism in liver.

subtopics.label: Chromosomal Instability, Epigenetic Reprogramming, and Cancer Progression
subtopics.description: Studies on how chromosomal instability and epigenetic dysregulation drive cancer progression and metastasis, including PRC1 loss in uveal melanoma, non-cell-autonomous CIN-driven metastasis, PKCλ/ι inhibition activating interferon responses, and machine learning prediction of chromatin conformation in cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Chromosomal instability and epigenetic dysregulation driving cancer progression and metastasis, with machine learning prediction of chromatin conformation.

subtopics.label: Stem Cell Reprogramming, Pluripotency, and Epigenetic Bookmarking
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular mechanisms of cellular reprogramming to pluripotency, including gene regulatory networks in iPSC generation, H3K27ac bookmarking post-mitosis, incomplete DNA replication in low-potency PSCs, and OTX2-driven enhancer remodeling in endoderm specification.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of cellular reprogramming to pluripotency, including gene regulatory networks, epigenetic bookmarking, and enhancer remodeling in iPSCs.

subtopics.label: Skeletal Stem Cells, Bone Biology, and Metastasis
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing skeletal stem cell lineages in bone development and cancer metastasis, including vertebral skeletal stem cells driving breast cancer metastasis, craniosynostosis multi-stem cell basis, and single-cell preparation methods for skeletal cells.
subtopics.display_name: Skeletal Stem Cells, Bone Biology & Metastasis
subtopics.short_description: Skeletal stem cell lineages in bone development and cancer metastasis, including vertebral stem cells driving breast cancer metastasis and craniosynostosis.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Multi-Omics and Transcriptomics
subtopics.description: Research employing single-cell RNA sequencing, multi-omics profiling (chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, transcriptome), and spatial transcriptomics to characterize cell-type-specific gene expression, epigenetic states, and splicing patterns across tissues and disease contexts.
subtopics.short_description: Cell-type-specific gene expression, epigenetic states, and splicing patterns profiled by single-cell and spatial transcriptomics.

subtopics.label: Metabolomics and Metabolic Profiling
subtopics.description: Studies applying untargeted and targeted metabolomics, metabolic flux analysis, and metabolic pathway characterization to identify biomarkers, disease subtypes, and metabolic reprogramming in cancer, diabetes, neurodegeneration, and other conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Untargeted and targeted metabolomics to identify biomarkers, disease subtypes, and metabolic reprogramming across conditions.

subtopics.label: Epigenomics, Chromatin Architecture, and Gene Regulation
subtopics.description: Research investigating DNA methylation, histone modifications, chromatin accessibility, 3D genome organization, and enhancer-promoter interactions to understand transcriptional regulation, cell identity, and disease-associated epigenetic alterations.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation, histone modifications, and 3D genome organization underlying transcriptional regulation and disease-associated epigenetic changes.

subtopics.label: Proteomics, Protein Interaction Networks, and Biomarker Discovery
subtopics.description: Studies using mass spectrometry-based proteomics, proximity labeling, protein-protein interaction mapping, and quantitative proteomic profiling to characterize protein networks, identify biomarkers, and understand disease mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Mass spectrometry-based proteomics and protein-protein interaction mapping for biomarker discovery and disease mechanism characterization.

subtopics.label: Transcriptomic Analysis of Disease Mechanisms and Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research applying bulk RNA sequencing, transcriptomic profiling, and gene expression analysis to characterize disease-associated transcriptional signatures, identify biomarkers, and elucidate molecular mechanisms in cancer, infection, and organ pathology.
subtopics.short_description: Bulk RNA sequencing and gene expression profiling to identify disease-associated transcriptional signatures in cancer, infection, and organ pathology.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genomics, Tumor Evolution, and Clonal Dynamics
subtopics.description: Research integrating whole-genome sequencing, structural variant analysis, clonal lineage tracing, and multi-omics to characterize tumor heterogeneity, mutational signatures, cancer evolution, and mechanisms of metastasis and therapy resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Whole-genome sequencing and multi-omics characterization of tumor heterogeneity, mutational signatures, and mechanisms of metastasis and therapy resistance.

subtopics.label: Multi-Omics Data Integration and Computational Methods
subtopics.description: Development and application of computational frameworks, machine learning models, Bayesian methods, network embedding, and statistical tools for integrating multi-omics datasets, identifying disease subtypes, and enabling biomedical discovery.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning, Bayesian, and network-based frameworks for integrating multi-omics datasets and enabling biomedical discovery.

subtopics.label: Brain Connectivity, Network Neuroscience, and Neurological Disease
subtopics.description: Research applying functional and structural connectome analysis, network control theory, and computational modeling to characterize brain state dynamics, predict cognitive outcomes, and understand neurological and psychiatric disorders.
subtopics.short_description: Connectome analysis and computational modeling of brain state dynamics, cognitive outcomes, and neurological and psychiatric disorders.

subtopics.label: Space Biology and Astronaut Multi-Omics
subtopics.description: Multi-omics studies characterizing molecular, physiological, and immunological changes in astronauts during and after spaceflight, including transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, epigenomics, and microbiome profiling.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular, physiological, and immunological changes in astronauts during spaceflight, profiled across transcriptomics, proteomics, and microbiome.

subtopics.label: Microbiome-Host Interactions and Metabolic Signaling
subtopics.description: Research integrating metagenomic, metabolomic, and transcriptomic approaches to characterize how gut and environmental microbiomes influence host metabolism, immunity, bile acid signaling, and disease susceptibility.
subtopics.short_description: Metagenomic, metabolomic, and transcriptomic approaches linking gut microbiome composition to host metabolism, immunity, and disease susceptibility.

subtopics.label: Gene Regulatory Networks and Transcription Factor Biology
subtopics.description: Studies elucidating transcription factor networks, enhancer activity, gene regulatory circuits, and chromatin remodeling complexes that control cell fate decisions, differentiation, and disease-associated transcriptional programs.
subtopics.short_description: Transcription factor networks, enhancer activity, and chromatin remodeling circuits controlling cell fate, differentiation, and disease-associated gene programs.

subtopics.label: Drug Repurposing, Knowledge Graphs, and Precision Medicine
subtopics.description: Research developing and applying biomedical knowledge graphs, network pharmacology, and machine learning to identify drug repurposing opportunities, predict therapeutic targets, and enable precision oncology and disease treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Network pharmacology and machine learning applied to knowledge graphs for identifying repurposing opportunities and precision therapeutic targets.

subtopics.label: Cell Cycle Regulation, Proliferation, and Quiescence
subtopics.description: Research investigating molecular mechanisms controlling cell cycle entry, CDK activity, quiescence, and proliferation commitment, including signaling dynamics, feedback loops, and their dysregulation in cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of cell cycle entry, CDK activity, quiescence, and proliferation commitment, including cancer-related dysregulation.

subtopics.label: RNA Modifications, Splicing, and Post-Transcriptional Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing m6A and other RNA modifications, alternative splicing, polyadenylation, and isoform diversity using long-read sequencing and computational tools to understand post-transcriptional gene regulation in development and disease.
subtopics.short_description: m6A modifications, alternative splicing, and isoform diversity characterized by long-read sequencing in development and disease.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming in Cancer and Therapeutic Targeting
subtopics.description: Research characterizing metabolic pathway alterations in cancer cells—including lipid metabolism, mitochondrial function, NAD/NADP biosynthesis, and amino acid metabolism—and identifying metabolic vulnerabilities for therapeutic intervention.
subtopics.short_description: Lipid, mitochondrial, and amino acid metabolic alterations in cancer cells, revealing vulnerabilities for therapeutic intervention.

subtopics.label: Lymphoma and Leukemia Genomics and Therapeutic Targeting
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular mechanisms, genomic drivers, and therapeutic vulnerabilities in B-cell lymphomas, T-cell lymphomas, and acute leukemias, including studies of oncogenic mutations, tumor microenvironment, and targeted therapies.
subtopics.short_description: Genomic drivers, oncogenic mutations, and therapeutic vulnerabilities in B-cell lymphomas, T-cell lymphomas, and acute leukemias.

subtopics.label: Tumor Immune Microenvironment and Immunotherapy Response
subtopics.description: Studies examining immune cell composition, immune evasion mechanisms, and immunotherapy response within the tumor microenvironment across multiple cancer types, including checkpoint blockade, CAR-T cells, and tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte dynamics.
subtopics.short_description: Immune cell composition, evasion mechanisms, and checkpoint blockade or CAR-T response dynamics across cancer types.

subtopics.label: Multi-Omics of Neurodegenerative Disease and Neuroinflammation
subtopics.description: Omics-based investigations of Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, tauopathies, and related neurodegeneration, including studies of microglial activation, tau propagation, protein aggregation, and metabolic dysfunction in the brain.
subtopics.short_description: Omics-based profiling of Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and tauopathies, including microglial activation, protein aggregation, and metabolic dysfunction.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Host Molecular Response and Organoid Models
subtopics.description: Multi-omic and organoid-based studies of SARS-CoV-2 infection mechanisms, host immune and inflammatory responses, and COVID-19 disease progression including lung pathology, cardiac involvement, and long-term sequelae.
subtopics.short_description: Multi-omic and organoid-based characterization of SARS-CoV-2 infection, immune response, and long-term disease sequelae.

subtopics.label: Mycobacterium tuberculosis Metabolism, Stress Response, and Drug Targets
subtopics.description: Studies of metabolic pathways, stress adaptation, and genetic essentiality in Mycobacterium tuberculosis and related mycobacteria, including nitrogen metabolism, lipid utilization, redox biology, and identification of novel drug targets.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic pathways, stress adaptation, and genetic essentiality in Mycobacterium tuberculosis for novel drug target identification.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Molecular Subtypes and Androgen Signaling
subtopics.description: Molecular characterization of prostate cancer progression, androgen receptor signaling, chromatin remodeling, and therapeutic resistance, including studies of tumor subtypes, metastasis, and neuroendocrine differentiation.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular characterization of prostate cancer progression, androgen receptor signaling, chromatin remodeling, and therapeutic resistance.

subtopics.label: Brain Organoids and Neuropsychiatric Disease Modeling
subtopics.description: Use of patient-derived cerebral organoids and 3D neural models to study neurodevelopmental and neuropsychiatric conditions including schizophrenia, autism, and substance exposure, revealing cell-type-specific molecular alterations.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived cerebral organoids revealing cell-type-specific molecular alterations in schizophrenia, autism, and neurodevelopmental conditions.

subtopics.label: Adipose Biology, Obesity, and Metabolic Dysfunction
subtopics.description: Molecular and omics studies of adipocyte differentiation, adipose tissue remodeling, and obesity-related metabolic dysfunction, including lipid metabolism, mitochondrial function, circadian regulation, and inflammatory signaling in fat tissue.
subtopics.short_description: Omics studies of adipocyte differentiation, lipid metabolism, and inflammatory signaling underlying obesity-related metabolic dysfunction.

subtopics.label: Hematopoiesis, Clonal Evolution, and Epigenetic Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies of normal and malignant hematopoiesis focusing on epigenetic regulation, DNA methylation, clonal hematopoiesis mutations, and differentiation trajectories in blood cell lineages.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic regulation, DNA methylation, and clonal hematopoiesis mutations shaping blood cell differentiation and malignant transformation.

subtopics.label: Endothelial Cell Biology, Vascular Remodeling, and Angiogenesis
subtopics.description: Research on endothelial cell heterogeneity, vascular development, angiogenesis, and vascular dysfunction in disease contexts including cancer, atherosclerosis, and organ development.
subtopics.short_description: Endothelial cell heterogeneity, angiogenesis, and vascular dysfunction in cancer, atherosclerosis, and organ development.

subtopics.label: Kidney Transplantation and Allograft Omics
subtopics.description: Transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic studies of kidney allograft function, rejection mechanisms, and biomarker discovery in transplant recipients, including urinary and blood-based molecular profiling.
subtopics.short_description: Transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic profiling of allograft function, rejection mechanisms, and biomarkers in transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: Network Analysis and Computational Omics Methods
subtopics.description: Development and application of computational methods for network analysis, community detection, multi-omics integration, and biomedical data science, including graph-based approaches, clustering algorithms, and statistical frameworks for omics data.
subtopics.short_description: Graph-based methods, community detection, and statistical frameworks for network analysis and multi-omics biomedical data science.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Beta Cell Biology and Diabetes Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Molecular studies of pancreatic beta cell function, failure, and regeneration in diabetes, including insulin secretion regulation, beta cell transdifferentiation, and therapeutic strategies to restore glucose homeostasis.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of beta cell function, failure, and regeneration, including insulin secretion and therapeutic restoration of glucose homeostasis.

subtopics.label: Airway Epithelium Transcriptomics and Lung Disease
subtopics.description: Transcriptomic and molecular studies of airway and lung epithelial responses to smoking, environmental exposures, and disease, including gene expression changes in COPD, lung cancer, and respiratory infections.
subtopics.short_description: Gene expression changes in airway and lung epithelium in response to smoking, environmental exposures, COPD, and respiratory infections.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic Aging, DNA Methylation Clocks, and Age-Related Biology
subtopics.description: Studies using DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks and age-related molecular signatures to quantify biological aging, identify age-modulating factors, and understand the molecular basis of aging across tissues and disease contexts.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation-based clocks and molecular signatures quantifying biological aging and age-modulating factors across tissues and disease.

subtopics.label: Traumatic Brain Injury Rehabilitation and Recovery
subtopics.description: Research on functional, cognitive, and neurological recovery following traumatic brain injury (TBI), including inpatient rehabilitation outcomes, neuroimaging biomarkers, deep brain stimulation, and assessment tools for pediatric and adult TBI populations.
subtopics.short_description: Functional, cognitive, and neurological recovery after TBI, including neuroimaging biomarkers and rehabilitation outcomes across age groups.

subtopics.label: Stroke Rehabilitation and Motor Recovery
subtopics.description: Research on post-stroke rehabilitation outcomes including motor recovery, functional connectivity reorganization, cognitive deficits, caregiver support, and predictive biomarkers for recovery following ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke.
subtopics.short_description: Post-stroke motor recovery, functional connectivity reorganization, cognitive deficits, and predictive biomarkers for rehabilitation outcomes.

subtopics.label: Disorders of Consciousness and Severe Brain Injury
subtopics.description: Research on assessment, ethics, and intervention for patients with disorders of consciousness (DoC) including cognitive motor dissociation, covert cognition detection via EEG, legal rights, and ethical frameworks for severe brain injury care.
subtopics.display_name: Disorders of Consciousness & Severe Brain Injury
subtopics.short_description: Assessment, ethics, and intervention for patients with disorders of consciousness, including covert cognition detection and legal frameworks.

subtopics.label: Dysphagia Assessment and Swallowing Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on evaluation and treatment of swallowing disorders, including FEES-based assessment tools (VASES, DIGEST), respiratory-swallow coordination, bolus characteristics, orofacial strength measurement, and dysphagia in neurological conditions such as Parkinson's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Evaluation and treatment of swallowing disorders, including endoscopic assessment tools, respiratory-swallow coordination, and neurological dysphagia.

subtopics.label: Cognitive Training and Functional Skills in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on computerized cognitive training programs, functional skills assessment and training (CFSAT), adherence prediction using machine learning, and technology-based interventions to improve everyday functioning in older adults with and without cognitive impairment.
subtopics.short_description: Computerized cognitive training and functional skills interventions to improve everyday functioning in older adults with or without cognitive impairment.

subtopics.label: Post-Acute COVID-19 Sequelae and Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on the neuropsychiatric, cognitive, and functional consequences of COVID-19 infection including long COVID brain fog, post-intensive care syndrome, rehabilitation interventions, and digital tools for cognitive recovery in COVID-19 survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Neuropsychiatric, cognitive, and functional consequences of COVID-19, including long COVID brain fog and digital rehabilitation interventions.

subtopics.label: Traumatic Spinal Injury Management in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research on presentation, surgical management, neurological outcomes, complications, and post-discharge follow-up of traumatic spinal cord injuries in East Africa and other low- and middle-income country settings.
subtopics.display_name: Spinal Cord Injury in Low-Income Settings
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management, neurological outcomes, and post-discharge follow-up for traumatic spinal cord injuries in East Africa and other LMICs.

subtopics.label: Multiple Sclerosis Disability and Neuroimaging Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research on structural and functional connectivity biomarkers of disability in multiple sclerosis, including lesion-based disconnectivity, dynamic functional connectivity, corneal nerve fiber loss, and cognitive outcomes with disease-modifying therapy.
subtopics.short_description: Structural and functional connectivity biomarkers of disability in MS, including lesion-based disconnectivity and cognitive outcomes with therapy.

subtopics.label: Chronic Pain Management and Psychosocial Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on biopsychosocial approaches to chronic pain including peer-delivered cognitive behavioral therapy, positive affect interventions, digital self-management tools, pain beliefs, discrimination, and pain outcomes in diverse populations including older adults and torture survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Biopsychosocial approaches to chronic pain, including cognitive behavioral therapy, digital self-management tools, and outcomes in diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Voice Disorders, Laryngology, and Communication Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on assessment and rehabilitation of voice disorders including gender-affirming voice modification, outcomes following laryngeal surgery, telehealth delivery of voice care, voice injury in performers, and speech-language pathology practice.
subtopics.short_description: Assessment and rehabilitation of voice disorders, including gender-affirming voice care, laryngeal surgery outcomes, and telehealth delivery.

subtopics.label: Assistive Technology and Disability Access
subtopics.description: Research on access to and usability of assistive technology for individuals with disabilities, including children with acquired brain injury, older adults with cognitive impairments, individuals with dexterity impairments, and automatic speech recognition for deaf and hard-of-hearing users.
subtopics.short_description: Access and usability of assistive technology for individuals with disabilities, including brain injury, cognitive impairment, and hearing loss populations.

subtopics.label: Disability Policy, Ethics, and Health Equity
subtopics.description: Research on disability rights frameworks, health equity, bioethics, and policy issues affecting people with disabilities including crisis standards of care, ableism in bioethics, intellectual and developmental disabilities, and interagency coordination for co-occurring conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Disability rights frameworks, bioethics, and health equity issues affecting people with disabilities, including crisis care standards and ableism.

subtopics.label: Osseointegrated Prostheses and Amputee Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on osseointegrated prosthetic implants for lower limb amputees, including cost-benefit analysis, infection management, surgical considerations such as concurrent thigh lifts, and functional outcomes compared to conventional prostheses.
subtopics.short_description: Osseointegrated prosthetic implants for lower limb amputees, including cost-benefit analysis, infection management, and functional outcomes.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Brain Injury Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on cognitive and functional recovery during inpatient rehabilitation for children with traumatic brain injury, including delirium screening, cognitive assessment tools, neuroimaging predictors, and access to assistive technology in pediatric neurorehabilitation.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive and functional recovery in children with TBI during inpatient rehabilitation, including delirium screening and neuroimaging predictors.

subtopics.label: Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation and Sports Medicine
subtopics.description: Research on rehabilitation of musculoskeletal conditions including shoulder pain in wheelchair users, osteoarthritis interventions, sports-related concussion, peer coaching for joint replacement, and exercise-based interventions for low back pain.
subtopics.short_description: Rehabilitation of musculoskeletal conditions including shoulder pain, osteoarthritis, sports concussion, and exercise-based interventions for back pain.

subtopics.label: Sensory Recovery and Neurotization in Breast Reconstruction
subtopics.description: Research on sensory outcomes following mastectomy and breast reconstruction, including neurotized DIEP flap techniques, nerve coaptation strategies, and the impact of chemotherapy/radiation on breast sensation and quality of life.
subtopics.short_description: Sensory outcomes following mastectomy and breast reconstruction, including neurotized flap techniques and impact of treatment on breast sensation.

subtopics.label: Lumbar Spine Surgery Outcomes and Techniques
subtopics.description: Studies examining surgical approaches for lumbar spine conditions including minimally invasive TLIF, direct lateral interbody fusion, cauda equina syndrome, and degenerative disc disease, with focus on clinical and functional outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical approaches for lumbar spine conditions, including minimally invasive fusion, cauda equina syndrome, and degenerative disc disease outcomes.

subtopics.label: Cervical and Thoracic Spine Surgery and Neurological Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of cervical and cervicothoracic spine pathology, including fusion techniques, adjacent segment disease, atlanto-axial osteoarthritis, and neurological outcomes following spinal cord and nerve compression.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of cervical and cervicothoracic spine pathology, including fusion techniques, adjacent segment disease, and neurological outcomes.

subtopics.label: Social Skills Interventions and Autism Spectrum Disorder
subtopics.description: Research on behavioral and social skills interventions for children and youth with autism spectrum disorder, including group-based programs, caregiver-mediated naturalistic developmental behavioral interventions, and diagnosis disclosure practices.
subtopics.short_description: Behavioral and social skills interventions for children with autism spectrum disorder, including group-based and caregiver-mediated programs.

subtopics.label: Physical Function, Cognition, and Pain in Older Adults with HIV
subtopics.description: Studies examining the interrelationships among physical function, cognitive performance, pain, inflammation, and mood in older adults living with HIV, including gait speed as a functional biomarker.
subtopics.display_name: Physical Function & Cognition in Older Adults with HIV
subtopics.short_description: Interrelationships among physical function, cognition, pain, and inflammation in older adults living with HIV, including gait speed as a biomarker.

subtopics.label: Orofacial and Respiratory Muscle Strength Assessment
subtopics.description: Research validating low-cost and portable measurement tools for tongue, lip, cheek, and respiratory muscle strength, including comparisons with gold-standard devices for clinical and research applications.
subtopics.short_description: Validation of portable tools for measuring tongue, lip, cheek, and respiratory muscle strength for clinical and research applications.

subtopics.label: Sleep Interventions and Wearable Monitoring in Parkinson's Disease
subtopics.description: Research on non-pharmacological interventions for sleep disturbance in Parkinson's disease, including light therapy trials, and the use of wearable devices for monitoring motor and non-motor symptoms in clinical care.
subtopics.display_name: Sleep & Wearable Monitoring in Parkinson's Disease
subtopics.short_description: Non-pharmacological sleep interventions and wearable device monitoring of motor and non-motor symptoms in Parkinson's disease.

subtopics.label: Telehealth and Remote Care Delivery in Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Studies examining the feasibility, effectiveness, and accessibility of telehealth and tele-paramedicine for delivering rehabilitation and geriatric care, including fall risk reduction and social skills programs delivered remotely.
subtopics.short_description: Feasibility and effectiveness of telehealth and tele-paramedicine for delivering rehabilitation, geriatric care, and fall risk reduction programs.

subtopics.label: Cancer Rehabilitation and Neuro-Oncology Functional Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on rehabilitation outcomes in patients with brain tumors and cancer, including inpatient rehabilitation for glioblastoma, neurocognitive effects of meningiomas, spine tumor rehabilitation, and comprehensive survivorship care models.
subtopics.short_description: Rehabilitation outcomes in patients with brain tumors and cancer, including inpatient recovery, neurocognitive effects, and survivorship care models.

subtopics.label: Intrathecal Drug Delivery and Neurostimulation Devices
subtopics.description: Research on implantable devices for spasticity and pain management, including intrathecal baclofen pump placement techniques, management of hypertonia in movement disorders, and MRI compatibility challenges with spinal cord stimulators.
subtopics.short_description: Implantable devices for spasticity and pain management, including intrathecal baclofen pumps, hypertonia treatment, and spinal cord stimulators.

subtopics.label: Fall Prevention and Risk Reduction in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Studies on fall risk factors and prevention strategies in older adults, including the role of polypharmacy, chronic kidney disease, benzodiazepine use post-stroke, and tele-paramedicine-based fall risk reduction programs.
subtopics.short_description: Fall risk factors and prevention strategies in older adults, including polypharmacy, chronic kidney disease, and tele-paramedicine-based programs.

subtopics.label: Neuropsychological Assessment in Neurosurgical and Acquired Brain Injury Contexts
subtopics.description: Research on cognitive and neuropsychological evaluation in neurosurgical settings, including assessment before and after brain tumor resection, colloid cyst surgery, and multicontext cognitive rehabilitation approaches for acquired brain injury.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive evaluation before and after brain tumor resection and acquired brain injury, including multicontext cognitive rehabilitation approaches.

subtopics.label: Myofascial Pain Assessment and Interventional Treatments
subtopics.description: Research on diagnosis and treatment of myofascial pain syndromes, including ultrasound-guided trigger point injection techniques, virtual reality as an adjunct therapy, and shoulder ultrasound reliability for musculoskeletal assessment.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and treatment of myofascial pain syndromes, including ultrasound-guided trigger point injections and virtual reality adjunct therapy.

subtopics.label: Hearing Loss, Communication, and Psychosocial Impact
subtopics.description: Studies on the functional and psychosocial consequences of hearing loss across populations, including cancer survivors, heart failure patients, and the emotional dimensions of audiological care.
subtopics.short_description: Functional and psychosocial consequences of hearing loss across populations, including cancer survivors and the emotional dimensions of audiological care.

subtopics.label: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Training, Workforce, and Practice
subtopics.description: Research on PM&R residency training, clinical practice patterns, and workforce issues, including the impact of COVID-19 on resident clinical experience, sleep health documentation by physiatrists, and skilled nursing facility rehabilitation intensity.
subtopics.short_description: Physical medicine and rehabilitation residency training, clinical practice patterns, and workforce issues including COVID-19 impacts on resident experience.

subtopics.label: Ambulatory Care Coordination and Fragmentation
subtopics.description: Research examining how fragmented ambulatory care delivery affects patient outcomes including hospitalization, emergency department visits, stroke, and cardiovascular events, as well as studies measuring care coordination gaps and their association with preventable adverse events across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Gaps in ambulatory care coordination and their association with hospitalizations, adverse events, and poor outcomes.

subtopics.label: Telemedicine, Telehealth, and Digital Health Delivery
subtopics.description: Studies on the implementation, effectiveness, utilization patterns, and patient/provider experiences with telemedicine and digital health tools in primary and ambulatory care settings, including direct-to-consumer telehealth, video visits, remote patient monitoring, and telehealth disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Implementation, effectiveness, and equity of telemedicine and digital health tools in primary and ambulatory care.

subtopics.label: Family Caregiver Assessment, Support, and Needs in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Research focused on identifying, assessing, and addressing the needs of family caregivers within primary care settings, including caregiver burden, self-efficacy, preparedness, distress, and interventions to support caregivers of older adults and persons with dementia.
subtopics.display_name: Family Caregiver Support in Primary Care
subtopics.short_description: Assessment and intervention for caregiver burden, distress, and preparedness among families of older adults and dementia patients.

subtopics.label: Chronic Disease Management: Diabetes and Multimorbidity
subtopics.description: Studies on diabetes prevention, self-management education, medication adherence, glycemic control, and co-management of diabetes with other chronic conditions including cancer, hypertension, and chronic pain in primary and ambulatory care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Diabetes prevention, self-management, glycemic control, and co-management with hypertension, cancer, and chronic pain.

subtopics.label: Hypertension Management and Cardiovascular Disease Prevention
subtopics.description: Research on blood pressure control, cardiovascular risk assessment and prediction, hypertension treatment strategies, and primary prevention of cardiovascular disease across diverse populations including low-income countries, rural communities, and high-risk groups.
subtopics.short_description: Blood pressure control, cardiovascular risk assessment, and primary prevention strategies across diverse and high-risk populations.

subtopics.label: Heart Failure Care Delivery and Management
subtopics.description: Studies examining heart failure management in primary and ambulatory care settings, including home health care, medication management, polypharmacy, guideline-directed therapy, care transitions, patient education, and outcomes such as readmission and mortality.
subtopics.short_description: Ambulatory heart failure management including medication adherence, care transitions, patient education, and readmission reduction.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use Disorder, Substance Use Treatment, and Harm Reduction in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Research on the management of opioid use disorder and other substance use disorders in primary care settings, including buprenorphine treatment, stigma reduction, harm reduction approaches, prescribing patterns, and integration of addiction treatment into general medical practice.
subtopics.short_description: Buprenorphine treatment, stigma reduction, and integration of addiction care into general medical practice.

subtopics.label: Hepatitis C, HIV, and Infectious Disease Management in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Studies on the treatment and care of hepatitis C, HIV, and other infectious diseases in primary care and community settings, including low-threshold treatment models, rapid treatment initiation, provider roles, and barriers to care for people who inject drugs.
subtopics.display_name: Hepatitis C, HIV & Infectious Disease Care
subtopics.short_description: Low-threshold treatment models and care delivery for hepatitis C, HIV, and infectious disease in primary care settings.

subtopics.label: Cancer Screening, Survivorship, and Primary Care Integration
subtopics.description: Research on cancer screening practices, survivorship care coordination, and the role of primary care in managing cancer survivors, including disparities in screening uptake, barriers to preventive care, and co-management of chronic conditions in cancer survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Screening disparities, survivorship coordination, and primary care co-management of chronic conditions in cancer survivors.

subtopics.label: Physician Payment, Quality Measurement, and Practice Organization
subtopics.description: Studies examining physician payment models including MIPS and value-based care, quality measurement systems, practice organization, physician time use, and the relationship between payment structures and care quality or physician behavior.
subtopics.short_description: Value-based payment models, quality measurement systems, and their effects on physician behavior and care quality.

subtopics.label: Social Determinants of Health and Health Disparities in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Research investigating how social determinants of health, neighborhood conditions, race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic factors influence health outcomes, healthcare utilization, and quality of care in primary and ambulatory care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Influence of race, socioeconomic status, and neighborhood conditions on health outcomes and care quality in primary care.

subtopics.label: Depression, Mental Health Integration, and Behavioral Health in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Studies on screening, treatment, and management of depression and mental health conditions in primary care settings, including integration of behavioral health services, treatment adherence, late-life depression interventions, and mental health-physical health comorbidity.
subtopics.short_description: Screening, treatment, and integration of mental health and behavioral health services within primary care settings.

subtopics.label: Obesity Management and Weight Loss Interventions in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Research on pharmacological and behavioral interventions for obesity management in primary care settings, including anti-obesity medications, telemedicine-based weight management, AI-assisted approaches, and weight loss outcomes in diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Pharmacological, behavioral, and telehealth-based obesity interventions and weight loss outcomes in primary care.

subtopics.label: Nursing Home and Post-Acute Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Studies on the organization and quality of care in nursing homes and post-acute settings, including the role of clinicians who specialize in nursing home care (SNFists), care continuity, telehealth use in nursing homes, and outcomes for residents with dementia and other chronic conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Quality, continuity, and clinician roles in nursing home and post-acute care for residents with dementia and chronic conditions.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Management, Long COVID, and Pandemic-Era Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Research on outpatient COVID-19 treatment, post-acute sequelae (long COVID), pandemic-related changes in care delivery, and the impact of COVID-19 on chronic disease management and healthcare access in primary care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Outpatient COVID-19 treatment, post-acute sequelae, and pandemic-driven changes in primary care access and delivery.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular Risk Prediction, Screening, and Prevention
subtopics.description: Research on tools, models, and strategies for predicting and preventing cardiovascular disease risk across diverse populations, including ASCVD risk equations, screening programs, and primary prevention interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Risk models, screening tools, and primary prevention strategies for cardiovascular disease across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular and Chronic Disease Care in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Studies examining the epidemiology, management, and health system delivery of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, hypertension, and other chronic conditions in low- and middle-income countries, particularly Haiti, Tanzania, and other resource-limited settings.
subtopics.display_name: Chronic Disease Care in Low-Income Countries
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology and health system delivery of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and hypertension in resource-limited settings.

subtopics.label: Smoking Cessation and Tobacco Use Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on smoking cessation interventions, medication prescribing patterns, and tobacco use treatment across clinical settings including post-stroke, mental illness, and pharmacist-led programs.
subtopics.short_description: Cessation interventions, prescribing patterns, and tobacco treatment across clinical populations including post-stroke and mental illness.

subtopics.label: Chronic Pain Assessment and Management in Primary Care
subtopics.description: Research on assessment tools, patient beliefs, treatment barriers, and management strategies for chronic and neuropathic pain across diverse patient populations including older adults and refugees.
subtopics.short_description: Assessment tools, patient beliefs, and treatment strategies for chronic and neuropathic pain in diverse primary care populations.

subtopics.label: Medication Adherence, Deprescribing, and Polypharmacy
subtopics.description: Studies examining medication nonadherence, barriers and facilitators to deprescribing, polypharmacy management, and the downstream healthcare utilization and spending consequences of medication-related issues.
subtopics.short_description: Barriers to adherence, deprescribing strategies, and healthcare utilization consequences of polypharmacy and medication-related issues.

subtopics.label: High-Cost Patients, Preventable Utilization, and Healthcare Spending
subtopics.description: Research identifying high-cost Medicare patients, patterns of preventable healthcare utilization and spending, and strategies to reduce unnecessary care through patient taxonomy and risk stratification.
subtopics.short_description: Risk stratification of high-cost Medicare patients and strategies to reduce preventable healthcare utilization and spending.

subtopics.label: Genetic Testing, Hereditary Cancer Risk, and Lynch Syndrome
subtopics.description: Research on cascade genetic testing, hereditary colorectal and other cancer risk assessment, Lynch syndrome identification, and digital tools for genetic cancer risk evaluation in diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Cascade genetic testing, Lynch syndrome identification, and digital tools for hereditary cancer risk assessment.

subtopics.label: Patient Trust, Clinician-Patient Relationship, and Communication
subtopics.description: Studies examining the determinants of patient trust in clinicians, the role of compassion and communication in care quality, and organizational factors that support or undermine therapeutic relationships.
subtopics.short_description: Determinants of patient trust, compassion, and organizational factors shaping the clinician-patient therapeutic relationship.

subtopics.label: Medical Education, Residency Training, and Clinical Competency
subtopics.description: Research on graduate medical education including residency training environments, curriculum gaps, competency development in behavioral health, nutrition, referrals, and career preferences among trainees.
subtopics.short_description: Graduate medical education environments, curriculum gaps, and competency development in primary care training programs.

subtopics.label: Care Transitions, Hospital Discharge, and Readmission Prevention
subtopics.description: Studies on improving transitions from hospital to home or post-acute settings, including discharge planning interventions, medication barriers at discharge, readmission reduction strategies, and navigator programs.
subtopics.short_description: Discharge planning interventions, medication barriers, and navigator programs to improve hospital-to-home transitions.

subtopics.label: Palliative Care, Advance Care Planning, and End-of-Life Needs
subtopics.description: Research on palliative care delivery, unmet palliative care needs, advance care planning, and depression screening in palliative settings, particularly among older adults and those with cognitive impairment.
subtopics.short_description: Palliative care delivery, unmet needs, and advance care planning among older adults and those with cognitive impairment.

subtopics.label: Vaccine Hesitancy, Uptake, and Communication Strategies
subtopics.description: Studies examining COVID-19 and other vaccine hesitancy, factors influencing vaccine acceptance, physician communication strategies, and community outreach interventions to improve vaccination rates.
subtopics.short_description: Factors driving vaccine hesitancy and physician communication strategies to improve vaccination rates across communities.

subtopics.label: Liver Disease: NAFLD, MASH, Alcohol-Related Liver Disease, and Cirrhosis
subtopics.description: Research on identification, risk stratification, and management of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease, metabolic-associated steatohepatitis, alcohol-related liver disease, and cirrhosis in primary and specialty care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Risk stratification and management of NAFLD, metabolic steatohepatitis, alcohol-related liver disease, and cirrhosis.

subtopics.label: Community Health Workers and Lay Health Worker Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating community health worker and lay health worker programs for chronic disease management, including diabetes, hypertension, and rheumatic conditions, across diverse and underserved populations.
subtopics.short_description: Community and lay health worker programs for chronic disease management in diverse and underserved populations.

subtopics.label: Elder Abuse, Mistreatment Screening, and Caregiver Neglect
subtopics.description: Research on screening for elder abuse and mistreatment in healthcare settings, including caregiver neglect identification, healthcare utilization patterns among abuse victims, and system-level screening approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Healthcare-based screening for elder abuse, caregiver neglect, and utilization patterns among mistreatment victims.

subtopics.label: Sepsis and Multi-Organ Dysfunction in Critical Illness
subtopics.description: Research on sepsis pathophysiology, subphenotyping by organ dysfunction trajectory, vasopressor use, corticosteroid therapy, and outcomes in critically ill patients with sepsis-induced ARDS and multi-organ failure. Includes molecular and immune mechanisms underlying sepsis-associated cognitive dysfunction and microvascular injury.
subtopics.short_description: Pathophysiology, subphenotyping, vasopressor use, and outcomes in sepsis-induced ARDS and multi-organ dysfunction.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Hospitalization: Clinical Characteristics, Severity, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining clinical features, risk factors, comorbidities, and in-hospital mortality among patients hospitalized with COVID-19, including variant-specific severity comparisons (Delta, Omicron, Beta) and predictive biomarkers such as troponin, viral load, and inflammatory markers.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical features, comorbidities, variant-specific severity, and in-hospital mortality among hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Cardiovascular and Thrombotic Complications
subtopics.description: Research on cardiac manifestations of COVID-19 including myocarditis, arrhythmias, right ventricular dysfunction, pulmonary embolism, thrombotic events, and anticoagulation management in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.
subtopics.short_description: Myocarditis, arrhythmias, pulmonary embolism, and anticoagulation management in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

subtopics.label: ICU Operations, Staffing, and Quality Improvement
subtopics.description: Research on ICU staffing models, patient-to-intensivist ratios, bed-to-physician ratios, interprofessional staffing patterns, quality improvement initiatives for clinical deterioration communication, and patient safety huddles in intensive care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Staffing models, intensivist ratios, interprofessional patterns, and quality improvement initiatives in intensive care.

subtopics.label: Resuscitation Science and Cardiac Arrest Management
subtopics.description: Studies on out-of-hospital and in-hospital cardiac arrest resuscitation including CPR training programs, bystander CPR, REBOA, resuscitative transesophageal echocardiography, epinephrine use, EEG prognostication post-arrest, and mechanical circulatory support in cardiac arrest.
subtopics.short_description: CPR training, bystander response, REBOA, epinephrine use, and mechanical circulatory support in cardiac arrest.

subtopics.label: Acute Pulmonary Embolism: Risk Stratification and Catheter-Based Therapies
subtopics.description: Research on risk stratification tools, catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, surgical embolectomy, and anticoagulation strategies for acute pulmonary embolism, including outcomes in intermediate- and high-risk patients and access disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Risk stratification, catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, and anticoagulation for acute pulmonary embolism.

subtopics.label: Cardiogenic Shock and Mechanical Circulatory Support
subtopics.description: Studies on management of cardiogenic shock including mechanical circulatory support devices (Impella, IABP, VA-ECMO, LVAD), outcomes at specialized centers, socioeconomic disparities in device utilization, sex-based differences, and trends in MCS use following heart allocation policy changes.
subtopics.short_description: Impella, IABP, VA-ECMO, and LVAD outcomes in cardiogenic shock, including disparities in device utilization.

subtopics.label: Stroke and Cerebrovascular Emergencies in the ED
subtopics.description: Research on emergency department diagnosis, misdiagnosis, and management of ischemic stroke, TIA, intracerebral hemorrhage, and subarachnoid hemorrhage, including mobile stroke units, thrombectomy access, diagnostic error analysis, and risk stratification after ED headache visits.
subtopics.short_description: ED diagnosis, misdiagnosis, thrombectomy access, and risk stratification for stroke and hemorrhagic cerebrovascular events.

subtopics.label: Traumatic Injury Management and Trauma Systems
subtopics.description: Research on management of traumatic injuries including traumatic brain injury, spinal cord injury, blunt thoracic aortic injury, rib fractures, facial fractures, and hemorrhage control, as well as trauma system design, volume-outcome relationships, and outcomes in both high-income and low-resource settings.
subtopics.short_description: Management of TBI, spinal injury, hemorrhage, and rib fractures, plus trauma system design and volume-outcome relationships.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Critical Care: Delirium, Transfusion, and PICU Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies on pediatric intensive care including delirium assessment and outcomes, blood product transfusion practices in critically ill children and those on ECMO, bleeding assessment, sedation practices, and PICU staffing and quality metrics.
subtopics.short_description: Delirium, transfusion practices, sedation, and staffing quality metrics in pediatric intensive care.

subtopics.label: Emergency Department Operations, Telemedicine, and Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Research on ED workflow optimization, telemedicine and virtual urgent care programs, patient navigator programs, discharge processes, return visit prediction, health information technology, and care coordination in emergency settings.
subtopics.short_description: Workflow optimization, virtual urgent care, patient navigation, and health IT for emergency care delivery.

subtopics.label: Elder Mistreatment Identification and Response in Emergency Settings
subtopics.description: Research on screening, assessment tools, interdisciplinary response teams, and outcomes for elder mistreatment in emergency departments and hospitals, including the Vulnerable Elder Protection Team model, social worker roles, prehospital documentation, and community multidisciplinary team approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Screening tools, interdisciplinary response teams, and outcomes for elder mistreatment identified in emergency departments.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use Disorder and Substance Use in Emergency Settings
subtopics.description: Studies on emergency department-initiated buprenorphine for opioid use disorder, prescription drug monitoring programs, cost-effectiveness of MOUD implementation, stigma reduction, and healthcare utilization patterns among patients with opioid and substance use disorders presenting to emergency settings.
subtopics.display_name: Opioid Use Disorder in Emergency Settings
subtopics.short_description: ED-initiated buprenorphine, prescription monitoring, MOUD cost-effectiveness, and utilization patterns for opioid use disorder.

subtopics.label: Global Emergency Care and Trauma in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research on emergency care systems, trauma management, prehospital EMS, and outcomes in low- and middle-income countries including Tanzania, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Kenya, covering traumatic spinal injuries, out-of-hospital cardiac arrest, heat emergencies, and capacity building for emergency response.
subtopics.display_name: Global Emergency Care in Low-Resource Settings
subtopics.short_description: Emergency systems, trauma management, prehospital EMS, and capacity building in low- and middle-income countries.

subtopics.label: Neurocritical Care and Acute Brain Injury Management
subtopics.description: Research on management and outcomes of intracerebral hemorrhage, subarachnoid hemorrhage, traumatic brain injury, and disorders of consciousness in critical care settings, including EEG monitoring, ICP management, cognitive motor dissociation, and prognostication tools.
subtopics.short_description: ICH, subarachnoid hemorrhage, TBI, ICP management, EEG monitoring, and prognostication in critical care settings.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pathophysiology, Biomarkers, and Molecular Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research investigating the biological mechanisms of severe COVID-19 including vascular injury, cytokine profiles, epigenetic signatures, multi-omics, and laboratory biomarkers that predict disease severity and mortality.
subtopics.short_description: Vascular injury, cytokine profiles, multi-omics, and laboratory biomarkers predicting severe COVID-19 and mortality.

subtopics.label: Neurological Complications and Cognitive Sequelae of COVID-19
subtopics.description: Studies examining neurological manifestations of COVID-19 including stroke risk, brain imaging findings, prolonged unconsciousness, cognitive deficits, posterior reversible encephalopathy, and post-acute neurological sequelae.
subtopics.short_description: Stroke risk, brain imaging findings, cognitive deficits, and post-acute neurological sequelae of COVID-19.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Treatment: Immunomodulators, Antivirals, and Therapeutic Strategies
subtopics.description: Clinical studies and reviews evaluating pharmacological treatments for COVID-19 including immunomodulators (anakinra, infliximab, vilobelimab), antivirals (remdesivir), hydroxychloroquine, and evolving therapeutic paradigms.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical evaluation of immunomodulators, antivirals, and evolving pharmacological strategies for COVID-19 treatment.

subtopics.label: Hospital and Departmental Operations During the COVID-19 Pandemic
subtopics.description: Studies describing institutional adaptations during COVID-19 including surgical shutdowns, departmental restructuring, simulation training, resource reallocation, palliative care expansion, and ethical frameworks for crisis standards of care.
subtopics.short_description: Institutional adaptations including surgical shutdowns, resource reallocation, simulation training, and crisis care ethics.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Outcomes in Patients with Specific Comorbidities and Special Populations
subtopics.description: Research examining COVID-19 severity and outcomes in patients with specific conditions including cancer, CKD, diabetes, Parkinson's disease, rheumatic diseases, pregnancy, and the oldest-old, as well as variant-specific severity analyses.
subtopics.short_description: COVID-19 severity and outcomes in patients with cancer, CKD, diabetes, pregnancy, and other specific conditions.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Respiratory Failure: Mechanical Ventilation, Proning, and Pulmonary Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on respiratory management of COVID-19 including mechanical ventilation strategies, awake proning, barotrauma, pneumothorax, intrathoracic complications, tracheostomy, and ARDS-related outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanical ventilation strategies, awake proning, barotrauma, tracheostomy, and ARDS outcomes in COVID-19.

subtopics.label: Post-Acute COVID-19 Sequelae and Long COVID Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research characterizing post-COVID-19 syndrome including persistent symptoms, effort intolerance, cardiopulmonary dysfunction, post-intensive care syndrome, gender disparities in recovery, and 30-day post-discharge outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Persistent symptoms, cardiopulmonary dysfunction, post-intensive care syndrome, and recovery disparities after COVID-19.

subtopics.label: Antimicrobial Resistance, Rapid Diagnostics, and Stewardship
subtopics.description: Studies on detection and management of multidrug-resistant organisms including carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, rapid molecular diagnostics, polymyxin breakpoints, and antimicrobial stewardship programs.
subtopics.short_description: Detection of multidrug-resistant organisms, rapid molecular diagnostics, and antimicrobial stewardship in critical care.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Transfusion Practices and Blood Product Management
subtopics.description: Research on blood component transfusion practices in hospitalized and critically ill children including platelet transfusions, cardiac surgery transfusions, fibrinogen replacement, storage duration effects, and transfusion-associated outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Platelet and blood component transfusion practices, storage effects, and transfusion outcomes in critically ill children.

subtopics.label: Lung Transplantation and ECMO: Perioperative Outcomes and Complications
subtopics.description: Studies examining outcomes of lung transplantation including primary graft dysfunction prediction, perioperative ECMO use, retransplantation in cystic fibrosis, intraoperative lactate as predictor, and ECMO withdrawal decisions.
subtopics.short_description: Primary graft dysfunction, perioperative ECMO use, retransplantation, and ECMO withdrawal decisions in lung transplant.

subtopics.label: Palliative Care, End-of-Life Ethics, and Surrogate Decision-Making in Critical Illness
subtopics.description: Research on palliative care delivery, ethical consultations, surrogate decision-maker support, do-not-resuscitate orders, disorders of consciousness ethics, and end-of-life care frameworks in critical and emergency settings.
subtopics.short_description: Surrogate decision-making, DNR orders, ethical consultations, and end-of-life frameworks in critical and emergency care.

subtopics.label: Clinical Informatics, AI, and Data Science in Critical and Emergency Care
subtopics.description: Studies applying machine learning, deep learning, federated learning, reinforcement learning, and electronic health record data systems to improve ICU mortality prediction, AKI sub-phenotyping, COVID-19 monitoring, and emergency care documentation.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning, EHR data systems, and federated learning applied to ICU mortality prediction and emergency care.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Surgery: Perioperative Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on outcomes and management in cardiac surgery including vasoactive medication use, pulmonary artery catheter use, subclinical hypothyroidism effects, CABG in low ejection fraction, robotic mitral surgery, and aortic dissection repair.
subtopics.short_description: Vasoactive medications, pulmonary artery catheters, CABG, robotic mitral surgery, and aortic dissection repair outcomes.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Emergency Department: Acute Illness Presentations and Management
subtopics.description: Studies on acute pediatric conditions presenting to the ED including osteomyelitis, febrile infants, croup, BRUE, MIS-C, concussion, mental health emergencies, and pediatric early warning scores.
subtopics.short_description: Febrile infants, croup, MIS-C, concussion, mental health emergencies, and early warning scores in pediatric emergency care.

subtopics.label: Hypertension, Cardiac Biomarkers, and Acute Coronary Syndromes in Emergency Settings
subtopics.description: Research on management of severe hypertension in the ED, cardiac troponin assay performance, STEMI complications including hypoglycemia and diabetes, Takotsubo syndrome outcomes, and anticoagulation for new atrial fibrillation.
subtopics.short_description: Severe hypertension management, troponin assay performance, STEMI complications, and new atrial fibrillation in the ED.

subtopics.label: Obesity Pharmacotherapy and Weight Management Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on pharmacological, surgical, and behavioral interventions for obesity and weight management, including GLP-1 receptor agonists (semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide), bariatric surgery outcomes, anti-obesity medications, and long-term weight loss maintenance strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Pharmacological, surgical, and behavioral interventions for obesity, including GLP-1 agonists, bariatric surgery, and long-term weight loss strategies.

subtopics.label: Dietary Patterns, Food Environment, and Nutritional Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies examining dietary patterns, food quality, food environment, and their associations with chronic disease risk including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and cancer, encompassing population-based cohorts and dietary assessment methodologies.
subtopics.short_description: Population-based studies linking dietary patterns, food quality, and food environment to chronic disease risk including cardiovascular disease and diabetes.

subtopics.label: Metabolomics, Proteomics, and Multi-Omics Profiling
subtopics.description: Studies employing metabolomics, proteomics, and integrated multi-omics approaches to characterize metabolic signatures of disease states, drug responses, and physiological conditions, including development of computational tools and pipelines for omics data analysis.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolomic, proteomic, and integrated multi-omics approaches to characterize disease states, drug responses, and physiological metabolic signatures.

subtopics.label: Lipid Metabolism, Adipose Biology, and Adipogenesis
subtopics.description: Research on lipid metabolic pathways, adipocyte biology, adipogenesis, and adipose tissue function including fatty acid oxidation, de novo lipogenesis, adipokines, thermogenesis, and the molecular regulation of fat storage and mobilization.
subtopics.short_description: Lipid metabolic pathways, adipocyte biology, adipogenesis, and molecular regulation of fat storage, mobilization, and thermogenesis.

subtopics.label: NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Cellular Bioenergetics
subtopics.description: Research on NAD+/NADH biosynthesis, salvage pathways, and precursors (NMN, NRH, NR), mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, and cellular energy metabolism, including their roles in metabolic disease, aging, and therapeutic interventions.
subtopics.short_description: NAD+/NADH biosynthesis, mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, and cellular energy metabolism in metabolic disease, aging, and therapeutic contexts.

subtopics.label: Glucose Homeostasis, Insulin Signaling, and Type 2 Diabetes
subtopics.description: Studies on glucose metabolism, insulin secretion and resistance, beta-cell function, and type 2 diabetes pathophysiology, including molecular mechanisms of glucose transport, glycemic control interventions, and epidemiological modeling of diabetes burden.
subtopics.short_description: Insulin secretion, insulin resistance, beta-cell function, and molecular mechanisms of glucose transport underlying type 2 diabetes pathophysiology.

subtopics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Reprogramming in Tumors
subtopics.description: Research on metabolic alterations in cancer cells and the tumor microenvironment, including Warburg effect, lipid biosynthesis, oncometabolites, and how metabolic reprogramming drives tumor progression, metastasis, and therapeutic resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic alterations in tumors, including Warburg effect, lipid biosynthesis, and oncometabolites driving progression, metastasis, and therapeutic resistance.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome, Dietary Fiber, and Host Metabolism
subtopics.description: Research on interactions between dietary components (fiber, fermentable carbohydrates, amino acids) and gut microbiota, and their downstream effects on host metabolism, immunity, bile acid signaling, and disease outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Interactions between dietary fiber, fermentable carbohydrates, and gut microbiota, and their effects on host metabolism, immunity, and disease outcomes.

subtopics.label: Vitamins, Micronutrients, and Mineral Metabolism
subtopics.description: Studies on the roles of vitamins (D, B12, A/retinoids, K), minerals (iron, phosphate, magnesium, zinc, copper), and other micronutrients in metabolic health, disease prevention, and clinical outcomes, including deficiency states and supplementation trials.
subtopics.short_description: Roles of vitamins, minerals, and micronutrients in metabolic health, disease prevention, and clinical outcomes, including deficiency states and supplementation.

subtopics.label: Sphingolipid and Ceramide Metabolism in Cardiometabolic Disease
subtopics.description: Research on sphingolipid biosynthesis, ceramide and sphingosine-1-phosphate signaling, and their roles in cardiovascular disease, atherosclerosis, and metabolic dysfunction, including endothelial sphingolipid homeostasis and therapeutic targeting.
subtopics.short_description: Sphingolipid biosynthesis, ceramide and sphingosine-1-phosphate signaling, and their roles in cardiovascular disease and metabolic dysfunction.

subtopics.label: Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease, NAFLD, and Hepatic Metabolism
subtopics.description: Research on metabolic mechanisms underlying alcohol-associated liver disease and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, including retinoid metabolism, hepatic steatosis, lipid accumulation, and therapeutic interventions targeting liver metabolic pathways.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic mechanisms of alcohol-associated liver disease and NAFLD, including retinoid metabolism, hepatic steatosis, and therapeutic targeting of liver pathways.

subtopics.label: Dietary Interventions and Nutritional Strategies for Chronic Disease Prevention
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational studies evaluating specific dietary interventions—including ketogenic diets, Mediterranean diet, omega-3 fatty acids, carotenoids, and caloric restriction—for prevention or management of chronic diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, cardiovascular disease, and cancer.
subtopics.display_name: Dietary Interventions for Chronic Disease Prevention
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and translational evaluation of ketogenic, Mediterranean, and caloric-restriction diets for preventing or managing cardiovascular disease, cancer, and Alzheimer's.

subtopics.label: Mycobacterium tuberculosis Metabolic Pathways and Nutritional Vulnerabilities
subtopics.description: Research on the metabolic physiology of Mycobacterium tuberculosis, including carbon and nitrogen metabolism, fatty acid oxidation, NAD/NADP biosynthesis, lipid assimilation, and identification of metabolic vulnerabilities as drug targets.
subtopics.short_description: Carbon and nitrogen metabolism, fatty acid oxidation, and NAD biosynthesis in M. tuberculosis as targets for novel drug development.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Syndrome, Cardiometabolic Risk, and Obesity-Related Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Studies on metabolic syndrome components, cardiometabolic risk factors, and obesity-related comorbidities including hypertension, dyslipidemia, peripheral neuropathy, and cardiovascular outcomes, with emphasis on epidemiological associations and clinical management.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiological and clinical studies on metabolic syndrome components, obesity-related comorbidities, dyslipidemia, hypertension, and cardiovascular outcomes.

subtopics.label: Obesity, Weight Management, and Nutritional Interventions in Cancer Survivors
subtopics.description: Research on weight management programs, dietary interventions, and body composition changes in cancer survivors, including behavioral and remote-based approaches to reduce obesity-related cancer recurrence risk.
subtopics.short_description: Weight management programs, dietary interventions, and body composition changes in cancer survivors to reduce obesity-related recurrence risk.

subtopics.label: Renal Electrolyte Transport, Potassium, and Sodium Homeostasis
subtopics.description: Studies examining kidney tubular mechanisms regulating sodium and potassium excretion, including ENaC, ROMK channels, aldosterone signaling, and dietary potassium effects on proximal tubule transport.
subtopics.short_description: Kidney tubular mechanisms regulating sodium and potassium excretion, including ENaC, ROMK channels, aldosterone signaling, and dietary potassium effects.

subtopics.label: Immune Cell Metabolism, T Cell Function, and Immunotherapy
subtopics.description: Research on metabolic reprogramming in immune cells—particularly T cells and dendritic cells—and how nutrient availability, lipid oxidation, and glycolytic pathways influence antitumor immunity and immunotherapy efficacy.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic reprogramming in T cells and dendritic cells, and how nutrient availability and glycolytic pathways influence immunotherapy efficacy.

subtopics.label: COVID-19, Metabolic Dysregulation, and Nutritional Status
subtopics.description: Studies investigating metabolic and nutritional aspects of COVID-19, including hyperglycemia, insulin resistance, adipose tissue infectivity, multi-omics signatures of disease severity, and albumin kinetics in critically ill patients.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic and nutritional aspects of COVID-19, including hyperglycemia, insulin resistance, adipose tissue infectivity, and multi-omics signatures of disease severity.

subtopics.label: Breast Tissue Composition, Adiposity, and Cancer Risk Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research examining how body fat, adiposity measures, alcohol consumption, and hormonal factors influence breast tissue composition, mammographic features, and breast cancer risk.
subtopics.display_name: Breast Adiposity, Tissue Composition & Cancer Risk
subtopics.short_description: Influence of body fat, adiposity, alcohol consumption, and hormonal factors on breast tissue composition, mammographic features, and cancer risk.

subtopics.label: mTOR Signaling, Lysosomal Nutrient Sensing, and Autophagy
subtopics.description: Studies on nutrient-sensing pathways including mTORC1 regulation by Rap1-GTPases, lysosomal catabolism controlled by phosphoinositide switches, and SAM dynamics as metabolic signals in mammalian cells.
subtopics.short_description: Nutrient-sensing pathways including mTORC1 regulation, lysosomal catabolism via phosphoinositide switches, and SAM dynamics as metabolic signals.

subtopics.label: Neurological Disorders, Brain Metabolism, and Glucose Utilization
subtopics.description: Studies on metabolic underpinnings of neurological conditions including Glut1 deficiency syndrome, Alzheimer's disease succinylation, adenosine deficiency in AD, and triglyceride utilization at synapses.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic underpinnings of neurological conditions including Glut1 deficiency, Alzheimer's-related succinylation, and synaptic triglyceride utilization.

subtopics.label: Obesity Disparities, Behavioral Determinants, and Community Interventions
subtopics.description: Research addressing racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in obesity prevalence and management, including behavioral determinants of eating, community-based interventions, and culturally tailored weight loss programs.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in obesity, behavioral determinants of eating, and culturally tailored community weight-loss programs.

subtopics.label: Hepatic Gene Expression, Dietary Carbohydrates, and Fasting-Feeding Regulation
