subtopics.description: Studies examining how dietary composition and fasting-feeding cycles regulate liver gene expression and transcriptomic responses, including strain-specific differences in mouse models.
subtopics.display_name: Hepatic Gene Expression & Dietary Carbohydrate Regulation
subtopics.short_description: Dietary composition and fasting-feeding cycles regulating liver gene expression and transcriptomic responses, including strain-specific mouse model findings.

subtopics.label: Pediatric and Neonatal Nutrition, Infant Feeding, and Early-Life Metabolic Health
subtopics.description: Studies on nutritional interventions and feeding practices in neonates and children, including lactoferrin supplementation in preterm infants, dextrose gel for neonatal hypoglycemia, breastfeeding practices, and gestational diabetes outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: Pediatric & Neonatal Nutrition for Metabolic Health
subtopics.short_description: Nutritional interventions in neonates and children, including lactoferrin supplementation, neonatal hypoglycemia management, breastfeeding, and gestational diabetes outcomes.

subtopics.label: Adipokines, FGF Signaling, and Cardiometabolic Organ Crosstalk
subtopics.description: Research on adipokine and fibroblast growth factor signaling between adipose tissue and other organs, including FGF21 in metabolic regulation, FGF23/FGFR4 in cardiac remodeling, pancreatic islet responses to adipokines, and NOV silencing in cardiometabolic dysfunction.
subtopics.short_description: Adipokine and fibroblast growth factor signaling between adipose tissue and organs, including FGF21 in metabolic regulation and FGF23 in cardiac remodeling.

subtopics.label: Tryptophan, Kynurenine, and Amino Acid Metabolic Pathways in Disease
subtopics.description: Studies on tryptophan catabolism and related amino acid pathways, including kynurenamine immunomodulation, transsulfuration pathway alterations in ALS, and homoarginine effects on amino acid homeostasis.
subtopics.short_description: Tryptophan catabolism, kynurenamine immunomodulation, transsulfuration pathway alterations in ALS, and homoarginine effects on amino acid homeostasis.

subtopics.label: Racial & Ethnic Disparities in Maternal Morbidity and Mortality
subtopics.description: Research examining racial and ethnic inequities in severe maternal morbidity, mortality, obstetric readmissions, and delivery outcomes across U.S. hospital systems and states. Includes studies on hospital-level racial composition, anesthesia disparities, and interventions to reduce perinatal health inequities.
subtopics.short_description: Racial and ethnic inequities in severe maternal morbidity, mortality, and delivery outcomes across U.S. hospital systems.

subtopics.label: Perinatal Mental Health: Anxiety, Depression, and Psychosocial Risk
subtopics.description: Studies on the prevalence, prediction, biological mechanisms, and clinical management of perinatal mental health conditions including postpartum depression, antenatal anxiety, and peripartum mood disorders. Covers machine learning prediction models, neuroactive steroids, immune phenotypes, and psychosocial risk factors.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, prediction, and management of postpartum depression, antenatal anxiety, and peripartum mood disorders.

subtopics.label: Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy and Cardiovascular Outcomes
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and clinical research on hypertensive disorders of pregnancy including preeclampsia, chronic hypertension, and their associations with maternal cardiovascular morbidity, cerebral oxygen metabolism, postpartum hypertension persistence, and long-term cardiovascular risk.
subtopics.short_description: Preeclampsia, chronic hypertension in pregnancy, and long-term maternal cardiovascular outcomes.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 in Pregnancy: Outcomes, Vaccination, and Perinatal Impact
subtopics.description: Population-level and clinical research on SARS-CoV-2 infection and vaccination during pregnancy, including effects on birth outcomes, placental pathology, maternal morbidity, postpartum length of stay, neonatal management, and vaccine safety and effectiveness in pregnant populations.
subtopics.short_description: SARS-CoV-2 infection and vaccination during pregnancy, including birth outcomes, placental pathology, and vaccine safety.

subtopics.label: Prenatal Substance Use, Policy, and Child Welfare Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology and policy landscape of substance use during pregnancy, including opioid use disorder, cannabis use, prenatal drug screening, and the effects of punitive versus supportive state laws on maternal health, infant maltreatment reports, neonatal outcomes, and child welfare involvement.
subtopics.display_name: Prenatal Substance Use & Child Welfare Policy
subtopics.short_description: Opioid and cannabis use during pregnancy, drug screening policy, and effects on neonatal and child welfare outcomes.

subtopics.label: Gestational Diabetes: Screening, Prevalence, and Community Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies on gestational diabetes mellitus prevalence across diverse populations, glucose challenge test performance and associated outcomes, community health worker-led screening programs, and online support interventions for GDM management.
subtopics.short_description: GDM prevalence, glucose screening performance, and community health worker-led interventions across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Viral Hepatitis (B and C) in Pregnancy and Perinatal Transmission
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and clinical research on hepatitis B and C infection during pregnancy, including seroprevalence, adherence to care guidelines, adverse pregnancy outcomes, mother-to-child transmission risk, and treatment approaches during the perinatal period.
subtopics.short_description: Hepatitis B and C seroprevalence, adverse pregnancy outcomes, and mother-to-child transmission risk during the perinatal period.

subtopics.label: Intrapartum Care, Labor Management, and Cesarean Delivery
subtopics.description: Research on intrapartum clinical practices including oxytocin regimens, cervical ripening, labor analgesia, cesarean delivery decision-making, enhanced recovery after cesarean, VBAC outcomes, and perinatal complications associated with obstetric interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Labor management, oxytocin regimens, cesarean decision-making, VBAC outcomes, and enhanced recovery after delivery.

subtopics.label: Penicillin Allergy Management in Obstetric Patients
subtopics.description: Studies examining the prevalence, clinical management, and outcomes of reported penicillin allergy in pregnant women, including GBS prophylaxis alternatives, outpatient allergy evaluation programs, neonatal outcomes, and cost analyses of antepartum referral programs.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence and management of reported penicillin allergy in pregnancy, including GBS prophylaxis and allergy evaluation programs.

subtopics.label: Placenta Accreta Spectrum: Imaging, Risk Factors, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, ultrasound detection, risk stratification, and clinical outcomes of placenta accreta spectrum disorders, including the role of prior cesarean and myomectomy, novel imaging signs, and prevention through reducing unnecessary cesarean deliveries.
subtopics.short_description: Ultrasound detection, risk stratification, and clinical outcomes of placenta accreta spectrum disorders.

subtopics.label: Family Planning, Contraceptive Access, and Reproductive Health in Tanzania
subtopics.description: Community-based and qualitative research on contraceptive uptake, autonomy, and family planning education in rural Tanzania, including the role of religious leaders, health provider perspectives, and external social influences on women's contraceptive decision-making.
subtopics.display_name: Family Planning & Contraceptive Access in Tanzania
subtopics.short_description: Contraceptive uptake, autonomy, and family planning education in rural Tanzania, including social and religious influences.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health Education and Access
subtopics.description: Research on sexual and reproductive health knowledge, education interventions, and access to care among adolescents including Syrian refugee girls, Latinx youth, and U.S. adolescents, covering topics such as HPV vaccination, privacy laws, and SRH curriculum development.
subtopics.short_description: SRH knowledge, education interventions, and care access among adolescents, including refugee and Latinx youth populations.

subtopics.label: Child and Adolescent Mental Health and Social Determinants of Health
subtopics.description: Population-level studies on child and adolescent mental health outcomes in relation to social determinants of health, COVID-19 pandemic impacts, adverse childhood experiences, screen use, and social network influences, including disparities by race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status.
subtopics.short_description: Child and adolescent mental health outcomes in relation to adverse experiences, social determinants, and pandemic impacts.

subtopics.label: Maternal HIV Antibodies, Vertical Transmission, and Infant Immunization
subtopics.description: Research on maternal HIV-specific antibody responses, broadly neutralizing antibodies, and their role in vertical transmission risk during pregnancy and breastfeeding, including passive immunization strategies and vaccine development for prevention of mother-to-child HIV transmission.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal HIV antibody responses and passive immunization strategies for preventing mother-to-child HIV transmission.

subtopics.label: Congenital Cytomegalovirus Transmission and Maternal Immune Responses
subtopics.description: Studies investigating maternal immune mechanisms—including neutralizing antibodies, Fc-mediated responses, and ADCC-activating antibodies—that influence congenital human cytomegalovirus transmission risk, as well as placental IgG transfer efficiency and vaccine development strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal immune mechanisms influencing congenital cytomegalovirus transmission risk and placental antibody transfer efficiency.

subtopics.label: Pregnancy Complications and Maternal Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Research on pregnancy outcomes complicated by maternal medical conditions including autoimmune disorders (lupus, antiphospholipid syndrome), connective tissue disorders (Marfan syndrome), inflammatory bowel disease, sleep apnea, and other chronic conditions affecting gestational health.
subtopics.short_description: Gestational outcomes complicated by autoimmune disorders, connective tissue disease, IBD, and other chronic maternal conditions.

subtopics.label: Stroke and Vascular Complications in Pregnancy
subtopics.description: Studies examining cerebrovascular and vascular complications during pregnancy and the postpartum period, including cervical artery dissection, pregnancy-associated stroke, and aortic complications.
subtopics.short_description: Cerebrovascular and vascular complications during pregnancy and postpartum, including pregnancy-associated stroke and aortic events.

subtopics.label: Tuberculosis Screening, Prevention, and Immunology in Pregnancy
subtopics.description: Research on tuberculosis diagnosis, prevention, and immune responses during pregnancy, including QuantiFERON assay performance, transcriptional signatures, and safety of preventive therapy regimens in pregnant women.
subtopics.short_description: TB diagnosis, immune responses, and safety of preventive therapy regimens in pregnant women.

subtopics.label: Neonatal Resuscitation, Preterm Infant Care, and NICU Management
subtopics.description: Studies focused on resuscitation techniques, respiratory support, and clinical management of preterm and critically ill neonates in the NICU, including CPAP systems, ventilation strategies, and neonatal hypoglycemia treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Resuscitation techniques, respiratory support, and clinical management of preterm and critically ill neonates.

subtopics.label: Preterm Brain Development and Neurodevelopmental Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining brain development, cerebral blood flow, intraventricular hemorrhage, and neurodevelopmental outcomes in preterm infants, including MRI-based assessments and longitudinal follow-up studies.
subtopics.short_description: Cerebral blood flow, intraventricular hemorrhage, and longitudinal neurodevelopmental outcomes in preterm infants.

subtopics.label: Assisted Reproductive Technology: Outcomes, Access, and Disparities
subtopics.description: Studies on IVF and ART outcomes including the effects of obesity, underweight status, racial disparities, and clinic membership on live birth rates, as well as stroke risk and cognitive development in ART-conceived children.
subtopics.short_description: IVF and ART live birth rates, racial disparities, and long-term health outcomes in ART-conceived children.

subtopics.label: Uterine Fibroids, Myomectomy, and Fertility-Sparing Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of uterine fibroids and other gynecologic conditions through fertility-sparing approaches, including laparoscopic myomectomy, radiofrequency ablation, and reproductive outcomes following surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of uterine fibroids via myomectomy and radiofrequency ablation, with reproductive outcome assessment.

subtopics.label: Maternal and Perinatal Vaccination: Immunogenicity and Safety
subtopics.description: Studies on vaccine safety and immunogenicity in pregnant and lactating women, including Tdap, HPV, hepatitis B, and COVID-19 vaccines, as well as placental antibody transfer and policy strategies for including pregnant women in vaccine trials.
subtopics.short_description: Vaccine immunogenicity and safety in pregnant and lactating women, including placental antibody transfer and trial inclusion policy.

subtopics.label: Fetal Programming, Maternal Stress, and Offspring Neurobiology
subtopics.description: Research on how prenatal maternal exposures—including stress, immune activation, hormones, and cytokines—program offspring brain development, anxiety, and behavioral outcomes through biological mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Prenatal maternal stress, immune activation, and hormonal exposures shaping offspring brain development and behavior.

subtopics.label: Prenatal Diagnosis, Genetic Screening, and Fetal Anomalies
subtopics.description: Studies on prenatal genetic screening, diagnosis of fetal structural and genetic abnormalities, and decision-making around termination of pregnancy for fetal indications, including timing of diagnosis and procedure safety.
subtopics.short_description: Prenatal screening, diagnosis of fetal structural and genetic abnormalities, and decision-making around fetal indications.

subtopics.label: Postpartum Depression: Biomarkers, Prediction, and Digital Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on biological predictors of postpartum depression including neuroactive steroids, machine learning risk models, and AI-based educational platforms for screening and supporting affected women.
subtopics.short_description: Neuroactive steroid predictors, machine learning risk models, and AI-based platforms for postpartum depression screening.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Infectious Disease Management in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Studies on the burden, management, and outcomes of infectious diseases in children in resource-limited settings, including sepsis, pneumonia, malaria, tuberculosis, and diarrheal disease in sub-Saharan Africa and other LMICs.
subtopics.display_name: Pediatric Infectious Disease in Low-Income Settings
subtopics.short_description: Burden and management of sepsis, pneumonia, malaria, and TB in children across sub-Saharan Africa and other LMICs.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Obesity, Nutrition, and Cardiometabolic Risk
subtopics.description: Research on the prevalence, assessment, and management of obesity and related cardiometabolic conditions in children and adolescents, including dietary patterns, physical activity, and clinical practice guidelines.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence and management of childhood obesity, dietary patterns, and cardiometabolic risk in children and adolescents.

subtopics.label: Medicaid Expansion, Insurance Coverage, and Child Welfare Policy
subtopics.description: Studies examining the impact of Medicaid expansion and health insurance policy on child welfare outcomes, foster youth coverage, child maltreatment rates, and access to health services for vulnerable pediatric populations.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of Medicaid expansion and insurance coverage on child maltreatment rates and health access for vulnerable youth.

subtopics.label: Maternal-Neonatal Microbiome, Immunity, and Breastfeeding
subtopics.description: Research on how maternal gut microbiome, breast milk components, and feeding practices shape neonatal immune development and microbiome composition, including engineered antibody delivery via breast milk.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal microbiome, breast milk components, and feeding practices shaping neonatal immune development and microbiome composition.

subtopics.label: NIH Funding, Grants, and Physician-Scientist Career Development
subtopics.description: Research examining NIH funding mechanisms, grant success rates, funding gaps, and career development programs (K-awards, K99/R00, R38) for physician-scientists, surgeon-scientists, and trainees in academic biomedical research.
subtopics.short_description: NIH grant mechanisms, funding success rates, and career development awards for physician-scientists and biomedical trainees.

subtopics.label: Scholarly Activity and Research Training in Residency and Fellowship Programs
subtopics.description: Studies assessing the quantity, quality, and barriers to scholarly activity and research training during medical residency and fellowship programs across pediatrics, surgery, and other specialties.
subtopics.short_description: Quantity, quality, and barriers to scholarly activity and research training across medical residency and fellowship programs.

subtopics.label: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion in Academic Medicine and Research Workforce
subtopics.description: Investigations into representation, promotion, retention, and systemic barriers for underrepresented minorities, women, and other marginalized groups in academic medicine, surgery, and biomedical research.
subtopics.short_description: Representation, promotion, and systemic barriers for underrepresented minorities and women in academic medicine and biomedical research.

subtopics.label: Clinical Trial Design, Conduct, Quality, and Premature Termination
subtopics.description: Analyses of the characteristics, methodological quality, reporting standards, and factors leading to premature termination of randomized controlled trials across surgical and medical specialties.
subtopics.short_description: Methodological quality, reporting standards, and factors driving premature termination of randomized controlled trials.

subtopics.label: Peer Review, Scientific Publishing, and Research Integrity
subtopics.description: Studies examining the peer review process, publication practices, article retractions, research misconduct, conflicts of interest, and integrity frameworks in biomedical literature.
subtopics.short_description: Publication practices, article retractions, research misconduct, and integrity frameworks in biomedical literature.

subtopics.label: Electronic Health Records, Data Warehouses, and Clinical Research Informatics Infrastructure
subtopics.description: Research on enterprise data warehouses, EHR-based data extraction, common data models, and informatics infrastructure supporting clinical and translational research at academic medical centers.
subtopics.short_description: Enterprise data warehouses, EHR-based data extraction, and informatics infrastructure supporting translational research.

subtopics.label: Biobanking, Biospecimen Collection, and Repository Management
subtopics.description: Studies addressing the establishment, standardization, ethical governance, and operational management of biobanks and biospecimen repositories, including space biobanking and pandemic-era adaptations.
subtopics.short_description: Establishment, ethical governance, and operational management of biobanks and biospecimen repositories.

subtopics.label: Race, Ethnicity Data Quality, and Representation in Research Databases
subtopics.description: Investigations into the accuracy, completeness, and standardization of race and ethnicity data in EHRs, clinical registries, and research publications, and their implications for health equity research.
subtopics.display_name: Race & Ethnicity Data Quality in Research
subtopics.short_description: Accuracy and standardization of race and ethnicity data in EHRs, registries, and publications for health equity research.

subtopics.label: Systematic Reviews, Evidence Synthesis Methods, and Literature Search Quality
subtopics.description: Research on the methodology, quality assessment, search strategies, and infrastructure supporting systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and evidence synthesis in biomedical research.
subtopics.short_description: Methodology, search quality, and infrastructure supporting systematic reviews and meta-analyses in biomedical research.

subtopics.label: Clinical Registries, Coordinated Registry Networks, and Real-World Evidence
subtopics.description: Studies developing and evaluating coordinated registry networks, data linkage algorithms, and real-world evidence frameworks for medical devices and clinical outcomes research.
subtopics.short_description: Coordinated registry networks, data linkage algorithms, and real-world evidence frameworks for clinical outcomes research.

subtopics.label: Omics Technologies, Sequencing Platforms, and Benchmarking Standards
subtopics.description: Studies benchmarking and standardizing next-generation sequencing, epigenomics, metabolomics, and other omics platforms to ensure reproducibility and data quality in biomedical research.
subtopics.short_description: Benchmarking and standardization of next-generation sequencing, epigenomics, and metabolomics for reproducible biomedical research.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence, NLP, and Machine Learning in Biomedical Research Infrastructure
subtopics.description: Research developing and evaluating AI, natural language processing, and machine learning tools for biomedical data extraction, image analysis, literature mining, and clinical research support.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning and natural language processing tools for biomedical data extraction, image analysis, and literature mining.

subtopics.label: Institutional Repositories, Research Data Management, and Knowledge Dissemination
subtopics.description: Studies on institutional repositories, research data systems, authorship tracking tools, library services, and computable biomedical knowledge frameworks that support research dissemination and discovery.
subtopics.short_description: Institutional repositories, authorship tracking tools, and computable knowledge frameworks supporting research discovery.

subtopics.label: Clinical Trial Recruitment, Participant Engagement, and Research Participation
subtopics.description: Research on strategies, barriers, and facilitators for recruiting diverse participants into clinical trials and research studies, including older adults, minority populations, and caregivers.
subtopics.short_description: Strategies and barriers for recruiting diverse participants, including older adults and minority populations, into clinical trials.

subtopics.label: Global Health Research Capacity Building and International Collaboration
subtopics.description: Studies examining infrastructure development, training programs, and collaborative frameworks to build research capacity in low-resource settings and among underrepresented global health researchers.
subtopics.short_description: Infrastructure development and training programs to build research capacity in low-resource settings and underrepresented communities.

subtopics.label: Laboratory Methods, Cell Line Generation, and Biological Sample Preparation
subtopics.description: Research focused on protocols and techniques for preparing biological samples, generating cell lines, and isolating biological materials including DNA, extracellular vesicles, and skeletal cells for downstream analysis.
subtopics.short_description: Protocols for preparing biological samples, generating cell lines, and isolating DNA and other materials for downstream analysis.

subtopics.label: Genomic Databases, Bioinformatics Atlases, and Computational Biology Resources
subtopics.description: Development and characterization of genomic and transcriptomic databases, atlases, and bioinformatics tools including cancer driver databases, transcriptome atlases, transposon sequencing databases, and protein interaction resources.
subtopics.short_description: Development of genomic atlases, cancer driver databases, and computational biology tools for transcriptomic and proteomic research.

subtopics.label: Medical Imaging Data Standards, Formats, and Reproducibility Frameworks
subtopics.description: Research establishing standardized data formats, acquisition protocols, and reproducibility frameworks for medical and biological imaging modalities including MRI, MRS, AFM, and neuroimaging classification models.
subtopics.short_description: Standardized data formats, acquisition protocols, and reproducibility frameworks for MRI, neuroimaging, and biological imaging.

subtopics.label: Fellowship and Residency Program Director Demographics and Leadership Characteristics
subtopics.description: Descriptive analyses of the demographic composition, qualifications, and leadership characteristics of program directors across medical specialties including radiology, ophthalmology, and interventional radiology.
subtopics.short_description: Demographic composition, qualifications, and leadership characteristics of program directors across medical specialties.

subtopics.label: Academic Medicine Compensation, Staffing Shortages, and Workforce Equity
subtopics.description: Studies examining compensation models, salary transparency, staffing shortages, and workforce equity issues across academic medical specialties including radiology, emergency medicine, and otolaryngology.
subtopics.short_description: Compensation models, salary transparency, staffing shortages, and workforce equity across academic medical specialties.

subtopics.label: Preclinical Tumor Models and Experimental Platforms for Drug Discovery
subtopics.description: Development and application of in vivo and ex vivo tumor models, patient-derived xenografts, and automated experimental platforms for cancer drug discovery and neuroscience research.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived xenografts and automated experimental platforms for cancer drug discovery and neuroscience research.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Practice Adaptation, Treatment Guidelines, and Epidemiological Data
subtopics.description: Research documenting institutional and national responses to COVID-19 including clinical practice adaptations, treatment guideline development, and epidemiological data resources.
subtopics.short_description: Institutional and national responses to COVID-19, including clinical practice adaptations and epidemiological data resources.

subtopics.label: Specialty Society Awards, Recognition, and Gender Equity in Academic Medicine
subtopics.description: Analyses of recognition awards and honors within medical specialty societies, with a focus on identifying gender and demographic disparities in award recipients.
subtopics.short_description: Gender and demographic disparities in recognition awards and honors across medical specialty societies.

subtopics.label: Clinical Trial Outcomes Extraction, NLP Datasets, and Evidence Annotation
subtopics.description: Development of annotated datasets and NLP benchmarks for extracting clinically meaningful outcomes from trial publications, supporting automated evidence synthesis.
subtopics.short_description: Annotated datasets and NLP benchmarks for extracting clinically meaningful outcomes from trial publications.

subtopics.label: Genetic Variant Classification, Reclassification, and Genetic Counselor Training
subtopics.description: Studies addressing the evidence quality behind genetic variant classification and reclassification, and the training needs of genetic counselors in emerging subspecialties.
subtopics.short_description: Evidence quality behind genetic variant reclassification and training needs of genetic counselors in emerging subspecialties.

subtopics.label: Cytopathology, Histopathology, and Surgical Pathology
subtopics.description: Research focused on morphologic evaluation of tissue and cytology specimens, including fine-needle aspiration, Papanicolaou tests, immunohistochemistry, and histopathologic characterization of tumors and non-neoplastic lesions across organ systems.
subtopics.short_description: Morphologic evaluation of tissue and cytology specimens, including immunohistochemistry and tumor characterization across organ systems.

subtopics.label: Molecular and Genomic Characterization of Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies employing next-generation sequencing, whole-genome/exome sequencing, RNA sequencing, and molecular profiling to characterize somatic mutations, structural variants, copy number alterations, and gene fusions in solid tumors and hematologic malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Next-generation sequencing and molecular profiling to characterize mutations, structural variants, and gene fusions in solid and hematologic cancers.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy, Circulating Tumor DNA, and Cell-Free DNA
subtopics.description: Research on detection, quantification, and clinical utility of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), cell-free DNA (cfDNA), and circulating tumor cells (CTCs) for cancer diagnosis, monitoring treatment response, and detecting resistance mutations.
subtopics.short_description: Detection and clinical utility of ctDNA, cell-free DNA, and circulating tumor cells for cancer diagnosis, treatment monitoring, and resistance detection.

subtopics.label: Digital Pathology, Computational Pathology, and AI-Based Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Development and validation of machine learning, deep learning, and image analysis algorithms applied to whole slide images, tissue microarrays, multiplexed imaging, and other pathology data for automated diagnosis, classification, and biomarker quantification.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning and image analysis algorithms applied to whole slide images for automated diagnosis, classification, and biomarker quantification.

subtopics.label: Clinical Laboratory Assays, Diagnostics, and Test Validation
subtopics.description: Development, validation, and performance evaluation of clinical laboratory tests including immunoassays, PCR-based assays, flow cytometry, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and point-of-care diagnostics for infectious diseases, cancer, and other conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Development and validation of immunoassays, PCR-based tests, flow cytometry, and point-of-care diagnostics for infectious disease, cancer, and other conditions.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 and SARS-CoV-2 Pathology and Laboratory Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Histopathologic, molecular, and laboratory investigations of SARS-CoV-2 infection, including autopsy findings, tissue pathology, serological assays, viral load measurements, and multi-omic profiling of COVID-19 disease severity and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Histopathologic, molecular, and serological investigations of SARS-CoV-2 infection, including autopsy findings and multi-omic profiling of disease severity.

subtopics.label: Transplant Pathology and Allograft Monitoring
subtopics.description: Molecular, genomic, and histopathologic studies of kidney, liver, and lung allograft rejection, including urinary cell mRNA profiling, donor-derived cell-free DNA, RNA sequencing, and noninvasive biomarkers for diagnosing acute and chronic rejection and BK virus nephropathy.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and histopathologic assessment of allograft rejection using donor-derived cell-free DNA, RNA sequencing, and noninvasive biomarkers.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy as a Biomarker of Neuropathy and Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Studies using corneal confocal microscopy (CCM) to detect and quantify corneal nerve fiber loss and immune cell changes as surrogate biomarkers for diabetic neuropathy, neurodegenerative diseases, multiple sclerosis, and other systemic conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Corneal nerve fiber loss and immune cell changes as surrogate biomarkers for diabetic neuropathy and neurodegenerative disease.

subtopics.label: Epigenomics, DNA Methylation, and Epigenetic Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research on DNA methylation profiling, epigenetic alterations, and chromatin-based analyses in cancer and other diseases, including methylation-based liquid biopsy assays, MGMT methylation, and epigenetic biomarkers for diagnosis and prognosis.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation profiling and epigenetic alterations in cancer, including methylation-based liquid biopsy assays and prognostic biomarker discovery.

subtopics.label: Extracellular Vesicles and Particle-Based Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing extracellular vesicles (EVs), exosomes, and particles as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in cancer, cardiovascular disease, HIV, and other conditions, including proteomic profiling and functional analyses.
subtopics.short_description: Characterization of extracellular vesicles and exosomes as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in cancer, cardiovascular disease, and HIV.

subtopics.label: Hematopathology: Myeloid Neoplasms and Lymphomas
subtopics.description: Clinicopathologic and molecular characterization of hematologic malignancies including acute myeloid leukemia, myelodysplastic syndromes, lymphomas, and multiple myeloma, encompassing bone marrow biopsy evaluation, flow cytometry, cytogenetics, and molecular diagnostics.
subtopics.short_description: Clinicopathologic and molecular characterization of leukemia, myelodysplastic syndromes, lymphomas, and myeloma using cytogenetics and molecular diagnostics.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Pathology, Biomarkers, and Molecular Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research on histopathologic grading, molecular profiling, genomic biomarkers, and imaging-pathology correlations in prostate cancer, including Gleason grading, genomic risk scores, multiparametric MRI-biopsy concordance, and tumor microenvironment characterization.
subtopics.short_description: Histopathologic grading, genomic risk scores, and imaging-pathology correlations in prostate cancer, including tumor microenvironment characterization.

subtopics.label: Thyroid and Endocrine Pathology and Cytopathology
subtopics.description: Studies on thyroid nodule evaluation by fine-needle aspiration cytology, molecular testing, histopathologic classification of thyroid carcinomas, and clinicopathologic features of endocrine tumors including parathyroid and adrenal neoplasms.
subtopics.short_description: Fine-needle aspiration cytology, molecular testing, and histopathologic classification of thyroid carcinomas and endocrine neoplasms.

subtopics.label: Infectious Disease Laboratory Diagnostics and Microbiology
subtopics.description: Development and evaluation of laboratory methods for detecting and characterizing bacterial, viral, fungal, and parasitic pathogens, including molecular diagnostics, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, rapid point-of-care tests, and epidemiological surveillance.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and rapid diagnostic methods for detecting bacterial, viral, fungal, and parasitic pathogens, including antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

subtopics.label: Breast Pathology, Tissue Biomarkers, and Histologic Characterization
subtopics.description: Research on histopathologic features, immunohistochemical biomarkers, tissue composition, and molecular characterization of benign and malignant breast lesions, including HER2 testing, stem cell markers, breast density, and radiologic-pathologic correlation.
subtopics.short_description: Histopathologic features, immunohistochemical biomarkers, and molecular characterization of benign and malignant breast lesions, including HER2 testing.

subtopics.label: Statistical Methods and Biostatistical Methodology
subtopics.description: Development and application of novel statistical methods including Bayesian approaches, quantile regression, zero-inflated models, survival analysis, mixed effects models, and nonparametric testing for biomedical data, with emphasis on microbiome, omics, and high-dimensional settings.
subtopics.short_description: Novel statistical approaches for biomedical data, including Bayesian, survival, mixed-effects, and high-dimensional omics methods.

subtopics.label: Clinical Trial Design, Conduct, and Reporting
subtopics.description: Research on the design, rationale, conduct, and reporting quality of randomized controlled trials and pragmatic trials, including adaptive designs, registry-based trials, trial termination predictors, and methodological standards for surgical and cardiovascular RCTs.
subtopics.short_description: Design, conduct, and reporting standards for randomized and pragmatic trials, including adaptive and registry-based trial methods.

subtopics.label: Risk Prediction Models and Clinical Decision Tools
subtopics.description: Development, validation, and comparative evaluation of risk prediction models and clinical scoring tools for disease outcomes, including prognostic scores, nomograms, and risk stratification instruments applied across cardiovascular, oncologic, neurologic, and other clinical domains.
subtopics.short_description: Development and validation of prognostic models, scoring tools, and risk stratification instruments across clinical domains.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence in Health Research
subtopics.description: Application of machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and artificial intelligence methods to clinical prediction, disease classification, patient subphenotyping, electronic health record analysis, and medical imaging interpretation in biomedical research.
subtopics.display_name: Machine Learning & AI in Health Research
subtopics.short_description: AI and machine learning methods for clinical prediction, disease classification, EHR analysis, and medical imaging interpretation.

subtopics.label: Causal Inference and Comparative Effectiveness Research
subtopics.description: Studies employing causal inference frameworks including target trial emulation, propensity score methods, instrumental variables, difference-in-differences, and observational study designs to estimate treatment effects and compare interventions using real-world data.
subtopics.short_description: Propensity scores, target trial emulation, and observational designs to estimate real-world treatment effects.

subtopics.label: Epidemiological Modeling and Infectious Disease Surveillance
subtopics.description: Mathematical modeling, seroprevalence studies, vaccine effectiveness estimation, and epidemiological analyses of infectious diseases including SARS-CoV-2, HIV, tuberculosis, hepatitis, and sexually transmitted infections, with focus on transmission dynamics and intervention impact.
subtopics.short_description: Mathematical modeling, vaccine effectiveness estimation, and surveillance of infectious diseases including COVID-19, HIV, and tuberculosis.

subtopics.label: Health Disparities, Social Determinants of Health, and Equity Research
subtopics.description: Quantitative research examining racial, ethnic, socioeconomic, and geographic disparities in health outcomes, access to care, and treatment utilization, including studies on social determinants of health and their association with cardiovascular, maternal, oncologic, and other outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Quantitative analysis of racial, socioeconomic, and geographic inequities in health outcomes, access, and treatment utilization.

subtopics.label: Real-World Evidence, Healthcare Utilization, and Health Policy
subtopics.description: Analyses of administrative claims, electronic health records, and registry data to evaluate healthcare utilization patterns, costs, quality of care, policy impacts (including Medicaid expansion, opioid laws, and payment models), and provider or system-level performance.
subtopics.short_description: Claims, EHR, and registry analyses evaluating healthcare utilization, costs, quality of care, and policy impacts.

subtopics.label: Omics, Multi-omics, and Biomarker Discovery
subtopics.description: Statistical and computational methods for analyzing genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic, and epigenomic data, including biomarker discovery, multi-omics integration, pathway analysis, and population-level omics studies for disease prediction and characterization.
subtopics.short_description: Statistical methods for genomic, proteomic, and metabolomic data analysis, biomarker discovery, and multi-omics integration.

subtopics.label: Patient Subphenotyping, Clustering, and Precision Medicine
subtopics.description: Data-driven identification of patient subgroups and disease subphenotypes using clustering, latent class analysis, and unsupervised learning applied to clinical, imaging, and omics data, with the goal of informing precision medicine and tailored treatment strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Data-driven patient subgroup identification using clustering and latent class analysis to inform tailored treatment strategies.

subtopics.label: Survival Analysis, Longitudinal Methods, and Time-to-Event Outcomes
subtopics.description: Application and development of survival analysis methods, longitudinal data analysis, and time-to-event modeling in clinical and epidemiological research, including dynamic prediction, competing risks, and methods for handling censoring and time-varying covariates.
subtopics.short_description: Time-to-event modeling, competing risks, and longitudinal data methods for clinical and epidemiological research.

subtopics.label: Diagnostic Accuracy, Measurement Validation, and Instrument Development
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating the diagnostic performance, reliability, and validity of clinical tests, imaging modalities, biomarkers, patient-reported outcome instruments, and clinical scales, including sensitivity/specificity analyses and psychometric validation.
subtopics.short_description: Sensitivity, specificity, and psychometric validation of clinical tests, biomarkers, imaging modalities, and patient-reported instruments.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use, Substance Use Disorders, and Drug Policy Research
subtopics.description: Quantitative research on opioid prescribing patterns, persistent opioid use, substance use disorder treatment effectiveness and cost-effectiveness, naloxone distribution, and the impact of drug policies including prescribing cap laws, PDMP mandates, and cannabis legalization.
subtopics.short_description: Quantitative analysis of opioid prescribing, substance use disorder treatment, and the impact of drug policy interventions.

subtopics.label: Cost-Effectiveness Analysis and Health Economic Evaluation
subtopics.description: Economic evaluations including cost-effectiveness analyses, cost-benefit analyses, and budget impact models applied to medical interventions, screening programs, drug therapies, and health policies, with emphasis on methodological rigor and decision-analytic modeling.
subtopics.short_description: Decision-analytic modeling and economic evaluation of medical interventions, screening programs, and health policies.

subtopics.label: Obstructive Sleep Apnea: Cardiovascular and Metabolic Consequences
subtopics.description: Research examining the cardiovascular and metabolic consequences of obstructive sleep apnea, including platelet activation, blood pressure effects, CPAP therapy outcomes, and biomarkers such as NOV and endothelial progenitor cells linked to OSA severity.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular and metabolic effects of obstructive sleep apnea, including blood pressure, platelet activation, and CPAP outcomes.

subtopics.label: Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Special Clinical Populations
subtopics.description: Studies investigating OSA prevalence, risk factors, and outcomes in specific populations including infants, pregnant women, pediatric obesity, thyroid eye disease patients, and surgical patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty.
subtopics.short_description: OSA prevalence, risk factors, and outcomes in infants, pregnant women, pediatric obesity, and surgical patients.

subtopics.label: OSA Treatment: CPAP and Oral Appliance Therapies
subtopics.description: Research evaluating therapeutic interventions for obstructive sleep apnea, including mandibular advancement devices, CPAP efficacy comparisons, and their effects on clinical outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: CPAP & Oral Appliance Therapies for OSA
subtopics.short_description: Comparative efficacy of CPAP and mandibular advancement devices as therapeutic interventions for obstructive sleep apnea.

subtopics.label: Sleep Disruption, Neurodegeneration, and Cognitive Decline
subtopics.description: Research linking impaired sleep to neurodegenerative processes including tau deposition, NREM delta power, tauopathy gene networks, and accelerated cognitive decline in Alzheimer's disease and related conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Links between impaired sleep, tau deposition, NREM delta power, and accelerated cognitive decline in Alzheimer's disease.

subtopics.label: Sleep Disorders in Parkinson's Disease and REM Sleep Behavior Disorder
subtopics.description: Studies on sleep disturbances in Parkinson's disease and isolated REM sleep behavior disorder (iRBD), including light therapy interventions, ambient lighting trials, and neurologic features predicting phenoconversion.
subtopics.short_description: Sleep disturbances in Parkinson's disease and REM sleep behavior disorder, including light therapy and phenoconversion predictors.

subtopics.label: Molecular and Cellular Mechanisms of Circadian Clock Biology
subtopics.description: Research into the molecular underpinnings of circadian rhythms, including the role of TIMELESS in synaptic memory via cAMP signaling, circadian regulation of cell differentiation, and circadian glucocorticoid oscillations driving metabolic dysfunction.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular underpinnings of circadian rhythms, including cAMP signaling, cell differentiation, and glucocorticoid oscillations.

subtopics.label: Wearable Technology and AI for Sleep Monitoring and Disorders
subtopics.description: Studies applying wearable devices and artificial intelligence to detect, monitor, and manage sleep disorders, including scoping reviews of wearable AI for sleep apnea diagnosis and assessment of sleep in hepatic encephalopathy.
subtopics.short_description: Wearable devices and artificial intelligence applied to the detection, monitoring, and management of sleep disorders.

subtopics.label: Auditory and Environmental Interventions for Sleep Improvement
subtopics.description: Research evaluating the effects of auditory stimulation (white noise, sound) and environmental factors (extreme heat, ambient lighting) on sleep quality and duration.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of white noise, sound stimulation, ambient lighting, and extreme heat on sleep quality and duration.

subtopics.label: Sleep Management Education in Palliative and Clinical Care Settings
subtopics.description: Studies developing and evaluating educational interventions to improve sleep management knowledge among palliative care and clinical professionals, including online programs and staff training initiatives.
subtopics.short_description: Educational programs and staff training initiatives to improve sleep management knowledge in palliative and clinical care settings.

subtopics.label: Sleep and Mental Health: Psychiatric Disorders and Psychological Well-being
subtopics.description: Research examining the bidirectional relationships between sleep and psychiatric conditions including schizophrenia, depression, and anxiety, as well as the role of bedtime and coping skills in mental health outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Bidirectional relationships between sleep and psychiatric conditions including schizophrenia, depression, anxiety, and psychological well-being.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Effects on Sleep and Mental Health
subtopics.description: Studies examining how COVID-19 pandemic policies, lockdowns, and long COVID sequelae (including brain fog and PASC subphenotypes) affect sleep patterns, mental health, and child well-being.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of pandemic lockdowns and long COVID sequelae on sleep patterns, mental health, and child well-being.

subtopics.label: Sleep Quality in Chronic Conditions and Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Research investigating sleep quality and its associations with chronic comorbid conditions including tinnitus, cancer in hospitalized children, and musculoskeletal disorders, using both subjective and objective sleep measures.
subtopics.short_description: Sleep quality associations with chronic conditions including tinnitus, pediatric cancer, and musculoskeletal disorders.

subtopics.label: Sleep Deprivation, Fatigue, and Occupational Safety
subtopics.description: Research on the consequences of sleep restriction and fatigue in occupational contexts, including driving safety impairment among surgical residents and the effects of mild sleep restriction on blood pressure.
subtopics.short_description: Consequences of sleep restriction and fatigue in occupational settings, including driving impairment and blood pressure effects.

subtopics.label: Nocturnal Heart Rate Variability and Autonomic Function
subtopics.description: Research examining nocturnal heart rate variability and blood pressure dipping patterns as markers of autonomic dysfunction, including in HIV-positive individuals and pregnant women with anxiety.
subtopics.display_name: Nocturnal Heart Rate Variability & Autonomic Function
subtopics.short_description: Nocturnal heart rate variability and blood pressure dipping as markers of autonomic dysfunction across clinical populations.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Screening and Risk Prediction
subtopics.description: Research on mammographic screening modalities (digital mammography, tomosynthesis, abbreviated MRI), risk prediction models including polygenic risk scores, and screening program effectiveness across diverse populations. Includes studies on mammographic density as a risk factor and screening disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Mammographic and MRI screening approaches, polygenic risk scores, and mammographic density as a risk factor across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Hormone Receptor-Positive Breast Cancer Treatment and Endocrine Therapy
subtopics.description: Studies on treatment of hormone receptor-positive breast cancer including CDK4/6 inhibitors (palbociclib), aromatase inhibitors, tamoxifen, endocrine therapy adherence and side effects, and outcomes in luminal subtypes. Includes pharmacogenomics of endocrine therapy and management of metastatic HR+ disease.
subtopics.short_description: CDK4/6 inhibitors, aromatase inhibitors, tamoxifen, and endocrine therapy outcomes in luminal and metastatic HR+ breast cancer.

subtopics.label: Triple-Negative and HER2-Positive Breast Cancer Biology and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular biology, targeted therapies, and clinical outcomes of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) and HER2-positive breast cancer, including immunotherapy combinations, neoadjuvant chemotherapy response prediction, and novel therapeutic targets.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular biology, targeted therapies, immunotherapy combinations, and neoadjuvant response prediction in TNBC and HER2-positive disease.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy: Circulating Tumor Cells and Circulating Tumor DNA
subtopics.description: Studies on the detection, characterization, and clinical utility of circulating tumor cells (CTCs) and circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) in breast cancer, including their use for treatment monitoring, resistance profiling, and prognostication in metastatic disease.
subtopics.short_description: Detection and clinical utility of circulating tumor cells and circulating tumor DNA for treatment monitoring and resistance profiling.

subtopics.label: Breast Reconstruction: Surgical Techniques and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on postmastectomy breast reconstruction including implant-based and autologous (DIEP flap) techniques, complications such as capsular contracture and skin necrosis, nipple reconstruction, and comparative outcomes across reconstruction methods.
subtopics.short_description: Implant-based and autologous reconstruction techniques, complications, nipple reconstruction, and comparative surgical outcomes.

subtopics.label: Radiotherapy and Immunotherapy in Breast Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on radiation therapy approaches for breast cancer including hypofractionation, prone positioning, MRI-guided radiotherapy, and the combination of radiation with immunotherapy (checkpoint inhibitors, TLR agonists, CD40 agonism). Includes studies on radiation-induced neoantigens and immune modulation.
subtopics.short_description: Hypofractionation, MRI-guided radiotherapy, and radiation combined with checkpoint inhibitors and immune modulators.

subtopics.label: Breast Imaging, Diagnosis, and Biopsy
subtopics.description: Studies on breast imaging modalities including MRI (DCE-MRI, abbreviated MRI), ultrasound, contrast-enhanced mammography, and tomosynthesis for lesion detection, characterization, and biopsy guidance. Includes quantitative imaging methods, AI-assisted image analysis, and management of imaging findings.
subtopics.short_description: MRI, ultrasound, contrast-enhanced mammography, and AI-assisted image analysis for lesion detection, characterization, and biopsy guidance.

subtopics.label: Racial, Ethnic, and Socioeconomic Disparities in Breast Cancer
subtopics.description: Research examining disparities in breast cancer incidence, treatment access, reconstruction rates, psychosocial care, and outcomes across racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic groups. Includes studies on African American, Hispanic, and Asian American populations and interventions to reduce disparities.
subtopics.short_description: Disparities in breast cancer incidence, treatment access, reconstruction rates, and outcomes across racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic groups.

subtopics.label: Hereditary Breast Cancer Genetics and Cascade Testing
subtopics.description: Research on hereditary breast cancer risk genes (BRCA1/2 and others), cascade genetic testing strategies, polygenic risk scores, variant classification, and the molecular consequences of BRCA deficiency including DNA repair mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: BRCA1/2 and other hereditary risk genes, cascade testing strategies, polygenic risk scores, and DNA repair mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Breast Tumor Molecular Biology and Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Studies on the molecular biology of breast cancer including gene expression, non-coding RNAs, transcription factors, signaling pathways (PI3K, STIM1/NFAT1), tumor heterogeneity, and tissue biomarkers such as stem cell markers (CD44, CD24, ALDH1A1) and IHC-based assays.
subtopics.short_description: Gene expression, signaling pathways, tumor heterogeneity, and tissue biomarkers including stem cell markers and IHC-based assays.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Metastasis and Tumor Metabolism
subtopics.description: Research on mechanisms of breast cancer metastasis including organ tropism, metabolic reprogramming (copper, propionate, glucose metabolism), and novel therapeutic strategies targeting metastatic progression in TNBC and other subtypes.
subtopics.short_description: Organ tropism, metabolic reprogramming, and therapeutic strategies targeting metastatic progression in TNBC and other subtypes.

subtopics.label: Ductal Carcinoma In Situ and Early-Stage Breast Cancer Management
subtopics.description: Studies on the diagnosis, treatment decision-making, quality of life, and patient-reported outcomes in ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) and early-stage breast cancer, including cryoablation, active surveillance criteria, and local therapy choices.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, treatment decision-making, active surveillance, and patient-reported outcomes in DCIS and early-stage breast cancer.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Risk Factors, Epidemiology, and Tissue Composition
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies on breast cancer risk factors including reproductive factors, diet (carotenoids, vitamin D), anthropometric measures, alcohol, environmental exposures (radon, PM2.5), and their associations with breast tissue composition and cancer incidence.
subtopics.short_description: Reproductive factors, diet, environmental exposures, and anthropometric measures in relation to breast tissue composition and cancer incidence.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Survivorship, Quality of Life, and Comorbidity Management
subtopics.description: Research on survivorship issues in breast cancer including quality of life after treatment, management of comorbidities (diabetes, cardiovascular disease), weight management, psychosocial well-being, and patient-reported outcomes during and after treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Quality of life, comorbidity management, psychosocial well-being, and patient-reported outcomes during and after breast cancer treatment.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Vaccine Effects and Pandemic Impact on Breast Imaging
subtopics.description: Research examining COVID-19 vaccine-induced axillary adenopathy and its imaging implications, as well as the pandemic's disruption of breast imaging volumes and operational recovery across North America.
subtopics.short_description: Vaccine-induced axillary adenopathy and its imaging implications, plus pandemic disruption of breast imaging volumes and recovery.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genome Structural Variation and Multi-Omics Characterization
subtopics.description: Studies applying genome-scale sequencing and multi-omics approaches to characterize complex structural variants, chromatin conformation, and tumor heterogeneity across cancer types including breast cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Genome-scale sequencing and multi-omics characterization of structural variants, chromatin conformation, and tumor heterogeneity.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning and Computational Methods in Precision Oncology
subtopics.description: Development and application of machine learning models—including biologically constrained and deep learning frameworks—to improve cancer risk prediction, treatment response, and molecular profiling.
subtopics.short_description: Biologically constrained and deep learning models for cancer risk prediction, treatment response, and molecular profiling.

subtopics.label: CDK Inhibitors and Cell Cycle Regulation in Breast Cancer
subtopics.description: Mechanistic and translational studies of CDK4/6 inhibitors and their effects on cell cycle regulators such as p21 and CDK2, informing therapeutic strategies in breast cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanistic and translational studies of CDK4/6 inhibitors and cell cycle regulators informing breast cancer therapeutic strategies.

subtopics.label: Exercise, Immune Microenvironment, and Reproductive Factors in Breast Cancer
subtopics.description: Research investigating how physical activity and reproductive factors modulate the breast tumor immune microenvironment and influence cancer progression in preclinical and clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Physical activity and reproductive factors as modulators of the breast tumor immune microenvironment and cancer progression.

subtopics.label: Cardiotoxicity and Cardio-Oncology in Breast Cancer Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies assessing cardiac toxicity from breast cancer therapies—including radiotherapy and chemotherapy—using imaging modalities such as PET and MRI to monitor subacute and chronic cardiovascular effects.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiac toxicity from radiotherapy and chemotherapy, monitored via PET and MRI imaging for cardiovascular effects.

subtopics.label: Cancer Screening Access, Policy, and Health System Interventions
subtopics.description: Population-level studies examining adherence to cancer screening guidelines across diverse patient groups—including stroke survivors, mental illness patients, and Medicaid enrollees—and the policy interventions that affect screening uptake.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level screening adherence across diverse patient groups and policy interventions affecting cancer screening uptake.

subtopics.label: Patient-Derived Models and Novel Biomarkers for Cancer Detection
subtopics.description: Development of patient-derived in vitro and in vivo cancer models and novel blood-based or imaging biomarkers—including methylation assays and circulating macrophage-like cells—for cancer detection and monitoring.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived cancer models and blood-based or imaging biomarkers, including methylation assays, for cancer detection and monitoring.

subtopics.label: Global Health, Capacity Building, and Decision Support in Oncology
subtopics.description: Research addressing global breast oncology capacity-building in low-resource settings, decision-making support for racial and ethnic minorities, and health literacy as a determinant of cancer outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Capacity-building in low-resource settings, decision support for minority populations, and health literacy as a cancer outcomes determinant.

subtopics.label: Advanced PET Imaging and HER2/ER Biomarker Assessment in Breast Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies utilizing advanced PET imaging modalities such as FES-PET for estrogen receptor-positive brain metastases and evaluating HER2 protein expression levels including very low HER2 subsets.
subtopics.short_description: FES-PET for ER-positive brain metastases and evaluation of HER2 protein expression levels including very low HER2 subsets.

subtopics.label: Adolescent and Young Adult Cancer: Fertility Preservation and Trial Participation
subtopics.description: Research focused on adolescent and young adult cancer patients, including fertility preservation service utilization, clinical trial accrual patterns, and SOGI data collection to address underrepresentation.
subtopics.short_description: Fertility preservation, clinical trial accrual, and SOGI data collection for adolescent and young adult cancer patients.

subtopics.label: Hereditary Cancer Risk Communication and Family Notification
subtopics.description: Studies examining the communication of hereditary cancer risk information to at-risk relatives, including barriers to family notification and the role of diverse ancestry consortia in understanding hereditary cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Communication of hereditary cancer risk to at-risk relatives, barriers to family notification, and diverse ancestry consortium research.

subtopics.label: Extent of Surgical Resection in Early-Stage NSCLC
subtopics.description: Research comparing lobectomy, segmentectomy, and wedge resection for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer, focusing on oncologic outcomes, locoregional recurrence, survival, and lymph node dissection strategies.
subtopics.display_name: Surgical Resection Extent in Early NSCLC
subtopics.short_description: Comparative outcomes of lobectomy, segmentectomy, and wedge resection for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer.

subtopics.label: Neoadjuvant Immunotherapy and Radiation in NSCLC
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and analyses evaluating neoadjuvant durvalumab, stereotactic body radiotherapy, and chemoimmunotherapy combinations in resectable non-small cell lung cancer, including pathologic response rates, surgical feasibility, and survival outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Pathologic response, surgical feasibility, and survival outcomes from neoadjuvant immunotherapy and SBRT combinations in resectable NSCLC.

subtopics.label: Lung Cancer Screening, Access, and Racial Disparities
subtopics.description: Studies examining lung cancer screening utilization, guideline eligibility, racial and ethnic disparities, risk-model-based screening approaches, and implementation strategies to improve screening uptake in diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Screening utilization, guideline eligibility gaps, and racial disparities in lung cancer detection across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Molecular Drivers and Targeted Therapy in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on oncogenic driver mutations (EGFR, KRAS, ALK, LKB1) and targeted therapeutic strategies in lung adenocarcinoma and NSCLC, including resistance mechanisms, allelic variation, and drug sensitivity profiles.
subtopics.short_description: Oncogenic driver mutations (EGFR, KRAS, ALK) and targeted treatment strategies, including resistance mechanisms in NSCLC.

subtopics.label: Tumor Microenvironment and Immune Evasion in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Investigations into the lung cancer tumor microenvironment, including immune cell dynamics, immune evasion mechanisms (EMSY, IRE1α, PD-L1/EGFR interactions), and the evolution of immunity from preinvasive to invasive adenocarcinoma.
subtopics.short_description: Immune cell dynamics, PD-L1 interactions, and immune evasion mechanisms from preinvasive to invasive lung adenocarcinoma.

subtopics.label: Second Primary Lung Cancer Risk and Surveillance
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing the incidence, risk prediction, racial differences, and clinical impact of second primary lung cancers among lung cancer survivors, including validated risk models and surveillance recommendations.
subtopics.short_description: Incidence, risk prediction models, and surveillance strategies for second primary lung cancers among survivors.

subtopics.label: Genomic Profiling, Liquid Biopsy, and Molecular Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research on next-generation sequencing, cell-free DNA, circulating tumor DNA, and fusion detection methods applied to lung cancer diagnosis, molecular profiling, and treatment monitoring.
subtopics.short_description: Next-generation sequencing, circulating tumor DNA, and fusion detection for lung cancer diagnosis and treatment monitoring.

subtopics.label: Small Cell Lung Cancer Biology and Histological Transformation
subtopics.description: Studies on the molecular biology of small cell lung cancer, including TP53/RB1 deficiency, MYC overexpression, lineage plasticity, and histological transformation from lung adenocarcinoma to SCLC.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular biology of small cell lung cancer, including lineage plasticity and transformation from lung adenocarcinoma to SCLC.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming and Vulnerabilities in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Research identifying metabolic alterations in lung cancer cells, including serine/one-carbon metabolism, propionate metabolism, and LKB1-dependent metabolic regulation, as potential therapeutic targets.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic alterations in lung cancer cells, including serine, propionate, and LKB1-dependent pathways as drug targets.

subtopics.label: Surgical Outcomes and Perioperative Management in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies on perioperative factors affecting lung cancer surgery outcomes, including pulmonary function testing before resection, intraoperative opioid exposure, COVID-19 impact on surgical safety, and nodal staging quality metrics.
subtopics.short_description: Perioperative factors affecting lung cancer surgery, including pulmonary function, opioid exposure, and nodal staging quality.

subtopics.label: Immunotherapy Response Biomarkers and Checkpoint Inhibition
subtopics.description: Research identifying molecular and genomic biomarkers predictive of response to immune checkpoint inhibitors in lung cancer, including PD-L1 expression, proliferation gene signatures, and tumor-immune interactions.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and genomic predictors of checkpoint inhibitor response, including PD-L1 expression and tumor-immune gene signatures.

subtopics.label: Pulmonary Nodule Detection and Management
subtopics.description: Studies on the identification, imaging, follow-up, and clinical management of pulmonary nodules, including incidental findings, emergency department programs, and CT-guided biopsy techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Imaging, follow-up protocols, and clinical management of pulmonary nodules, including incidental findings and CT-guided biopsy.

subtopics.label: Treatment Disparities and Survival Outcomes in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Analyses of racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in access to guideline-concordant care, immunotherapy, and survival outcomes among lung cancer patients in the United States.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic gaps in guideline-concordant care, immunotherapy access, and survival among U.S. lung cancer patients.

subtopics.label: Preclinical Models and Novel Drug Delivery in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Research using patient-derived xenografts, in vitro/in vivo cancer models, and engineered nanoparticle-drug conjugates to identify actionable pathways and improve therapeutic delivery in lung cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived xenografts, cancer models, and nanoparticle-drug conjugates to identify actionable pathways and improve therapy delivery.

subtopics.label: Combination Immunotherapy and CAR T-Cell Strategies in Solid Tumors
subtopics.description: Studies investigating combinatorial approaches to enhance anti-tumor immunity, including MEK inhibitor scheduling with checkpoint blockade and radiation-enhanced CAR T-cell therapy in solid tumor models.
subtopics.short_description: MEK inhibitor scheduling with checkpoint blockade and radiation-enhanced CAR T-cell approaches in solid tumor models.

subtopics.label: Cancer Screening Adherence, Health Literacy, and Access Barriers
subtopics.description: Population-level analyses examining adherence to guideline-recommended cancer screening, health literacy as a mortality predictor, and utilization of imaging modalities across cancer types and patient subgroups.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level adherence to cancer screening guidelines, health literacy as a mortality predictor, and imaging utilization barriers.

subtopics.label: Pan-Cancer Biomarkers, Mutation Detection, and Molecular Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Cross-cancer studies evaluating novel mutation detection assays, ERBB2/HER2 copy number gain by NGS, and circulating tumor macrophage-like cells as pan-cancer diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers.
subtopics.short_description: Cross-cancer mutation detection assays, HER2 copy number profiling, and circulating tumor macrophage-like cells as diagnostic biomarkers.

subtopics.label: Treatment Delay Modeling and Tumor Microbiome in Cancer Progression
subtopics.description: Research quantifying the impact of treatment delays on tumor control and metastasis risk, alongside pan-cancer mycobiome analyses linking fungal communities to gastrointestinal and lung tumor progression.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of treatment delays on metastasis risk and pan-cancer mycobiome links to gastrointestinal and lung tumor progression.

subtopics.label: Active Surveillance and Focal/Partial Gland Ablation for Localized Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on conservative management strategies for localized prostate cancer including active surveillance protocols, partial gland ablation, cryoablation, and focal therapy outcomes, with emphasis on patient selection, monitoring intensity, and oncologic versus functional trade-offs.
subtopics.short_description: Conservative management of localized prostate cancer via active surveillance protocols, partial gland ablation, and focal therapy outcomes.

subtopics.label: Surgical Management and Functional Outcomes in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies examining radical prostatectomy techniques including robot-assisted, Retzius-sparing, and pelvic fascia-sparing approaches, with outcomes covering urinary continence, oncologic control, perioperative safety, and comparative effectiveness across surgical methods.
subtopics.short_description: Robot-assisted and nerve-sparing prostatectomy techniques with outcomes covering continence, oncologic control, and perioperative safety.

subtopics.label: PSMA-Targeted Imaging and Theranostics in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-based PET imaging, radioligand therapy (including 177Lu-PSMA-617 and novel PSMA ligands), and theranostic applications for staging, biochemical recurrence detection, and treatment of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
subtopics.short_description: PSMA-targeted PET imaging and lutetium-177 radioligand therapy for staging, recurrence detection, and metastatic disease treatment.

subtopics.label: MRI-Guided Prostate Biopsy and Imaging-Based Cancer Detection
subtopics.description: Studies on multiparametric MRI, PI-RADS classification, transperineal versus transrectal biopsy approaches, MRI-targeted biopsy techniques, and AI/radiomics methods for detecting clinically significant prostate cancer and reducing unnecessary procedures.
subtopics.short_description: Multiparametric MRI, PI-RADS classification, targeted biopsy techniques, and AI-assisted detection of clinically significant prostate cancer.

subtopics.label: Systemic Therapy for Advanced and Metastatic Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Clinical research on androgen receptor pathway inhibitors (enzalutamide, abiraterone, cabazitaxel), combination regimens, treatment sequencing, and survival outcomes in metastatic castration-sensitive and castration-resistant prostate cancer settings.
subtopics.display_name: Systemic Therapy for Metastatic Prostate Cancer
subtopics.short_description: Androgen receptor inhibitors, combination regimens, and treatment sequencing in castration-sensitive and castration-resistant prostate cancer.

subtopics.label: Molecular Biology, Genomics, and Tumor Heterogeneity in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Investigations into the molecular underpinnings of prostate cancer including androgen receptor signaling variants (AR-V7, SPOP mutations), neuroendocrine differentiation, chromatin remodeling, clonal evolution, structural rearrangements, and multi-focal tumor heterogeneity.
subtopics.short_description: AR signaling variants, neuroendocrine differentiation, chromatin remodeling, and clonal evolution driving prostate tumor heterogeneity.

subtopics.label: Lipid Metabolism and Metabolomics in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Preclinical and translational studies examining fatty acid synthesis (FASN), de novo lipogenesis, metabolomic profiling, and lipid pathway targeting as therapeutic vulnerabilities in prostate cancer including castration-resistant disease.
subtopics.short_description: Fatty acid synthesis, de novo lipogenesis, and metabolomic profiling as therapeutic vulnerabilities in prostate cancer.

subtopics.label: Racial and Socioeconomic Disparities in Prostate Cancer Screening and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research documenting racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in PSA screening rates, MRI access, active surveillance utilization, surgical approach selection, and treatment outcomes in prostate cancer, including analyses of USPSTF guideline impacts.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic gaps in PSA screening, MRI access, active surveillance use, and prostate cancer treatment outcomes.

subtopics.label: Systemic Therapy and Immunotherapy for Advanced Urothelial and Bladder Cancer
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and real-world studies evaluating immune checkpoint inhibitors (atezolizumab, pembrolizumab), antibody-drug conjugates (sacituzumab govitecan), FGFR inhibitors, and combination regimens for locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma.
subtopics.display_name: Immunotherapy & Systemic Therapy for Bladder Cancer
subtopics.short_description: Checkpoint inhibitors, antibody-drug conjugates, and FGFR inhibitors for locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma.

subtopics.label: Surgical Management, Pathology, and Cytology of Bladder and Urothelial Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies on surgical approaches for bladder cancer (radical cystectomy, TURBT), urothelial carcinoma cytopathology and histopathology including The Paris System criteria, neoadjuvant chemotherapy outcomes, and sex/demographic disparities in treatment access.
subtopics.short_description: Radical cystectomy, TURBT, urothelial cytopathology, neoadjuvant chemotherapy outcomes, and demographic disparities in treatment access.

subtopics.label: Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma: Molecular Features, Surgery, and Chemotherapy
subtopics.description: Research focused on upper tract urothelial carcinoma (UTUC) including molecular characterization, genomic landscape, neoadjuvant chemotherapy efficacy, surgical outcomes (nephroureterectomy), nomogram development, and clonal evolution of metastatic disease.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular characterization, neoadjuvant chemotherapy, surgical outcomes, and clonal evolution in upper tract urothelial carcinoma.

subtopics.label: Renal Cell Carcinoma Biology, Biomarkers, and Systemic Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies on clear cell and other renal cell carcinoma subtypes covering molecular biology (ATF4, NDUFA4L2, VHL pathway), liquid biopsy biomarkers, targeted therapy (pazopanib, cabozantinib), immunotherapy combinations, and surgical approaches including ablation.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular biology, liquid biopsy biomarkers, targeted therapy, and immunotherapy combinations across renal cell carcinoma subtypes.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy, ctDNA, and Genomic Profiling in Bladder and Urothelial Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), cell-free DNA methylation, APOBEC mutagenesis, and genomic/transcriptomic profiling for monitoring disease progression, treatment response prediction, and understanding clonal evolution in bladder and urothelial cancers.
subtopics.display_name: Liquid Biopsy & Genomic Profiling in Bladder Cancer
