subtopics.short_description: Circulating tumor DNA, cell-free DNA methylation, and genomic profiling for monitoring progression and treatment response in urothelial cancers.

subtopics.label: Biomarkers, Genomic Risk Scores, and Molecular Diagnostics in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating tissue-based genomic tests (Decipher), metabolomic and proteomic biomarkers, polygenic risk scores, tumor volume and PSA density as predictors of pathologic risk, recurrence, and treatment selection in localized and advanced prostate cancer.
subtopics.display_name: Biomarkers & Genomic Risk in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.short_description: Tissue-based genomic tests, polygenic risk scores, and proteomic biomarkers predicting pathologic risk and guiding treatment selection.

subtopics.label: Comorbidity Management and Health Outcomes in Cancer Survivors
subtopics.description: Research examining how comorbid conditions such as diabetes and heart failure are managed before and after cancer diagnosis, including racial disparities in comorbidity care among cancer survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Management of diabetes, heart failure, and other comorbidities before and after cancer diagnosis, including racial disparities in survivor care.

subtopics.label: Patient Decision-Making Support, Health Literacy, and Cancer Beliefs
subtopics.description: Studies investigating health literacy, fatalistic cancer beliefs, and decision-making support interventions among diverse and minority cancer patient populations, and their effects on screening, quality of life, and mortality.
subtopics.short_description: Health literacy, fatalistic cancer beliefs, and decision-support interventions affecting screening, quality of life, and outcomes in diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Tools in Oncology Decision Support
subtopics.description: Research on AI and machine learning applications for clinical decision support, therapeutic sequencing, and precision oncology, including biologically constrained predictive models and AI-generated patient information.
subtopics.short_description: AI-driven clinical decision support, therapeutic sequencing models, and precision oncology tools for urologic and other cancers.

subtopics.label: Racial and Ethnic Disparities in Surgical Access and Minimally Invasive Procedures
subtopics.description: Systematic reviews and studies examining racial and ethnic disparities in access to robot-assisted surgery and minimally invasive surgical procedures for pelvic and urologic cancers.
subtopics.display_name: Disparities in Minimally Invasive Surgery Access
subtopics.short_description: Racial and ethnic gaps in access to robot-assisted and minimally invasive surgical procedures for urologic and pelvic cancers.

subtopics.label: Immune-Related Adverse Events and Inflammatory Biomarkers in Urologic Cancer Immunotherapy
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing immune-related adverse events (irAEs) and inflammatory biomarkers such as NLR and SII as prognostic factors in patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma and urothelial cancer treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
subtopics.short_description: Immune-related adverse events and inflammatory markers as prognostic factors in renal cell carcinoma and urothelial cancer immunotherapy.

subtopics.label: Long Non-Coding RNAs and Chromatin Regulation in Urologic Cancers
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular functions of long non-coding RNAs and high-order chromatin conformations in prostate and other cancers, including their roles in gene regulation and therapeutic resistance.
subtopics.display_name: lncRNA & Chromatin Regulation in Urologic Cancers
subtopics.short_description: Long non-coding RNA functions and chromatin conformation in gene regulation and therapeutic resistance across urologic cancers.

subtopics.label: Preclinical Biology and Novel Therapeutic Targets in Bladder Cancer
subtopics.description: Preclinical studies investigating molecular targets and novel agents in bladder cancer, including fascin inhibitors that reduce cell migration and adhesion, and circulating tumor cell phenotyping in solid cancers.
subtopics.display_name: Preclinical Biology & Targets in Bladder Cancer
subtopics.short_description: Novel molecular targets, fascin inhibitors, and circulating tumor cell phenotyping in preclinical bladder cancer research.

subtopics.label: Patient-Reported Outcomes, Quality of Life, and Survivorship After Prostate Cancer Treatment
subtopics.description: Qualitative and quantitative studies capturing the lived experience of prostate cancer survivors, including long-term treatment trade-offs, functional outcomes, and perspectives following contemporary localized prostate cancer treatment.
subtopics.display_name: Quality of Life & Survivorship After Treatment
subtopics.short_description: Patient-reported functional outcomes, long-term treatment trade-offs, and lived experience following localized prostate cancer treatment.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Cancer Biology and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms, oncogenic drivers (KRAS, p53, NADK, RHAMM), tumor microenvironment, and therapeutic strategies in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, including surgical outcomes and systemic therapy trials.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular drivers, tumor microenvironment, and therapeutic strategies in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and neuroendocrine tumors.

subtopics.label: Gastric and Gastroesophageal Cancer Systemic Therapy and Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and biomarker studies in gastric, gastroesophageal junction, and esophageal adenocarcinoma, including targeted agents (zolbetuximab, ramucirumab, andecaliximab), immunotherapy, CLDN18.2, FGFR2, HER2, and TP53 mutation stratification.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical trials and biomarker studies in gastric, gastroesophageal junction, and esophageal adenocarcinoma using targeted and immunotherapy agents.

subtopics.label: Esophageal Cancer Surgery and Multimodal Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies on surgical approaches, lymphadenectomy, neoadjuvant chemoradiation, and survival outcomes in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma, including robotic esophagectomy and immunotherapy biomarkers.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical approaches, neoadjuvant chemoradiation, and survival outcomes in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Cancer Molecular Biology and Tumor Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms driving colorectal cancer initiation and progression, including Wnt/APC signaling, PKCλ/ι, aPKC, SOX17, ILC3 dysregulation, immune evasion, lineage plasticity, and tumor microenvironment characterization.
subtopics.short_description: Signaling pathways, immune evasion, lineage plasticity, and tumor microenvironment characterization driving colorectal cancer progression.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Cancer Endoscopic and Surgical Management
subtopics.description: Studies on endoscopic resection techniques (ESD, EMR, cold snare polypectomy, FTRD), minimally invasive and robotic colorectal surgery, colonic stenting, and perioperative outcomes for colorectal cancer and polyps.
subtopics.short_description: Endoscopic resection techniques, robotic colorectal surgery, colonic stenting, and perioperative outcomes for colorectal cancer and polyps.

subtopics.label: Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Cholangiocarcinoma Biology and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on molecular pathogenesis, imaging, locoregional therapies (Y-90 radioembolization, TACE), surgical approaches, and biomarkers in hepatocellular carcinoma and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, including PKCλ/ι, STING pathway, and IDH1/2 mutations.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular pathogenesis, imaging, locoregional therapies, and biomarkers in hepatocellular carcinoma and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

subtopics.label: Pretargeted Radioimmunotherapy and Targeted Drug Delivery in GI Cancers
subtopics.description: Development and evaluation of pretargeted radioimmunotherapy (GPA33, HER2 targeting), antibody-drug conjugates, nanoparticle drug delivery systems, and novel radiohaptens for colorectal, gastric, and other GI cancers.
subtopics.short_description: Pretargeted radioimmunotherapy, antibody-drug conjugates, and nanoparticle delivery systems for colorectal, gastric, and other GI cancers.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Cancer Screening, Disparities, and Lynch Syndrome
subtopics.description: Studies on colorectal cancer screening uptake, racial and socioeconomic disparities, Lynch syndrome identification and surveillance, hereditary cancer risk assessment, and factors influencing screening receipt.
subtopics.short_description: Screening uptake, racial and socioeconomic disparities, Lynch syndrome surveillance, and hereditary colorectal cancer risk assessment.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Cystic Lesions, Biliary Tract, and Ampullary Neoplasms
subtopics.description: Diagnostic and pathological studies of pancreatic cystic neoplasms, biliary tract adenocarcinomas, ampullary adenocarcinoma, intracholecystic papillary neoplasms, and EUS-guided tissue acquisition and biliary drainage.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and pathology of pancreatic cysts, biliary tract adenocarcinomas, ampullary neoplasms, and EUS-guided tissue acquisition.

subtopics.label: Tumor Microenvironment, Immunotherapy Resistance, and Immune Modulation in GI Cancers
subtopics.description: Research on immune cell interactions, immunotherapy resistance mechanisms, and novel immune-modulating strategies in GI cancers, including TGFβ inhibition, MEK inhibition with GITR costimulation, PKCλ/ι-mediated interferon response, and neutrophil-driven resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Immune cell interactions, immunotherapy resistance mechanisms, and novel immune-modulating strategies across gastrointestinal cancers.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy, ctDNA, and Molecular Diagnostics in GI Cancers
subtopics.description: Studies on circulating tumor DNA detection, next-generation sequencing of plasma and tissue, methylation markers, and molecular biomarker testing for diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment selection in GI and other solid tumors.
subtopics.short_description: Circulating tumor DNA detection, next-generation sequencing, and methylation markers for GI cancer diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment selection.

subtopics.label: Gastrointestinal Neuroendocrine and Stromal Tumors
subtopics.description: Clinical and molecular studies of gastrointestinal neuroendocrine tumors (colorectal, pancreatic) and gastrointestinal stromal tumors, including surgical timing, recurrence predictors, novel gene fusions, and endoscopic resection.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and molecular studies of gastrointestinal neuroendocrine tumors and stromal tumors, including novel gene fusions and endoscopic resection.

subtopics.label: Rectal Cancer Treatment, Staging, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on rectal cancer management including neoadjuvant chemoradiation, surgical outcomes, MRI-based response assessment, care fragmentation, Medicaid expansion impact, and staging reproducibility.
subtopics.short_description: Neoadjuvant chemoradiation, surgical outcomes, MRI-based response assessment, and health policy impacts on rectal cancer management.

subtopics.label: Preclinical Cancer Models, Epigenetics, and Tumor Initiation
subtopics.description: Development and use of preclinical models (mouse, organoid, xenograft) and epigenetic studies to investigate GI cancer initiation, lineage plasticity, chromatin remodeling, and oncogenic mutation modeling.
subtopics.short_description: Mouse, organoid, and xenograft models alongside epigenetic studies of GI cancer initiation, chromatin remodeling, and lineage plasticity.

subtopics.label: Extracellular Vesicles in Cancer Metastasis and Systemic Effects
subtopics.description: Research on tumor-derived extracellular vesicles and particles that drive metastatic progression, cancer-associated thrombosis, liver metabolic dysfunction, and antitumor immune priming via Kupffer cells.
subtopics.short_description: Tumor-derived extracellular vesicles driving metastatic progression, cancer-associated thrombosis, and antitumor immune priming.

subtopics.label: Cancer Care Disparities, Access, and Health Equity
subtopics.description: Studies examining racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in cancer screening adherence, surgical access (robot-assisted and minimally invasive surgery), health literacy, and care utilization across cancer populations.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in cancer screening, surgical access, health literacy, and care utilization.

subtopics.label: Comorbidity Management and Survivorship in Cancer Patients
subtopics.description: Investigations into the management of chronic comorbidities such as diabetes and cardiovascular disease before and after cancer diagnosis, including racial disparities in comorbidity care among cancer survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Chronic comorbidity care—including diabetes and cardiovascular disease—before and after cancer diagnosis, with attention to racial disparities.

subtopics.label: Liver Transplantation, Viral Hepatitis, and Obesity
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on liver transplantation outcomes in the context of viral hepatitis (HCV, HDV, HBV) and obesity, including epidemiology of HCV in high-prevalence regions and management challenges in obese transplant candidates.
subtopics.short_description: Transplantation outcomes in the context of viral hepatitis and obesity, including HCV epidemiology and obese transplant candidate management.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genomics, Structural Variation, and Clonal Hematopoiesis
subtopics.description: Pan-cancer genomic analyses uncovering complex structural rearrangements across cancer genomes and the association of clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) and mosaic chromosomal alterations with solid tumor incidence and mortality.
subtopics.short_description: Pan-cancer structural rearrangements and clonal hematopoiesis associations with solid tumor incidence and mortality.

subtopics.label: Cancer Treatment Timing, Regionalization, and Surgical Quality
subtopics.description: Research on the impact of treatment delays on tumor control and metastatic risk, and systematic evidence on regionalization of surgical oncology care to improve patient outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of treatment delays on tumor control and evidence for regionalizing surgical oncology care to improve patient outcomes.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming and Immune Enhancement in Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies on pharmacologic and metabolic interventions—including LDH inhibition and tumor extracellular vesicle signaling—that redirect glucose metabolism and enhance antitumor T cell immunity in solid tumors.
subtopics.short_description: Pharmacologic and metabolic interventions redirecting glucose metabolism and enhancing T cell antitumor immunity in solid tumors.

subtopics.label: Systemic Therapy Resistance and Novel Agents in Colorectal and Gastric Cancer
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational studies on resistance mechanisms and novel therapeutic strategies in colorectal and gastric cancers, including taxane resistance in gastric cancer, napabucasin plus FOLFIRI in metastatic colorectal cancer, and HER2 testing practices.
subtopics.display_name: Systemic Therapy Resistance in Colorectal & Gastric Cancer
subtopics.short_description: Resistance mechanisms and novel therapeutic strategies in colorectal and gastric cancers, including taxane resistance and HER2 testing practices.

subtopics.label: Glioma Molecular Biology and Tumor Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research into the molecular, epigenetic, and cellular mechanisms driving glioma and glioblastoma, including tumor microenvironment interactions, glioma stem cell biology, chromatin remodeling, and transcriptional cell states.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic, cellular, and stem cell mechanisms driving glioma, including tumor microenvironment interactions and transcriptional cell states.

subtopics.label: Glioblastoma and High-Grade Glioma Treatment Strategies
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational studies on treatment of glioblastoma and high-grade gliomas, including chemotherapy, radiation, immunotherapy combinations, targeted agents, and novel therapeutic approaches such as CHI3L1 inhibitors and IDH inhibitors.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and translational approaches to glioblastoma therapy, including immunotherapy, targeted agents, IDH inhibitors, and novel combinations.

subtopics.label: Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Glioma and Convection-Enhanced Delivery
subtopics.description: Studies focused on diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG) treatment using convection-enhanced delivery (CED), including pharmacokinetics, dosimetry, drug formulations, and clinical trials of agents such as 124I-omburtamab and DM1.
subtopics.short_description: Treatment of diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma via convection-enhanced delivery, covering drug formulations, dosimetry, and clinical trials.

subtopics.label: Meningioma Imaging, Radiosurgery, and Medical Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on meningioma diagnosis and management using DOTATATE PET/MRI, radiosurgery planning, radiation therapy outcomes, novel medical therapies, and neurocognitive impact of intracranial meningiomas.
subtopics.short_description: Meningioma diagnosis and management using DOTATATE PET/MRI, radiosurgery planning, novel medical therapies, and neurocognitive outcomes.

subtopics.label: Pediatric CNS Tumor Biology, Diagnosis, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies on pediatric brain tumors including medulloblastoma, ATRT, choroid plexus carcinoma, and low-grade gliomas, covering molecular profiling, classification, novel therapeutics, and leptomeningeal dissemination.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular profiling, classification, and therapeutics for pediatric brain tumors including medulloblastoma, ATRT, and low-grade gliomas.

subtopics.label: Glioma Molecular Classification and Diagnostic Markers
subtopics.description: Research on molecular diagnostic tools and classification of gliomas, including IDH mutation detection, MGMT methylation, WHO classification updates, and machine learning-based histopathological prediction of tumor genotype.
subtopics.short_description: IDH mutation detection, MGMT methylation, WHO classification, and machine learning-based histopathological genotype prediction in gliomas.

subtopics.label: Advanced MRI Techniques for Brain Tumor Characterization
subtopics.description: Development and application of advanced MRI methods including DCE-MRI, diffusion kurtosis imaging, radiomic analysis, and ACE-MRI for tumor characterization, treatment response assessment, and pseudoprogression prediction in gliomas and other CNS tumors.
subtopics.display_name: Advanced MRI for Brain Tumor Characterization
subtopics.short_description: DCE-MRI, diffusion kurtosis, and radiomic methods for tumor characterization, treatment response, and pseudoprogression assessment in CNS tumors.

subtopics.label: Skull Base Surgical Approaches and Techniques
subtopics.description: Anatomical and technical studies on surgical approaches to the skull base, including frontotemporal, transpetrosal, far lateral, and cavernous sinus approaches for resection of tumors and vascular lesions.
subtopics.short_description: Anatomical and technical studies on frontotemporal, transpetrosal, and far lateral approaches for skull base tumor and vascular lesion resection.

subtopics.label: Intraoperative Neurophysiology and Awake Craniotomy
subtopics.description: Research on intraoperative techniques for brain tumor surgery including motor cortex mapping with bipolar stimulation, awake craniotomy with antiseizure medication management, and augmented reality-assisted resection.
subtopics.short_description: Motor cortex mapping, awake craniotomy protocols, and augmented reality-assisted resection techniques for brain tumor surgery.

subtopics.label: Brain Metastases: Imaging, Treatment, and Multidisciplinary Care
subtopics.description: Studies on the management of brain metastases from systemic cancers, including PET-based imaging with FES and DOTATATE, pharmacological treatment trials, and multidisciplinary care pathways to optimize time to adjuvant irradiation.
subtopics.short_description: PET-based imaging, pharmacological trials, and multidisciplinary care pathways for managing brain metastases from systemic cancers.

subtopics.label: Blood-Brain Barrier Drug Delivery and Focused Ultrasound
subtopics.description: Research on strategies to overcome the blood-brain barrier for CNS tumor therapy, including focused ultrasound-enhanced drug delivery, intraarterial administration, and convection-enhanced delivery of novel agents.
subtopics.short_description: Focused ultrasound, intraarterial administration, and convection-enhanced delivery strategies to overcome the blood-brain barrier for CNS therapy.

subtopics.label: Glioblastoma Disease Models and Preclinical Research
subtopics.description: Development and use of preclinical models for glioblastoma and other CNS tumors, including patient-derived cerebral organoids, 3D spheroid models, and in vivo mouse glioma models for therapeutic testing.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived cerebral organoids, 3D spheroid models, and in vivo mouse glioma systems for preclinical therapeutic testing.

subtopics.label: CNS Lymphoma, Craniopharyngioma, and Rare Brain Tumors
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on rare CNS tumors including primary CNS lymphoma (EBV-positive), craniopharyngioma with hypothalamic involvement, colloid cysts, and pituitary neoplasms with somatostatin receptor expression.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical studies on primary CNS lymphoma, craniopharyngioma, colloid cysts, and pituitary neoplasms with somatostatin receptor expression.

subtopics.label: Neuro-Oncology Rehabilitation and Functional Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on rehabilitation and functional recovery in patients with brain and spinal cord tumors, including inpatient rehabilitation after glioblastoma resection, spine tumor rehabilitation, and neuropsychological care in neurosurgical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Functional recovery, inpatient rehabilitation, and neuropsychological care for patients with brain and spinal cord tumors.

subtopics.label: Ovarian Cancer Immunology and Tumor Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research investigating immune evasion mechanisms, immunosuppressive cell populations, and innate/adaptive immune responses in ovarian cancer, including roles of neutrophils, macrophages, T cells, and lipid mediators in tumor progression and therapy resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Immune evasion, immunosuppressive cell populations, and innate/adaptive immune responses driving ovarian tumor progression and therapy resistance.

subtopics.label: Ovarian Cancer Molecular Targets and Novel Therapeutics
subtopics.description: Studies identifying and validating molecular targets and novel therapeutic strategies in ovarian cancer, including functional genomics screens, kinase inhibitors, PARP imaging, and combination therapies targeting PI3K/mTOR and CRL4 pathways.
subtopics.short_description: Functional genomics, kinase inhibitors, and combination therapies targeting PI3K/mTOR and CRL4 pathways in ovarian cancer.

subtopics.label: Ovarian Cancer Pathology and Histologic Classification
subtopics.description: Clinicopathologic and molecular characterization of ovarian tumor subtypes including granulosa cell tumors, mucinous tumors, malignant struma ovarii, and germ cell tumors, emphasizing diagnostic criteria, HER2 expression, and prognostic features.
subtopics.short_description: Clinicopathologic and molecular characterization of ovarian tumor subtypes, including diagnostic criteria, HER2 expression, and prognostic features.

subtopics.label: Endometrial Cancer Molecular Pathology and Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Molecular profiling, biomarker expression, and histopathologic characterization of endometrial cancers, including RHAMM expression, HER2/ERBB2 testing practices, recurrence-associated mutations in low-grade disease, and uterine tumors resembling ovarian sex cord tumors.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular profiling and histopathologic characterization of endometrial cancers, including HER2 testing, recurrence-associated mutations, and biomarker expression.

subtopics.label: Cervical Cancer Screening, HPV Testing, and Cytology
subtopics.description: Research on cervical cancer screening practices including Papanicolaou test interpretation, HPV co-testing, management of unsatisfactory specimens, and cytologic patterns of HSIL and squamous metaplasia in cervicovaginal samples.
subtopics.short_description: Papanicolaou test interpretation, HPV co-testing, and cytologic management of cervicovaginal specimens including HSIL patterns.

subtopics.label: HPV Infection Biology, Vaccination, and Prevention
subtopics.description: Studies on HPV epidemiology, vaccine knowledge and uptake, antibody responses to HPV capsid peptides, HPV persistence in the context of co-infections and microbiota alterations, and HPV cell-free DNA testing for cancer detection.
subtopics.short_description: HPV epidemiology, vaccine uptake, antibody responses, viral persistence, and cell-free DNA testing for cancer detection.

subtopics.label: Hereditary Cancer Syndromes, Genetic Testing, and Cascade Testing
subtopics.description: Research on cascade genetic testing strategies for hereditary breast/ovarian cancer and Lynch syndrome, including barriers to uptake, facilitated referral pathways, family communication of risk, and digital tools for genetic risk assessment.
subtopics.short_description: Cascade testing strategies for hereditary breast/ovarian cancer and Lynch syndrome, including barriers, referral pathways, and digital risk tools.

subtopics.label: Lynch Syndrome Surveillance and Endometrial Cancer Screening
subtopics.description: Studies focused on cancer surveillance strategies for Lynch syndrome patients, including combined colon and endometrial screening protocols, population-level identification via EHR, and long-term outcomes of prevention strategies in at-risk individuals.
subtopics.short_description: Cancer surveillance protocols for Lynch syndrome patients, including combined colon and endometrial screening and population-level EHR identification.

subtopics.label: Disparities in Gynecologic Cancer Care and Access
subtopics.description: Research examining racial, ethnic, socioeconomic, and geographic disparities in gynecologic cancer screening, treatment timeliness, use of minimally invasive and robotic surgery, and access to care including impacts of policy and pandemic conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, socioeconomic, and geographic disparities in gynecologic cancer screening, treatment timeliness, and access to minimally invasive surgery.

subtopics.label: Minimally Invasive and Robotic Surgical Techniques in Gynecologic Oncology
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating minimally invasive surgical approaches in gynecologic oncology including robotic-assisted surgery, HIPEC via vaginal access, and tissue extraction techniques for myomas and pelvic cancers.
subtopics.short_description: Robotic-assisted surgery, HIPEC via vaginal access, and tissue extraction techniques for pelvic cancers and myomas.

subtopics.label: Gynecologic Cancer Survivorship and Psychosocial Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on quality of life, coping strategies, financial toxicity, mental health, and survivorship care planning for women with gynecologic cancers, including breast cancer risk assessment in gynecologic oncology clinic settings.
subtopics.short_description: Quality of life, financial toxicity, mental health, and survivorship care planning for women with gynecologic cancers.

subtopics.label: BRCA and Somatic/Germline Genomic Profiling in Gynecologic Cancers
subtopics.description: Studies on plasma-based and tumor genomic profiling to detect germline, somatic, and reversion BRCA mutations, complex structural variants, and molecular alterations relevant to targeted therapy selection in gynecologic and related cancers.
subtopics.short_description: Plasma-based and tumor genomic profiling to detect germline, somatic, and reversion BRCA mutations for targeted therapy selection.

subtopics.label: Vulvar and Rare Gynecologic Tumor Pathology
subtopics.description: Molecular and clinicopathologic characterization of rare gynecologic tumors including vulvar angiomyofibroblastoma defined by MTG1-CYP2E1 fusions and other uncommon gynecologic neoplasms with distinct molecular features.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and clinicopathologic characterization of rare gynecologic neoplasms, including vulvar tumors defined by distinct molecular fusions.

subtopics.label: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Clinical Outcomes in Advanced Melanoma
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and real-world analyses evaluating efficacy, long-term survival, toxicity, and retreatment strategies for PD-1, CTLA-4, and combination checkpoint inhibitor therapies in advanced melanoma patients.
subtopics.short_description: Efficacy, survival, toxicity, and retreatment outcomes for PD-1, CTLA-4, and combination checkpoint inhibitor therapies in advanced melanoma.

subtopics.label: BRAF/MEK Targeted Therapy in Melanoma
subtopics.description: Studies examining BRAF and MEK inhibitor therapies (dabrafenib, trametinib) in BRAF-mutant melanoma, including long-term outcomes, combination strategies, and resistance mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Long-term outcomes, combination strategies, and resistance mechanisms for BRAF and MEK inhibitors in BRAF-mutant melanoma.

subtopics.label: Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocytes and Melanoma Immune Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research characterizing tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte states, differentiation trajectories, and functional properties within the melanoma tumor microenvironment and their prognostic significance.
subtopics.short_description: Lymphocyte states, differentiation trajectories, and functional properties within the melanoma immune microenvironment and their prognostic significance.

subtopics.label: CAR T Cell and Adoptive Immunotherapy for Melanoma
subtopics.description: Preclinical and translational studies developing CAR T cell therapies and adoptive T cell transfer strategies targeting melanoma-specific antigens such as TYRP1 and MART-1.
subtopics.short_description: Preclinical and translational development of CAR T cell and adoptive T cell therapies targeting melanoma-specific antigens such as TYRP1 and MART-1.

subtopics.label: Molecular Biology and Metastatic Mechanisms in Melanoma
subtopics.description: Investigations into molecular pathways, epigenetic regulators, and cellular mechanisms driving melanoma progression, metastasis, and resistance to oxidative stress, including PRC1 loss and tRNA methylation.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular pathways, epigenetic regulators, and cellular mechanisms driving melanoma progression, metastasis, and oxidative stress resistance.

subtopics.label: Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma and Lymphoproliferative Disorders
subtopics.description: Clinical and histopathological studies of cutaneous lymphomas including mycosis fungoides, lymphomatoid papulosis, and CD4+ small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorders, covering diagnosis, treatment, and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, treatment, and outcomes for cutaneous lymphomas including mycosis fungoides, lymphomatoid papulosis, and CD4+ lymphoproliferative disorders.

subtopics.label: Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma in Immunocompromised Patients
subtopics.description: Studies examining the impact of immunosuppression—including solid organ transplantation and other immunomodulating conditions—on the prognosis, metastasis, and management of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of solid organ transplantation and immunosuppression on prognosis, metastasis, and management of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.

subtopics.label: Surgical Management and Reconstruction of Skin Cancer Defects
subtopics.description: Clinical studies evaluating surgical techniques for reconstruction of cutaneous defects following skin cancer resection, including scalp reconstruction with dermal templates and keystone advancement flaps.
subtopics.display_name: Surgical Reconstruction of Skin Cancer Defects
subtopics.short_description: Techniques for reconstructing cutaneous defects after skin cancer resection, including dermal templates and keystone advancement flaps.

subtopics.label: Melanoma Epidemiology, Racial Disparities, and Patient-Reported Outcomes
subtopics.description: Population-level analyses and patient-centered research examining racial disparities in melanoma survival, staging accuracy in acral melanoma, and health-related quality of life in melanoma patients.
subtopics.short_description: Racial disparities in melanoma survival, staging accuracy in acral melanoma, and health-related quality of life at the population level.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Imaging for Skin Lesion Detection
subtopics.description: Development and evaluation of deep learning and machine learning models for automated classification and early detection of skin lesions including melanoma.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning and machine learning models for automated classification and early detection of melanoma and other skin lesions.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Tumor DNA Monitoring in Melanoma
subtopics.description: Studies developing and applying ctDNA and cell-free DNA technologies for ultrasensitive tumor burden monitoring, minimal residual disease detection, and treatment response assessment in melanoma and solid tumors.
subtopics.short_description: Cell-free and circulating tumor DNA technologies for tumor burden monitoring, minimal residual disease detection, and treatment response in melanoma.

subtopics.label: Combination Immunotherapy Strategies and Preclinical Tumor Models
subtopics.description: Preclinical studies investigating combination approaches to enhance antitumor immunity, including TGFβ inhibition, LDH inhibition, phosphatidylserine targeting, GITR engagement, and cyclophosphamide-based regimens in melanoma and solid tumor models.
subtopics.short_description: Preclinical combination strategies enhancing antitumor immunity, including TGFβ inhibition, phosphatidylserine targeting, and GITR engagement in melanoma models.

subtopics.label: Tumor Microenvironment and Cancer Immunity
subtopics.description: Research on the cellular and molecular composition of the tumor microenvironment, including tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, tumor-associated macrophages, cancer-associated fibroblasts, immune evasion mechanisms, and the interplay between immune cells and tumor cells that shapes cancer progression and therapy response.
subtopics.short_description: Immune cell composition, stromal interactions, and immune evasion mechanisms shaping tumor progression and therapy response.

subtopics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy and Immune Checkpoint Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on immune checkpoint pathways (PD-1/PD-L1, CTLA-4, LAG-3, TIM-3, ICOS, VISTA, GITR), checkpoint inhibitor therapies, CAR T cell engineering, adoptive cell therapies, and combination immunotherapy strategies including radiation plus immunotherapy in preclinical and clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Immune checkpoint pathways, CAR T cell engineering, adoptive cell therapies, and combination immunotherapy strategies.

subtopics.label: Cancer Epigenetics and Chromatin Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on epigenetic mechanisms in cancer including DNA methylation, histone modifications, chromatin remodeling complexes (SWI/SNF, PRC1/2, EZH2), 3D chromatin architecture, and how epigenetic dysregulation drives tumor initiation, progression, and therapy resistance.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation, histone modifications, and chromatin remodeling driving tumor initiation, progression, and therapy resistance.

subtopics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Reprogramming
subtopics.description: Studies on metabolic alterations in cancer cells including lipid biosynthesis (FASN, ACC1, cholesterol), glucose metabolism, mitochondrial function, one-carbon metabolism, NAD+/NADPH pathways, and how metabolic reprogramming supports tumor growth, metastasis, and therapy resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Lipid biosynthesis, glucose metabolism, and mitochondrial reprogramming supporting tumor growth and therapy resistance.

subtopics.label: Cancer Metastasis and Invasion Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms driving cancer metastasis, including epithelial-mesenchymal transition, cancer cell invasion, organotropism, pre-metastatic niche formation, extracellular vesicle-mediated communication, and specific signaling pathways that promote metastatic dissemination.
subtopics.short_description: Epithelial-mesenchymal transition, organotropism, pre-metastatic niche formation, and signaling pathways driving metastatic spread.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genomics and Molecular Profiling
subtopics.description: Studies employing whole-genome, whole-exome, transcriptomic, and multi-omic sequencing to characterize somatic mutations, structural variants, copy number alterations, fusion genes, and molecular subtypes across cancer types, including computational methods for cancer driver discovery and tumor evolution.
subtopics.short_description: Multi-omic sequencing to characterize somatic mutations, structural variants, and molecular subtypes across cancer types.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Tumor Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research on circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), circulating tumor cells (CTCs), cell-free DNA methylation, and extracellular vesicle-based biomarkers for cancer detection, monitoring treatment response, tracking resistance mutations, and minimal residual disease assessment across cancer types.
subtopics.short_description: Circulating tumor DNA, CTCs, and extracellular vesicle biomarkers for cancer detection, treatment monitoring, and residual disease assessment.

subtopics.label: Cell Cycle Regulation and Cancer Proliferation
subtopics.description: Research on cell cycle control mechanisms relevant to cancer, including CDK4/6 activity, Rb-E2F signaling, G1 checkpoint regulation, quiescence entry and exit, and how dysregulation of these pathways drives uncontrolled proliferation and informs CDK inhibitor therapy.
subtopics.short_description: CDK4/6 activity, Rb-E2F signaling, and checkpoint dysregulation driving uncontrolled tumor proliferation and CDK inhibitor response.

subtopics.label: DNA Damage Response and Genomic Instability in Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies on DNA repair pathways (homologous recombination, NHEJ, base excision repair), replication stress, BRCA1/2 deficiency, chromosomal instability, and how defects in DNA damage response contribute to cancer mutagenesis, tumor evolution, and sensitivity to DNA-damaging therapies.
subtopics.short_description: DNA repair pathway defects, replication stress, and chromosomal instability contributing to tumor evolution and therapy sensitivity.

subtopics.label: Preclinical Cancer Models and Experimental Systems
subtopics.description: Development and application of preclinical cancer models including patient-derived xenografts, genetically engineered mouse models, organoids, cell lines, and in vivo systems used to study tumor biology, test therapeutic hypotheses, and recapitulate human cancer features.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived xenografts, engineered mouse models, and organoids used to study tumor biology and test therapeutic hypotheses.

subtopics.label: Targeted Therapy Mechanisms and Drug Resistance
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of response and resistance to targeted cancer therapies including kinase inhibitors, CDK inhibitors, KRAS inhibitors, androgen receptor antagonists, and epigenetic drugs, encompassing both intrinsic and acquired resistance mechanisms and strategies to overcome them.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of response and resistance to kinase inhibitors, CDK inhibitors, and epigenetic drugs, with strategies to overcome them.

subtopics.label: Radiation Biology and Radiotherapy Combinations
subtopics.description: Studies on the biological effects of ionizing radiation on tumors and the immune system, including radiation-induced immunogenic cell death, neoantigen exposure, combination of radiotherapy with immunotherapy or targeted agents, and mechanisms of radiosensitivity and resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Radiation-induced immunogenic cell death, neoantigen exposure, and combination strategies with immunotherapy or targeted agents.

subtopics.label: Lymphoma and Leukemia Molecular Biology
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular pathogenesis of hematologic malignancies including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, follicular lymphoma, AML, MDS, and CLL, encompassing oncogenic drivers, epigenetic dysregulation, tumor microenvironment interactions, and mechanisms of transformation and clonal evolution.
subtopics.short_description: Oncogenic drivers, epigenetic dysregulation, and clonal evolution in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, AML, MDS, and CLL.

subtopics.label: Nanoparticle Drug Delivery and Radioimmunotherapy
subtopics.description: Research on engineered nanoparticles, antibody-drug conjugates, pretargeted radioimmunotherapy, and novel drug delivery platforms designed to improve therapeutic index, tumor targeting, and efficacy of cancer treatments including radiopharmaceuticals and small molecule delivery systems.
subtopics.short_description: Engineered nanoparticles, antibody-drug conjugates, and radiopharmaceutical platforms designed to improve tumor targeting and therapeutic index.

subtopics.label: Oncogenic Signaling Pathways and Tumor Suppressor Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on key oncogenic and tumor suppressor signaling networks in cancer including PI3K/AKT/mTOR, RAS/MAPK, Wnt/β-catenin, Hippo, NF-κB, and androgen receptor pathways, and how their dysregulation drives malignant transformation and informs therapeutic targeting.
subtopics.short_description: PI3K/AKT/mTOR, RAS/MAPK, Wnt, and Hippo pathway dysregulation driving malignant transformation and informing therapeutic targeting.

subtopics.label: Thyroid Cancer Diagnosis and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on thyroid cancer subtypes including papillary, anaplastic, follicular, and medullary thyroid carcinoma, covering molecular diagnostics, cytopathology, radioiodine therapy, surgical outcomes, and prognostic factors.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular diagnostics, radioiodine therapy, and surgical outcomes across papillary, anaplastic, follicular, and medullary thyroid carcinoma.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Risk Factors and Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Studies examining breast cancer risk factors including reproductive history, genetic ancestry, polygenic risk scores, environmental exposures, biomarkers in benign breast tissue, and population-based cohort analyses.
subtopics.short_description: Reproductive history, polygenic risk scores, environmental exposures, and population-based analyses of breast cancer risk factors.

subtopics.label: Hematologic Malignancy Treatment and Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical studies of treatment strategies for acute and chronic leukemias, myelodysplastic syndromes, myeloproliferative neoplasms, and multiple myeloma, including novel agents, combination regimens, and survival outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Novel agents and combination regimens for leukemias, myelodysplastic syndromes, myeloproliferative neoplasms, and multiple myeloma.

subtopics.label: Genitourinary Cancer Therapy and Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on bladder, renal cell, and prostate cancers including targeted therapies, immunotherapy combinations, biomarker-driven treatment selection, and outcomes analyses.
subtopics.short_description: Targeted therapies, immunotherapy combinations, and biomarker-driven treatment selection for bladder, renal cell, and prostate cancers.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Molecular Biology and Genomics
subtopics.description: Research on molecular subtypes, genomic alterations, tumor heterogeneity, and signaling pathways in prostate cancer, including studies of neuroendocrine differentiation, metabolomics, and clonal evolution.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular subtypes, genomic alterations, neuroendocrine differentiation, and clonal evolution in prostate cancer.

subtopics.label: Gastroesophageal and Colorectal Cancer Therapy
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and translational studies of systemic therapies for gastric, gastroesophageal junction, and colorectal cancers, including targeted agents, immunotherapy combinations, and biomarker analyses such as CLDN18.2 and HER2.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical trials and translational studies of targeted agents and immunotherapy for gastric, GEJ, and colorectal cancers.

subtopics.label: Brain Tumors and Glioma Biology
subtopics.description: Research on glioblastoma, lower-grade gliomas, and pediatric brain tumors covering molecular classification, tumor microenvironment, therapeutic vulnerabilities, and treatment strategies including IDH inhibition and immunotherapy.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular classification, tumor microenvironment, and therapeutic vulnerabilities in glioblastoma, lower-grade gliomas, and pediatric brain tumors.

subtopics.label: Melanoma Biology and Immunotherapy
subtopics.description: Studies on melanoma molecular biology, immune responses, and clinical outcomes with checkpoint inhibitors and targeted therapies, including biomarker analyses, tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte characterization, and long-term survival data.
subtopics.short_description: Melanoma molecular biology, checkpoint inhibitor outcomes, tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte characterization, and long-term survival analyses.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Computational Pathology in Cancer
subtopics.description: Development and application of machine learning, deep learning, and AI-based tools for cancer diagnosis, classification, prognosis prediction, and treatment response assessment using histopathological images, omics data, and clinical records.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning and deep learning tools for cancer diagnosis, prognosis prediction, and treatment response assessment from histopathology and omics data.

subtopics.label: Cancer Imaging: MRI, PET, and Quantitative Methods
subtopics.description: Development and evaluation of advanced imaging techniques including MRI-based tumor characterization, PET tracers, quantitative ultrasound, and multiparametric imaging for cancer diagnosis, treatment response monitoring, and theranostics.
subtopics.display_name: Cancer Imaging: MRI, PET & Quantitative Methods
subtopics.short_description: Advanced MRI, PET tracers, and multiparametric imaging for cancer diagnosis, treatment response monitoring, and theranostics.

subtopics.label: Cancer-Associated Thrombosis, Stroke, and Cardiovascular Complications
subtopics.description: Research on thromboembolic and cardiovascular complications in cancer patients, including ischemic stroke mechanisms, arterial thromboembolism risk, cardiac tumors, cardiotoxicity, and anticoagulation strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Thromboembolic events, ischemic stroke, cardiotoxicity, and anticoagulation strategies in cancer patients.

subtopics.label: Small Molecule Drug Discovery and Target Identification in Cancer
subtopics.description: High-throughput screening, virtual screening, and medicinal chemistry efforts to identify and optimize small molecule inhibitors targeting cancer-relevant proteins including immune checkpoints, kinases, and protein-protein interactions.
subtopics.display_name: Small Molecule Drug Discovery & Target Identification
subtopics.short_description: High-throughput screening and medicinal chemistry to identify inhibitors targeting cancer-relevant kinases, checkpoints, and protein interactions.

subtopics.label: Clonal Hematopoiesis, Genomic Evolution, and Cancer Risk
subtopics.description: Studies on clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential, somatic mosaicism, chromosomal alterations, and their associations with cancer risk, progression, and outcomes across hematologic and solid malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Somatic mosaicism, chromosomal alterations, and clonal hematopoiesis associations with cancer risk and progression.

subtopics.label: Tumor Biology: Microenvironment Crosstalk, Immune Evasion, and Progression Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Mechanistic studies of cancer progression involving tumor-stroma interactions, immune evasion strategies, metabolic reprogramming in the tumor microenvironment, and non-cell-autonomous mechanisms driving metastasis and therapy resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanistic studies of tumor-stroma interactions, immune evasion, and metabolic reprogramming driving metastasis and therapy resistance.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Molecular Subtypes and Targeted Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on molecular characterization, targeted therapy, and treatment outcomes in breast cancer subtypes including triple-negative, HER2-positive, and hormone receptor-positive disease, encompassing CDK4/6 inhibitors, antibody-drug conjugates, and resistance mechanisms.
subtopics.display_name: Breast Cancer Molecular Subtypes & Targeted Therapy
subtopics.short_description: Molecular characterization and targeted treatment of triple-negative, HER2-positive, and hormone receptor-positive breast cancer subtypes.

subtopics.label: Clinical Ethics Frameworks and Bioethical Theory
subtopics.description: Research examining foundational bioethical theories, ethical frameworks for clinical practice, the history of bioethics, and philosophical approaches to medical decision-making including paternalism, patient autonomy, disability rights, and justice in healthcare.
subtopics.short_description: Foundational bioethical theories and philosophical frameworks guiding clinical decision-making, patient autonomy, and justice in healthcare.

subtopics.label: Clinician Burnout, Moral Distress, and Wellbeing
subtopics.description: Studies investigating physician and healthcare worker burnout, moral distress, compassion fatigue, and psychological wellbeing, including predictors, measurement tools, and interventions to support clinician resilience and professional fulfillment.
subtopics.short_description: Predictors, measurement, and interventions addressing physician burnout, moral distress, and psychological wellbeing in healthcare workers.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Ethics and Healthcare Worker Experience
subtopics.description: Research on ethical challenges, resource allocation dilemmas, healthcare worker mental health impacts, and institutional responses during the COVID-19 pandemic, including ethics consultation services, crisis standards of care, and clinician psychological support programs.
subtopics.short_description: Ethical challenges, resource allocation, and clinician mental health impacts during the COVID-19 pandemic and crisis standards of care.

subtopics.label: End-of-Life Decision-Making and Advance Care Planning
subtopics.description: Research on ethical and clinical dimensions of end-of-life care including DNR orders, surrogate decision-making, advance care planning, goals of care conversations, and the ethics of withholding or withdrawing life-sustaining treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Ethical and clinical dimensions of DNR orders, surrogate decision-making, and goals-of-care conversations in serious illness.

subtopics.label: Neuroethics, Disorders of Consciousness, and Brain Injury
subtopics.description: Ethical, legal, and clinical research concerning patients with disorders of consciousness, severe brain injury, and neuromodulation interventions including deep brain stimulation, focusing on consent, disability rights, identity, and research ethics.
subtopics.short_description: Ethical, legal, and clinical issues in severe brain injury, disorders of consciousness, and neuromodulation interventions.

subtopics.label: AI Ethics, Bias, and Accountability in Healthcare
subtopics.description: Research examining ethical dimensions of artificial intelligence in medicine including algorithmic bias and fairness in diagnostic tools, liability for AI errors, patient and clinician perspectives on AI, and governance frameworks for responsible AI deployment in clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Fairness, bias, liability, and governance frameworks for responsible AI deployment in clinical settings.

subtopics.label: Reproductive Ethics and Autonomy
subtopics.description: Studies addressing ethical issues in reproductive medicine including abortion, contraceptive autonomy, prenatal substance use policies, embryo editing, pregnancy in special populations, and reproductive counseling, with attention to justice and patient rights.
subtopics.short_description: Ethical issues in reproductive medicine including abortion, contraceptive autonomy, embryo editing, and reproductive justice.

subtopics.label: Clinical Communication, Shared Decision-Making, and Patient Trust
subtopics.description: Research on clinician-patient communication practices, shared decision-making processes, prognostic disclosure, patient trust, and interventions to improve communication quality in serious illness, cancer, and other clinical contexts.
subtopics.short_description: Clinician-patient communication, prognostic disclosure, and interventions to improve shared decision-making in serious illness.

subtopics.label: Medical Education, Professional Identity, and Narrative Medicine
subtopics.description: Research on medical education innovations including narrative medicine, storytelling, arts-based approaches, grading reform, simulation, and professional identity formation, as well as the role of humanities in cultivating empathy and resilience among trainees and clinicians.
subtopics.short_description: Narrative medicine, arts-based learning, and humanities approaches to empathy, resilience, and professional identity formation.

subtopics.label: Gender, Diversity, and Equity in the Medical Workforce
subtopics.description: Studies examining gender disparities, sexual harassment, LGBTQ inclusion, racial bias, and structural inequities in medical training and practice, including their effects on career development, workplace culture, and professional wellbeing.
subtopics.short_description: Gender disparities, racial bias, LGBTQ inclusion, and structural inequities in medical training and professional culture.

subtopics.label: Research Ethics, Informed Consent, and Conflicts of Interest
subtopics.description: Research addressing ethical standards in clinical and translational research including informed consent processes, disclosure of conflicts of interest, research integrity, biobanking ethics, and ethical challenges in clinical trials.
subtopics.short_description: Ethical standards in clinical research including consent processes, conflicts of interest, research integrity, and biobanking ethics.

subtopics.label: Stigma, Substance Use Disorders, and Healthcare Access
subtopics.description: Studies examining stigma toward substance use disorders among clinicians and the public, its effects on treatment access and policy support, and structural interventions to reduce stigma in healthcare settings.
subtopics.short_description: Clinician and public stigma toward substance use disorders and its effects on treatment access, policy support, and care quality.

subtopics.label: Elder Mistreatment, Abuse, and Ethical Care of Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on identification, evaluation, and ethical dimensions of elder mistreatment and abuse in hospital and community settings, including interdisciplinary response teams, survivor perspectives, and the role of dehumanization and ageism.
subtopics.short_description: Identification, evaluation, and ethical dimensions of elder abuse in hospital and community settings, including ageism and dehumanization.

subtopics.label: Palliative Care Ethics, Spirituality, and Psychosocial Support
subtopics.description: Research on ethical and psychosocial dimensions of palliative and hospice care including spiritual care, mental health integration, cultural and religious influences on end-of-life preferences, and support for patients, families, and clinicians in serious illness settings.
subtopics.short_description: Spiritual care, mental health integration, and cultural influences on end-of-life preferences in palliative and hospice settings.

subtopics.label: Disability Rights, Crisis Standards of Care, and Resource Allocation
subtopics.description: Research examining disability justice frameworks applied to crisis standards of care, ventilator and resource allocation during public health emergencies, and the rights of vulnerable populations including those with intellectual disabilities and severe neurological conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Disability justice frameworks applied to crisis standards of care and resource allocation during public health emergencies.

subtopics.label: AI and Machine Learning Applications in Clinical Practice
subtopics.description: Research on the development, evaluation, and interpretability of AI/ML tools—including large language models, imaging algorithms, and predictive models—applied to clinical diagnosis, documentation, and patient management.
subtopics.display_name: AI & Machine Learning in Clinical Practice
subtopics.short_description: Development, evaluation, and interpretability of AI tools including large language models and predictive algorithms in clinical care.

subtopics.label: Family Caregiver Roles, Needs, and Support in Healthcare
subtopics.description: Studies examining the experiences, burdens, and support needs of family caregivers, including their involvement in primary care, dementia care, and the relationship between caregiver preparedness and patient outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Experiences, burdens, and support needs of family caregivers in dementia, primary care, and serious illness settings.

subtopics.label: Physician Workload, Time Use, and Practice Management
subtopics.description: Research examining how physicians allocate their work time, manage clinical workloads, and navigate practice environments, including the effects of duty hour restrictions and team-based care models on physician performance and burnout.
subtopics.short_description: How physicians allocate work time, manage clinical loads, and navigate duty-hour restrictions and team-based care models.

subtopics.label: Patient Perspectives, Preferences, and Experiences with Treatment Decisions
subtopics.description: Qualitative and survey-based studies capturing patients' lived experiences, treatment preferences, and decision-making processes across conditions including cancer, neurological disorders, and chronic disease.
subtopics.short_description: Patients' lived experiences, treatment preferences, and decision-making across cancer, neurological, and chronic disease contexts.

subtopics.label: Health Equity, Language Access, and Disparities in Care
subtopics.description: Research addressing disparities in healthcare access and quality related to immigrant status, language proficiency, race/ethnicity, and geography, including interpreter use and equity frameworks in clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Disparities in healthcare access and quality related to race, language, immigration status, and geography.

subtopics.label: Religion, Culture, and Clinical Ethics
subtopics.description: Exploration of how religious traditions and cultural frameworks—including Orthodox Judaism, Islam, and other theocentric worldviews—shape medical ethics, clinical decision-making, and patient care.
subtopics.short_description: How religious traditions and cultural frameworks shape medical ethics, clinical decision-making, and patient care.

subtopics.label: Asylum Seekers, Immigration, and Forensic Medical Evaluation
subtopics.description: Studies on the medical and psychological evaluation of asylum seekers, including forensic documentation of trauma, the psychological impact of displacement and FGM/C, and student-run asylum clinic models.
subtopics.short_description: Medical and psychological evaluation of asylum seekers, forensic trauma documentation, and student-run asylum clinic models.

subtopics.label: Cognitive Bias and Group Dynamics in Clinical Decision-Making
subtopics.description: Research examining how cognitive biases—including confirmation bias, groupthink, and diagnostic anchoring—affect clinical judgment and decision-making quality among healthcare providers.
subtopics.short_description: How confirmation bias, groupthink, and diagnostic anchoring affect clinical judgment and decision quality among providers.

subtopics.label: Nursing Leadership, Resilience, and Workforce Wellbeing
subtopics.description: Studies on transformational leadership, resilience, and job satisfaction among nurses and allied health workers, including home health aides and frontline staff in underserved or high-stress settings.
subtopics.short_description: Transformational leadership, resilience, and job satisfaction among nurses and allied health workers in high-stress settings.

subtopics.label: Medical Aid in Dying: Physician Practice and Policy
subtopics.description: Research on physician participation in medical aid-in-dying (MAID), including methodologies for identifying participating physicians, practice patterns, and policy implications.
subtopics.display_name: Medical Aid in Dying: Practice & Policy
subtopics.short_description: Physician participation patterns, practice methodologies, and policy implications of medical aid-in-dying programs.

subtopics.label: Cancer Survivorship, Diagnosis Communication, and Patient Education
subtopics.description: Studies on how cancer diagnoses are communicated to patients and survivors, including uncertainty around diagnoses like DCIS, survivorship myths, and the role of multidisciplinary programs in patient education.
subtopics.short_description: How cancer diagnoses are communicated to patients and survivors, including uncertainty around diagnoses and survivorship education.

subtopics.label: Geriatric Care, Aging, and Specialized Clinical Needs
subtopics.description: Research addressing the unique clinical and ethical challenges of caring for older adults, including geriatric cardiology, geriatrics fellowship training, and the intersection of aging with chronic disease management.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and ethical challenges of caring for older adults, including geriatric cardiology, fellowship training, and chronic disease.

subtopics.label: Emergency and Hospital Care Protocols, Refusal, and Discharge Practices
subtopics.description: Studies examining variability and ethical dimensions in emergency medical services protocols, against-medical-advice discharges, and hospital-based care models including psychiatric consultation.
subtopics.short_description: Ethical dimensions of EMS protocols, against-medical-advice discharges, and hospital-based care models including psychiatric consultation.

subtopics.label: Heat-Related Illness and Climate Health Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on the health impacts of extreme heat events, including heat stroke, heat exhaustion, cardiovascular and sleep effects, and community-based or educational interventions to prevent and manage heat-related illness.
subtopics.short_description: Health impacts of extreme heat events and community-based strategies to prevent heat stroke, exhaustion, and cardiovascular effects.

subtopics.label: Hurricane and Natural Disaster Impacts on Health
subtopics.description: Studies examining the short- and long-term health consequences of hurricanes and extreme weather events, including cardiovascular disease, mortality, and health outcomes in vulnerable populations such as nursing home residents and Medicare beneficiaries.
subtopics.short_description: Short- and long-term health consequences of hurricanes and extreme weather events in vulnerable populations.

subtopics.label: Air Pollution and Respiratory Health
subtopics.description: Research on the effects of ambient and indoor air pollutants—including NO2, PM2.5, soybean dust, mold, and cooking fuels—on respiratory outcomes such as asthma, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, and lung function.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of ambient and indoor air pollutants on asthma, lung function, and other respiratory outcomes.

subtopics.label: Chemical and Toxic Substance Exposures
subtopics.description: Studies investigating health effects of exposure to toxic chemical elements, flame retardants, radon, fine particulate matter, and other environmental chemicals, including DNA damage, gene expression changes, and systemic toxicity.
subtopics.short_description: Systemic health effects of environmental chemicals, flame retardants, radon, and fine particulate matter, including DNA damage.

subtopics.label: Urban Microbiomes and Antimicrobial Resistance
subtopics.description: Research characterizing microbial communities and antimicrobial resistance genes in urban environments, including indoor dust, wastewater, and global metagenomic surveys of city microbiomes.
subtopics.short_description: Microbial communities and antimicrobial resistance genes in urban environments, from indoor dust to global city metagenomics.

subtopics.label: Built Environment and Urban Health Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies linking features of the urban built environment—including neighborhood design, food access, noise, and green space—to health outcomes such as cardiovascular disease, maternal mental health, and diet quality.
subtopics.short_description: Neighborhood design, food access, green space, and noise as determinants of cardiovascular and maternal health outcomes.

subtopics.label: Spaceflight Environmental Health and Physiology
subtopics.description: Research on the physiological and molecular health effects of spaceflight on astronauts, including cardiovascular changes, clonal hematopoiesis, genomic stability, telomere dynamics, and nutritional challenges in the space environment.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular, genomic, and nutritional health effects of spaceflight on astronauts, including telomere and hematopoietic changes.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic Aging and Early-Life Environmental Exposures
subtopics.description: Research using epigenetic clocks and molecular biomarkers to characterize how childhood and gestational environmental exposures accelerate or alter biological aging trajectories.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic clock-based assessment of how childhood and gestational environmental exposures alter biological aging trajectories.

subtopics.label: Tobacco and E-Cigarette Exposure and Lung Pathology
subtopics.description: Studies examining the biological and clinical effects of cigarette smoke and electronic cigarette use on lung tissue, including lymphatic dysfunction, emphysema, oral epithelium changes, and smoking cessation behavior.
subtopics.short_description: Biological and clinical effects of cigarette smoke and e-cigarette use on lung tissue, including emphysema and lymphatic dysfunction.

subtopics.label: Ambient Temperature and Cardiovascular Health
subtopics.description: Research on how ambient temperature extremes and climate-related exposures affect cardiovascular outcomes, including myocardial infarction severity, left ventricular function, and COVID-19 transmission dynamics.
subtopics.short_description: Climate-related temperature extremes and their effects on myocardial infarction severity, cardiac function, and disease transmission.

subtopics.label: Occupational Exposures and Worker Health
subtopics.description: Studies on health risks and outcomes among workers in occupationally hazardous settings, including home health aides, healthcare workers, and surgical professionals, with attention to physical, mental, and ergonomic health impacts.
subtopics.short_description: Physical, mental, and ergonomic health risks among workers in hazardous occupational settings, including healthcare and home care.

subtopics.label: Lead and Heavy Metal Exposure in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research on environmental heavy metal exposures—particularly lead—in low- and middle-income country settings and their associations with cardiovascular and systemic health outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: Lead & Heavy Metal Exposure in LMICs
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular and systemic health consequences of environmental lead and heavy metal exposures in low- and middle-income countries.

subtopics.label: Vector Control, Water, and Sanitation-Related Health
subtopics.description: Studies on environmental determinants of infectious disease burden including mosquito vector resistance, waterborne diarrheal disease in children, and solar lighting interventions affecting health in low-resource settings.
subtopics.short_description: Environmental determinants of infectious disease burden, including mosquito resistance, waterborne diarrheal illness, and low-resource interventions.

subtopics.label: Disaster Exposure, PASC, and Environmental Risk Factors for Respiratory and Post-Acute Disease
subtopics.description: Research on long-term respiratory and post-acute health sequelae following major environmental disaster exposures, including 9/11 World Trade Center dust exposure and environmental risk factors for post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2.
subtopics.short_description: Long-term respiratory and post-acute sequelae following 9/11 dust exposure and environmental risk factors for post-COVID conditions.
